Desc.SourceString: 这里是接待大厅，通常受理已有预约的低级异象事件。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is the reception hall. It usually handles scheduled low threat anomaly cases.

Desc.SourceString: 比格赫罗斯岛的大厅热闹很多。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's much busier than the hall on Ghroth Island.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，毕竟城市中相关的事件每天都在发生。
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, after all, those incidents happen in the city every day.

Desc.SourceString: 未来大家还会经常联络。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sure we'll keep in touch.

Desc.SourceString: 唔，空间又发生改变了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh, the space is changing again…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，我会注意周围。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah, I'll keep an eye out.

Desc.SourceString: 这里也没有感应到奇点的存在么？
Desc.LocalizedString: No signs of the nexus here either?

Desc.SourceString: 没有，继续调查吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: No, let's keep searching.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm…

Desc.SourceString: 进展如何？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's your status?

Desc.SourceString: 歧骸变得厉害起来了，不过完全不是我们的对手！
Desc.LocalizedString: The oddities are getting tougher, but still no match for us!

Desc.SourceString: 这样看，我们应该离奇点很近了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like we're getting closer to the nexus.

Desc.SourceString: 锁定奇点后，如果依旧无法泯除异象，就设法收容，不要浪费时间。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you still can't nullify the anomaly after locking onto the nexus, try to contain it. Don't waste a second.

Desc.SourceString: 明白！
Desc.LocalizedString: Roger!

Desc.SourceString: 不安定的感觉在这周围更强烈了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It feels unstable here.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯！我也闻到了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah! I can smell it too!

Desc.SourceString: （这里是……另一个虚构空间？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Is this… another dimension?)

Desc.SourceString:
「海特洛快讯
今日头条
【独家】新西里安重建计划揭秘：全面启动，重建家园！
Desc.LocalizedString:
Hethereau Daily
Headlines Today
[Exclusive] New Helios Rebuilding Plan Revealed: Reconstruction In Full Swing!

Desc.SourceString:
【揭秘】异象管理局掩盖新西里安事件真相，引发民众质疑与不安！
【劲爆】德沃夏克家族长子四婚在即流言疯传，引社交圈热议
，投资者信心动摇？！」
Desc.LocalizedString:
[Revealed] The Bureau of Anomaly Control covered up the truth about the New Helios Incident, sparking doubts and anxiety among citizens!
[Hot] Rumors go viral that the Dvořák eldest son's fourth marriage is imminent.
Investor confidence shattered?!

Desc.SourceString:
「伊波恩古董店宣传单 
近日全场优惠！价格直逼底线，只为让您轻松拥有稀世珍藏！机不可失！
Desc.LocalizedString:
A flier from Eibon
Enjoy massive discounts with unblievable prices! Own your dream antique today!

Desc.SourceString:
购买指定古董还将享受特~别~福~利~ 
详情请前往店铺咨询：………」
Desc.LocalizedString:
Certain antiques offer special gifts.
Head to the shop for details: …

Desc.SourceString:
本期速览：红榜第一名——金边管家
向风度翩翩的恰帕先生/女士致敬！
家政界不可多得的全能助手，异象社会化能力评测中的高分精英！
Desc.LocalizedString:
This Week's Spotlight: The uncontested winner — The Gilded Butler
A round of applause for the ever-graceful Mr./Ms. Chappa!
Behold! A gem not just good at housekeeping, but also a top-scorer in the Anomaly Socialization Aptitude Test!

Desc.SourceString: 局长，客人到了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Director, the guest has arrived.

Desc.SourceString: <TypingTitle titlename="监狱" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">「格赫罗斯岛」</>的<blue>「押解者」</>，终于学会了守时。
Desc.LocalizedString: The <blue>Escorter</> from <TypingTitle titlename="Prison" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Ghroth Island</> has finally learned to be punctual.

Desc.SourceString: 这应该是我们第一次正式见面，省略掉一些无聊的寒暄，直入正题吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: This should be our first official meeting. Let's skip the boring pleasantries and get straight to the point.

Desc.SourceString: 可可……这些黑影好像一直嘟囔着重复的话，怪瘆人的……
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco… Those shadows keep mumbling the same things. They give me the chills…

Desc.SourceString: 不断循环的片段……这样看，这个异象应该跟影像有关。
Desc.LocalizedString: The same scenes playing over and over… This anomaly must be related to images somehow.

Desc.SourceString: 这附近街区好吃的都特别多。
Desc.LocalizedString: There are lots of great places to eat in this area.

Desc.SourceString: 半角广场的噗卡糖果店，百汇巷的猫丸拉面……
Desc.LocalizedString: Puka Candy at Hankaku Square, Nekomaru Ramen in Baihui Alley…

Desc.SourceString: 噢对！还有卜多力小屋——他们家的热舞章鱼烧最好吃啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh yeah! Don't forget the Budoriya—their Dancing Takoyaki are the best!

Desc.SourceString: 说好请你吃大餐，等这个月工资发了，你随便挑！
Desc.LocalizedString: I promised you a feast, so after I get my paycheck this month, you can choose any place you like!

Desc.SourceString: 那我就先道谢了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thanks in advance.

Desc.SourceString: 半角街是桥间地人气很高的商店街。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hankaku Street is a very popular shopping street in Bridge Crossings.

Desc.SourceString: 靠近海边，又有很多好玩的店铺，很多游客都会特地来这边呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's close to the sea, and there are lots of fun shops, attracting many tourists!

Desc.SourceString: 看着是挺热闹的，伊波恩店里应该也很忙吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: It does look lively. Is Eibon busy as well?

Desc.SourceString: ……呃……这个……咳，一会到了你就知道啦……
Desc.LocalizedString: Uh… well… cough, you'll see when we get there…

Desc.SourceString: 啧，这个鬼天气……还是一如既往闷热得没什么创意。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh, this weather… still as muggy as ever, no creativity.

Desc.SourceString: 一点小事，浔本来就不必出来的……
Desc.LocalizedString: This minor issue really doesn't need you to come personally…

Desc.SourceString: 啊呀，都说了，钱要花在刀刃上嘛～
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, come on, money should be spent wisely.

Desc.SourceString: 刚交完下一年的房租，我这口袋里都摸不出两个多余的钢镚。
Desc.LocalizedString: I just paid next year's rent, and my pockets are empty.

Desc.SourceString: 兰德里柯鱼子面霜和红宝瓶精华啊——都再见了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Farewell, Landric's Cavi Cream and Red Bottle Essence!

Desc.SourceString: 是护肤品么？以浔的异能，似乎用不上这些……
Desc.LocalizedString: Skincare products? With your Esper abilities, you don't need those…

Desc.SourceString: 要的就是仪式感啊仪式感！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's all about treating yourself!

Desc.SourceString: （阿德勒先生，一会儿塔吉多想要和鉴定师站在一起！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Mr. Adler, Taygedo wants to stand next to the appraiser for the photo!)

Desc.SourceString: 看来塔吉多和鉴定师特别投缘呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like Taygedo and the Appraiser are quite the pair.

Desc.SourceString: （还有塔吉多想要站得靠左边一些，塔吉多左脸比较好看！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (And Taygedo wants to stand a little to the left, Taygedo's left side looks better!)

Desc.SourceString: 噢？原来塔吉多也有自己的黄金角度么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh? Taygedo has a golden angle too?

Desc.SourceString: 咳咳……比伊波恩杂物间还大的灰尘……
Desc.LocalizedString: Cough, cough… more dust than Eibon's storage room…

Desc.SourceString: 看来许久没有被使用过了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like it hasn't been used in a long time.

Desc.SourceString: 胶片不被需要之后，这里也逐渐在被遗忘。
Desc.LocalizedString: After film became obsolete, this place started to be forgotten.

Desc.SourceString: 实在的老板，就这么被浔忽悠了进去！
Desc.LocalizedString: What an honest guy, fooled by Hotori just like that!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么能叫忽悠呢？该省省该花花懂不懂？
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not fooling! Spend wisely, save wisely, got it?

Desc.SourceString: 我这是在给阿德勒减负，赔钱惹麻烦的小鬼当然不会在意店里的收支状况咯～
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm helping Adler out. Mischief-makers don't care about the shop's finances—

Desc.SourceString: 上次委托人家里的鱼缸……上上次的路障……你倒是算算，最近几个月赔了多少进去！
Desc.LocalizedString: The fish tank from the last commission… the roadblock before that… count how much we've lost in recent months!

Desc.SourceString: 看看阿德勒愁得，最近又憔悴不少吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Look how worried Adler is, he's aged a lot recently!

Desc.SourceString: 咳……说起来，小姐为什么会突然想拍胶片？
Desc.LocalizedString: Cough… By the way, Lady, why did you suddenly want film photography?

Desc.SourceString: 偶尔走走怀旧路线也不错，何况谁让咱们开的是古董店呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: A little nostalgia isn't bad, plus, we run an antique shop.

Desc.SourceString: 咱们伊波恩啊——还是跟有故事的老物件更有缘呢～
Desc.LocalizedString: Eibon… just vibes with older things, y'know.

Desc.SourceString: 咱们需要尽快找到奇点，拖太久的话，空间可能会叠加。
Desc.LocalizedString: We need to find the nexus quickly. If we take too long, the space may enter superposition.

Desc.SourceString: 被捕捉到了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Uh oh, caught red-handed…

Desc.SourceString: 白光处连接了现实世界，咻啪，把情况告诉大家。
Desc.LocalizedString: The white light connects to the world out there. Chuppa, update everyone.

Desc.SourceString: 当当——轻松找到空间出口，有其他人还在里面吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ta-da—Found the exit! Is anyone else still inside?

Desc.SourceString: 还以为是什么了不起的能力，真是浪费表情。
Desc.LocalizedString: I thought it had some amazing ability, what a waste of expression.

Desc.SourceString: 哟，刚才屁股着地的是谁来着？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, who just landed on their butt?

Desc.SourceString: 吵死了！那是脚滑，脚滑！
Desc.LocalizedString: Shut up! That was a slip, a slip!

Desc.SourceString: 有伴生的歧骸。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oddities spotted.

Desc.SourceString: 对付这种杂鱼不要弄坏店里的东西！尤其是娜娜莉和早雾！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't damage the shop! Especially Nanally and Sakiri!

Desc.SourceString: OK！那我就稍微抑制一下我这无上的力量吧——
Desc.LocalizedString: OK! I'll restrain my immense power—

Desc.SourceString: 切，委托条款里有写不需要我们赔偿嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch, the contract says we don't have to pay for damages!

Desc.SourceString: 口碑啊口碑！
Desc.LocalizedString: Reputation, reputation!

Desc.SourceString: 知道啦知道啦……真是麻烦……
Desc.LocalizedString: Got it, got it… what a hassle…

Desc.SourceString: （小海胆乖乖，把壳打开~快点开开，塔吉多在等待~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Little sea urchin, open your shell. Hurry and open, Taygedo's waiting.)

Desc.SourceString: （来了！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Here we go!)

Desc.SourceString: 科学应对不能少，异象分级早知道~发现异象怎么办？以下几点要记牢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Stay sharp, stay smart—know anomaly grades from the start!

Desc.SourceString: 是薄荷的声音？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is that Mint's voice?

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多每天都听！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo listens every day!)

Desc.SourceString: Ⅰ到Ⅳ级异象波动时，不要急，不要慌，先保护好自己，及时向异象管理局或正规异象猎人组织寻求帮助。
Desc.LocalizedString: For Class I to IV anomalies, don't panic, don't fret, protect yourself first. Seek help from the Bureau of Anomaly Control or certified anomaly hunters.

Desc.SourceString: 特别提醒——千万不要因为贪便宜或偷懒等原因，轻信没有官方认证的异象猎人，避免造成更大损失！
Desc.LocalizedString: Daily reminder - "Think twice, don't pay the price. Unlicensed Anomaly Hunters can cost you more!"

Desc.SourceString: Ⅴ级及Ⅵ级异象出现的时候，请听从异象管理局调控，寻找最近的临时避难层，耐心等待官方救援。
Desc.LocalizedString: For Class V and VI anomalies, follow the Bureau's instructions, find the nearest temporary shelter and wait for rescue.

Desc.SourceString: Ⅶ级及以上异象，请仔细听从异象管理局安排指引，迅速有序地撤离当前地区，请相信，我们不会放弃任何一位市民！
Desc.LocalizedString: For Class VII and above anomalies, follow the Bureau's guidelines carefully, evacuate the area quickly and orderly. Trust that we won't abandon any citizen!

Desc.SourceString: 以上内容在《异象管理局安全手册（最新版）》中都有总结，市民朋友可以凭借自身终端前往异象管理局免费领取哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: All this information is summarized in the "BAC Manual (Latest Edition)." You can get a free copy from the Bureau with your terminal.

Desc.SourceString: （《异象管理局安全手册（最新版）》，免费领取！）
Desc.LocalizedString: ("BAC Manual (Latest Edition)," free copy!)

Desc.SourceString: ……接下来是一则快讯：兰德里柯品牌发言人称，旗下合作调香师冬司因身体不适被医生建议修养，
Desc.LocalizedString: …Next, a quick update: Landric spokesperson states their collaborating perfumer, Toshi, has been advised by doctors to rest due to health issues.

Desc.SourceString: 集团为当事人身体状况考量，预备取消原定于本月底在卡利斯展馆举办的香水新品发布会……
Desc.LocalizedString: The group is considering canceling the perfume launch event scheduled at the Calis Pavilion at the end of this month…

Desc.SourceString: 那就听那个委托人说的，先去失踪的家伙住的地方看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: We'll do as the client said and visit the place of the guy who went missing.

Desc.SourceString: 路上小心，一定注意安全。娜娜莉，照顾好大家。
Desc.LocalizedString: Take care and stay safe. Do take good care of them, Nanally.

Desc.SourceString: 放心放心~交给我柯林斯家族一代目吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Yup, you ain't got to worry when the Colucci family is in charge!

Desc.SourceString: 装神弄鬼的家伙！交易？我的愿望可不是那么便宜的东西！
Desc.LocalizedString: Creepy psychic fraud! A deal? My wish is worth a lot more than that!

Desc.SourceString: 像您这样不由分说上来就动手的客人，本店可是……会感到困扰的啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: People who punch instead of talk aren't really… welcomed here… Ah…

Desc.SourceString: 早雾！早雾打那里！
Desc.LocalizedString: Sakiri! Sakiri, over there!

Desc.SourceString: 给我闭嘴！
Desc.LocalizedString: Shut it!

Desc.SourceString: 早雾！那里！早雾！
Desc.LocalizedString: Sakiri! Over there! Sakiri!

Desc.SourceString: 吵死了！再吵我就把你扔进狗嘴里！
Desc.LocalizedString: Shut up! If you make another sound, I'll feed you to the dog!

Desc.SourceString: 鬼郎丸！回去你就自求多福吧！我们可被你害惨咯！
Desc.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru! You'll be on your own on your way back! You've caused us enough trouble!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯~不愧是我出外勤时最喜欢的味道~
Desc.LocalizedString: Mmm… This is my favorite scent when I'm out on duty.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm?

Desc.SourceString: 可可你也闻闻，木头、煦山樱和青苔，咸咸涩涩的石板路，暖融融的人群……
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, take a sniff too. The wood, the cherry blossoms, and moss, the salty and bitter stone road, the warm crowd…

Desc.SourceString: 当然，还有海风里热腾腾的食物香气！这就是桥间地的味道啦——
Desc.LocalizedString: And of course, the delicious smell of food in the sea breeze! This is the scent of Bridge Crossings—

Desc.SourceString: 这边这边，前面就是广场啦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Over here. That's the plaza.

Desc.SourceString: 在这边出外勤的时候，我最喜欢买一只碎雪的冰淇淋，啃着蛋卷来广场逛逛。
Desc.LocalizedString: I love to get a Blizzi ice cream and munch on egg rolls while I wander around in the plaza when I'm on patrol here.

Desc.SourceString: 当然！是午休时间！我才没有偷懒噢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course! We were on lunch break! Definitely not slacking off!

Desc.SourceString: 走吧，咱们继续去伊波恩~
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go, onwards to Eibon.

Desc.SourceString: 应该就是前面这栋了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Should be this building.

Desc.SourceString: 门似乎没有锁……
Desc.LocalizedString: The door looks unlocked…

Desc.SourceString: （在这边~在这边~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This way, this way!)

Desc.SourceString: 后院有两栋员工宿舍，店内的人都住在那边。
Desc.LocalizedString: The backyard has two staff dormitories where everyone from the shop lives.

Desc.SourceString: 知道有鉴定师要来，刚才塔吉多和我正收拾着房间和仓库。
Desc.LocalizedString: Knowing an appraiser was coming, Taygedo and I were just tidying up the rooms and storage.

Desc.SourceString: （鉴定师，待遇一流！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Top-notch treatment for the appraiser!)

Desc.SourceString: 就在这里，一层比较方便。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here we are, it's more convenient on the first floor.

Desc.SourceString: （先休息一会儿吧……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Let's take a break first…)

Desc.SourceString: （修整得差不多了，去前面跟大家打个招呼吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I'm almost done. Let's go and say hi to everyone.)

Desc.SourceString: 咳，那个——一会儿路过易聘屋，你们俩帮我挡着点。
Desc.LocalizedString: Cough, uh—when we pass by EZ-Hire, can you two hide me?

Desc.SourceString: 你又偷偷去找那家黑中介了？
Desc.LocalizedString: You went to that shady agency again?

Desc.SourceString: 才、才没有！
Desc.LocalizedString: I-I didn't!

Desc.SourceString: 阿德勒——
Desc.LocalizedString: Adler—

Desc.SourceString: 嘘——哎呀我说我说！我只是通过易聘屋去跟奥利哈刚那个号称「铁臂」的工头小小地切磋了一下！
Desc.LocalizedString: Shh—alright, alright! I just had a little spar with Orichalcos' so-called Iron Arm foreman!

Desc.SourceString: 我哪儿知道他们那儿的破铜烂铁都那么脆！以柯林斯家族的荣耀发誓，我真的就轻轻碰了一下——
Desc.LocalizedString: How was I supposed to know their scrap metal was so brittle! I swear on the honor of the Coluccis, I just lightly touched it—

Desc.SourceString: 日薪都给我扣完了，还欠着五千方斯！
Desc.LocalizedString: They deducted my wage, and I still owe 5,000 Fons!
Uh…

Desc.SourceString: 这阵子我得避避风头，可不能让这件事传进大叔和大姐头的耳朵里！
Desc.LocalizedString: I gotta lay low, can't let old man and Boss hear of this!

Desc.SourceString: ……呆子，走这边，把她挡住……
Desc.LocalizedString: Block for her, you dummy…
Okay.

Desc.SourceString: 我就知道你们不会——
Desc.LocalizedString: I knew you'd—

Desc.SourceString: 小声点吧你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Keep your voice down!

Desc.SourceString: 接待客人的地方……就从这里入手吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's start here, the reception.

Desc.SourceString: 真是精致的样片，从光影到人物神态的捕捉，都很用心呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Such exquisite samples, capturing light and expressions with great care.

Desc.SourceString: 3……9999方斯？！开照相馆就可以光明正大地抢钱吗！
Desc.LocalizedString: 3… 9,999 Fons?! Running a photo studio is daylight robbery!

Desc.SourceString: 哼……这些黑店……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmph… these rip-offs…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？……这边。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm?… Over here.

Desc.SourceString: 看样子这里是员工们的办公区域。
Desc.LocalizedString: This looks like the employees' workspace.

Desc.SourceString: 一群可怜虫。
Desc.LocalizedString: A bunch of poor souls.

Desc.SourceString: 这都什么乱七八糟的，看得我头晕！还好大姐头从不让我们写委托报告！
Desc.LocalizedString: What a mess, it's making me dizzy! Thank goodness Boss Lady never makes us write commission reports!

Desc.SourceString: 那是因为她自己懒得看吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: That's because she's too lazy to read them!

Desc.SourceString: （生日还会有蛋糕！塔吉多也喜欢蛋糕！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Birthday means cake! Taygedo loves cake!)

Desc.SourceString: 这般细致，看来菲林轨迹的火爆不无道理。
Desc.LocalizedString: Such attention to detail, no wonder Film Orbit is so popular.

Desc.SourceString: 联系刚才的备忘录，照相馆里丢东西持续有一阵了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Including info on the notes from earlier, things have been going missing from the Photo Studio for a while now…

Desc.SourceString: 东西变作照片，应该是积蓄到了爆发的时刻。
Desc.LocalizedString: Things turning into photos… It's probably just reaching the breaking point.

Desc.SourceString: 这边不像是有什么异常。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nothing unusual here.

Desc.SourceString: 那去二楼看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's check upstairs.

Desc.SourceString: 又有被窥视的感觉。
Desc.LocalizedString: That feeling of being watched again.

Desc.SourceString: 深夜响起的铃声，不见踪影的访客——
Desc.LocalizedString: The phone rings in the dead of night, but no visitor in sight—

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉！不许这个时候说！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally! Not now!

Desc.SourceString: 既然是相机一样的东西在捣鬼，那就分头检查下吧！我去这边！
Desc.LocalizedString: Since it's the camera causing trouble, let's split up and check! I'll go this way!

Desc.SourceString: 没有插内存卡，相片应该不是从这里拍出来的。
Desc.LocalizedString: No memory card, the photos weren't taken from here.

Desc.SourceString: 像是被重重摔在了地上……已经坏掉了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It looks like it was smashed to the ground… it's broken.

Desc.SourceString: 杂鱼通通闪开！
Desc.LocalizedString: Out of the way, chumps!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？消失了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hm? It's gone…

Desc.SourceString: 这台也坏掉了，奇点不在这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: This one is broken, too. The nexus isn't here.

Desc.SourceString: 坏掉的相机真是可惜了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a pity that the camera broke.

Desc.SourceString: 有一张没有过度曝光的照片，似乎有些年头了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here's a photo that's not overexposed, seems quite old.

Desc.SourceString: 「菲林轨迹正式开业」……是照相馆的老板。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Film Orbit Grand Opening"… it's the owner.

Desc.SourceString: 那时候看上去，还不是一张苦瓜脸嘛~
Desc.LocalizedString: Didn't look so fretful back then.

Desc.SourceString: 来了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Here it comes!

Desc.SourceString: 伤脑筋，都是坏掉的相机，看不出什么问题。
Desc.LocalizedString: Troublesome, all these broken cameras, can't tell what's wrong.

Desc.SourceString: 从之前的记录来看，店内的设备间可能有一批新购入的数码相机。
Desc.LocalizedString: According to records, there might be a batch of new digital cameras in the equipment room.

Desc.SourceString: 那边或许能有什么新线索。
Desc.LocalizedString: We might find more clues there.

Desc.SourceString: 欸，原来真的有人一直在看那些字啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, so someone does read those notes!

Desc.SourceString: 唔——打不开。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm—won't open.

Desc.SourceString: 今天鬼郎丸还没怎么放出来透气吧，不如我们直接——
Desc.LocalizedString: Haven't let Kiroumaru out for a walk today, should we just—

Desc.SourceString: 那个摄像框一样的东西一直跟着我们，可以将它引过来，利用它将门消去。
Desc.LocalizedString: That viewfinder-like thing has been following us. We can lure it over and use it to erase the door.

Desc.SourceString: ……塔吉多！害怕就给我去扯自己的尾巴！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo! If you're scared, pull your own tail!

Desc.SourceString: （切，娜娜莉小气鬼。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Tch, Nanally is a meanie.)

Desc.SourceString: （相机——塔吉多最先找到！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Camera—Taygedo found it first!)

Desc.SourceString: 看来那批新进购的数码相机，都在这里了，有什么异样么……
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like the new digital cameras are all here. Anything strange…?

Desc.SourceString: ——小心！
Desc.LocalizedString: —Watch out!

Desc.SourceString: （看样子又是异象制造的空间，得想办法出去。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Looks like another space created by an anomaly. I gotta find a way to get out.)

Desc.SourceString: 咻啪，告诉大家我没事。
Desc.LocalizedString: Chuppa, let everyone know I'm fine.

Desc.SourceString: （这里面的一切，跟真实的场景是相反的……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Everything in here is the opposite of what they are in the world out there…)

Desc.SourceString: （鉴定师！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Appraiser!)

Desc.SourceString: 没事吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you okay?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，里面没有什么危险的东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, there's nothing dangerous inside.

Desc.SourceString: 看来被摄像框捕捉到，就有进入到另一个空间的风险。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like being captured by the viewfinder risks entering another space.

Desc.SourceString: 刚才架子上那些相机，都不见了……
Desc.LocalizedString: The cameras on the shelf just now… they're gone…

Desc.SourceString: 奇怪……我们没有离开过这边。
Desc.LocalizedString: Strange… we haven't left this area.

Desc.SourceString: 可恶啊，线索又中断了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Well great! That's another trail that's gone cold!

Desc.SourceString: 去三楼再看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's check the third floor.

Desc.SourceString: 这个布景，很有品味很有品味~
Desc.LocalizedString: This setting is quite tasteful, quite tasteful!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯~看来我要列入家族入会仪式的考察备选！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… I should include this in the family initiation exam!

Desc.SourceString: 哇塞，这把剑，也很合我的心意！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow, this sword suits my taste!

Desc.SourceString: （有魔法的剑！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Magic sword!)

Desc.SourceString: 大姐头，或许，我们可以——
Desc.LocalizedString: Boss Lady, maybe we can—

Desc.SourceString: 不，你不可以。
Desc.LocalizedString: No, you can't.

Desc.SourceString: 诶——不要这么冷酷嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Eh—don't be so cold!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么又变暗了一些？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why is it getting darker?

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多，快换个亮点的频道照明！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo, switch to a brighter channel!

Desc.SourceString: （娜娜莉，坏心眼！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Nanally, you're mean!)

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多！再踩到我你就死定了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo! Step on me again, and you're dead!

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多才没有……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo did not…)

Desc.SourceString: 那里！那里像不像出口？
Desc.LocalizedString: There! Doesn't that look like an exit?

Desc.SourceString: 看来得想想该怎么上去。
Desc.LocalizedString: We need to figure out how to get up there.

Desc.SourceString: 这里面看起来，怎么这么奇怪？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why does it look so weird in here?

Desc.SourceString: 负片空间么……阿德勒的推测果然没错，我们要找的家伙，的确和胶片有关。
Desc.LocalizedString: A Negative Space… Adler was right. The anomaly we're looking for is definitely related to film.

Desc.SourceString: 我之前被捕捉到，也是进入了这样的空间。
Desc.LocalizedString: When I was captured, I also entered a space like this.
Hotori…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯~暗处有些家伙，可按捺不住了呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… Some things in the dark can't stay hidden any longer…

Desc.SourceString: 空间是混乱的，应该都是被摄像框捕捉到的画面。
Desc.LocalizedString: The space is chaotic. These must be images captured by the viewfinder.

Desc.SourceString: 好昏暗的房间。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a dark room.

Desc.SourceString: 跟我第一次进入比起来，异象的能力似乎有所增强。
Desc.LocalizedString: Compared to my first entry, the anomaly's power seems to have increased.

Desc.SourceString: 白光处或许就是出口。
Desc.LocalizedString: The white light may be the exit.

Desc.SourceString: （还是先和阿德勒先生打个招呼吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I should greet Adler first.)

Desc.SourceString: （还有东西没有拿。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I still haven't gotten everything.)

Desc.SourceString: 多加当心。
Desc.LocalizedString: Be extra careful.

Desc.SourceString: 还来？
Desc.LocalizedString: Again?

Desc.SourceString: 又增强了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's stronger now.

Desc.SourceString: 这种无聊的小把戏，差不多该看厌了……
Desc.LocalizedString: This is getting old…

Desc.SourceString: （OK，安全着陆！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (OK, safe landing!)

Desc.SourceString: 这个摄像框鬼鬼祟祟一直跟着，真是烦人！
Desc.LocalizedString: That sneaky viewfinder keeps following us, so annoying!

Desc.SourceString: 去地下室。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's head to the basement.

Desc.SourceString: 是局内禁制机动队四队的成员，其中两位，之前新西里安的行动中应该跟你打过照面。
Desc.LocalizedString: They're from ETD-4. You probably ran into two of them in the New Helios op.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，有过一些渊源。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, we've had some encounters.

Desc.SourceString: 禁制机动队主要执行高级别异象任务，海特洛市相关的案件偶有发生……
Desc.LocalizedString: The ETD handles high threat anomaly missions, sometimes in Hethereau…

Desc.SourceString: 未来你们或许会再有往来。
Desc.LocalizedString: You might work with them in the future.

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多，还记得我们看过的那本漫画么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo, remember that manga we read?

Desc.SourceString: 这下面，不会也有长出头和脚的——
Desc.LocalizedString: Underneath here, there might be heads and feet growing—

Desc.SourceString: （不、不要！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (No, no!)

Desc.SourceString: 委托人的住址就在这附近……
Desc.LocalizedString: It should be around here.

Desc.SourceString: 站在那边的那位，是委托人么？
Desc.LocalizedString: And that should be our client…

Desc.SourceString: 先从周边开始收集情报吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's start looking around here.

Desc.SourceString: 他昨天出校门时还一切如常，但却没有像往日一样去花店买花。
Desc.LocalizedString: He left school normally yesterday but didn't buy flowers like usual.

Desc.SourceString: 是在到达花店前就遭遇了什么事情，还是一开始就去了别的地方……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did something happen before he reached the shop, or did he go somewhere first…?

Desc.SourceString: 我打算去书店看一看。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm going to check the bookstore.

Desc.SourceString: 稍稍有些头疼啊，按照你的描述，这位少年不是那种有了什么想法就会讲给别人听的类型。
Desc.LocalizedString: A bit tricky. According to you, he's not the type to share his thoughts.

Desc.SourceString: 呃嗯……打听起来恐怕会有些艰难呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Asking around might be tough.

Desc.SourceString: 接下来是要去学校吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Going to the school?

Desc.SourceString: 最好要抓紧时间咯，再晚点就是放学的时间了吧？人就要走光了。
Desc.LocalizedString: We better hurry, school's gonna be off soon, right? We're gonna miss it!

Desc.SourceString: 在干什么？！你不是我们学校的学生吧！离学校围墙远点！
Desc.LocalizedString: What are you doing?! You're not a student here! Stay away from the school wall!

Desc.SourceString: 这是要……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this…?

Desc.SourceString: 一般应该会有那种……学生为逃课开辟的隐蔽路线吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: There should be some… hidden routes students use to skip classes, right?

Desc.SourceString: 我们不需要多费工夫，巧妙利用捷径就能节约下大把的时间了。
Desc.LocalizedString: We don't need to exert too much effort. Clever use of shortcuts can save us a lot of time.

Desc.SourceString: 这也算是前辈的心得。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is also a senior's wisdom.

Desc.SourceString: 似乎是不怎么正经的心得……
Desc.LocalizedString: That doesn't sound very proper…

Desc.SourceString: 这儿有进进出出的鞋印。看来是条常用的逃课路线？
Desc.LocalizedString: Look, footprints going in and out. Seems like a frequently used escape route?

Desc.SourceString: 就悄悄从这里翻进去吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's quietly climb in from here.

Desc.SourceString: 自然些，自然些，被门卫发现，就免不了被请去喝杯茶了~
Desc.LocalizedString: Just be natural. You don't want to be flagged and brought on a trip to the Security Office.

Desc.SourceString: 大概明白麦月同学为什么不太说话了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Guess I know why Maiyue never really spoke now.

Desc.SourceString: 长期不使用语言，人的发声能力就会减弱。
Desc.LocalizedString: He stopped talking for way too long, and his vocal capabilities suffered as a result.

Desc.SourceString: 初期只是因表达障碍不愿说话的人，时间久了发声能力也会跟着退化，如此恶性循环。
Desc.LocalizedString: He only seemed like he didn't want to talk at first because had a hard time expressing himself, but that took a toll on his vocal capabilities as it went on. It was a vicious cycle.

Desc.SourceString: 这孩子过得……只会越来越不容易……
Desc.LocalizedString: Well… life is gonna be hard for the kid…

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>美丽<TypingImg id="6"/>表达<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>Beautiful way of<TypingImg id="6"/>speaking<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 思绪<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>生芽
Desc.LocalizedString: Thoughts<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>grow

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>话语<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>绽放<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Words<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>bloom<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 好像能感受到有谁在说话……
Desc.LocalizedString: You hear that?

Desc.SourceString: 不对，是有谁说话的……气味？能感受到话语的气味……
Desc.LocalizedString: No, it's… the smell of someone talking, I can smell it…

Desc.SourceString: 「说话的气味」？还挺新奇的形容方式~
Desc.LocalizedString: The smell of someone talking? Well, that's unheard of.

Desc.SourceString: 从花香中能隐约感受到某种，零碎语言片段般的东西……虽然……很难拼凑出完整的语义。
Desc.LocalizedString: I can hear some broken phrases coming from the flowers… that… I can't quite string them into meaningful sentences.

Desc.SourceString: 该说是某种……絮絮叨叨的低喃？
Desc.LocalizedString: It sounds more like… someone mumbling to themselves.

Desc.SourceString: ……我只闻到了越来越浓郁的花香……
Desc.LocalizedString: The flowers sure are smelling stronger than before…

Desc.SourceString: 翳，作为你异能代价的这个兽化，难道就只是多了层看起来炫酷的皮套？嗅觉方面的强化……没有么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Skia, is the dope fursuit the only thing you got from your ability? I mean, did it sort of… you know, upgrade your nose?

Desc.SourceString: 好了好了，我这不是，担心气氛变紧张么……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, don't be so upset. I was just trying to lighten up the mood…

Desc.SourceString: 话说回来，我也暂时没感觉到有什么奇怪的声音。
Desc.LocalizedString: But, well, I'm not hearing anything weird either.

Desc.SourceString: 这就是你的那个「异象感知力」的体现吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Guess this is your Anomaly Perception at work?

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>不欢迎你们<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>You aren't welcome<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 动起来了？！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's moving?!

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>入侵者就回去吧<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Intruders… leave<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 我又听到、不，是又闻到了……？
Desc.LocalizedString: There, I just heard it again. I mean, I just smelled it again…

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>清扫庭园，<TypingImg id="6"/>扑灭害虫<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Prune the garden.<TypingImg id="6"/>Eradicate the pests.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 植物仿佛是遵从我所闻见的话语行动起来的……
Desc.LocalizedString: The plants seem to be moving according to what I smell…

Desc.SourceString: 嚯？真的吗？那要不你多注意注意下一句？
Desc.LocalizedString: Uhm, is that so? You probably want to weigh the next words you smell carefully, then.

Desc.SourceString: 细细品味一下你说的那个「话语的花香」，与植物活动之间的联系吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Take your time to appreciate the smell of whoever's talking and what the plants have to do with one another.

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>这里不需要粗俗和混乱<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>There's no place here… for vulgarity and disorder.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 还不能十分确定，不过……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not 100% sure yet, but…

Desc.SourceString: 更像是话语落地化形，构成了那株植物，因此它的花香中包含了那句话的信息？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's more like those words turn into plants when they land on the ground, so they smell like those words themselves.

Desc.SourceString: ……对闻不出「话香」的我和翳来说，有些难懂咯。
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, Skia and I can't "smell" those words, so what you're saying doesn't really make sense to us.

Desc.SourceString: 简单理解就是有人在这里讲了话，然后讲的话变成了现在袭击我们的这些东西……
Desc.LocalizedString: In short, someone is talking, and whatever comes out of their mouth becomes these things that are attacking us…

Desc.SourceString: 还挺有趣的，那我是不是也可以靠动动嘴皮子把它们骂走？
Desc.LocalizedString: That's interesting. Well, can I try to give them a piece of my mind and see if that's gonna scare them off?

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>闲言赘语也会成为庭园的养料<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Idle chatter… becomes nourishment for the garden.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀呀……
Desc.LocalizedString: Uh oh…

Desc.SourceString: 看起来太吵的话会造成反作用。
Desc.LocalizedString: They don't seem to like it when you're too noisy.

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>不用管我，<TypingImg id="6"/>明明这样子就好<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Don't mind me…<TypingImg id="6"/>this… is just fine.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 那边的玻璃房……
Desc.LocalizedString: That glass house over there…

Desc.SourceString: 咳咳……熏到快呛死人的味道，都是从这个方向飘来的吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Argh… Geez, this smell is killing me. It's all coming from this way, no?

Desc.SourceString: 这儿的花粉恐怕不宜吸入太多……
Desc.LocalizedString: You don't want to breathe in too much of these pollens…

Desc.SourceString: 从这里很难过去……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hard to get over there from here…

Desc.SourceString: 上方有好多藤蔓伸出来，是不是还有一个入口呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm seeing a lot of vines coming from up there. Is there another entrance?

Desc.SourceString: 「想要前进。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Go forward."

Desc.SourceString: 嘶，好痛。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hiss… That hurts.

Desc.SourceString: 喂喂，这「前进」是针对它们来说的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Guess the plants found their path to do harm.

Desc.SourceString: 「果熟蒂落。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "The time is ripe."

Desc.SourceString: 那上面……有什么闪闪发光的东西好像快要掉下来了？小心头顶哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Up there… there is this shiny thing that's about to fall. Watch out.

Desc.SourceString: 「根朽枝枯。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "The roots decay and the branches wither."

Desc.SourceString: 噫……什么东西烂掉了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Yikes… is that something rotten that I'm smelling?

Desc.SourceString: 弥漫起一股，会让意识钝化的味道……
Desc.LocalizedString: This smell is making me sleepy…

Desc.SourceString: 沉默。
Desc.LocalizedString: Silence

Desc.SourceString: 「这里很美丽。」
Desc.LocalizedString: It's beautiful here.

Desc.SourceString: 花是不是比刚才开得更多了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is it just me or are we seeing more flowers now?

Desc.SourceString: 「这里很压抑。」
Desc.LocalizedString: It's suffocating here.

Desc.SourceString: 噢？这前面被打开了啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Uhm? It's open up ahead.

Desc.SourceString: 但流进来的空气，不能说清新……
Desc.LocalizedString: But I wouldn't describe the air coming in as fresh…

Desc.SourceString: 刚刚的是……
Desc.LocalizedString: What was that just now…

Desc.SourceString: 这座庄园的密道设计也真是别出心裁。
Desc.LocalizedString: This secret tunnel sure is something.

Desc.SourceString: 这么多碰不得的高压线？要在这个「家」里生活，还真是不太容易。
Desc.LocalizedString: Stressful, isn't it? Must have been a struggle for the kid trying to live with a family like this.

Desc.SourceString: 连呼吸都得小心翼翼的压迫感……
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah, must have been suffocating…

Desc.SourceString: ……只要还在呼吸，想法也未必不会从气息中泄露出去。
Desc.LocalizedString: And as long as you're still alive, you never know which of your thoughts are picked up by people.

Desc.SourceString: 就像花香中蕴含信息一样……是吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Like all the subtle messages coming with the smell… right?

Desc.SourceString: 很多情感与想法啊，即使不说出口，也并非会不复存在，不这么觉得么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Just because these feelings and thoughts are never expressed doesn't mean they never exist, right?

Desc.SourceString: 作为抒发欲旺盛的生物，人只要活着，想「传达」的内容就一定会以某种形式流露、实现。
Desc.LocalizedString: The human animal seeks connection. As long as we're alive, our thoughts and feelings always find a way out of our minds into the external world.

Desc.SourceString: 「传达」的形式，从来都不一定会是语言。
Desc.LocalizedString: And language has never been the only way our thoughts and feelings show themselves.

Desc.SourceString: 通过这条植物搭出的路径，似乎可以上去……
Desc.LocalizedString: We just need to follow this path of plants to get up there.

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>我能够表达出来了<TypingImg id="6"/>所以能理解我的真实想法吧<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Now I can speak…<TypingImg id="6"/>so you must understand my true thoughts, right?<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 在这种地方打起来……呃……咳咳咳……都是灰……！
Desc.LocalizedString: Picking a fight here, huh… Argh… geez, the dust is killing me…!

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>真吵<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Noisy…<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 那孩子就是下落不明的……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is that the boy we're looking for…?

Desc.SourceString: 应该是他……
Desc.LocalizedString: Should be him…

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>不是那个<TypingImg id="6"/>已经成为了全新的我<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>No, not that…<TypingImg id="6"/>I've already become something new.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: 好像能听清他在念叨什么了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't you think you can hear what he's saying now?

Desc.SourceString: 根据先前的说法，麦月同学每周都会买一束新鲜的花带回家吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: The florist said Maiyue would bring a bunch of fresh flowers home every week, right?

Desc.SourceString: 昨天会过来这里的理由，会不会就是别出心裁地想找一种能更好寄托自己心意的花……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did he visit here yesterday to find a unique flower that… better expresses his sentiments?

Desc.SourceString: 如果拿出他本应带回家里送给父母的花，多少会有点反应吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Guess he just might show us some reaction if we show him the flowers he was going to bring home to his parents.

Desc.SourceString: 就算用牛头不对马嘴的方式去鼓励，也很难想象会有什么效果吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't think that's gonna work when it doesn't really address the issue?

Desc.SourceString: 你不会是打算按他说的，就这样安静离开吧？是不是有点太好说话了？
Desc.LocalizedString: You are not just going to leave like he told us to, right?

Desc.SourceString: 有些无聊的花语，就像园艺部同学们说的一样，更像是花店的营销手段啊~
Desc.LocalizedString: The floriography seems boring. The kids at the Garden Club said it, right? How it's something the flower shops try to boost their sales with.

Desc.SourceString: 我也不是没想过能不能靠骂的把他骂清醒点……不过真的可以这么做吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I was thinking about giving him a piece of my mind… but would that work?

Desc.SourceString: 送这个是想保佑父母发财？好像不是不行……但有哪里怪怪的吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Was he bringing his parents these flowers because he wanted them to get rich? I mean, not that he shouldn't… but it's just weird, no?

Desc.SourceString: 晚上的向日葵看起来少了生气呢，缺了点那种……能吸引人的魅力啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sunflowers at night seem to be missing something, don't you think? They seem… a little less attractive.

Desc.SourceString: 康乃馨就是他上周买的花吗？按照可能的意愿来说……
Desc.LocalizedString: Did he buy carnations last week? So I guess he was trying to say…

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>……！
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>…!

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀，搞错了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oops, got that wrong.

Desc.SourceString: 不是这个花语吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Not this one…?

Desc.SourceString: 没能好好参透他的真心啊，重新来一次试试？
Desc.LocalizedString: We didn't really figure out what he wanted. Should we give it another try?

Desc.SourceString: 不过是抱团的杂草，也会恼羞成怒么？呵。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ha. You're nothing more than a pathetic bunch of weed. Makes me want to laugh seeing you mad.

Desc.SourceString: ……结果还是没能拿出什么温和的解决方式。
Desc.LocalizedString: There goes trying to be gentle.

Desc.SourceString: 只靠委婉含蓄的好言软语没法说动人心的情况，可多得是啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sometimes, you just can't hope to get people to do what you want them to do being all nice and soft-spoken with them.

Desc.SourceString: 索性直截了当地，引导其全部释放出来……这么办对于我来说也会更方便。
Desc.LocalizedString: So I'm just going to be honest and rough to help him pour his feelings out… Guess that would make my life easier, too.

Desc.SourceString: 那么，帮我创造一个合适的时机，就拜托你们俩了！
Desc.LocalizedString: And I was hoping you guys could help by creating an opportunity!

Desc.SourceString: ……什么时机？
Desc.LocalizedString: An opportunity for what?

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/> 思绪为种，<TypingImg id="6"/> 落根生芽<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Thoughts take root…<TypingImg id="6"/>and grow.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/> 话语，<TypingImg id="6"/>自然如花朵般绽放<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>And words…<TypingImg id="6"/>bloom like flowers.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>入侵者，<TypingImg id="6"/>回去！<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Intruders…<TypingImg id="6"/>be gone!<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>清扫庭园，<TypingImg id="6"/>扑灭害虫<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Prune the garden.<TypingImg id="6"/>Eradicate the pests.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>不需要粗俗和混乱 <TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>There's no place here… for vulgarity and disorder.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>闲言赘语，<TypingImg id="6"/>腐化为庭园的养料<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Idle chatter…<TypingImg id="6"/>rots into the garden's soil.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>听不见<TypingImg id="6"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>I can't… hear you.<TypingImg id="6"/>

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>言语语语语……花粉雨……<TypingImg id="6"/>……
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Words… words… words… pollen rain…<TypingImg id="6"/>
…I wanted to…

Desc.SourceString: <TypingImg id="6"/>想、说出口……的……
Desc.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="6"/>Wanted to say it out loud

Desc.SourceString: 什么怪东西？抓住它！
Desc.LocalizedString: What was that?! Catch it!

Desc.SourceString: 别跑！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop!

Desc.SourceString: 别以为这是你的地盘，我们就逮不到你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Think you can escape? We'll catch you on your own turf!

Desc.SourceString: 哟呵，还搬救兵？
Desc.LocalizedString: Whoo, calling for backup?

Desc.SourceString: 打包一起揍趴下！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's pack them all up and knock them down!

Desc.SourceString: 绕来绕去头快给我绕晕了……
Desc.LocalizedString: This is making me dizzy…

Desc.SourceString: 在那边。
Desc.LocalizedString: Over there.

Desc.SourceString: 切，一直躲在后面算什么本事！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tsk, hiding isn't a real skill!

Desc.SourceString: 刚刚是在这边……
Desc.LocalizedString: It was just here…

Desc.SourceString: 突然静下来了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Suddenly it's all quiet…

Desc.SourceString: 藏到哪儿去了？……嚯，这里面——
Desc.LocalizedString: Where did it go?… Wow, this place—

Desc.SourceString: 怎么跟伊波恩储物间似的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Feels like the Eibon storage room.

Desc.SourceString: 快看看快看看，有没有什么好东西！
Desc.LocalizedString: Quick, look around! See if they've got any goodies!

Desc.SourceString: 这些东西……磨磨叽叽的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Those things are so… wishy-washy!

Desc.SourceString: 在这个房间内调查看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's take a look around this room.

Desc.SourceString: 代价后面标注的数字是……？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's the number written after the price…?

Desc.SourceString: 没听嘭嘭提，原来照顾宠物这么费劲啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Boomboom never mentioned how much work it is to take care of pets!

Desc.SourceString: 绑来的狗，还能有这个待遇？
Desc.LocalizedString: Who knew an abducted dog would get treated so well?

Desc.SourceString: 诶，快看迷你蒲公英！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow, look at the mini Dandelion!

Desc.SourceString: 看起来是有人用收集起来的狗毛做的……
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like someone made it with their dog hair collection…

Desc.SourceString: 怪不得叫「蒲公英」，这可真是狗毛纷飞啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: No wonder it's called Dandelion, it really is a flurry of dog hair!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……咱们见过蒲公英，它有这么大么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Well… We've seen Dandelion. Was it always that big?

Desc.SourceString: 呃……它……它可以有……
Desc.LocalizedString: Uh… It… it can be…

Desc.SourceString: 药膳食谱这就太夸张了吧！蒲公英看上去已经够肥了！
Desc.LocalizedString: A nutritional food menu? That seems excessive. Dandelion already looks plump enough!

Desc.SourceString: ……这个……应该是给人准备的……
Desc.LocalizedString: That is probably… for humans…

Desc.SourceString: 居然还有漫画……诶，这不是那个……谁谁谁的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: And a manga book, too… Whoo, isn't that… you know who?

Desc.SourceString: 怪不得带她逛了一圈！粉丝啊这是！
Desc.LocalizedString: Makes sense she got the grand tour—total fan moment!

Desc.SourceString: 呃……这地方的头头……怎么越看越不像坏蛋……
Desc.LocalizedString: Uh, the more I learn about the boss here, the less they strike me as the bad guy type…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，我也有这种感觉。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yep, I feel that way too.

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼哼～这回可考不倒我了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmph hmph hmph, I got it this time!

Desc.SourceString: 我知道我知道，往亮的地方走！
Desc.LocalizedString: I know, I know! Head for the light!

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀，肯定是往有灯的门走！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, gotta head to the door that's lit up!

Desc.SourceString: 这要是不对，我、我就倒立走回伊波恩！
Desc.LocalizedString: If this isn't right, I'll walk back to Eibon on my hands!

Desc.SourceString: 你这家伙！藏不住了吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: You there! Can't hide anymore, can you?

Desc.SourceString: (塔吉多的座位！好酷！)
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo's seat! So cool!)

Desc.SourceString: (出发！！！ 塔吉多喜欢在这吹风~)
Desc.LocalizedString: (Let's go! Taygedo, breezing!)

Desc.SourceString: (鉴定师！加速！！！)
Desc.LocalizedString: (Appraiser! Speed up!!!)

Desc.SourceString: (再快点！再快点！)
Desc.LocalizedString: (Faster! Even faster!)

Desc.SourceString: (鉴定师，塔吉多要抓不住了，啊~)
Desc.LocalizedString: (Appraiser, Taygedo! Falling off! Ahhh…)

Desc.SourceString: (呼~安全抵达！塔吉多才没有怕！)
Desc.LocalizedString: (Phew! We made it safely! Another day in the life of the brave Taygedo.)

Desc.SourceString: 谁啊？大清早吵死啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: What? So early in the morning?!

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀喂，这个太阳，早知道多涂些防晒。
Desc.LocalizedString: My gosh. The sun is burning. Should've used more sunscreen.

Desc.SourceString: 刚才为什么不坐车一起去呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why didn't we accept his ride?

Desc.SourceString: 他臭显摆，我才不坐，晒死也不坐。
Desc.LocalizedString: He's a showoff and I'd rather be dead than be seen sitting in his car.

Desc.SourceString: 啊啊啊啊啊，西汀！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahhhh, Settyn!

Desc.SourceString: 西汀！西汀！西汀！
Desc.LocalizedString: Settyn! Settyn! Settyn!

Desc.SourceString: 西汀！！你是最棒的！！
Desc.LocalizedString: Settyn!!! You're amazing!!!

Desc.SourceString: 天啊，好多人，不知道能不能排到我……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my, so many people! I wonder if I'll ever get to the front…

Desc.SourceString: 就算只能远远看到本尊，今天的应援也值了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Even just seeing him from all the way out here makes my day!

Desc.SourceString: 呜呜，等了好久，没拿到签名真的会很可惜哎。
Desc.LocalizedString: Waah, I waited all this time… It'll be such a bummer if I can't even get an autograph.

Desc.SourceString: 车不错，技术不太行啊看来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nice ride, but you could use some driving lessons!

Desc.SourceString: （呃……她生气了……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Uh oh… she's mad…)

Desc.SourceString: 喂，知道我谁吗？你们给本大爷发来的邀请函，现在说是假的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, do you know who I am? You sent me the invitation, and now you're saying it's fake?!

Desc.SourceString: 开什么玩笑！我什么身份，用得着拿假邀请函？
Desc.LocalizedString: What a joke! Do you know who I am?! Will I need a fake invitation?!

Desc.SourceString: 你们主管是谁？让他来见我！喂！
Desc.LocalizedString: Get your manager here, now! Oi!

Desc.SourceString: 惠比寿拍卖行一直是卡佩大酒店最大的幕后投资者，酒店为满足惠比寿的联络需求而建立。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ebisu Auction House is the Kapé most important secret investor. The hotel is built for Ebisu's networking needs.

Desc.SourceString: 现代艺术大师<blue>拉赫曼</>参与设计，商船从世界各地运输珍稀物料，不计资金和人力投入，让酒店得以在一年内完工。
Desc.LocalizedString: Designed with modern art master <blue>Rahman</>, the hotel was completed in just one year—no expense spared, with rare materials shipped in from across the world.

Desc.SourceString: 定期举办的沙龙、公开或邀请制拍卖会，都恰到好处地满足了「某些人」的期待。
Desc.LocalizedString: The salons and auctions here perfectly meet the expectations of certain people.

Desc.SourceString: 因此这里算得上是惠比寿人际网络的核心之一。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a hub for Ebisu's network.

Desc.SourceString: 地下二层是举办拍卖会的场所，安保措施非常严密，只有受到邀请的客人，才能前往。
Desc.LocalizedString: The auctions are held in the second basement, with tight security—only the invited can enter.

Desc.SourceString: 那就希望，我们这样的小意外……能够无伤大雅吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Then let's hope our little mishap… won't cause too much of a stir.

Desc.SourceString: 这些画作是拍卖会展示的历届拍品，均价过亿。
Desc.LocalizedString: These paintings on display are previous lots, all auctioned for over a hundred million.

Desc.SourceString: 艺术么……
Desc.LocalizedString: Art…

Desc.SourceString: 对于某些人而言，拥有艺术史，比拥有一副价值过亿的画作更为重要。
Desc.LocalizedString: For some, owning a piece of art history is more valuable than the billions of Fons the painting represents.

Desc.SourceString: 就像比起异象的能力，对异象的收藏品味才更受人瞩目。
Desc.LocalizedString: And collecting anomalies is more about taste than their abilities.

Desc.SourceString: 所以买家本人也会到场？
Desc.LocalizedString: So, the buyer's coming in person?

Desc.SourceString: 到场多数是和我们一样的<blue>「替身」</>。拍卖开始前，雇主会将心仪拍品的预期价告知代理。
Desc.LocalizedString: Most of the people here are just <blue>stand-ins</> like us. Employers tell the agents their max bid beforehand.

Desc.SourceString: 如果在预算内顺利拍下，除了商定的佣金比例，预期价与成交价的差额还可作为代理奖金。
Desc.LocalizedString: If we win, any amount saved under the budget will be added to our commission as a bonus reward.

Desc.SourceString: 这么好赚，看来我们的委托费还是要低了。
Desc.LocalizedString: So lucrative! Maybe we're not charging enough.

Desc.SourceString: 哈哈，承蒙浔小姐的关照，这次就当是卖我们个人情吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Haha, thanks for your generosity, Hotori. Let's call this a favor.

Desc.SourceString: 瞧瞧，是巴布罗的「当代赞助人」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Look, it's Pablo's "Contemporary Patron".

Desc.SourceString: 哦~我要是真有办法回到那个年代，可不用现在花十倍价格去「赞助」了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, if I could turn back time, I wouldn't be paying ten times the price to be a "patron" now.

Desc.SourceString: 当然，毋庸置疑，巴布罗是个伟大的画家，我欣赏他的色彩诠释，层次分明又富有想象力。
Desc.LocalizedString: No question, Pablo was genius with colors—so vivid and imaginative.

Desc.SourceString: 没想到你也会有成为收藏家的志向。
Desc.LocalizedString: I never took you for the collector type.

Desc.SourceString: 显得自己忍痛割爱，才能找到下一个「赞助人」嘛。
Desc.LocalizedString: The best way to attract a new "patron" is to make the separation look as agonizing as possible.

Desc.SourceString: 不愧是<blue>「方斯绕一圈，回来变两圈」</>的内穆尔家族。
Desc.LocalizedString: The Nemur family sure knows how to <blue>multiply their riches</>.

Desc.SourceString: 这话从你嘴里说出来，可不对味啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: It doesn't sound right when you say it like that.

Desc.SourceString: 哈哈哈哈。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hahahaha.

Desc.SourceString: 我似乎……看到了当年异象管理局那个<blue>魔女</>……
Desc.LocalizedString: I think I spotted that <blue>Witch</> from BAC…

Desc.SourceString: 出现在这里？那可要再立一笔大功劳了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Showing up here? That'll be another big win.

Desc.SourceString: 已经跟那帮看门狗分道扬镳那么久了，就算她真的在这里，此次的目标，也不会是我们。
Desc.LocalizedString: She's gone separate ways with those watchdogs for a while. Even if she's here, we're not the target.

Desc.SourceString: 哦，这么说来，拍品的传言似乎是真的？
Desc.LocalizedString: So, the rumors about that item might be true?

Desc.SourceString: 看来大家的品味相同？
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like we all have similar tastes.

Desc.SourceString: 我只想收藏一些有趣的小玩意，那件拍品，就不凑热闹了~
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm here to pick up some quirky collectibles. I won't join the bidding war!

Desc.SourceString: 嗝~再来10瓶巴克斯！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hic… Another 10 more bottles of Bacchus, please!

Desc.SourceString: 真是抱歉，她有些醉了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Our apologies, she's had a bit too much.

Desc.SourceString: 造型费心了，头顶这么亮，整个宴厅都省下好些电了。
Desc.LocalizedString: What a thoughtful style. With a head so shiny, the hall can save a lot on lighting.

Desc.SourceString: 秃头，这件拍品又不是假发，你拿来干嘛？
Desc.LocalizedString: What do you need that piece for? It's not a wig.

Desc.SourceString: 猜谜时间：下雨了，在场第一个感觉到的人是谁？
Desc.LocalizedString: Quiz time: If it rains now, who here will feel it first?

Desc.SourceString: 喂，你的出价呢？喂喂，假装卡住了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oi, what's your bid? Hello? Are you stuck?

Desc.SourceString: 这里可不是你这种不入流的人该来的场合！
Desc.LocalizedString: This isn't the place for nobodies like you!

Desc.SourceString: 给我住嘴！我有！！今天没戴而已！
Desc.LocalizedString: Zip it! I have one! Just didn't put it on today!
It's… me?

Desc.SourceString: 是你的粗鄙之语一直打断我的思路！
Desc.LocalizedString: Your rude interruptions are messing with my train of thought!

Desc.SourceString: 一串有风险的东西，这么加价……
Desc.LocalizedString: Why would you bid like that for a risky piece…

Desc.SourceString: 看上去是个生面孔，听说是什么古董店的老板。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a new face in the crowd, an antique shop owner, I hear.

Desc.SourceString: 是叫伊什么来着？反正没听过，这么看，是有点背景的代理吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: What's it called again? Something starts with an "E." Probably an agent with some clout.

Desc.SourceString: 溢价了近一倍，该说是委托人实力不容小觑呢，还是说外行鲁莽呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: The bidding's almost doubled—is it savvy or just foolishness?

Desc.SourceString: 出手果决，外表美艳。要是她再出手几轮，可就在今晚的拍卖会大出风头了。
Desc.LocalizedString: She's got a sharp eye and stunning looks. If she keeps bidding like this, she'll be the talk of the night.

Desc.SourceString: 名头我都替她想好了，<blue>「惠比寿的迷醉粉红豹」</>！
Desc.LocalizedString: I've already thought of a nickname for her—<blue>Ebisu's Enchanted Pink Panther</>!

Desc.SourceString: 惠比寿现在的门槛真是低呢，什么人都能和我堂堂「惠比寿的金钱美人鱼」同场。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ebisu's standards must be slipping if anyone can rub shoulders with me, Ebisu's Golden Mermaid.

Desc.SourceString: 惠比寿的包装，还真应了那句<blue>「从砒霜汲出蜜糖」</>。这串项链带来的诅咒可不是什么好玩的东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ebisu's promo is quite the paradox—<blue>"venom to sweetness"</>. The curse linked to this necklace isn't child's play.

Desc.SourceString: 怪不得觉得今天的开场词比起以往多了几分偏执呢……这种东西都是买来收藏的，难道还真有傻子去许愿？
Desc.LocalizedString: The opening speech today did seem more paranoid than usual… People buy this thing to collect, not to make wishes, right?

Desc.SourceString: 它的上一任主人，是<blue>「赛润尼缇」</>的家主哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Its last owner was the head of the <blue>Serenetti family</>.

Desc.SourceString: ……你的意思是，那个家族的没落是项链造成的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you saying the family's downfall was because of the necklace?

Desc.SourceString: 谁知道呢，只是一些传言罢了……
Desc.LocalizedString: But hey, it's all hearsay…

Desc.SourceString: 这才第一件拍品，竞争就这么激烈，轮到那件拍品时，可有好戏看了。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is only the first item, and it's already intense. When the big-ticket item comes up, it'll be quite the spectacle.

Desc.SourceString: 听你的意思，今天不准备出手了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Sounds like you're sitting this one out?

Desc.SourceString: 对今天的重头戏都不感兴趣，不像你的风格。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not into the big-ticket item? That's not like you.

Desc.SourceString: 劝你们也别掺和。
Desc.LocalizedString: My advice? Stay out of it.

Desc.SourceString: 哦？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh?

Desc.SourceString: 拍品的真正能力于我们而言并不重要，一件「玩具」而已。
Desc.LocalizedString: We're not here for the item's power. It's a fancy toy at best.

Desc.SourceString: 用自己的性命，去交换一件风险不可控的玩具，可不是划算的买卖。
Desc.LocalizedString: Risking your life for an unpredictable toy? That's a bad deal.

Desc.SourceString: 什么意思？
Desc.LocalizedString: What does that mean?

Desc.SourceString: 多少方斯都不要紧，只是拿下那件拍品，那东西也未必能掌握在自己手中……
Desc.LocalizedString: The cost doesn't matter. But even if I snag the piece, controlling that thing may not be easy…

Desc.SourceString: 看来以后也没必要再来参加了，今天的拍卖，就当做「惠比寿的金钱美人鱼」这段传说的华丽谢幕吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe I won't bother coming to these auctions anymore. Let's make today's auction the grand exit for the legendary Ebisu's Golden Mermaid.

Desc.SourceString: 希望你这蝼蚁能多撑几个回合，可别坏了金钱美人鱼的告别仪式。
Desc.LocalizedString: Try to last a few rounds, worm. Don't ruin the grand finale of the Golden Mermaid's auction legend!

Desc.SourceString: 我很期待你的海豹鼓掌表演呢~千万别让我失望哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Can't wait to see your clapping performance. Don't let me down now.

Desc.SourceString: 没瞧见美人鱼，鼓掌的海豹倒是有一只。
Desc.LocalizedString: Haven't seen the mermaid yet, but I did spot a clapping seal.

Desc.SourceString: 因为鱼尾纹多，所以是鱼吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… you remind me of the fish market—loud and stinky.

Desc.SourceString: 谢幕这么费劲，外头的人知道你吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Putting all these show up… but do people actually know you?

Desc.SourceString: 是美人鱼！！！！！惠比寿的金钱美人鱼！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's Mermaid, mind you! Ebisu's Golden Mermaid!!!

Desc.SourceString: 是金钱美人鱼！美人鱼！你这阴暗角落里的蝼蚁！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's the Golden Mermaid! Mermaid! You gutter vermin!

Desc.SourceString: 呵，你的脑袋装得挺满，满是对我的嫉妒！
Desc.LocalizedString: Jealousy's all that fits in your tiny brain!

Desc.SourceString: 角落的可怜虫，敢在我面前挑衅！！
Desc.LocalizedString: A minor character in the shadows dare provoke the Golden Mermaid?!

Desc.SourceString: 要叫醒其他人吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Should we wake up the others?

Desc.SourceString: 叫醒无关的人，局面会变得更混乱。
Desc.LocalizedString: Waking others might just add to the chaos.

Desc.SourceString: <TypingTitle titlename="异象" titlecolor="grey_title" " contextcolor="blue">「起司」</>的定格效果，没那么轻易解除，让惠比寿的人自己收拾残局吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: The freeze effect of <TypingTitle titlename="Anomaly" titlecolor="grey_title" " contextcolor="blue">Cheese</> is not easily lifted. Let Ebisu clean up the mess themselves.

Desc.SourceString: 那我们几个是怎么解除的？唔~是我们太强了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Then why are we unaffected? Hmm… Are we too strong?

Desc.SourceString: 这可得问问某位<blue>「时间的魔女」</>了~
Desc.LocalizedString: That's a question for a certain <blue>Witch of Time</>.

Desc.SourceString: 浔姐姐还在定格状态吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is Hotori still frozen?

Desc.SourceString: 呃……看着像喝多睡着了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Uh… looks like she's had too much and passed out…

Desc.SourceString: 喝……接着喝……
Desc.LocalizedString: Drink up… And keep it coming…

Desc.SourceString: 上酒！巴克斯……打包！
Desc.LocalizedString: Where's the wine? Bacchus… to go!

Desc.SourceString: 发财……我的……都是我的方斯……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wealth and riches… Mine… All mine…

Desc.SourceString: 注意周围的拍品，要财务危机了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Keep an eye on the items around. This is going to be a financial crisis…

Desc.SourceString: 嫁祸给那群坏家伙就行了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Blame it on the bad guys!
…Hmm

Desc.SourceString: 简森哥知道有哪些异象解离了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Jenson, do you know which anomalies have breached?

Desc.SourceString: 拍品容器上只写了编号，没有具体信息。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not sure. The containers are numbered but give no details.

Desc.SourceString: 看来只能逐一调查了。
Desc.LocalizedString: We'll have to investigate them one by one.

Desc.SourceString: 解离的异象招来了脏东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: Containment breaches attract hostile entities.

Desc.SourceString: 宴厅那边那么多人，会不会有危险？
Desc.LocalizedString: With so many people in the banquet hall, is it dangerous?

Desc.SourceString: 南塔妮的规则会保护他们。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nantanì's rules will protect them.

Desc.SourceString: 况且浔也还在宴厅，贵宾们的处境，可比我们安全多了~
Desc.LocalizedString: Plus, Hotori's still in the hall. The guests are safer than us!

Desc.SourceString: 嚯，什么情况，分成一块一块的了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Whoa, what's with the segments?

Desc.SourceString: 它叫<TypingTitle titlename="异象" titlecolor="grey_title" " contextcolor="blue">「回转门外」</>，侵蚀现实空间，造成空间分离和反转。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's called <TypingTitle titlename="Anomaly" titlecolor="grey_title" " contextcolor="blue">Outside the Inner Door</>. It erodes real space and causes spatial separation and inversion.

Desc.SourceString: 提问！如果装没看见，就这么放着不管可以吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Question! Can we ignore it and leave it be?

Desc.SourceString: 那么「回转门外」影响范围会逐步蔓延，大概九个月后将分离整个海特洛市吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Then its effects will spread, possibly segmenting Hethereau in nine months.

Desc.SourceString: 酷！
Desc.LocalizedString: Cool!

Desc.SourceString: 提问！该怎么收容？
Desc.LocalizedString: Question! How do we contain it?

Desc.SourceString: 将它与现实连接的<blue>「门」</>全部关闭，便能阻止侵蚀。
Desc.LocalizedString: Close all the <blue>Doors</> connecting it to reality to stop the erosion.

Desc.SourceString: 酷！
Desc.LocalizedString: Cool!

Desc.SourceString: 逆流而上，即可关闭「回转门外」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Go upstream to terminate the Outside the Inner Door.

Desc.SourceString: 关上一扇了，没什么难度嘛，轻松！
Desc.LocalizedString: Closed one, no big deal, easy!

Desc.SourceString: 傻子当然不会受影响。
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course, fools are unaffected.

Desc.SourceString: 闭嘴，呆头鸟！
Desc.LocalizedString: Shut up, silly!

Desc.SourceString: 最后一个~简简单单~顺顺利利~
Desc.LocalizedString: And there's the last one! Easy-peasy!

Desc.SourceString: 你的反向预言，消停会儿吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Give your gloomy predictions a rest, will you?

Desc.SourceString: 安~静~
Desc.LocalizedString: QUI-ET!

Desc.SourceString: （安静。）
看吧，这下我学会了，它这就是在说「安静」。
Desc.LocalizedString: See, I've got it down now—it's saying "quiet."

Desc.SourceString: ……的确是。
Desc.LocalizedString: Indeed.

Desc.SourceString: 情况不对。
Desc.LocalizedString: Something's wrong.

Desc.SourceString: 黑暗在吞噬空间，跑！
Desc.LocalizedString: Darkness is swallowing the space, run!

Desc.SourceString: 打开尽头的那盏灯！
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn on the light at the end!

Desc.SourceString: 可恶的女人，这么张扬！一定是冲着我来的！休想抢走人称「惠比寿的金钱美人鱼」——我的风头！
Desc.LocalizedString: Darn that woman, such a show-off! She must be here for me! You think you can steal the spotlight from Ebisu's Golden Mermaid? From me?

Desc.SourceString: 多少方斯都不要紧，只是拿下那件拍品，那东西也未必能掌握在自己手中……
Desc.LocalizedString: The cost doesn't matter. But even if I snag the piece, controlling that thing may not be easy…

Desc.SourceString: 周围的气息并不平静，大家一起行动或许更为稳妥。
Desc.LocalizedString: The atmosphere around is not calm. It might be safer for everyone to act together.

Desc.SourceString: 阵仗摆了半天了，还不过来打上一架！
Desc.LocalizedString: All that posturing is pointless. They should just come over here and fight!

Desc.SourceString: 这么看，它们更像是进不来这里面的样子……
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like they can't get in here…

Desc.SourceString: 顺着这些东西走，或许能更快出去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe following these will get us out sooner.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么还没走到头？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why haven't we reached the end yet?

Desc.SourceString: 让我看看，那些鬼鬼祟祟的东西，都藏在哪儿呢——
Desc.LocalizedString: Let me see, where are those sneaky things hiding—

Desc.SourceString: 诶？怎么回事？
Desc.LocalizedString: Eh? What's going on?

Desc.SourceString: 像是需要遵循某种规则，才能进入下一个房间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Seems like certain rules must be followed to get into the next room.

Desc.SourceString: 嘿——还敢捉弄我？
Desc.LocalizedString: Really… How dare they play tricks on me?

Desc.SourceString: 你想起了小时候那片野草莓地——也许你的童年根本没有这个地方，但是这个香味就是让你想到了，那个无忧无虑，散发着酸甜味的平凡午后。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're reminded of a wild strawberry field from your childhood—though who can say if such a thing really existed? Still, this scent whisks you back regardless to that ordinary, carefree afternoon filled with sweet and tangy nostalgia.

Desc.SourceString: 是深夜仍泛着莹莹微光的屏幕，是永远停滞的红灯，是胀痛的双腿和血肉摩擦的水泡，疲倦是最沉重最轻浮的，散发着咸涩味。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's the screen still glowing faintly in the dead of night, the traffic light frozen forever on red, the throbbing legs and blisters where flesh rubs raw. Exhaustion is both the heaviest and most weightless thing, reeking of bitter saltiness.

Desc.SourceString: 你从来没有闻过这么难闻的气味，像是过期很久却没什么变化的月饼放进麻辣香锅的调料中，加入了芥末酱油和巧克力翻炒，出锅时又加上了葱姜蒜调味和一整瓶橘子汽水。
Desc.LocalizedString: You've never smelled anything so awful before. It's like stale mooncakes expired ages ago got tossed into hot pot seasoning with wasabi soy sauce and chocolate, stir fried all together, then topped with scallions, ginger, garlic, and a bottle of orange soda.

Desc.SourceString: 不行，太香了，再闻下去鼻子就要没了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nope, nope. I'd like my nose.

Desc.SourceString: 汪姿势怎样？是不是很有汪范？！
Desc.LocalizedString: How's this pose? Got a whole lot of Dawgster, no?

Desc.SourceString: （里尔跑远了，还是去找找他吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Ruddy ran away. Better go find him.)

Desc.SourceString: （他似乎受了很大打击，不知道现在怎么样了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Seems like it hit him hard. I wonder how he is now.)

Desc.SourceString: （糟糕！忘记现在状态，没有战斗力。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Whoops, I forgot I basically can't fight like… this.)

Desc.SourceString: 没问题。
Desc.LocalizedString: No problem.

Desc.SourceString: （这家伙又变了？居然可以直接模仿别的歧骸，你小心点。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This guy changed again? It's mimicking Oddities. Gotta be careful with this one.)

Desc.SourceString: （拿到照片了，去之前约定的地点找里尔吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Got the photo. Time to head over to where Ruddy and I agreed to meet.)

Desc.SourceString: 这家热汪店超级好吃，汪和奥尔、布尔都超级喜欢。
Desc.LocalizedString: This Hot Dawg shop is super good. Me, Auddy, and Buddy all love it.

Desc.SourceString: 最可恶的是奥尔那家伙吃完他的热汪后，总是喜欢把头伸过来，抢汪的热汪！
Desc.LocalizedString: Auddy would always try to steal a bite of my Hot Dawg when he finished eating his. Really can't stand him!

Desc.SourceString: 布尔总是能很轻易记住吃热汪的时候，对面马路上究竟跑过多少辆车，有时候不得不羡慕啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Buddy could always recall how many cars passed on the road across when eating Hot Dawgs. Can't say I wasn't jealous.

Desc.SourceString: （不见了！之前还在这里……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It's gone! It was here before…)

Desc.SourceString: 会不会丢在某个角落里？再仔细看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: We gotta leave no stone unturned.

Desc.SourceString: 找到了，在这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: Found it. It's here.

Desc.SourceString: 镜头感不错。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a nice picture.

Desc.SourceString: 这张照片上整只狗都在发光。
Desc.LocalizedString: You shine like a star in this picture.

Desc.SourceString: （不知道他们究竟能不能和好……明天去电影院看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I wonder if they can reconcile… Let's try going to the cinema tomorrow.)

Desc.SourceString: 大骨头、冻干、玩具球……杂物太多了，照片是被压在箱底了吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Big bones, Froze'n'Dried, toy balls… there is just too much stuff here. Bet the photo is buried deep at the bottom of the box.

Desc.SourceString: 早知道就不把照片扔里面了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Shouldn't have thrown the photo inside.

Desc.SourceString: 好多肉骨头碎屑，是被小动物咬碎的痕迹……
Desc.LocalizedString: All these bone fragments. Seems like some little animal bit it into pieces…

Desc.SourceString: 照片不会也被咬碎了汪……
Desc.LocalizedString: Boy, I wonder if the photo is still in one piece…

Desc.SourceString: 箱底碎了一块，应该是某只小动物咬碎木头后爬进箱子了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The bottom of the box is missing a piece. Bet some little animal bit its way through the wood and crawled in.

Desc.SourceString: 味道好熟悉，汪闻出来了！是可恶的团三郎！
Desc.LocalizedString: Danzaburou!!! I know this smell!

Desc.SourceString: （你跟了我一路了，想打架？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (You've been following me all the way. Trying to pick a fight?)

Desc.SourceString: 这味道……这多闻一下都是对鼻子的暴击吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Boy… this smell is killing my nose…

Desc.SourceString: （什么东西，好香！汪，再翻翻！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Boy, this smells amazing! Gotta dig some more!)

Desc.SourceString: 真是积极的行动……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow, I see you really mean business there…

Desc.SourceString: （里面没有团三郎！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Danzaburou is not in there!)

Desc.SourceString: 啊——这味道……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, this smell…

Desc.SourceString: （有了有了！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Got it, got it!)

Desc.SourceString: 团三郎在哪？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Where is Danzaburou?!

Desc.SourceString: （是美味大骨头！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It's a delicious Yummers Bone!)

Desc.SourceString: （这个也没有找到团三郎……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Didn't find Danzaburou in here either…)

Desc.SourceString: 垃圾桶背后好像有东西？
Desc.LocalizedString: Seems like there is something behind the trash can?

Desc.SourceString: （爆米花！奥尔喜欢！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Popcorn! I love it!)

Desc.SourceString: （嗯……爆米花、垃圾桶……团三郎！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Hmm… popcorn, trash can… Danzaburou!)

Desc.SourceString: 不排除爆米花是在团三郎逃跑的过程中从包袱里掉出来的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Danzaburou might have dropped some popcorn escaping.

Desc.SourceString: 这里的墙边也有一些爆米花……可能现在团三郎已经不在这片区域了……
Desc.LocalizedString: There's some popcorn by the wall here, too… Danzaburou might not even be here anymore…

Desc.SourceString: 沿着爆米花的踪迹追过去看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's follow the popcorn and see where it leads.

Desc.SourceString: （奥尔也是这么想！你和奥尔一样！聪明！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I think so, too! Great minds think alike! Smart!)

Desc.SourceString: （奥尔先去抓那家伙，你跟上！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I'm going to catch the guy first. Tag along!)

Desc.SourceString: （快跟上奥尔！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Hurry and follow Auddy!)

Desc.SourceString: （你好慢啊……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (You're so slow…)

Desc.SourceString: （就是这里！快过来！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It's here! Hurry up!)

Desc.SourceString: （榴莲味大骨头！汪汪！好香好香！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Durian-flavored Big Bone! Woof woof! Smells awesome!)

Desc.SourceString: （芝士味大骨头……奥尔不爱吃，里尔爱吃……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Cheese-Flavored Big Bone… I don't like it, but Ruddy does…)

Desc.SourceString: （芥末味大骨头……布尔爱吃……还是留下吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Wasabi-flavored Big Bone… Buddy likes it… better save it for him.)

Desc.SourceString: （你要吃大骨头吗？我们平分！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Do you want a big bone? We can split it!)

Desc.SourceString: （我的电影票原来在这里！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (So this is where my movie ticket has been this whole time!)

Desc.SourceString: （不对，我明明买了三张，另外两张去哪了？再翻翻。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (No, I'm sure I bought three. Where are the other two? Gotta keep looking.)

Desc.SourceString: （原来是被压在箱子底下。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Been sitting at the bottom of the box, huh?)

Desc.SourceString: （团三郎还没有出来……不会是怂了吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Danzaburou is still nowhere to be seen… Did he chicken out?)

Desc.SourceString: （这是最后的储备粮了吧？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This should be the last bit of reserved food.)

Desc.SourceString: （汪——我们要把你的东西都搬走吃掉了汪！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Woof—we're going to take all your stuff and eat it, Woof!)

Desc.SourceString: （嗷嗷傲，好怂的家伙，继续搬！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Awoo awoo, such a coward. Don't stop!)

Desc.SourceString: （这应该就是你要找的照片吧。等等，照片上的是……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This should be the photo you're looking for. Wait, am I seeing who I think I'm seeing in there…)

Desc.SourceString: （嗷！照片、照片咬我的爪！！！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Awo! The photo, the photo bit my paw!!!)

Desc.SourceString: （小偷！小偷！小偷！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Thief! Thief! Thief!)

Desc.SourceString: （可恶！这家伙居然敢咬我！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Ugahh! I can't believe this guy bit me!)

Desc.SourceString: 这味道……唤醒了不久前某些糟糕记忆……但是居然莫名地好吃！
Desc.LocalizedString: This smell… reminds me of something bad that happened not too long ago… but it tastes super good!

Desc.SourceString: 芝士的奶香，味道不错！
Desc.LocalizedString: Gotta love this cheesy taste!

Desc.SourceString: 强劲的气流冲力涌上鼻腔和眼眶……不行，要醍醐灌顶了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I can feel it in my nose and eyes… Oh boy, I can't take this anymore!

Desc.SourceString: （就是这个力道！千万别停~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (That's more like it! Don't stop!)

Desc.SourceString: 相当舒适~
Desc.LocalizedString: This feels good!

Desc.SourceString: 挺好……
Desc.LocalizedString: Pretty good…

Desc.SourceString: 好像没有丝毫作用……
Desc.LocalizedString: It doesn't seem like it's working…

Desc.SourceString: 灵魂要飞了……
Desc.LocalizedString: I think I'm about to die here…

Desc.SourceString: （起飞！起飞！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Take off! Take off!)

Desc.SourceString: 后背再来两下汪~
Desc.LocalizedString: Two more hits on the back, Woof!

Desc.SourceString: 汪！不错！
Desc.LocalizedString: Woof! Nice!

Desc.SourceString: 还是不起效果……
Desc.LocalizedString: Not working…

Desc.SourceString: 力道会不会还是太轻了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Harder…!

Desc.SourceString: （继续、继续！不要停！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Keep going! Don't stop!)

Desc.SourceString: （舒服舒服~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This feels great!)

Desc.SourceString: 头皮有点……
Desc.LocalizedString: My scalp feels funny…

Desc.SourceString: 嗷嗷，疼疼疼疼疼……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ouch ouch ouch ouch…

Desc.SourceString: 各位靠得近一些。
Desc.LocalizedString: Everyone, let's all move closer.
(Woof!)

Desc.SourceString: 奥尔，你能不能笑得别这么……傻。
Desc.LocalizedString: Auddy, you really need to stop smiling like a… goof.

Desc.SourceString: 这下是四个人拍照，汪也算是c位了吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Now it's four people in the photo, and where I'm standing is the center spot, no?
Perfect. Now, 3, 2, 1!

Desc.SourceString: 感觉他的拍照包袱有些重……
Desc.LocalizedString: He's taking this photo thing way too seriously.

Desc.SourceString: 啧！工服又白洗了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tsk! Washed the work uniform again for nothing.

Desc.SourceString: 棉布、雨伞、陶瓷、电灯泡……这里面装满了垃圾。这只是一个平平无奇的垃圾桶。
Desc.LocalizedString: Cotton fabric, umbrellas, ceramics, light bulbs… Filled with garbage, this is just an ordinary trash can.

Desc.SourceString: （奇怪，垃圾箱不是异象……为什么这里面会固定长出棉绒绒？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Strange, the trash can isn't an anomaly, but why do Fluffies keep appearing inside?)

Desc.SourceString: （每个垃圾箱里都有棉布……是巧合吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Every trash can has cotton fabric… Is it a coincidence?)

Desc.SourceString: （这条街只有这一处垃圾箱里会出现棉绒绒吗？去别的垃圾箱那里看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Is this the only trash can on this street where Fluffies appear? Let's check the others.)

Desc.SourceString: （信息收集的差不多了，找个地方整理一下吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I've collected enough information. Let's find a place to organize it.)

Desc.SourceString: 那位便利店店员没在这里，他应该是回家了吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: The convenience store staff is not here. He probably went home already…

Desc.SourceString: 喝！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hah!

Desc.SourceString: 我还以为是那家伙……白高兴一场……
Desc.LocalizedString: I thought he was the guy… Got me excited for nothing…

Desc.SourceString: 你别再开垃圾箱盖子了，我怕会误伤到你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't open the trash can lid anymore. I might accidentally hurt you.

Desc.SourceString: 喝！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hah!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么又是你……万一打草惊蛇怎么办？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's you again… What if you scare off the target?

Desc.SourceString: 别再开盖子了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop opening the trash can.

Desc.SourceString: 我知道还是你，别再过来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I know it's you again. Don't come back.

Desc.SourceString: 垃圾桶中干干净净，并没有棉绒绒……
Desc.LocalizedString: The trash can is empty with no Fluffy inside…

Desc.SourceString: 棉绒绒在垃圾桶里睡得正香。
Desc.LocalizedString: Fluffy is sleeping soundly in the trash can.

Desc.SourceString: 扔棉绒绒的家伙还没有光顾这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: The guy dumping Fluffy around isn't here yet.

Desc.SourceString: 看来那个扔棉绒绒的家伙应该是行动了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It looks like the guy dumping Fluffy is on the move.

Desc.SourceString: （那家伙在做什么？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (What is that guy doing?)

Desc.SourceString: 棉！棉！棉！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fluff! Fluff! Fluff!

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多，联系达芙蒂尔小姐！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo, call Daffodill!

Desc.SourceString: 告诉她月光当铺在绿墙坡，请她将人带过来，嘭嘭先生一定可以进来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ask her to bring Boomboom here. He can come in just fine!

Desc.SourceString: 明白！
Desc.LocalizedString: (Roger!)

Desc.SourceString:
谁是最美的人？
眼睛说，你是最美的人。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Who is the most beautiful person?
The eyes say, you are the most beautiful person.

Desc.SourceString:
谁是我的爱人？
倒影说，我是你的爱人。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Who is my lover?
The reflection says, I am your lover.

Desc.SourceString:
谁能让我拥抱爱人？
镜子说，我能让你拥抱爱人。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Who will allow me to embrace my lover?
The mirror says, I will allow you to embrace your lover.

Desc.SourceString:
为什么我看不到爱人？
小狗说，我不能让你看到爱人。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Why can't I see my lover?
The dog says, I can't let you see your lover.

Desc.SourceString:
为什么爱人如此丑陋？
爱人说，你现在如此丑陋。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Why is my lover so ugly?
The lover says, you're so ugly now.

Desc.SourceString:
为什么我要爱他！
他们都叽叽喳喳地说，你就是他。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Why should I love him!
They chatter, "you are him".

Desc.SourceString: 诶？发生了什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Eh? What happened?

Desc.SourceString: 你刚刚听到没，好像有个声音在嘀咕——什么……嗯……什么「这里的功能太复杂，为了防止bug，影响到任务流程，快进」？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you hear that? It sounded like mumbling—something… hmm… something about "The functions here are too complex. Fast forward to stop bugs affecting the quest "?

Desc.SourceString: 这家店主营的是平价类的服饰。
Desc.LocalizedString: This store sells affordable clothing.

Desc.SourceString: （老大要穿得神气！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The boss gotta look stylish!)

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多很多私房钱！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo got a huge secret stash!)

Desc.SourceString: 那么，就去火炬木大道上的Q³ 服装店吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: In that case, let's head to Q³ Fashion on Torchwood Avenue.

Desc.SourceString: （快到了！新衣服！新衣服！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (We're almost there! New clothes! New clothes!)

Desc.SourceString: （要做西装塔吉多！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo! Suiting up!)

Desc.SourceString: （西装塔吉多，回头率满分！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo in suit, turning heads left and right!)

Desc.SourceString: （礼物要承载塔吉多满满心意！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The gift must be bursting with Taygedo's feelings!)

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多，选择困难！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo can't decide!)

Desc.SourceString: 如果感到无从下手，要不要先去其他店转一转？
Desc.LocalizedString: If you're feeling stuck, how about we take a stroll at other shops first?

Desc.SourceString: 先挑选好漂亮的礼物箱、丝带、搭配用的花束，再配合它们来选择礼品，似乎也不失为一种妥当的方式。
Desc.LocalizedString: It might be a good approach to first choose a nice gift box, ribbon, and matching bouquet, then select the gift to go with them.
(…A bouquet!)

Desc.SourceString: （阿德勒先生，约会专家！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Mr. Adler, the date whisperer!)

Desc.SourceString: （花束好主意！塔吉多想买——大红色玫瑰！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A bouquet's perfect! Taygedo wants… red roses!)

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多动手能力很强！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo, crafty hands, DIY master!)

Desc.SourceString: 如果是选择用素材自己制作手工礼物，的确要比购买现成的更有诚意。
Desc.LocalizedString: A handicraft is indeed more sincere and meaningful than buying something off the shelf.

Desc.SourceString: 从另一个角度看，也算是预算内的实惠之选。
Desc.LocalizedString: And it's very friendly for Taygedo's fat secret stash.

Desc.SourceString: 不知道埃德嘉把约会计划制定得怎么样了……
Desc.LocalizedString: I wonder how Edgar's coming along with the date plan…

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多，最最期待！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo can't wait!)

Desc.SourceString: 说起来最后……计划制定得怎么样了？
Desc.LocalizedString: By the way, how did the final plan turn out?

Desc.SourceString: （第一精彩，胜券在握！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It's gonna be epic! Victory is in the bag!)

Desc.SourceString: （这里……登场是……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (And next to make entrance is…)

Desc.SourceString: （呜呜呜，娜、娜娜莉？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Eep! N-Nanally?)

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉他们已经去准备了，塔吉多不用太过紧张。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally and the others have already gone to get ready. There's no need to be so nervous, Taygedo.

Desc.SourceString: 只要大胆走上前即可，其余的交给我们就好。
Desc.LocalizedString: All you need to do is step forward confidently. We'll take care of the rest.

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多不紧张、不紧张……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo's not nervous, not nervous at all…)

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多可以教教咱你拿手的游戏吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey Taygedo, can you teach me the games you're really good at?

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多最擅长那种——方块会从天上掉下来的游戏！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo's best at that game where blocks fall from the sky!)

Desc.SourceString: 喂……埋伏的位置需要临时变更。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey… We need to change the ambush position on short notice.

Desc.SourceString: ……嗯，对。尽快确认一下……
Desc.LocalizedString: …Yes, that's right. Confirm it as soon as possible…

Desc.SourceString: （阿德勒先生在打电话吗？真不容易啊，不过埋伏是指……？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Is Adler on the phone? His job seems tough… But what's this ambush about?)

Desc.SourceString: 之后要让塔吉多怎么补偿我好呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Now, how am I gonna have Taygedo make this up to me later…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，我们从白鹦鹉街的路口过去吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, let's go through the intersection at White Parrot Street.

Desc.SourceString: ……是还准备了什么东西吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: …Have you got something else planned?

Desc.SourceString: 另一边就交给鄙人。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll take care of the other arrangements.

Desc.SourceString: 柯林斯家族一代目，娜娜莉！来当你的对手！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm Nanally, the Ichi-daime of The Coluccis! Here to face you head-on!

Desc.SourceString: 不会让你伤到老大的一根毫毛！
Desc.LocalizedString: I won't let you lay a finger on the boss.

Desc.SourceString: 没想到曾被称为桥间地的……唔，桥间地之……嗯嗯嗯……
Desc.LocalizedString: I can't believe the… umm… the one who Bridge Crossings once named… umm… once named…

Desc.SourceString: 总之，没想到你会甘心做那小海獭的手下啊！让我会会你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Anyway, I can't believe you'd willingly work for that otter! Let's see what you're made of!

Desc.SourceString: （你们和塔吉多，各自编出来的设定也不知道有没有商量过……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I wonder if you and Taygedo ever bothered to coordinate your made-up backstories…)

Desc.SourceString: 哇~~~异能者之间的战斗，太酷了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Woah!!! A battle between Espers, it's so cool!

Desc.SourceString: （加油！加油！鉴定师！不要输！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Go, go, Appraiser! Don't lose!)

Desc.SourceString: 不愧是有着……桥间地「无双之龙」名号的存在！够难缠的！
Desc.LocalizedString: As expected from… the Invincible Dragon of Bridge Crossings! You're one tough cookie!

Desc.SourceString: 彼此彼此！桥间地……「轰雷之虎」！
Desc.LocalizedString: Right back at you! The… Roaring Tiger of Bridge Crossings!

Desc.SourceString: 噢——我还挺喜欢这个……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ooh… I actually like this quite a bit…

Desc.SourceString: 可恶，我柯林斯家族的高洁意志，绝不……屈服……！
Desc.LocalizedString: Curse it all! The noble spirit of the Coluccis will never… give in…!

Desc.SourceString: （怪了……难不成我们是反派吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Huh… Are we the baddies here?)

Desc.SourceString: 不论如何，方才没能防范到那两位仇家的靠近都是鄙人的疏忽，让老爷受惊了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nevertheless, I must apologize for my oversight in not preventing those two adversaries from approaching earlier. I'm sorry for causing you alarm, Sir.
