Desc.SourceString: （无妨！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Don't worry about it!)

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多经常会碰到这种事吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Does this kind of thing happen to Taygedo often?

Desc.SourceString: 这对我们来说是家常便饭，对吧老大？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's just another day at the office for us, right, boss?

Desc.SourceString: （伊波恩……历经风风雨雨！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Eibon… battle-hardened through thick and thin!)

Desc.SourceString: （一点小事，不痛不痒！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Minor hiccup, no sweat!)

Desc.SourceString: （对不起！塔吉多搞砸了！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo is so sorry! Taygedo messed everything up!)

Desc.SourceString: 不是老大您的错。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's not your fault, boss.

Desc.SourceString: 请退后，这里就交给我们。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please step back. We'll handle this from here.

Desc.SourceString: 手感……软趴趴的……
Desc.LocalizedString: The texture… it's all soft and mushy…

Desc.SourceString: 但并非毫无效果，它正在渐渐地被打回原形。
Desc.LocalizedString: But it's not ineffective. It's slowly reverting to its original form.

Desc.SourceString: 还有其他的门吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are there any other doors?

Desc.SourceString: 这扇门也被荆棘封住了……
Desc.LocalizedString: This door is also blocked by thorns…

Desc.SourceString: 房间被植物侵蚀得很严重。
Desc.LocalizedString: The room is severely corroded by plants.

Desc.SourceString: 看得出以前还挺豪华的。我们借机参观一下咯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can tell this place used to be luxurious. Let's take the chance to look around?

Desc.SourceString: 这么迅速起效的腐蚀性？是不是可以借用来开路呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Corrosion that works this fast? Maybe we can use it to clear the way.

Desc.SourceString: 还真是生命力旺盛……虽说于我而言，生物其实比死物处理起来更方便点。
Desc.LocalizedString: Truly full of life… For me though, dealing with living things is a bit easier than non-living ones.

Desc.SourceString: 通过这条植物搭出的路径，似乎可以上去……
Desc.LocalizedString: We just need to follow this path of plants to get up there.

Desc.SourceString: 你还是留好余力吧。我们去别处找找清理通道的方法。
Desc.LocalizedString: You should save your strength. Let's look elsewhere for a way to clear the path.

Desc.SourceString: 唔——这下能听清了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Now I'm hearing it!

Desc.SourceString: 可听起来……不像什么好话……
Desc.LocalizedString: But it sounds… kinda ominous…

Desc.SourceString: 可可，你有没有听到奇怪的动静？
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, you hearing anything strange?

Desc.SourceString: 好像有什么声音嘀嘀咕咕个不停，但又不知道到底在说什么！
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a sound muttering… but I can't make head nor tail of it!

Desc.SourceString: 的确很模糊，听不清具体内容。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's really mumbled, can't make out the specifics.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……那咱们就再走走看！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… let's keep walking and see!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，你觉不觉得，这里让人怪不舒服的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, don't you think there's something off about this place?

Desc.SourceString: 吵得没个消停，那么多不友好的话！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's so noisy, and everyone's being so mean! Can't they give it a rest?

Desc.SourceString: 啊——耳朵受不了啦——
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahhh… My poor ears can't take it anymore…

Desc.SourceString: 我们离嘈杂的源头越来越近了。
Desc.LocalizedString: We're getting closer to the source of all this noise.

Desc.SourceString: 呜呜可可——这种时候，你的声音显得更好听了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Waaah, Coco… At times like this, your voice is even more soothing…

Desc.SourceString: 还有还有，我们听到了奇怪的声音，像是在说些什么的样子，现在听得越来越清楚了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, and! We heard some voices, mumbling… It's getting clearer now!

Desc.SourceString: （摇滚吗……唱片机失窃时，似乎正在播放摇滚唱片。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Rock music, huh… The record player was playing rock when it disappeared.)

Desc.SourceString: （或许，他们提到的音乐声与失窃事件有关。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Maybe the music they mentioned has something to do with the theft.)

Desc.SourceString: （先去噗卡糖果店看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I should check out Puka Candy first.)

Desc.SourceString: （看来方向没错。多留意一下附近的情况吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Looks like I'm on the right track. I should keep a close eye on the surroundings.)

Desc.SourceString: （……确实能听到音乐声从伊波恩传来。发生了什么？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…Music's indeed coming from Eibon. What's going on in there?)

Desc.SourceString: （好大的声音……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It's so loud…)

Desc.SourceString: （莫非是先前的线索链错了？或者，是有谁想要嫁祸伊波恩？还是说……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Could it be that my clues were wrong? Or is someone trying to frame Eibon? Or maybe…)

Desc.SourceString: （音乐声是从二楼传来的。姑且先上去看看情况吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The music is from the second floor. I should head up there and check it out.)

Desc.SourceString: （他应该……往那个方向去了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (He went… in that direction.)

Desc.SourceString: 那是……？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's that…?

Desc.SourceString: 这里也没有异常情况……向附近的路人打听一下吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: No anomalies here either… Let's ask the people around here.

Desc.SourceString: 墙壁上凝了一层水膜……这种现象，通常只有在格外潮湿的时候才会出现。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a layer of water film on the wall… This usually happens when it's extremely humid.

Desc.SourceString: 向那边的路人打听一下情况吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's ask the people over there about the situation.

Desc.SourceString: 这附近的地面湿漉漉的……但今天一整天都没有下过雨啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: The ground around here is wet… but it hasn't rained at all today.
Hmm!

Desc.SourceString: 门后有着强烈的异象波动。要小心。
Desc.LocalizedString: There are strong anomaly fluctuations behind the door. Stay alert.

Desc.SourceString: 门似乎锁上了……
Desc.LocalizedString: The door seems to be locked…

Desc.SourceString: 现在无法确定室内情况，贸然破门风险很大。
Desc.LocalizedString: We can't determine the situation inside now, breaking in recklessly is too risky.

Desc.SourceString: 先在附近找找有没有其他入口吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's look around for another entrance first.

Desc.SourceString: 不愧是异象猎人，身手不凡！……我去附近找把梯子。
Desc.LocalizedString: As expected of an Anomaly Hunter, impressive skills!… I'll go find a ladder.

Desc.SourceString:
哒哒哒哒，卡伦小姐穿着新舞鞋，
跳呀跳呀，剧场的帷幕永不落下。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Tap, tap, tap, Miss Karen's new shoes gleam,
Dance, dance, the curtain stays up like a dream.

Desc.SourceString:
哒哒哒哒，卡伦小姐穿着旧舞鞋，
哭呀哭呀，单脚的天鹅总是害怕。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Tap, tap, tap, Miss Karen's old shoes sigh,
Cry, cry, the one-legged swan is shy.

Desc.SourceString:
哒哒哒哒，卡伦小姐穿着红舞鞋，
笑呀笑呀，善良的刽子手啊，
放下手中的斧子吧，就算是卡伦小姐的葬礼，舞步不会停下。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Tap, tap, tap, Miss Karen's red shoes glow,
Laugh, laugh, kind executioner, let the axe go,
Even at Miss Karen's funeral, the dance will flow.

Desc.SourceString: 户田想要爱情，
Desc.LocalizedString: Toda wants love,

Desc.SourceString: 周一，他得到了，
Desc.LocalizedString: Monday, he got it,

Desc.SourceString: 周二，他失去了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tuesday, he lost it.

Desc.SourceString: 周三，他失去了，
Desc.LocalizedString: Wednesday, he lost it,

Desc.SourceString: 周四，他得到了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thursday, he got it.

Desc.SourceString: 周五，他得到了，
Desc.LocalizedString: Friday, he got it,

Desc.SourceString: 周六，他失去了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Saturday, he lost it.

Desc.SourceString: 周日，神要休息。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sunday, God needs to rest.

Desc.SourceString: 户田失去爱情。
Desc.LocalizedString: Toda lost love.

Desc.SourceString:
他要结婚了，
麻雀说，就在明天。
Desc.LocalizedString:
He's getting married, 
The sparrow said, tomorrow.

Desc.SourceString:
新娘是谁，
猫头鹰说，新娘是谁？
Desc.LocalizedString:
Who's the bride? 
The owl said, who's the bride?

Desc.SourceString:
就是他呀，
乌鸦说，镜子里的。
Desc.LocalizedString:
It's him. 
The crow said, in the mirror.

Desc.SourceString:
结婚！结婚！
云雀说，和自己结婚！
Desc.LocalizedString:
Married! Married! 
The lark said, marry yourself!

Desc.SourceString:
他看不见，
红雀说，我啄瞎了他的眼睛。
Desc.LocalizedString:
He can't see, 
The cardinal said, I pecked his eyes blind.

Desc.SourceString:
他们在拥抱，
白鸽说，我会担任司仪。
Desc.LocalizedString:
They're hugging, 
The dove said, I'll officiate.

Desc.SourceString:
他不快乐，
鸢说，瞎子也会哭泣。
Desc.LocalizedString:
He's unhappy, 
The kite said, even the blind cry.

Desc.SourceString:
他们在争吵，
鹪鹩说，就像我们一样。
Desc.LocalizedString:
They're arguing, 
The wren said, just like us.

Desc.SourceString:
他真丑陋，
画眉说，我不愿在婚礼上歌唱。
Desc.LocalizedString:
He's really ugly, 
The thrush said, I won't sing at the wedding.

Desc.SourceString:
太阳出来了，
知更鸟说，教堂的钟声响起。
Desc.LocalizedString:
The sun has risen, 
The robin said, the church bells ring.

Desc.SourceString:
曾经美丽的新郎，
还有丑陋的新娘，
他们听见教堂的钟声，
为可怜的爱情响起。
Desc.LocalizedString:
The once beautiful groom,
And the ugly bride,
They heard the church bells,
Ringing for their pitiful love.

Desc.SourceString:
狂热的朝圣者，
在早上看到了星星，
晚上我们参加他的葬礼。
Desc.LocalizedString:
The fervent pilgrim,
Saw stars in the morning,
In the evening we attended his funeral.

Desc.SourceString:
听说他看到了真理，
像星空派一样好吃。
Desc.LocalizedString:
It's said he saw the truth, 
As delicious as the star pie.

Desc.SourceString: 奇怪……电话亭，怎么会在这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: Strange… A phone booth. Why is it here?

Desc.SourceString: 离开
Desc.LocalizedString: Leave

Desc.SourceString: 敲击一次。
Desc.LocalizedString: Knock

Desc.SourceString: 貌似没有什么反应。
Desc.LocalizedString: No response.

Desc.SourceString: 拍打一次。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tap

Desc.SourceString: 或许手段需要更直接一些……
Desc.LocalizedString: Might need to be more direct…

Desc.SourceString: 原来是谜皮鬼的伪装。
Desc.LocalizedString: Turns out it's a Mysty disguise.

Desc.SourceString: 谁！谁把空调内机和外机并排放在一起！还同时运行！
Desc.LocalizedString: Who put the indoor and outdoor air conditioner units side by side and running at the same time?!

Desc.SourceString: 这样似乎并不能起到制冷效果……
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't think this can cool a room…

Desc.SourceString: 谜皮鬼是往那个方向飞过去的，跟上去看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mysty flew in that direction, let's follow and see.

Desc.SourceString: 线索是「waka」？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is the clue "waka"?

Desc.SourceString: 异象玩偶怎么多出来一个……是清点的时候出错了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: How come there's an extra anomaly doll… Was there a mistake during counting?

Desc.SourceString: 最新推出的「waka~萌萌异象！」超级可爱，好想要！
Desc.LocalizedString: The new WakaWaka AnoAnomaly is super cute. I really want one!

Desc.SourceString: 这个！这个！这个！都想抱回家！
Desc.LocalizedString: This one! This one! And this one! I want to take them all home!

Desc.SourceString: 线索似乎和颜色有关……或许附近有符合这类颜色的物品。
Desc.LocalizedString: The clue seems to be related to color… Maybe something nearby matches that color pattern.

Desc.SourceString: 线索是「咔滋咔滋」？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is the clue "crunch crunch"?

Desc.SourceString: 「咔滋咔滋」听起来有些熟悉，似乎在哪里听到过……
Desc.LocalizedString: "Crunch crunch" sounds familiar, I think I've heard this sound somewhere before…

Desc.SourceString: 汪果然是广告巨汪的料……
Desc.LocalizedString: Totally knew I was a Stardawg material…

Desc.SourceString: 汪汪，这个姿势、更有巨汪的派头？
Desc.LocalizedString: Woof woof, do I look more like a superstar now posing like this?

Desc.SourceString: 要是能再来个人给汪拍照就好了。
Desc.LocalizedString: If only someone could take a photo of me.

Desc.SourceString: 单汪照片确实是没有了……不过汪还有张以前的照片……不行，汪有点丑，还斜视……
Desc.LocalizedString: No solo photos… But I do have one from back in the day… Nope, I'm cross-eyed and look ugly.

Desc.SourceString: 那张照片早被汪压箱底了……不过你想看汪可以给找找，你不准嘲笑汪斜视！
Desc.LocalizedString: That photo was buried deep… But if you want to see, I can try to find it, but just don't laugh when you see me cross-eyed!

Desc.SourceString: 不过斜视不是汪的问题，都怪奥尔，看电影害汪！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's not my fault that I'm cross-eyed, though. I blame Auddy for making me watch movies!

Desc.SourceString: 芝士热汪！榴莲热汪！芥末热汪！朋友，你喜欢吃什么热汪！
Desc.LocalizedString: Cheese Hot Dawg! Durian Hot Dawg! Wasabi Hot Dawg! Take your pick!

Desc.SourceString: 我都可以。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm fine with anything.

Desc.SourceString: 附近有一处好地方，汪们可以在一边晒太阳，一边吃东西汪。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a good spot nearby where we can bask in the sun and eat.

Desc.SourceString: （虽然我承认同事布洛凯德的维修技术确实高超，但是那家伙拖了整整三个月才把工位电脑修好，未免也太散漫了一些吧！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Barracuda is good, true! But three whole months on fixing a single computer is not very acceptable!)

Desc.SourceString: 这或许是和对方在理解上有偏差，找个机会把工作放一放，和对方好好沟通试试。
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe there's just been a misunderstanding. Try setting work aside for a bit and really talk things through.

Desc.SourceString: 有道理，谢谢布尔先生！
Desc.LocalizedString: Makes sense, thank you Mr. Buddy!

Desc.SourceString: 啊，布尔先生，有人要找您，我先走了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, Mr. Buddy, someone is looking for you. I'll take my leave now.

Desc.SourceString: 这里没有……到底是谁把灵魂提取器用完乱扔的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Not here… Who in the world was the last one using the Soultractor?

Desc.SourceString: （都看我做什么！我不心虚！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Why are you all looking at me?! I didn't do anything!)

Desc.SourceString: 这里也没有……
Desc.LocalizedString: Not here either…

Desc.SourceString: 话说老大……那家伙不会突然跳出来打汪吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Say… the guy isn't just going to pop out of nowhere and whack me, right?

Desc.SourceString: （放心，你嗷嗷叫的时候，我不会嘲笑你的。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Don't worry, I won't laugh when you cry.)

Desc.SourceString: （那家伙不会是跑了吧？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Did he run for it?)

Desc.SourceString: 这是……灵魂提取器？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this… the Soultractor?

Desc.SourceString: 就是它让汪们分头的！
Desc.LocalizedString: It made us split!

Desc.SourceString: 我没有感知到它的奇点……
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't sense its nexus…

Desc.SourceString: 这应该只是一个普通的按摩爪吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you sure this isn't just a massage claw?

Desc.SourceString: 我想，这正是它的狡猾之处。
Desc.LocalizedString: I think that's exactly what makes it cunning.

Desc.SourceString: 你们打算怎么解决它？
Desc.LocalizedString: How do you plan to deal with it?

Desc.SourceString: 按照之前分开的方法再重新试着按一下。
Desc.LocalizedString: Try pressing it again like you did before.

Desc.SourceString: 朋友，好久不见……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, it's been a while…

Desc.SourceString: 小汪跑哪去了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Where did Lil'Dawg go…

Desc.SourceString: 身为一只猫居然名字叫「小狗」，奇怪的名字。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Lil'Dog" sure is a weird name for a cat.

Desc.SourceString: 这里贴完了，去下一个地点吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Done here. Let's go to the next place.

Desc.SourceString: 寻猫启示张贴完了，回去跟奥布里说说吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Done posting all the missing cat posters. Let's have a talk with Aubury.

Desc.SourceString: 朋友，好久不见……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, it's been a while…

Desc.SourceString: (起飞！起飞！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Take off! Take off!)

Desc.SourceString: 还可以~
Desc.LocalizedString: Doing just fine!

Desc.SourceString: 挺好……
Desc.LocalizedString: Pretty good…

Desc.SourceString: 现在掌握的线索还太少了。嗯……先去附近的店铺打听打听吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: We will need more clues to work with… let's start by talking to the shops nearby.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然找到了一些线索，但事情好像变得更复杂了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Got a few clues, but things seems more complicated than it started now…

Desc.SourceString: 接下来……去半角广场附近人多热闹的大店打听一下吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright… time to check out the popular shops near Hankaku Square.

Desc.SourceString: （嗯？这个盒子，我刚刚在花店也见过……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Hmm? Isn't this the box from the florist earlier?)

Desc.SourceString: 「异象推销员」……花店店长和潮玩店店员都曾从这个人手上买过可疑的异象产品。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Anomaly Salesman"… both the florist and the pop toy staff have bought suspicious anomaly products from this person.

Desc.SourceString: 半角街的其他店家可能也和他有过交集。先去广场对面的店铺看看情况吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Other shops on Hankaku Street might also have seen him. Let's check out the stores across the square first.

Desc.SourceString: 这里也有相似的商品包装盒。旁边的台卡……是寻人启事？
Desc.LocalizedString: Another box with the same packaging… That card next to it—wait, is that a wanted poster?

Desc.SourceString: 和其他店铺不同，这个骗子并未直接骗取咖啡店店员的金钱，而是骗走了她昂贵的模型收藏。
Desc.LocalizedString: Unlike other shops, this scammer didn't directly steal money from the café staff but instead tricked her out of her valuable model collection.

Desc.SourceString: 除非他是狂热的模型爱好者，否则……这一批模型也很可能被他转手出售，换成金钱。
Desc.LocalizedString: Unless he’s a hardcore model collector, he’s probably just planning to resell them for cash…

Desc.SourceString: 如果他要销赃，很可能会前往中古店这类地方……嗯，去打听一下情况吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: If he's going to fence them, he might head to places like vintage shops… hmm, let's go check it out.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然调查已经告一段落，但骗子尚未落网……
Desc.LocalizedString: Although the investigation has wrapped up, the scammer is still at large…

Desc.SourceString: 「寻一墨镜青年，欺我感情骗我钱财，如有知其下落者，请速提供线索，必有重谢」……
Desc.LocalizedString: "Looking for a young man with sunglasses who deceived me emotionally and financially. If you know his whereabouts, please provide information, and there will be a reward"…

Desc.SourceString: 最好还是回去提醒伊波恩的大家近期多加防范。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's best to go back and remind everyone at Eibon to be more vigilant these days.

Desc.SourceString: 莫非，是异象……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Could it be… an anomaly?

Desc.SourceString: 这头总算安静了。刚刚那边那么吵，是不是因为噗卡公司的最新营销啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: They are finally gone. Maybe it was Puka's latest marketing campaign?

Desc.SourceString: 不可能。我可是绘莉殿下的真爱粉，没听说她最近有摇滚路线的广告。
Desc.LocalizedString: No way. I'm Lady Ellie's biggest fan. She'd never launch a rock campaign without me hearing about it first.

Desc.SourceString: 可我印象里大声放音乐的就是噗卡糖果店……难道是我听错了？
Desc.LocalizedString: But I swear it was Puka Candy blasting that music… Did I hear it wrong?

Desc.SourceString: 你刚才听到什么动静没？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you hear anything just now?

Desc.SourceString: 这附近人来人往，全是「动静」。你指什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Anything? This place is bustling with people. I can hear everything! What exactly are you looking for?

Desc.SourceString: 音乐，好大声的音乐！我现在耳膜还嗡嗡作响呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Music. Extremely loud music! The type that makes your ears ring for days!

Desc.SourceString: 当然听见了，估计是哪个商家想用这种手段博眼球呗。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, that. Of course. It's probably just another marketing campaign.

Desc.SourceString: 我记得那个「伊波恩」平常都很冷清啊，怎么这么热闹……
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't recall Eibon ever being this lively…

Desc.SourceString: 「热闹」？真是抬举了，明明是纯粹的「吵闹」！
Desc.LocalizedString: "Lively"? It's pure chaos in there!

Desc.SourceString: 难道他们店长新进了什么会唱歌的异象古董？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did the shop get some kind of singing antique anomaly?

Desc.SourceString: 要是砸手里卖不出去，这附近岂不是要一直吵下去……
Desc.LocalizedString: …I hope someone sees the beauty in that thing and brings it home, or else we're gonna be stuck with this racket for a while.

Desc.SourceString: 还好今晚没出事……
Desc.LocalizedString: Glad nothing happened tonight…

Desc.SourceString: 唉，什么时候才能回家啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahh… when can we be home?

Desc.SourceString: ……嗯？刚才那只站在仓库门前的「雨人」，衣袖上似乎沾着一些泥土……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm? The Rainman standing in front of the warehouse door seemed to have some soil on its sleeve…

Desc.SourceString: 谁能帮我把棉织物送过去……
Desc.LocalizedString: Can someone help me deliver the cotton fabric…

Desc.SourceString: 今天怎么就忘记清理垃圾箱了呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: How did I forget to clean the trash can today…

Desc.SourceString: 这肌肉秀也不好看啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: This muscle show isn't good either…

Desc.SourceString: 棉！棉！棉！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fluff! Fluff! Fluff!

Desc.SourceString: 棉！棉！棉！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fluff! Fluff! Fluff!

Desc.SourceString: 棉！棉！棉！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fluff! Fluff! Fluff!

Desc.SourceString: 小伙子，让让……
Desc.LocalizedString: Young man, make way…

Desc.SourceString: 这头总算安静了。刚刚那边那么吵，是不是新开的噗卡糖果店在做宣传啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: The people are finally gone. Was it because the new Puka Candy store was doing a promotion?

Desc.SourceString: 不可能。我可是绘莉殿下的真爱粉，噗卡集团从没用摇滚乐做过广告。
Desc.LocalizedString: No way. I'm Lady Ellie's biggest fan, and the Puka Group has never used rock music in their campaign.

Desc.SourceString: 可我印象里大声放音乐的就是噗卡糖果店……难道是我听错了？
Desc.LocalizedString: But I swear it was Puka Candy blasting that music… Did I hear it wrong?

Desc.SourceString: （摇滚吗……唱片机失窃时，似乎正在播放摇滚唱片。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Rock music, huh… The record player was playing rock when it disappeared.)

Desc.SourceString: （或许，他们提到的音乐声与失窃事件有关。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Maybe the music they mentioned has something to do with the theft.)

Desc.SourceString: （先去噗卡糖果店看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I should check out Puka Candy first.)

Desc.SourceString: 我已经画好了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I've finished the painting.

Desc.SourceString: 突然感觉睡得着了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Suddenly, I feel like I can sleep.

Desc.SourceString: 对了，这面墙……
Desc.LocalizedString: By the way, this wall…

Desc.SourceString: 「墙主」大人，太棒了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wall Lord, you're amazing!
Hmph…

Desc.SourceString: 无论看多少遍……
Desc.LocalizedString: No matter how many times I look…

Desc.SourceString: 平平无奇……
Desc.LocalizedString: Nothing special…

Desc.SourceString: 先生，您……
Desc.LocalizedString: Sir, you…

Desc.SourceString: 见鬼……
Desc.LocalizedString: Damn…

Desc.SourceString: 如您所愿，阁下。
Desc.LocalizedString: As you wish, sir.

Desc.SourceString: 要把整个图案都拍进去噢~~
Desc.LocalizedString: Make sure to capture the whole design!

Desc.SourceString: 知道了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Understood.

Desc.SourceString: 这里似乎一切正常……
Desc.LocalizedString: Everything seems normal here…

Desc.SourceString: 除了多了很多「雨人」，好像也没什么吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Apart from there being more Rainmen around, I don't see anything unusual…

Desc.SourceString: （这……是被破坏的涂鸦作品吗？完全看不懂哪里被破坏了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Is this… the vandalized graffiti work? I can't even tell where it's been damaged.)

Desc.SourceString: 这幅画……感觉和之前的作品不太一样？
Desc.LocalizedString: This painting… feels a bit different from your previous works?

Desc.SourceString: 伊森之前的涂鸦无一例外被破坏，而这次，「涂鸦怪」没有出现……这其中，应该有我还未察觉出的异常。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ethan's previous graffiti was all destroyed without exception, but this time, the Graffiti Goof didn't appear… There must be an anomaly here that I haven't noticed yet.

Desc.SourceString: 像伊森那样，拍张现场照片留证吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Like Ethan, take a photo of the scene as evidence.

Desc.SourceString: 接下来，去伊森拍摄的作品墙现场看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Next, let's go to the site of Ethan's artwork wall and take a look.

Desc.SourceString: 现场和照片比起来，还是直观多了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Seeing it in person is much more intuitive than comparing it to photos.

Desc.SourceString: 对了……这附近，说不定能找到其他线索。
Desc.LocalizedString: Right… Maybe we can find other clues nearby.

Desc.SourceString: 是布莱兹……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's Brades…

Desc.SourceString: 这幅涂鸦，也是被波普破坏的。
Desc.LocalizedString: This graffiti was also destroyed by Bopp.

Desc.SourceString: （「在『涂鸦怪』眼里，我们的作品并没有区别」么……）
Desc.LocalizedString: ("No difference between our works"… huh…)

Desc.SourceString: （说不定真是这样……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Maybe that's really the case…)

Desc.SourceString: 终于等到你了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Finally, I've been waiting for you…

Desc.SourceString: 新鲜出炉的蛋糕，请尝尝吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: The cake's fresh out of the oven! Please, try some!

Desc.SourceString: 没人吃的话菈比就端走咯~
Desc.LocalizedString: Rabi might just eat everything up if you're slow!

Desc.SourceString: 新鲜出炉的蛋糕，尝一尝吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: The cake's fresh from the oven! Have a taste!

Desc.SourceString: 松松软软的美味蛋糕~
Desc.LocalizedString: Soft, fluffy, delicious cake!

Desc.SourceString: 呜哇，这下麻烦了啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh, this is trouble…

Desc.SourceString: 重要的是做蛋糕时的「心意」……
Desc.LocalizedString: What matters most is the heart we put into making the cake…

Desc.SourceString: 味道怎么样？新口味会不习惯吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: How's the new flavor? Too different?

Desc.SourceString: 不愧是爱丽丝，做的蛋糕还是这么美味。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alice's cakes are as delicious as ever.

Desc.SourceString: 好耶，成功啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Yay, I did it!

Desc.SourceString: （将蛋糕扔进「幽灵们的蛋糕盛宴」张开的嘴巴里）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The cake was tossed into the gaping maw of the Ghastly Cakefest)

Desc.SourceString: 这会是幽灵先生想要的蛋糕吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Could this be the cake that our ghost friend wants?

Desc.SourceString: 什、什么情况呐！
Desc.LocalizedString: W-what's going on?!

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼，多谢款待啦！对了，我给你们留了一份礼物，可别不小心丢掉啦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe, thanks for the treat! Oh, and I left you guys a gift, make sure you don't lose it!

Desc.SourceString: （白色幽灵和店门口的「幽灵们的蛋糕盛宴」一同消失了）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Wight and the Ghastly Cakefest at the shop entrance vanished together)

Desc.SourceString: （菈比反复地摸自己尾巴的位置）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Rabi pats where her tail is)

Desc.SourceString: 「苦蛋糕」还没被泯除吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Bittercake still hasn't been nullified…?

Desc.SourceString: 再去店里看看吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go back and take another look…

Desc.SourceString: 出现了！小心！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's here! Watch out!

Desc.SourceString: 这附近……似乎一切正常。
Desc.LocalizedString: Everything seems normal around here…

Desc.SourceString: 应该就是这里了。
Desc.LocalizedString: This should be the place.

Desc.SourceString: 闭店……异象的影响这么严重吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Closed… Is the anomaly's influence really this severe…

Desc.SourceString: 去店里看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's head to the shop.

Desc.SourceString: 还是先仔细看看房间里有无漏掉的线索吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: We should carefully check the room for any missed clues first.

Desc.SourceString: 空调内机和外机都摆放在室外？
Desc.LocalizedString: Both indoor and outdoor AC units placed outside?

Desc.SourceString: 校外人士不得随意进入。
Desc.LocalizedString: Outsiders are not allowed to enter without permission.

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多好久没来异管局了，不知道现在办理市民证应该去哪里）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo hasn't been to BAC in so long, I wonder where is the Citizen ID counter.)

Desc.SourceString: 我们找人问一下吧，那边好像就有工作人员在修理机器。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's find someone to ask. It looks like there's staff over there fixing some machinery.

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多，发现目标！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo, target located!)

Desc.SourceString: 番茄酱恶魔是个人？
Desc.LocalizedString: The Tomato Devil is a person?

Desc.SourceString: 啊……怎么会，不是异象吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh… How can that be? I thought it was an Anomaly?

Desc.SourceString: 还不知道么，都在传是异象管理局的人呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Haven't you heard? Word is they're BAC…

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多付钱
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo will pay.

Desc.SourceString: （呜呜，没有了！塔吉多私房钱告急！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Waaah, it's all gone! Taygedo's pocket is running dry!)

Desc.SourceString: 购买
Desc.LocalizedString: Purchase

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷打算怎么守护番茄酱售卖机？
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, what's our plan?

Desc.SourceString: 先回刚才那边的售卖机蹲守吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's head back and keep watch at that vending machine!

Desc.SourceString: 委托人的住址就在这附近……
Desc.LocalizedString: It should be around here.

Desc.SourceString: 只能找个还没被破坏的售卖机，等它自己主动上门了。
Desc.LocalizedString: We could only find a working vending machine and wait there at night.

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多！埋伏！抓住它！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo's ready to ambush!)

Desc.SourceString: 番茄酱恶魔好像生气了！？之前没有发生过袭击路人的情况哎！
Desc.LocalizedString: Did the Tomato Devil get angry?! It never attacked people before!

Desc.SourceString: 觉得安魂曲抢了它的「工作」吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe it thinks Lacrimosa stole its job…

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲……不是故意的……
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa… didn't mean to…

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲前辈不用向它道歉啦！它是反派哎~
Desc.LocalizedString: No need to apologize to it! It's the bad guy!
Oh…

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多保镖~保护安魂曲~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo the bodyguard! Protect Lacrimosa!)

Desc.SourceString: ……番茄酱，没吃到。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, hungry… Tomato jelly.

Desc.SourceString: 委托人的住址就在这附近……
Desc.LocalizedString: It should be around here.
Mmm…

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多保镖~去买番茄酱~塔吉多保镖~保护安魂曲~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo the bodyguard! Off to buy some jelly! Taygedo the bodyguard! Protect Lacrimosa!)

Desc.SourceString: Taygedo~taygedo~
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo, Taygedo!

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多保镖~去买番茄酱~塔吉多保镖~保护安魂曲~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo the bodyguard! Off to buy some jelly! Taygedo the bodyguard! Protect Lacrimosa!)

Desc.SourceString: Taygedo~taygedo~
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo, Taygedo!

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多，会带路，塔吉多，要直播。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo, lead the way. Taygedo, time to stream.)

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多，提前搜索，售卖机，一个不漏！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo will search ahead, and check every vending machine!)

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多考虑得真周全。
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo really thinks of everything.

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多~来搜索~塔吉多~要直播~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo! Time to search! Taygedo! Time to stream!)

Desc.SourceString: Taygedo~taygedo~
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo, Taygedo!

Desc.SourceString: （变身！逃走了！耍赖！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It changed forms! It escaped! Not fair!)

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲……也会变身。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa… can change forms too…

Desc.SourceString: （安魂曲，好酷！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Lacrimosa, so cool!)

Desc.SourceString: 抓紧了，电视机。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hold on tight, television.

Desc.SourceString: 我会赶来会合的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll be there soon.

Desc.SourceString: 海獭电视机，胖。
Desc.LocalizedString: Otter TV, heavy.

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲，不会跟丢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, will not let loose.
(DIzzy dizzy…)

Desc.SourceString: （鉴定师！这里！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Appraiser! Over here!)

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲小心，相比上次，它似乎更不稳定了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Be careful, Lacrimosa. It seems more unstable than last time…

Desc.SourceString: （翳，迟到！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Skia, late!)

Desc.SourceString: 他对安魂曲的事情也很担心的样子，或许是被太多工作绊住了……
Desc.LocalizedString: He seems worried about Lacrimosa too… Perhaps he's just tied up with work.

Desc.SourceString: （狗狗人，辛苦！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Doggo, tough job!)

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多，要有礼貌……
Desc.LocalizedString: Come on, Taygedo, mind your manners…

Desc.SourceString: （知道了！)
Desc.LocalizedString: (Okay!)

Desc.SourceString: 我们也回伊波恩吧，塔吉多。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's head back to Eibon, Taygedo.
(Let's go!)

Desc.SourceString: 这里是歧骸检查的地方，我还是不要进去了吧
Desc.LocalizedString: This is where they check on oddities. I should probably stay away.

Desc.SourceString: （呜呜，鉴定师，大好人！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Uwah… Appraiser, the nicest!)

Desc.SourceString: （番茄百分百……把它留给安魂曲也不错。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Tomato 100… Let's get some for Lacrimosa.)

Desc.SourceString: 好奇怪的童谣……怎么还有刽子手！
Desc.LocalizedString: What a weird nursery rhyme… Why's there even an executioner in it?!

Desc.SourceString: 卡伦小姐似乎是典当了自己的痛觉，以此来换取继续跳舞的机会。
Desc.LocalizedString: Miss Karen must have pawned away her sense of pain to keep dancing.

Desc.SourceString: 连葬礼都……这样实现愿望也值得吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Even going as far as a funeral… Is any wish worth that price?

Desc.SourceString: 这个户田一周过得也太忙了吧，周一得到爱情，周二失去爱情，周三又失去……呃头好痛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Geez, Toda's having such a rough week—finding love on Monday, losing it on Tuesday, and then losing something else on Wednesday… Ugh, my head hurts!

Desc.SourceString: 按照画上所说，户田在得到爱情后被分手了，周三的失去是因为户田典当了爱情，于是他在周四得到了爱人的消息。
Desc.LocalizedString: According to the painting, after Toda found love, they broke up. Then on Wednesday, he pawned away his love, which led to him receiving news about his lover on Thursday.

Desc.SourceString: 我完全理解了！所以周五的得到是指再次联系上了爱人，结果发现爱人竟然是传说中的「爱情诈骗犯」？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, I've got it all figured out! The Friday part must be about reconnecting with their lover, only to find out it's one of those infamous romance scams!

Desc.SourceString: 最终真相尽在「平安海特洛」，感谢热心市民户田……原来这是防诈宣传吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Find truth with "Safe Hethereau", thanks to our concerned citizen Toda… Wait, this whole thing was an anti-scam PSA?!

Desc.SourceString: 这个人竟然典当了自己的寿命？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait, she pawned off her own life?!

Desc.SourceString: 对于朝圣者来说，或许世界的真理比生命更加重要吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: For a pilgrim, perhaps the truth of this world means more than life itself.

Desc.SourceString: 麻雀猫头鹰乌鸦云雀红雀白鸽鸢鹪鹩画眉知更鸟……呼啊，这次又是一个什么故事？
Desc.LocalizedString: Sparrows, owls, crows, larks, cardinals, doves, kites, wrens, thrushes, robins… Yawn… Wonder what kind of story we're getting into this time?

Desc.SourceString: 等等，让我猜猜！这个自恋的家伙和镜子中的自己结婚了？可这个后半段……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hold on, let me guess! Did this narcissist end up marrying their own reflection? Although that last part…

Desc.SourceString: 典当视觉之后，道林无法再欣赏自己的模样，逐渐颓丧，连爱情也随着视觉一起消失了。
Desc.LocalizedString: After pawning away his sight, Dorian could no longer admire his own appearance. He gradually fell into despair, and his love vanished along with his vision.

Desc.SourceString: 但按照当铺的规矩，「典当契约生效后即为绝当，既无赎当，也无续当。」
Desc.LocalizedString: But according to the rules of the pawnshop, once a Pawn Contract takes effect, it becomes a Confirmation—no redemption, no renewal.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么每一个来典当的人都没什么好下场。
Desc.LocalizedString: Why does everyone who comes to pawn something end up with such a terrible fate?

Desc.SourceString: 通过月光当铺实现的愿望，有时付出的代价远比愿望本身更大。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sometimes, the price we pay at Pawn Moonlight far exceeds the value of the wish itself.

Desc.SourceString: 你的自我介绍还挺别致的嘛，看来这种场合对你还是太勉强了~
Desc.LocalizedString: That's a cute self introduction. You don't really fit in here.

Desc.SourceString: 这里本应该是有品味的人共同交流的地方，你又是从哪混进来的暴发户？
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a venue for tasteful exchange. How did a nouveau riche like you even get in?

Desc.SourceString: 今天的造型可是费心了，整个宴厅都亮堂了呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll admit—your outfit really LIGHTS up the room, almost trying too hard.

Desc.SourceString: 出价磕磕绊绊的，是嗓子不舒服么？小心别感冒咯。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're stuttering your bids. Sore throat? Don't catch a cold.

Desc.SourceString: 项链倒是不错，就是有些人的脑子像清仓货。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nice necklace, shame your brain came from the clearance bin.

Desc.SourceString: 这是为了展现专属定制和绅士风度，你、你懂什么！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's bespoke! You… you wouldn't understand!

Desc.SourceString: 下等人也敢挑战我，快点滚……咳，回到你的角落里待着吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: You piece of… Ahem… A vulgarian such as you really shouldn't be here.

Desc.SourceString: 闭、闭嘴！你这没品的暴发户！
Desc.LocalizedString: Shut up! You tasteless parvenu trash!

Desc.SourceString: 先陪你玩玩吧，喏……可别太快认输？
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll play along for now, here… Just don't fold too fast on me.

Desc.SourceString: 这点钱，不至于让你心疼到退出吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: This little bid won't break the bank, won't it?

Desc.SourceString: 莫非这件拍品，真正的能力是增发？
Desc.LocalizedString: Does this item regrow hair for you or something?

Desc.SourceString: 不知道这个价格能不能让你更好地彰显品味呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Wonder if this price tag screams refined taste for you.

Desc.SourceString: 认输？是什么给你自信这么和我说话！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fold? You? What gives you the gall to talk to me like that?!

Desc.SourceString: 可笑！我河田从来没心疼过钱？
Desc.LocalizedString: Tsk! Do I look like tightwad to you?

Desc.SourceString: 有品味的人只关注价值，不关注发量，暴发户你、你还差得远呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: True connoisseurs focus on value, not hairlines! You're leagues below me!

Desc.SourceString: 竟、竟敢故意抬我的价！你哔——哔——哔！
Desc.LocalizedString: Y-you dare to drive up my bids?! You fucking piece of shit, you hear me?!

Desc.SourceString: 出价小心些，到时候可不要因为赖账而被请去休息室喝茶啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: Better watch those bids—you don't know what happens to people that can't pay their bids.

Desc.SourceString: 别让你的存在污染了我的完美谢幕！离远点，脏东西！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't let your greasy presence contaminate my perfect finale! Shoo, vermin!

Desc.SourceString: 和穷酸的你同台竞拍真是拉低我的档次。
Desc.LocalizedString: Competing with the likes of you is a stain on my legacy.

Desc.SourceString: 嘴角卡粉了哦，人鱼大婶~
Desc.LocalizedString: You've got powder caked at the corners of your mouth, Auntie Fish.

Desc.SourceString: 演了这么久，真是辛苦了，给自己鼓个掌吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Bravo! That was a performance. Go ahead, clap for yourself!

Desc.SourceString: 喂？在吗？掉线了吗？为什么还不出价呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hellooo? You still there? Did your Wi-Fi die, or just your wallet?

Desc.SourceString: 今日拍卖会的聚光灯早已为我照亮，就让我以璀璨的步伐，一举拿下你吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: The spotlight was lit for me from the start! Let my brilliance end this farce!

Desc.SourceString: 让我优雅的将胜利收入囊中，见证完美谢幕吧，可怜虫！
Desc.LocalizedString: This victory shall be the perfect addition to my finale… Behold my grace, worm.

Desc.SourceString: 加价的幅度小得想让人递个放大镜，要不改成黯淡退场吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: That raise was so tiny I almost offered a magnifying glass.

Desc.SourceString: 你的浮夸和你的出价不太符哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Big talk, small bid. Doesn't quite match.

Desc.SourceString: 闹剧也该收场了……这宝贝，我拿下了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, that's enough circus for one night… This beauty's mine.

Desc.SourceString: 金钱美人鱼……谢幕……
Desc.LocalizedString: The Golden Mermaid's… finale…

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀哎呀，今天真可谓是~时来运转~诸事顺利~
Desc.LocalizedString: Such a wonderful night.

Desc.SourceString: 我们的老朋友来了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Our old friend has arrived…

Desc.SourceString: 看来传言并不假哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like the rumors were true.

Desc.SourceString: 传言的真实性倒是有待惠比寿揭晓，不过诸位的出现，倒也是一个新的讯号呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Ebisu will settle the truth about the rumors. Still, your presence here is quite the sign.

Desc.SourceString: 哦哦~可别算上我，我是来看热闹的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh no, don't count me in. I'm just here for the show.

Desc.SourceString: 不过你得小心喽，周围关注着你的，可不是什么简单的货色~
Desc.LocalizedString: But be careful now. Those keeping an eye on you aren't your average bunch.

Desc.SourceString: 那就希望今夜斯特利也会给诸位带来一些小、惊、喜。
Desc.LocalizedString: Then let's hope Sterry has a few… surprises… for everyone tonight.

Desc.SourceString: 祝你成功，九原小姐~
Desc.LocalizedString: Good luck, Miss Jiuyuan!

Desc.SourceString: 要来杯特调吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Care to try one of our specialty cocktails?

Desc.SourceString: 虽说巴克斯本身的风味就足以醉人，但是再加上一些青柠和冰块，也别有一番风味。
Desc.LocalizedString: Bacchus wines are plenty intoxicating, but toss in some lime and ice and they get a different profile.

Desc.SourceString: 坐在这个地方，总会让人想做点什么，消遣或者是寻找某种更深层次的东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just sitting here makes you want to do stuff—whether it's for killing time or chasing something deeper.

Desc.SourceString: 人到中年总有些絮絮叨叨，那我就不打扰您了，鉴定师，请便。
Desc.LocalizedString: People become rather chatty once they hit middle age. I'll leave you to yourself, Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 巴克斯、艾琳诺、艾谱利……
Desc.LocalizedString: Bacchus, Irenor, or Apri…

Desc.SourceString: 来点什么好呢？一瓶巴克斯，再来一瓶艾琳诺……
Desc.LocalizedString: What should I get? A bottle of Bacchus, and a bottle of Irenor…

Desc.SourceString: 是我们家的招财宝啊，快来快来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, it's our Precious! Come over here!

Desc.SourceString: 惠比寿既然这么大方，我们要是还客客气气的放不开，岂不是败了兴？
Desc.LocalizedString: Since Ebisu's so generous, wouldn't it kill the mood if we held back and acted all polite?

Desc.SourceString: 把这一桌，都打包起来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Pack up everything on this table!

Desc.SourceString: 客人……可能现在食用的话，口味会更丰富一些……
Desc.LocalizedString: Um, dear guest… the food would be better if you try it now…

Desc.SourceString: 好酒……好酒……
Desc.LocalizedString: Such wine… such wine…

Desc.SourceString: 干杯！干杯！
Desc.LocalizedString: Bottoms up!

Desc.SourceString: 唔……是上次的合作人……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… it's that person I worked with before…

Desc.SourceString: 她在和谁聊天呢……嘻嘻，要不过去偷听一下……
Desc.LocalizedString: Who could she be chatting with…? Hehe, maybe I should eavesdrop…

Desc.SourceString: 请问有什么可以帮您？
Desc.LocalizedString: How can I help you?

Desc.SourceString: 5杯弗洛拉……
Desc.LocalizedString: Five glasses of Ferora…

Desc.SourceString: 非常荣幸为您服务，即刻为您送到！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's my pleasure to serve you! I'll bring them right over!

Desc.SourceString: 唔……那个家伙已经比我领先3个客人了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh… that one's already ahead of me by three customers!

Desc.SourceString: 我得好好表现，可不能被比了下去！
Desc.LocalizedString: I gotta step up my game! I can't let be out-performed!

Desc.SourceString: 我将始终在此，为您效劳。
Desc.LocalizedString: I shall remain here, at your service.

Desc.SourceString: 一些点心……
Desc.LocalizedString: Some pastries…

Desc.SourceString: 已经为您安排好了，稍后便可享受。
Desc.LocalizedString: They will be ready in a moment for you to enjoy.

Desc.SourceString: 如果您有任何需求，请随时告知我。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you need anything more, please don't hesitate to let me know.

Desc.SourceString: 呼呼……哼。
Desc.LocalizedString: Heh… humph.

Desc.SourceString: 无礼的女人……
Desc.LocalizedString: Such an insolent woman…

Desc.SourceString: 不入流！
Desc.LocalizedString: Classless!

Desc.SourceString: 真来气！
Desc.LocalizedString: Infuriating!

Desc.SourceString: 可恶……下次！
Desc.LocalizedString: Curse you… Next time…

Desc.SourceString: 下次一定要让她好看！
Desc.LocalizedString: …next time, I'll make her pay!

Desc.SourceString: 咦？刚刚还在这里……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? Weren't they right here…?

Desc.SourceString: 惠比寿的点心都去哪了……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where did all of Ebisu's desserts go…?

Desc.SourceString: 难道没有准备餐点吗？不对……我刚刚明明有看到。
Desc.LocalizedString: Didn't they prepare food? Wait… I definitely just saw some.

Desc.SourceString: 惠比寿的规格……真是一次不如一次了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ebisu's standards… they keep getting lower and lower.

Desc.SourceString: 啧……看样子被什么人一口气拿走了，哪来的没见过世面穷鬼蹭吃蹭喝？
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch… Looks like someone grabbed them all. What uncultured freeloader crawled in here?

Desc.SourceString: 抱歉为您带来不便，我们马上重新布置！
Desc.LocalizedString: We apologize for the inconvenience. We'll rearrange everything immediately!

Desc.SourceString: 请不用担心，我们正在重新布置餐点，感谢您的耐心等候。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please don't worry. The food is being prepared right now. Thank you for your patience.

Desc.SourceString: 「咕咕」的鸣叫还在脑子里回响……
Desc.LocalizedString: The sound of cooing is still echoing in my mind…

Desc.SourceString: 直接提交
Desc.LocalizedString: Submit

Desc.SourceString: 看！刚拿到的签名。
Desc.LocalizedString: Look! I just got his autograph!

Desc.SourceString: 亲笔签名还有典藏海报！
Desc.LocalizedString: Autographed signatures and collector's posters!

Desc.SourceString: 呜呜~什么时候我也能排到。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sob… When will it ever be my turn?

Desc.SourceString: 即使没有拿到签名，光是听到西汀的音乐都让人很满足。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even without getting an autograph, just listening to Settyn's music is incredibly satisfying.

Desc.SourceString: 欸~可、可是，不会遗憾吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Eh!? B-but, won't you regret it?

Desc.SourceString: 那就再听一遍！
Desc.LocalizedString: Then I'll listen to it one more time!

Desc.SourceString: 什么！你不是本地人！
Desc.LocalizedString: No way! You're not local?!

Desc.SourceString: 我来自一个很远很远的地方……
Desc.LocalizedString: I came from a place far, far away…

Desc.SourceString: 赶来这里花了7天的时间。
Desc.LocalizedString: It took me seven days to get here.

Desc.SourceString: 这就是爱的力量！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, all the things we'd do for love!

Desc.SourceString: 晚上好，浔小姐、鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Good evening, Hotori, Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 晚上好，宴会已经开始了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Good evening. Has the banquet started yet?

Desc.SourceString: 按照这些老家伙们的做派，大概得再礼节性地攀谈一会，才有开始的可能呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Based on how these old-timers operate, I suppose we'll need to make some polite small talk first before we can actually get started!

Desc.SourceString: 距离正式开始还有一段时间，既然人到齐，浔小姐，鉴定师，这边请。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's still some time before we officially begin. Since everyone is here, Hotori, Appraiser, this way please.

Desc.SourceString: 可怜的家伙。
Desc.LocalizedString: Poor thing.

Desc.SourceString: 或许我们还需感谢那位先生，少一个人等候，我们也早些进入会场。
Desc.LocalizedString: Perhaps we should thank that gentleman as well. With one fewer person waiting, we can enter the venue sooner.

Desc.SourceString: 难得的「好心人」，走吧，可别辜负了他的好意。
Desc.LocalizedString: Such a rare, kind soul. Let's go, we shouldn't waste his generosity.

Desc.SourceString: 非常抱歉，先生。
Desc.LocalizedString: Terribly sorry, sir.

Desc.SourceString: 请稍等一下，我们正在进行核实。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please wait a moment, we are verifying your information.

Desc.SourceString: 请稍作等候，先生。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please wait a moment, sir.

Desc.SourceString: 晚上好，尊敬的客人，要来杯巴克斯吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Good evening, esteemed guest. Would you care for a glass of Bacchus?

Desc.SourceString: 好吃~
Desc.LocalizedString: So delicious!

Desc.SourceString: 哈尼娅……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Haniel…?

Desc.SourceString: 唔~被抓到了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh, busted!

Desc.SourceString: 快来尝尝，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come try some, Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 今天的餐点可都是由白贝壳三星主厨准备的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Today's meal was prepared by a La Palourde Blanche 3-Star Chef!

Desc.SourceString: 太好吃啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is absolutely delicious!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师！快来快来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser! Come quick, come quick!

Desc.SourceString: 你找鉴定师做什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: What do you want with the Appraiser?

Desc.SourceString: 不告诉你~略略略。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not telling you! Nyah nyah nyah.

Desc.SourceString: 切~谁稀罕！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch! As if I care!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师来我这里！有独家情报！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, over here! I've got exclusive intel!

Desc.SourceString: 学人精！那家伙只会跟我学！
Desc.LocalizedString: Copycat! That guy just keeps copying me!

Desc.SourceString: 这边，看！都是刚出炉的点心。
Desc.LocalizedString: Over here, look! All these pastries are fresh out of the oven.

Desc.SourceString: 嗨！这边！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey! Over here!

Desc.SourceString: 咳。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahem.

Desc.SourceString: 是我打翻的，正准备让她再准备一份。
Desc.LocalizedString: I knocked it over. I was just about to ask her to prepare another one.

Desc.SourceString: 看！刚拿到的签名。
Desc.LocalizedString: Look! I just got his autograph!

Desc.SourceString: 请稍作等候，先生。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please wait a moment, sir.

Desc.SourceString: 可可，跟我来吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Come on, Coco! Follow me!

Desc.SourceString: 不过还得走上好长一段路呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: But we've still got a long way to go!

Desc.SourceString: 不管上下班多少次，都还是会感叹……
Desc.LocalizedString: No matter how many times I clock in and out of work, I'm still amazed…

Desc.SourceString: 管理局真的好~大呀。
Desc.LocalizedString: The bureau is sooo huge!

Desc.SourceString: 这就是我的办公室啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: And here's my office!

Desc.SourceString: 欢迎可可参观我的工位~
Desc.LocalizedString: Welcome to my workstation, Coco!

Desc.SourceString: （那边的是……哈尼娅？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Is that… Haniel?)

Desc.SourceString: 哈尼娅是打工结束了过来的么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you just get off work, Haniel?

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼，为了准时过来我今天可是一通小宇宙爆发，把积压的单子统统提前清空了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm! I went full cosmic burst mode today—cleared out my whole backlog of deliveries early, just to make it here on time!

Desc.SourceString: 听上去很累，没想到你还有精力一个人跑来这里玩。
Desc.LocalizedString: That sounds exhausting… I'm surprised you still had the energy to come out and party solo.

Desc.SourceString: 啧啧啧，才这个点就要躺下的，只有简森哥那种「老年人」啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tsk tsk tsk—only "grandpas" like Jenson call it a night this early!

Desc.SourceString: 对我来说，娱乐就是最棒的回血手段了！
Desc.LocalizedString: For me? A good night of fun is the best way to recharge!

Desc.SourceString: （哈尼娅可真有活力……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (She really is a bundle of energy…)

Desc.SourceString: ~<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>~<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>~
Desc.LocalizedString: ~<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>~<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>~

Desc.SourceString: 呜哇！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow!

Desc.SourceString: 乖乖——在地底下啊！不错不错！我很中意这儿的设计！适合当个家族分部！
Desc.LocalizedString: Whoa—underground hideout vibes! Not bad, not bad! I like the setup. This place has real potential for a family branch office!

Desc.SourceString: 咦！这是什么……
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? What's this…?

Desc.SourceString: 之前这里有这张海报吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Was this poster always here?

Desc.SourceString: 嚯嚯——看起来很有趣啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hoho! Looks like something very interesting.

Desc.SourceString: 上次的演出……
Desc.LocalizedString: That live show…

Desc.SourceString: 可恶，明明很想去看的……
Desc.LocalizedString: Damn it… I really wanted to go to that show…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师！这里这里！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser! Over here!

Desc.SourceString: 那俩笨蛋……
Desc.LocalizedString: You little idiots…

Desc.SourceString: 别出事啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Please be okay!

Desc.SourceString: 笨蛋！等会再跟你们算账！
Desc.LocalizedString: You idiots! I'll deal with you later!

Desc.SourceString: 别上来，照顾好自——看好乐器！坏了，你们就死定了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't get close—just protect the gear! If it breaks, you're both dead!

Desc.SourceString: 哇，明音姐好酷啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Whoa, Akane is so cool right now!

Desc.SourceString: 我的灵感涌出来了，哈尼娅！
Desc.LocalizedString: Haniel! I feel inspiration rushing in!

Desc.SourceString: 我也是，娜娜莉！
Desc.LocalizedString: Me too, Nanally!

Desc.SourceString: 伴奏，起！我们来为这场战斗送上勇气的赞歌！
Desc.LocalizedString: Cue the backing track! Let's turn this into an anthem of courage!

Desc.SourceString: 看来她们完全没事……
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like they're totally fine…

Desc.SourceString: <!>TEST这就是异象证伪会吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this the TEST, the disproving of anomalies?

Desc.SourceString: <!>TEST我倒要看看是什么东西
Desc.LocalizedString: I'd like to see what TEST is.

Desc.SourceString: 先去「集山忘野」看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's check out Hillside Blooms first.

Desc.SourceString: 花店啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: The flower shop…

Desc.SourceString: 或许……去二手电器铺？
Desc.LocalizedString: Or maybe… the used electronics store?

Desc.SourceString: 这种地方真的会有适合做信物的东西吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not sure if this is the best place to look for a token…

Desc.SourceString: 反正就在附近，先去看看嘛。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's right around here, so let's just go take a look!

Desc.SourceString: 对了，潮玩店！那里应该有适合做信物的东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh right, the Pop Toys shop! They should have something perfect for a token.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，至少听起来比二手电器合适……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm, at least that sounds more appropriate than used electronics…

Desc.SourceString: （这辆车就是他们说的……「海特洛的午夜幽灵车神」？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (So this car is what they were calling… the Midnight Ghost Racer of Hethereau?)

Desc.SourceString: （「海特洛幽灵车神」吗……）
Desc.LocalizedString: ("Ghost Racer of Hethereau", huh…)

Desc.SourceString: （这辆车上并没有异象的气息。这样看，应当确实如他们所说，只是店主一辆普通的爱车。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (There's no trace of an Anomaly on this car. From the looks of it, it really is just the owner's ordinary beloved car, as they said.)

Desc.SourceString: （好浓郁的豆香。周围的顾客们似乎都很享受店主的手艺啊。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Such a rich, fragrant soybean aroma. The customers around me all seem to be thoroughly enjoying the shopkeeper's craftsmanship.)

Desc.SourceString: （但店主的表情……看上去，他好像有些心事？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (But the shopkeeper's expression… he seems to have something weighing on his mind.)

Desc.SourceString: （好了，尽快把豆腐送过去吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Alright, I'd better deliver this tofu as quickly as possible.)

Desc.SourceString: （要注意尽量开平稳些……毕竟豆腐易碎，这又是店主的爱车。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I should try to drive as smoothly as possible… after all, tofu is delicate, and this is the owner's prized car.)

Desc.SourceString: 开车一路过来，豆腐竟然一点都没碎……我们用小推车运这么一小段路都很难做到，真是精湛的车技啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: You drove all the way here without breaking any of the tofu…? We can barely manage that with our cart over a short distance. You got some mad driving skills!

Desc.SourceString: 好厉害！在这么狭窄的小路上穿梭，豆腐居然只掉了一些边角的碎渣……
Desc.LocalizedString: Amazing! You drove through a narrow path with only minor tears from the corners of the tofu…

Desc.SourceString: 啊，豆腐碎了一些……不过没关系，没什么影响。倒不如说，如果豆腐真能完好无损才不正常呢，哈哈！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, some of the tofu have tears… That's not a problem. If anything, it'd be unusual if the tofu were intact, ha!

Desc.SourceString: 哟，辛苦啦！给你准备了一份我最拿手的炸豆腐，趁热吃吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey there, nice work! I've prepared some of my specialty fried tofu for you—dig in while it's hot!

Desc.SourceString: （既然店主都这么说了，还是过去看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Since the shopkeeper insisted, I might as well go check it out.)

Desc.SourceString: ……怎么突然这么热血？
Desc.LocalizedString: …Why did things suddenly get so intense?

Desc.SourceString: 但愿豆腐不会烧焦……
Desc.LocalizedString: I hope the tofu doesn't burn…

Desc.SourceString: 座椅高度合适吗？要不要再调一下？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is the seat height good for you? Need adjustments?

Desc.SourceString: 别忘了系好安全带，安全第一！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't forget to buckle up! Safety first!

Desc.SourceString: 跑得不错嘛，这种风驰电掣的感觉——颇有我当年的风范啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Not bad driving! This sensation of lightning speed—it's quite reminiscent of my prime years!

Desc.SourceString: 专注看前方！这段路我可太熟悉了，按你的水平，闭着眼都比他开得快！
Desc.LocalizedString: Keep your eyes on the road! I know this stretch like the back of my hand—with your skills, you could outrun that guy with your eyes closed!

Desc.SourceString: 集中注意！接下来可是这条路上最难对付的一段！
Desc.LocalizedString: Focus up! You're about to hit the toughest section on this mountain pass!

Desc.SourceString: 剩下的，油门踩死就行咯！
Desc.LocalizedString: Now just floor it and go!

Desc.SourceString: 完美完赛！哈哈，胜利的滋味就是好啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Perfect finish! Haha, nothing beats the sweet taste of victory!

Desc.SourceString: （不会是出什么意外了吧……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I hope nothing bad happened…)

Desc.SourceString: （最好还是去店里看一眼。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I should probably go check on the shop.)

Desc.SourceString: （贴纸？记得输给那辆异象赛车的下场就是被贴上「败北贴纸」吧……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A sticker? If I remember correctly, losing to that anomaly race car means getting branded with a "Loser's Mark"…)

Desc.SourceString: （店里没有人。店主怎么不在店里？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The shop is empty. Where's the shopkeeper?)

Desc.SourceString: （记得店主好像住在这里……敲敲门吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I remember the shopkeeper lives here… I should knock on the door.)

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢惠顾，预祝您比赛顺利！
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you for your purchase. Best of luck with your race!

Desc.SourceString: （对了，也得和薄荷说一声。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Oh, I should probably give Mint a heads-up too.)

Desc.SourceString: （与「别让我停下！」竞速时，不能让其他车辆被卷入。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I can't risk other vehicles getting caught up in the race.)

Desc.SourceString: （准备都做好了，接下来就等比赛开始了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Just waiting for the race to happen should be enough for now)

Desc.SourceString: 比赛马上开始！三、二、一——出发！
Desc.LocalizedString: The race is about to begin! Three, two, one—GO!

Desc.SourceString: 这段直道，就该油门踩到底！
Desc.LocalizedString: On this straightaway, you've gotta floor it!

Desc.SourceString: 过弯后立刻上山，这里处理好，能和对手拉开不短的距离。
Desc.LocalizedString: After the turn, head straight uphill! If you nail this section, you can put some serious distance between you and your opponent!

Desc.SourceString: 哈哈，想当年，我可喜欢这么开了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Haha! Back in my day, I loved driving like this!

Desc.SourceString: 前面是二连发夹弯，要小心，要稳住！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coming up is a double hairpin! Be careful and keep it steady!

Desc.SourceString: 适当提速，准备漂移！
Desc.LocalizedString: Pick up the pace, get ready to drift!

Desc.SourceString: 拐过这个U型弯，之后就是全速冲线了！
Desc.LocalizedString: After you clear this U-turn, it's a full-throttle sprint to the finish line!

Desc.SourceString: 身后的引擎声……消失了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The engine sound behind me… it's gone.

Desc.SourceString: 去StarSign吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Guess I should head to StarSign.

Desc.SourceString: 不过，哈尼娅真的起得来吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Though… can Haniel really be up this early?

Desc.SourceString: （看来昨天确实是玩得够累，居然一觉睡到了现在……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Guess I really did get worn out yesterday… Slept straight through the morning.)

Desc.SourceString: （……这么多未读消息？都是哈尼娅的？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…Wait, all these unread messages? They're all from Haniel?!)

Desc.SourceString: 上传呗果啰~创建个新合集……就叫《天才吉他少女的进化之路》！
Desc.LocalizedString: Uploading to Bagel! New album time… let's call it "The Evolution of a Guitar Prodigy"!

Desc.SourceString: 哎哟……但是发出去的话……算啦，先屏蔽一下好了……省得伊里卡拿这个烦我……
Desc.LocalizedString: Aaaah… but if I post it now… Eh, better set it to private just in case. Don't want Illica pestering me about it…

Desc.SourceString: 等我进化完毕了再解除屏蔽，就这么定了……！
Desc.LocalizedString: Once I hit my final form, then I'll unhide it. Settled!

Desc.SourceString: 小屁孩真是呗果成瘾……
Desc.LocalizedString: She's got a full-blown Bagel addiction…

Desc.SourceString: 练习咯，哼哼哼~
Desc.LocalizedString: Practicing now, hummm—♪

Desc.SourceString: 这个家伙到底喜欢听什么啊！我们已经把会的曲目都换了一圈了！
Desc.LocalizedString: What the heck does this guy like?! We've cycled through every song we know!

Desc.SourceString: 呼、呼！要不是我的贝斯不能脱手的话……早把它揍扁了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Huff… Huff! If I didn't have this bass strapped to me I'd have punched its lights out by now!

Desc.SourceString: 我们给你再换一首最近新学的好不好，你先停手听一下啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's try one of the newer ones, okay? Just stop freaking out and listen for once!

Desc.SourceString: 你的品味、家底，配不上这里的任何一件东西！
Desc.LocalizedString: The spotlight here will never be yours!

Desc.SourceString: 烂酒鬼，我奉劝你识相点，不然——
Desc.LocalizedString: Filthy drunk. Watch your step, or—

Desc.SourceString: 兜里掏不出几个钱，在这丢人现眼！
Desc.LocalizedString: Can't cough up enough to matter, yet still here embarrassing yourself.

Desc.SourceString: 留下你的地址~我带上「家底」去探望你，希望你的家底够厚又耐拆哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Aha, of course, sweetheart. None would ever dare to take the spotlight away from your tiny shiny dome.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么？不是要在这里动粗吧？惠比寿的「贵客」们还真是有教养~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oooo, are we throwing hands now? Didn't expect this from a VIP in Ebisu!

Desc.SourceString: 咦？兜里又摸出1方斯呢，再加价1方斯~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh? Just found another Fons in my pocket. I'll do 1 Fons more!

Desc.SourceString: 可别付款的时候变成空气支票了！
Desc.LocalizedString: You better can afford this!

Desc.SourceString: 你数得清有几个零吗，不知道哪来的地摊老板！
Desc.LocalizedString: Can you even count your own zeroes? Who let this flea market merchant in?

Desc.SourceString: 要是脑子能折现，你的余额应该是……嗯……负的？
Desc.LocalizedString: If there's a balance to your brain, yours is… probably less than zero.

Desc.SourceString: 比起拍品更关心价格，是想靠这些零来撑自己的脸面？那我再帮你抬高点，不用谢我~
Desc.LocalizedString: You care more about numbers than the item itself? I'll help boost your ego alright—don't thank me!

Desc.SourceString: 才刚提起点兴致，我可没打算退场。
Desc.LocalizedString: And just when I was getting into it. No way I'm backing out now.

Desc.SourceString: 闹剧也该收场了……这宝贝，我拿下了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, that's enough circus for one night… This beauty's mine.

Desc.SourceString: 你这个暴发户、没品味、只会用钱砸人的……垃圾！！！啊！！
Desc.LocalizedString: You filthy, tasteless, money-flinging… GARBAGE! ARGHHH!!!!!

Desc.SourceString: 别伤心，骄傲碎了一地还能缝缝补补，至少你最喜欢的钱是一个子儿没少。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't cry. You can glue your pride back together. At least your precious money didn't suffer.

Desc.SourceString: 先热热身也好，可别输不起就缺氧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Gotta warm up somehow. Hope you don't pass out from shame.

Desc.SourceString: 你每天都这样自导自演吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You always direct and star in your own tantrums?

Desc.SourceString: 出价迟疑了呢？这点钱都拿不出来，早点谢幕算了~
Desc.LocalizedString: Hesitating already? If even this bid's too steep, why don't you quit early?

Desc.SourceString: 让我看看你的告别仪式价值多少~
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's see what your grand finale is worth.

Desc.SourceString: 华丽的谢幕总得有人当陪衬，你这蹩脚的插曲倒也勉强合格。
Desc.LocalizedString: A glamorous finale needs someone to outshine—and I guess your lousy cameo barely passes.

Desc.SourceString: 人们围绕我才知道什么叫存在感，而你，连空气都懒得理会。
Desc.LocalizedString: The crowd comes for me. You? You don't even register.

Desc.SourceString: 没有！胡说！加价！加价！加价！
Desc.LocalizedString: LIES! LIES! RAISE! RAISE! RAISE!

Desc.SourceString: 不过是个凑热闹的小丑！我、我才是今天宴会的主角！
Desc.LocalizedString: Just a meddling clown! I—I'm the star tonight!

Desc.SourceString: 这拍品，我可不会轻易撒手呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: This prize? I'm not letting go.

Desc.SourceString: （薯条兽，昨天把薯条给了那个人类！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Frizzle gave fries to that human yesterday!)

Desc.SourceString: （又找到了，领取薯条的人类！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Found another human who took my fries!)

Desc.SourceString: 欸，这不是薯条兽吗！没想到在这里还能遇到你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh, if it isn't the Frizzle! I never thought I'd run into you here!

Desc.SourceString: （抢走薯条，大坏蛋！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Stealing fries, big meanie!)

Desc.SourceString: （薯条兽，一定要抓住它！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Frizzle will catch it for sure!)

Desc.SourceString: （……现在也只有跟上薯条兽了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…I guess I'd better follow the Frizzle for now.)

Desc.SourceString: （找到了，薯条强盗！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Found you, fry thief!)

Desc.SourceString: （薯条兽看上去好像很寂寞。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The Frizzle looks like it's feeling lonely.)

Desc.SourceString: （或许……为它送上一份临别礼物，能让它打起精神？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Maybe… if I give it a parting gift, that might lift its spirits?)

Desc.SourceString: （嗯，去附近的咔叽玛看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Hmm, I should check out the Clicky store nearby.)

Desc.SourceString: 太阳下山了啊……嗯，回家吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: The sun's going down… I should head home now.

Desc.SourceString: （听刚刚那对老夫妻的说法，薯条兽的薯条味道确实很不错……有点想尝尝了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (From what that elderly couple just said, the Frizzle's french fries really do taste great… I'm kind of curious to try them now.)

Desc.SourceString: （希望薯条兽能从下一个调查对象那里，收到温柔的回复。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I hope Fry Beast gets a gentle response from their next investigation target.)

Desc.SourceString: （……薯条兽突然停下了。出什么事了？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…Frizzle suddenly stopped. What happened?)

Desc.SourceString: （薯条兽想去的地方……会是哪里呢？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (What kind of place would attract the Frizzle…?)

Desc.SourceString: （虽然能听懂歧骸的语言，可它们的想法有时候还是有些难懂啊。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Even though I can understand what oddities are saying, their way of thinking can still be pretty hard to figure out sometimes.)

Desc.SourceString: （如果是塔吉多想去的地方，倒是大概能猜到……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (If it was Taygedo… I could probably have a better guess…)

Desc.SourceString: 哈尼娅！
Desc.LocalizedString: Haniel!

Desc.SourceString: 是没听到吗……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did she not hear me…?

Desc.SourceString: 应该就是这个袋子吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: This must be the bag, right?

Desc.SourceString: 《特工Z世代》联名款……看起来没错。
Desc.LocalizedString: Gen Z collab style… looks like it is.

Desc.SourceString: 嘘，鉴定师，快过来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Shh, Appraiser, come here!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么神神秘秘的？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's with all the secrecy?

Desc.SourceString: 以埃德嘉的性格……他应该会待在更安静的二楼吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Knowing Edgar's personality… he's probably on the quieter second floor.

Desc.SourceString: Tayge——！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tayge——!

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多，手机掉了！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo dropped the phone!)
Oh…

Desc.SourceString: 从我之前的一些了解来看，把空间弄得四分五裂的水流，象征着作家们癫狂的意识和思路。
Desc.LocalizedString: From what I've gathered, the currents fracturing this space represent the spiraling thoughts and frenzied minds of the writers.

Desc.SourceString: 难怪说艺术家们都是疯子……这抽象的行为还真是让人难以理解。
Desc.LocalizedString: No wonder they say all artists are crazy… I just can't wrap my head around this weird stuff.

Desc.SourceString: 或许是你太笨啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe you're too dumb to get it!

Desc.SourceString: 咳，总之，这些分割空间的水流，都是从一扇扇「门」中流出来的，我们得想办法把这些门关上。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahem, anyway, the currents dividing the space are all pouring out of "doors." We need to find a way to shut them.

Desc.SourceString: 看样子可不太容易~
Desc.LocalizedString: It might be more difficult than it seems.

Desc.SourceString: 这些团状物大概是作家们仅存的「理性」……看看能对它们做些什么吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: These blobs might be all that's left of the writers' rationality… Let's see what we can do with them.

Desc.SourceString: 看来有削弱哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like they're getting weaker.

Desc.SourceString: 好像什么东西生气了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Something just got mad…

Desc.SourceString: 别一惊一乍的，快走吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop freaking out. Let's move.

Desc.SourceString: 乱流平静了些，有效果了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The turbulence is calming down. It's working.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么突然看不清了，还有些奇怪的声音……
Desc.LocalizedString: Why is everything suddenly blurry? What's with these weird noises…

Desc.SourceString: 看来顺应作者的癫狂思路，也会影响到我们的感官和认知，都谨慎些。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like the crazier the writer's mind, the more it messes with our senses. Stay sharp.

Desc.SourceString: 如果感觉身体不适，记得早点告诉我，可别硬撑，鉴定师也是。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you're not feeling well, speak up early. Don't push yourself. That goes for the Appraiser too.

Desc.SourceString: 出现了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's here.

Desc.SourceString: 是回转门外的伴生歧骸。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's a Surge Oddity from Outside the Inner Door.

Desc.SourceString: 看起来好像没什么恶意。
Desc.LocalizedString: Doesn't seem hostile, at least not yet.

Desc.SourceString: 不过有些不太友好呢，提高警惕哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: It also doesn't look friendly. Let's stay alert.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么还偷袭啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey! Not cool?!

Desc.SourceString: 呃……我刚刚破坏了一个理性团，这些家伙好像生气了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Uh… I just destroyed a rationality blob. They look angry.

Desc.SourceString: 那就只能大战一场了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Then I guess it's time for a fight!

Desc.SourceString: 哈呼以！修拉呼啦！美少女变身！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hahuie! Shulahula! Magical girl transformation!

Desc.SourceString: 酒店的大门原来藏在这，嘿嘿，岂不是可以直接溜走？！
Desc.LocalizedString: So the hotel entrance was hidden here, huh? Hehe… maybe I can sneak out?!

Desc.SourceString: 欸——！逃跑计划泡汤了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Eh—! So much for that escape plan…

Desc.SourceString: 老实点吧你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Be good, will you?!

Desc.SourceString: 略略略！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nyeh nyeh nyeh!

Desc.SourceString: 过不去了……嗯？既然能改变空间要不帮帮忙？比如在这里搭一个桥？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can't get across… hmm? If space can shift, how about building us a bridge here?
(Bridge…)

Desc.SourceString: 酷！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nice!

Desc.SourceString: 我可以申请打开降噪模式吗？呜~好吵啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Can I turn on noise-canceling mode? Ugh, it's so loud!

Desc.SourceString: 小心脚下！
Desc.LocalizedString: Watch your step!

Desc.SourceString: 看这周围的样子，好像也不是很欢迎我们安抚它……
Desc.LocalizedString: From the looks of it, I don't think it wants to be calmed down…

Desc.SourceString: 感觉更棘手了……
Desc.LocalizedString: This just got a whole lot trickier…

Desc.SourceString: 计划有变，直接破坏掉好了~
Desc.LocalizedString: New plan—let's destroy it!

Desc.SourceString: 只能这样了。
Desc.LocalizedString: There is no other way.

Desc.SourceString: 欸~现在感觉，这四分五裂的空间还蛮艺术的嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Eh! You know, this fractured space is kinda artistic after all!

Desc.SourceString: 呵，等这玩意扩散到整个海特洛市，把你收藏的《特工Z世代》场贩限定海报也切割的四分五裂，你还觉得艺术吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Heh, wait until this thing spreads across all of Heathreau and cuts your limited edition Gen Z Poster to shreds. Would that still be artistic?

Desc.SourceString: 喂！你到底是猫头鹰还是乌鸦啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, did you know you're more of a jinx than an owl?

Desc.SourceString: 我知道这水从哪来的了！嘿嘿，一定是来自伊里卡的论文里！
Desc.LocalizedString: Heh, I know where this water is from! It's from the water-downed filler chapters of Illica's thesis!

Desc.SourceString: 哇！你在呗果写的小说难道就不水吗！据我所知，小说的原型是……唔……九原姐……我要……举报……
Desc.LocalizedString: Woah! Don’t tell me your Bagel novel isn't just one big puddle of plot holes! Pretty sure your MC is based on… Jiuyuan? I’m gonna… snitch…

Desc.SourceString: 哈尼娅，事情结束后，我们可得好好聊聊~
Desc.LocalizedString: Haniel, let's have a little chat after this is over.

Desc.SourceString: 呜~是，九原姐。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oooh… Yes, Jiuyuan…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 我来了，进去看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm here. Let's go in and take a look.

Desc.SourceString: 看起来，是店长在担心，达芙蒂尔出去了很久还没回来……
Desc.LocalizedString: It seems the owner is worried that Daffodill's been gone for a long time without returning…

Desc.SourceString: 她应该是去买解酒药了，去附近的药店找找吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: She's probably gone to buy a hangover remedy. Let's check the pharmacy nearby.

Desc.SourceString: 伊波恩附近的药店，也就只有这一家了。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's only this one pharmacy around Eibon.

Desc.SourceString: ……不在吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: …Not here?

Desc.SourceString: 离这里最近的药店……是在火炬木大道附近。
Desc.LocalizedString: The nearest pharmacy… is around Torchwood Avenue.

Desc.SourceString: 时间不早了，赶紧去那里看看吧……等天黑了就更难找人了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's getting late. I should hurry over there… It'll be even harder to find anyone once it gets dark.

Desc.SourceString: 夜晚的城市还是有点冷啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: The city does get a bit chilly at night…

Desc.SourceString: 靠近楼房的地方，会温暖一点。
Desc.LocalizedString: It is warmer near the buildings.

Desc.SourceString: 连这点细微的差别也能感受到吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You can even sense such subtle differences?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，习惯了就可以。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, one adapts with time.

Desc.SourceString: 周围好安静啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's so quiet around here.

Desc.SourceString: 有点好奇，你刚才说了其他感官……在这样的环境里，能靠听觉辨认方向吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm curious, you mentioned other senses… Can you use your hearing to navigate in an environment like this?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，习惯了就可以。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, one adapts with time.

Desc.SourceString: 比如风吹过植被的声音，脚步在墙壁上的回音。偶尔能听到楼里的交谈声。
Desc.LocalizedString: Such as the sound of wind passing through vegetation, the echo of footsteps against walls. Occasionally, I can hear conversations from inside buildings…

Desc.SourceString: 完全注意不到……
Desc.LocalizedString: I wouldn't notice any of that…

Desc.SourceString: 你不跟他们说明情况，就这样自己默默做这些事吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: So you're just quietly handling all this without telling them what happened?

Desc.SourceString: 说这说那的好麻烦。
Desc.LocalizedString: All this talking is such a pain.

Desc.SourceString: 而且事情能解决就行了，知不知道的都无所谓。
Desc.LocalizedString: Besides, as long as the problem gets fixed, it doesn't matter who knows about it.

Desc.SourceString: ……感觉比起娜娜莉，你更像是老大。
Desc.LocalizedString: …You seem more like the boss than Nanally does.

Desc.SourceString: 喂喂，这话别让娜娜莉听到！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, hey! Don't let Nanally hear you say that!

Desc.SourceString: 要让她知道了又得念叨半天什么一把手二把手的，有得烦呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: If she finds out, she'll lecture me forever about who's really in charge. That would be such a pain…

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉……
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally…

Desc.SourceString: 红蔷薇，白蔷薇，
Desc.LocalizedString: Red roses, white roses,

Desc.SourceString: 三个花盆高高堆。
Desc.LocalizedString: Three pots stacked to the sky.

Desc.SourceString: 红房子，白围墙，
Desc.LocalizedString: Red houses, white walls,

Desc.SourceString: 我们来玩捉迷藏。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hide and seek, shall we try?

Desc.SourceString: 衣柜里，床底下，
Desc.LocalizedString: In closets, under beds,

Desc.SourceString: 妈妈找不到我啦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mother won't find me today.

Desc.SourceString: 秋千啊，晃呀晃，
Desc.LocalizedString: The swing rocks back and forth,

Desc.SourceString: 妈妈快快回来吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mother, please don't stay away.

Desc.SourceString: （那个黑影给人的感觉很奇怪，还是不要直接闯进去了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: I have a strange feeling about that shadow. Better not barge in.

Desc.SourceString: （钨丝先生说「这里」存在两个世界，换个角度看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: Tungsten said two worlds exist here. Let's try a different perspective.

Desc.SourceString: 就是这里，快二十年未见，这里倒是变化不大。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here we are. It's been almost twenty years, but it hasn't changed much.

Desc.SourceString: 呼——熟悉的味道，只是站在这里就觉得变年轻了呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah… that familiar smell. Just standing here makes me feel young again.

Desc.SourceString: 不管别的，先单纯逛逛公园如何？
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's take a simple stroll around the park, shall we?

Desc.SourceString: 这些健身器材小孩子都不爱玩，上面总会长出被子来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Kids never want to play on this exercise equipment. They tend to be covered in blankets.

Desc.SourceString: 小时候总觉得滑梯很高也很长，现在看原来这么矮啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: As a kid, I always thought this slide was tall and long. Looking at it now, it's actually pretty short.

Desc.SourceString: 啊，现在的我可坐不进这个摇椅了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, there's no way I could fit in this chair anymore.

Desc.SourceString: 这个秋千居然还在！
Desc.LocalizedString: I can't believe the swing is still here!

Desc.SourceString: 我小时候经常来这个公园玩，秋千最受小朋友欢迎了，可惜整个公园里就这个一个。
Desc.LocalizedString: I used to come here all the time as a kid. The swing was the most popular equipment among us. Too bad the park only had one.

Desc.SourceString: 大家只能排好队，一个人上去推十下，大家一起数到十就换下一个人。
Desc.LocalizedString: We lined up and took turns. Each of us got ten pushes. We all counted to ten before the next kid got their turn.

Desc.SourceString: 一直玩到父母找过来，还因为没玩够哭闹着不肯回家。
Desc.LocalizedString: We would keep playing until our parents came looking for us, and make a fuss because we wanted to play more.

Desc.SourceString: 后来我们家院子里也建了一个，我想玩多久就能玩多久。
Desc.LocalizedString: Later on, we built one in our own yard at home, so I could play for as long as I wanted.

Desc.SourceString: 你的父母很爱你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your parents loved you.

Desc.SourceString: 是啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah…

Desc.SourceString: 我似乎有些不错的灵感了，再往前走走吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm getting some good inspiration. Let's keep walking.

Desc.SourceString: 这里什么时候新开了一家花店，我记得原本这里是家书店。
Desc.LocalizedString: When did this flower shop open? There used to be a bookstore in this spot.

Desc.SourceString: 也是，这么多年换了店面也很正常，说起来院子里也该种些花。
Desc.LocalizedString: I guess it's normal for shops to change after many years. Come to think of it, I should plant some flowers in the yard.

Desc.SourceString: 不如你帮我挑一些花吧，我相信你的审美。
Desc.LocalizedString: Why don't you help me pick out some flowers? I trust your taste.

Desc.SourceString: 我来选吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Me? Sure I should pick them?

Desc.SourceString: 我对种花还算有些研究，所以随意挑选就好。
Desc.LocalizedString: I know a thing or two about flowers. Feel free to pick whatever you like.

Desc.SourceString: 秋千，蔷薇……那首童谣里唱到过蔷薇，把蔷薇花带回去吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Swings, roses… that nursery rhyme mentioned roses. Let's get roses.

Desc.SourceString: 桔梗似乎和院子的氛围不太合适，看看别的花吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: The balloon flowers don't seem to match the yard. Let me take a look at other flowers.

Desc.SourceString: 很清新的绿植，不过帕蒂女士似乎想要的是花朵？
Desc.LocalizedString: A fresh green plant. Ms. Patty wants flowers though.

Desc.SourceString: 这应该是蔷薇……玫瑰……原来是月季吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: This should be a wild rose… or a rose… wait, it's an oriental rose?

Desc.SourceString: 这类盆栽并不适合在庭院内种植，换一种看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: These potted plants aren't suitable for a yard. Let me try to find something else.

Desc.SourceString: 这类盆栽并不适合在庭院内种植，换一种看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: These potted plants aren't suitable for a yard. Let me try to find something else.

Desc.SourceString: 让我看看，你选了什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Let me see, what did you pick?

Desc.SourceString: 这是……蔷薇花的种子？
Desc.LocalizedString: These are… wild rose seeds?

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢你！我很喜欢蔷薇。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you! I love wild roses!

Desc.SourceString: 蔷薇花有什么特殊含义吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do wild roses have any special meaning?

Desc.SourceString: 不……算不上什么特殊，只是因为这种花爬上院子的围墙很好看。
Desc.LocalizedString: No… nothing that special. It's just that they look pretty when they grow up on the fence.

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢你，我很喜欢你挑选的花。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you, I like the flowers you picked.

Desc.SourceString: 出来逛了有一会了，要去我家坐坐吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: We've been out for a while now. Why don't you come over to my place?

Desc.SourceString: 这个时候正适合来点下午茶，也感谢你带来的花种很符合我的心意。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a great time for afternoon tea. I also want to thank you for selecting a flower I like.

Desc.SourceString: 那就打扰了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sounds good.

Desc.SourceString: 妈妈，今天讲什么故事呀？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mom, what story are you going to tell today?

Desc.SourceString: 不要不要，这个故事我都会背了。
Desc.LocalizedString: No, I can recite this story already!

Desc.SourceString: 换一个没听过的新故事好不好？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can't you tell me a new story?

Desc.SourceString: 唉，要是有一本新的故事书就好了，我的朋友们最近都在看《狐狸的秋千》。
Desc.LocalizedString: If only we had a new storybook. My friends have all been reading "The Fox and the Swing."

Desc.SourceString: 要是有一本新的故事书就好了，是不是呀，妈妈？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mom, we just need a new storybook, don't we?

Desc.SourceString: 妈妈我好喜欢这个故事，明天再讲一遍好吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mom, I really love this story! Can you tell it again tomorrow?

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢妈妈，妈妈真好。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you, Mom. You're the best!

Desc.SourceString: 不要不要不要！不要去上学！
Desc.LocalizedString: No, no, no! I don't want to go to school!

Desc.SourceString: 真的会有礼物吗？可以现在就给我吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: A gift? Can I have it right now?

Desc.SourceString: 我一定会乖乖听课的！拜托拜托……
Desc.LocalizedString: I promise I'll be good and listen in class! Please…

Desc.SourceString: 好耶！这样我的红色小熊就有一样的伙伴了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Yay! Now my red teddy bear has a matching friend!

Desc.SourceString: 哇！谢谢妈妈！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow! Thank you, Mom!

Desc.SourceString: 对不起妈妈……今天早上我闹脾气了，以后就算没有礼物我也会乖乖上学的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sorry, Mom… I threw a tantrum this morning. I'll go to school like a good kid even if there are no gifts.

Desc.SourceString: 好哦好哦，我们拉钩。
Desc.LocalizedString: Okay, okay, pinky promise!

Desc.SourceString: 面粉、鸡蛋、牛奶……要放多少糖呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Flour, eggs, milk… how much sugar should I add?

Desc.SourceString: 呜……柠檬好酸，真的要放进去吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh… lemons are so sour, do I really have to use them?

Desc.SourceString: 蛋糕原来这么难做……不行不行，我一定要做出来送给妈妈当生日礼物！
Desc.LocalizedString: Baking a cake is so hard! I can' give up… I'm going to make a cake for my Mom's birthday!

Desc.SourceString: 要是能知道妈妈做蛋糕的配方就好了……
Desc.LocalizedString: If I had Mom's recipe…

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼，这可是我自己做的哦！妈妈你快尝尝！绝对跟你做的一模一样！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe, I made this all by myself! Mom, give it a try! It definitely tastes the same as yours!

Desc.SourceString: 嘿嘿……我也要吃！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fufufu… I want some too!

Desc.SourceString: 好甜QAQ
Desc.LocalizedString: So sweet…!

Desc.SourceString: 好！下次我们一起做蛋糕。
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course! Let's bake a cake together next time.

Desc.SourceString: 我想在这里画一个秋千可以吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can I paint a swing here?

Desc.SourceString: 太棒啦！跟公园里一样的秋千！
Desc.LocalizedString: Great! It's just like the swing in the park!

Desc.SourceString: 我还想要一些漂亮的花，房子画成什么颜色的呢……想不出来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I also want pretty flowers, but what color should the house be? I can't think of any…

Desc.SourceString: 院子……是什么样子的呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: The yard… what should it look like…?

Desc.SourceString: 当当当！完成啦！妈妈快看快看！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ta-da! All done! Mom, look, look!

Desc.SourceString: 设计……师？哇，那我长大后要成为最厉害的设计师！
Desc.LocalizedString: Architect…? Woah, when I grow up, I want to become the best architect! Ever!

Desc.SourceString: 等秋千做好了，我们一起玩哦！拉钩……
Desc.LocalizedString: Once the swing is ready, we'll play together! Pinky promise…

Desc.SourceString: 那是我们最喜欢的故事，小狐狸和妈妈一起在桔梗花田里荡秋千。
Desc.LocalizedString: That was our favorite story, about the little fox and mom swinging together in the bellflower field.

Desc.SourceString: 一遍又一遍，直到梦里都开满蓝色的桔梗花。
Desc.LocalizedString: Over and over again, until even our dreams bloomed with blue bellflowers.

Desc.SourceString: 我多想再为你讲一次这个故事。
Desc.LocalizedString: How I wish I could tell you this story one more time.

Desc.SourceString: 我们都遵守了约定，就算没有礼物也会乖乖上学。
Desc.LocalizedString: We all kept our promise, going to school like a good kid even without receiving any gifts.

Desc.SourceString: 就算没有我……也一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even without me… it's all the same.

Desc.SourceString: 那是我吃过最甜的蛋糕，甜到我们把家里的水都喝光了。
Desc.LocalizedString: That was the sweetest cake I ever had. It's so sweet, we drank all the water in the house.

Desc.SourceString: 甜到在我最后的那段时间里，依旧会想起那个味道。
Desc.LocalizedString: So sweet, that even in my final days, I still remembered the taste.

Desc.SourceString: 希望……小帕蒂以后也能继续开心地吃蛋糕。
Desc.LocalizedString: I hope… my dear Patty can have her cakes as delicious as ever…

Desc.SourceString: 对不起……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sorry…

Desc.SourceString: 对不起，帕蒂……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sorry, Patty…

Desc.SourceString: 没有能看着你成为最厉害的设计师。
Desc.LocalizedString: I wasn't able to see you become the most amazing architect.

Desc.SourceString: 为什么还不离开？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why won't you leave?

Desc.SourceString: 为什么要留下我？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why did you leave me alone?

Desc.SourceString: 离开这里！
Desc.LocalizedString: Get out of here!

Desc.SourceString: 离开这里！
Desc.LocalizedString: Get out of here!

Desc.SourceString: 你和「她」都离开这里！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: You and "her" both need to get out!!!

Desc.SourceString: 帕蒂女士？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ms. Patty?

Desc.SourceString: 帕蒂女士，这里有你的一封信。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ms. Patty, there's a letter for you.

Desc.SourceString: 一封信？
Desc.LocalizedString: A letter?

Desc.SourceString: 这是来自你母亲的信。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a letter from your mother.

Desc.SourceString: 要看看吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Would you like to read it?

Desc.SourceString: 不！
Desc.LocalizedString: No!

Desc.SourceString: 不……多谢您，还是……给我吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: No… thank you, but… please give it to me.

Desc.SourceString: 母亲啊，这是你给我讲的最后一个故事吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Mother… is this the last story you'll ever tell me…?

Desc.SourceString: 离别是那样的痛苦，就算是到了现在，我都抗拒去想起那段时间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Saying goodbye was so painful, even until now, I resist thinking back to those times.

Desc.SourceString: 只要看到和她相关的东西，甚至这个家里每一处地方，我都能想象出她的样子，她的话语。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just seeing anything related to her, even every corner of this house, I can picture her face and hear her voice.

Desc.SourceString: （呲溜——呲溜——）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Slurp… slurp…)

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢小雪人！
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you, little Snowman!

Desc.SourceString: 今年海特洛热得像个炉子，要不是你舔舐发烫的车座，我都不敢出远门。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hethereau has been as hot as an oven. I am only able to travel far because you licked my scorching seats!

Desc.SourceString: 冰淇淋都送给你！希望你吃得开心！
Desc.LocalizedString: All my ice cream is yours! Hope you enjoy it!

Desc.SourceString: 帕噜噜噜！！！（呀嘿——给帕活过来呀——帕噜！）
