Desc.LocalizedString: Puff puff puff! (Hyaa! Wake up! Don't sleep on Puff!)

Desc.SourceString: 发，发生什么事了？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wh-what just happened?

Desc.SourceString: （客户，记得帮帕拍照！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Remember to take pictures of Puff!)

Desc.SourceString: （猫丸味增拉面~大量猫毛里的少量拉面~喵呜呜呜~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Nekomaru miso ramen! Lots of cat hair and much less noodles! Meow-wow-wow!)

Desc.SourceString: （猫丸味增拉面~鲜到想挠墙的拉面~帕噜噜噜~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Nekomaru miso ramen! It's so tasty, it's wall-scratching tasty! Puuuufffff!)

Desc.SourceString: （帕噜——客户！好拉风的冷冻车！快，帕要跟它合影~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Puff! What a cool refrigerated truck! Quick, Puff wants a picture with it!)

Desc.SourceString: （好冷啊！吸溜~吸溜~，用这条带鱼做帕的新围巾怎么样？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (So cold! Slurp, slurp! Puff wants to wear this cutlassfish as a scarf!)

Desc.SourceString: 小帕，别在车厢里滚来滚去……我开车会分心的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Puff, stop rolling around in the back… it's distracting.

Desc.SourceString: （帕开心嘛~来海特洛以后，帕还没有像现在这样，待在这么有「安全感」的地方过呢。简直像睡在雪山肚子里一样「安心」。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (But Puff is happy! Puff has never been at a safer place since arriving at Hethereau! It's like sleeping in the belly of a snowy mountain, so peaceful!)

Desc.SourceString: 一直没问过你，之前生活很辛苦吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: I never asked you before, but life was pretty tough for you, wasn't it?

Desc.SourceString: （总有满头大汗的路人偷偷靠近帕，突然咬一口帕的屁股！哇！坏蛋！雪人的屁股不能吃啦！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (There are always sweaty people who sneak up and take a bite out of my butt! Hey meanies, you can't eat a Snowman's butt!)

Desc.SourceString: ……嗯。也许是好奇帕是什么「口味」的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… maybe they're curious about your flavor?

Desc.SourceString: （反正屁股那里是榴莲味。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Well, my butt is durian flavor.)
Oh…

Desc.SourceString: （刚开始，帕不知道怎么收集冷气，身无分文，肚子饿饿，就去许愿池捞硬币，但帕是冰淇淋体质耶，一碰水就化掉了。气！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (At first, Puff didn't know how to collect cold air. Puff was broke and hungry, and had to collect pennies from the wishing pool. Puff has an ice cream body and melts in water. So frustrating!)

Desc.SourceString: 那真的很惨了，雪生走不了捷径。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's rough. It's not easy for a Snowman like you.

Desc.SourceString: 不过帕很坚强呢。从来不哭，笑容灿烂又治愈，大家都有被鼓励到。
Desc.LocalizedString: But you're really strong, Puff. You never cry, and your bright smile encourages and heals everyone around you.

Desc.SourceString: （帕不敢哭，遇水会融化啦！帕噜。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Puff doesn't dare cry! Puff will melt in water! Puff!)

Desc.SourceString: ……辛苦了。
Desc.LocalizedString: That must be difficult.

Desc.SourceString: （帕也不敢睡觉，睡着了，万一咔叽玛里，有人偷偷用帕的屁股蘸薯条呢？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Puff can't sleep either! What if someone in Clicky tries to dip their French fries in Puff's durian ice cream?)

Desc.SourceString: 你现在可以依赖我，安心睡一觉吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: You can rely on me now. Go get some sleep.

Desc.SourceString: （呜哇——客户好讨厌，这下帕要哭啦！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Waaah! Puff is gonna cry!)

Desc.SourceString: 车厢里时不时传来小帕的轻鼾……呃，重鼾。听不到导航语音了。凭感觉开吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: I hear Puff's light snoring… umm, heavy snoring, from the passenger seat. I can't hear the GPS anymore. Guess I'll just have to drive with my instinct…

Desc.SourceString: （zzZz……ZZZz……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (zzZz… ZZZz…)

Desc.SourceString: （夏刑草嗯呜……等帕救嗯嘛嘛嘛……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Solifugae Vita… mmph… gotta save… mmm…)

Desc.SourceString: 在说什么梦话？
Desc.LocalizedString: What are you mumbling about?

Desc.SourceString: （哎呀呀，帕的头。磕得好痛！客户倒是开稳点。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Ow ow ow, Puff's head! That really hurt! Could you drive more carefully?)

Desc.SourceString: 醒了？那就聊聊天吧，一个人开车有点无聊。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're awake? Let's chat a bit. Driving by myself is boring.

Desc.SourceString: 现在可以告诉我了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can you tell me now?

Desc.SourceString: 这么努力地收集冷气。
Desc.LocalizedString: Working so hard to collect cold air.

Desc.SourceString: 是为了什么……才想在夏天降下一场雪？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why do you want to make it snow in summer?

Desc.SourceString: （zzzz~zzzz~zzzz~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (zzzz…zzzz…zzzz…)

Desc.SourceString: 开始装睡了，看来还是不想回答。
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh, pretending to sleep. Seems like you still don't want to answer.

Desc.SourceString: （要去卜多力小屋了吗？帕噜噜噜，好怀念！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Are we going to Budoriya? Oh Puff, so nostalgic!)

Desc.SourceString: （说起来，之前帕和友人流浪的时候，还被千代婆婆收留过一阵子呢。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Come to think of it, when Puff was wandering around with a friend, Granny Chiyo took us in for a while.)

Desc.SourceString: （千代婆婆专门购置了一台冰箱，给帕做小床，卜多力也每天给帕做冷食吃。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Granny Chiyo bought Puff a refrigerator as a little bed, while Budori fed Puff cold food every day.)

Desc.SourceString: （不过卜多力似乎有点高度近视？总是把帕的脸当成饭团，在手心里捏来捏去。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Budori seems to be nearsighted though? Always mistook Puff's face for a rice ball and kept squishing Puff around.)

Desc.SourceString: （啊啊……卜多力是章鱼，手手又很多。帕的脸，每天扁扁。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Ah… Budori is an octopus with many hands. Puff's face got squished flat every day.)

Desc.SourceString: （真怀念啊，那样灯火通明，客人们的啤酒花相继撞出来的日子。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Puff really misses those days… The place all lit up, with beer glasses clanking into each other.)

Desc.SourceString: 那为什么还要离开卜多力小屋，继续去流浪呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why did you leave Budoriya to wander around?

Desc.SourceString: （帕有不得不去做的事。帕噜。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Puff had something Puff had to do.)

Desc.SourceString: （噗噜 噗噜噜 ~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Puffupuffupuffupuffu…)

Desc.SourceString: 帕开始唱歌了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Puff started singing…

Desc.SourceString: （不同季节  跳起同一支舞 ）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Across the seasons, we danced cheek to cheek.)

Desc.SourceString: （地轴倾转瞬间 舞步终将重叠 ）
Desc.LocalizedString: (When the Earth takes a tilt, our steps will then meet.)

Desc.SourceString: （月光小船划破银雪……  ）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A moonlight boat glides on silver snow…)

Desc.SourceString: 耳塞呢？？我的降噪耳塞呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Where are my noise-canceling earbuds…?

Desc.SourceString: （哼！客户太小瞧帕了。帕也是参加过livehouse的！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Hey! Don't look down on Puff! Puff has been to a livehouse before!)

Desc.SourceString: 你是乐手？还是观众？
Desc.LocalizedString: As a musician or an audience?

Desc.SourceString: （呃……问这么细干嘛！帕当然是去打工的……就是当氛围造雪机啦！往人群里噗噗放冷气的，帕噜。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Ugh, why ask so many questions? Puff was there for work… as an atmospheric snow machine! Just puffing cold air into the crowd! Puff!)

Desc.SourceString: 帕的生活经历很丰富呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: You've really been through a lot!

Desc.SourceString: （当然，帕和友人一起走过很多地方。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Of course! Puff went to many places with Puff's friend.)

Desc.SourceString: 但可以的话……可以先不唱吗。我在开车，没手捂耳朵呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: But if possible… can you not sing right now? I can't cover my ears when I'm driving.

Desc.SourceString: （什么？客户你说什么？帕在车厢里，听——不——见——）
Desc.LocalizedString: (What? What did you say? Puff is in the back of the car and can't—hear—you!)

Desc.SourceString: （ ~噗噜 噗噜噜 ~）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Puffupuffupuffupuffu!)

Desc.SourceString: 好的。坐稳了，海特洛车神要加速了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hold on tight, the God Racer of Hethereau is about to speed up.

Desc.SourceString: （呀噜噜噜噜！！不唱了不唱了……客户，把油门从脚上挪开，呕！帕晕车了，帕要吐了哇。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Puffuffufuufuu! Puff will stop singing! Hey, get your foot off the gas pedal! Ugh! Puff is going to throw up!)

Desc.SourceString: （好气派呀，不愧是海特洛首富！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Impressive! No wonder they're Hethereau's richest!)

Desc.SourceString: （德沃夏克家族旗下不仅有粉爪银行，还有这个金苹果藏馆。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The Dvořák family doesn't just own Pink Paws Bank, they also own this Golden Apple Collection Hall.)

Desc.SourceString: （听说开这个藏馆，是因为德沃夏克实在太富裕了，家里的藏品多到摆不下。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I heard they opened this Collection Hall because the Dvořáks were so wealthy, they needed a place to store their collections.)

Desc.SourceString: （索性拿出来免费展览，给市民开开眼界。帕噜！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (That's why they decided to put them on free display to broaden the citizens' horizons. Pretty neat!)

Desc.SourceString: 帕知道的很多呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: You know quite a lot, don't you?

Desc.SourceString: （……呃，这是因为，因为德沃夏克家族经常做「慈善」嘛！而且总是找奇奇怪怪的「理由」，比如——）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Well, that's because the Dvořáks do a lot of charity work! They always come up with the strangest causes, like…)

Desc.SourceString: （庆祝我家锦鲤学会用尾巴比心？庆祝我的古董盔甲开始自己遛狗……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…celebrating how their koi fish learned to make a heart shape with its tail and how their antique armor started to walk the dog…)

Desc.SourceString: （听上去很荒诞吧？其实就是想借机分享给大家食物啦。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Pretty crazy, right? But really, they just want an excuse to share food with everyone.)

Desc.SourceString: （帕和友人流浪时，就接受过他们的救济。是一场非常豪华的流水席——德沃夏克长子的第！四！场！婚礼！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (When Puff was wandering with Puff's friend, we received their charity. It was an expensive banquet for the Dvořák eldest son's fourth wedding!)

Desc.SourceString: 啊，能结这么多次婚的话……想必是位很受欢迎的人物吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, if someone can marry that many times… they must be quite popular.

Desc.SourceString: （斯哈——斯哈——有好多美食的，帕已经开始期待德沃夏克的第五场婚礼了！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Slurp… slurp! There was so much good food! Puff is already waiting for his fifth wedding!)

Desc.SourceString: （帕从友人那听说过很多异象趣闻和豪门八卦，客户有想了解的，随便问帕！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Puff heard many anomaly stories and wealthy family gossip from Puff's friend. If you want to know anything, just ask Puff!)

Desc.SourceString: 这些展品都很有意思。比如这枚金币……
Desc.LocalizedString: These exhibits are very interesting, like this gold coin…

Desc.SourceString: （是100斤纯金打造的巨型方斯硬币啊帕噜！虽然见过的市民无不觉得阔气！震惊！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…a giant Fons coin made from 100 pounds of pure gold! Its extravagance amazes everyone who sees it!)

Desc.SourceString: （但长子本人只是用它来练习举重呢！帕噜！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (But the eldest son just uses it for weightlifting practice! Puff!)

Desc.SourceString: 那这把菜刀……谁会把菜刀放在展馆里啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: And this kitchen knife… why is it even being displayed?

Desc.SourceString: （这是家族初代厨师长的专用厨刀，出自这把刀下的美味，养育了德沃夏克三代家主呢！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This is the kitchen knife of the family's first head chef. The meals made from this knife nourished three generations of Dvořáks!)

Desc.SourceString: （听说长子能举起100斤巨型方斯的背后，就离不开厨师长精心烹饪食材的功劳呢！可以说，这把刀就是头号功臣！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Apparently, the eldest son was able to lift that 100-pound coin because he ate meals processed by this knife. It's a very important knife!)
Hmm…

Desc.SourceString: 帕更加期待冰雕了！帕都不敢想，它会有多震撼！
Desc.LocalizedString: Puff is even more excited about the ice sculptures! Puff can't imagine how amazing they'll be!

Desc.SourceString: （等等……帕换个姿势。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Wait… let Puff change to another pose.)

Desc.SourceString: （看，帕模仿情种先生，酷吧！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Look, Puff is imitating Mr. Romantic. Isn't Puff cool?)

Desc.SourceString: 酷。
Desc.LocalizedString: Cool.

Desc.SourceString: 接下来去哪儿呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where should we go next?

Desc.SourceString: （客户，跟帕走，这次帕带你去一个地方！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Follow Puff! Puff will take you to a place!)

Desc.SourceString: ……竟然真的下雪了！好美啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's really snowing… It's beautiful.

Desc.SourceString: 去找小帕吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go find Puff.

Desc.SourceString: 嚯呀？夏天竟然下雪了！海特洛总是发生美妙的事呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow, it's snowing in summer! Wonderful things are always happening in Hethereau!

Desc.SourceString: 这个雪甜甜的……好像冰淇淋。唔。就是冰淇淋！
Desc.LocalizedString: This snow is so sweet… like ice cream. Mmm. It is ice cream!

Desc.SourceString: 笨蛋，你到底在开心什么啊！还张嘴去接？
Desc.LocalizedString: You idiot, what are you so happy about! And you're opening your mouth to catch snow?

Desc.SourceString: 你忘了我们是卖「防晒喷雾」的吗？夏天！下雪！
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you forget we sell sunscreen spray? Summer? Snow?

Desc.SourceString: 刚囤的货都完了啦！哈。我可是把伊登公寓都抵押上了啊笨蛋——！
Desc.LocalizedString: All the sprays I just bought are useless now! I even mortgaged Eden Apartments for this! Arghhh!

Desc.SourceString: 亲爱的，你就是太容易焦虑……我们改卖「火锅毛绒绒清新喷雾」不就行啦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Honey, you get anxious too easily. We can just switch to selling hot pot fresh spray instead!

Desc.SourceString: 先来陪我打雪仗嘛！来嘛来嘛~
Desc.LocalizedString: Come on have a snowball fight with me! Let's do it!

Desc.SourceString: 下雪了？……终于不用在铁板烧上开摩托了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's snowing? Finally, I don't have to sit on a hot grill when I bike anymore.

Desc.SourceString: 咦，话说小雪人呢？今天好像就没见过它。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm, so where's the little Snowman? I don't think I've seen Puff all day.

Desc.SourceString: 奇怪，它不是最爱凑热闹的嘛？
Desc.LocalizedString: That's weird, Puff loves staying in the loop!

Desc.SourceString: 好了，我也该收摊啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, I should close up shop too!

Desc.SourceString: 今年不会再有人来买冰淇淋了。
Desc.LocalizedString: No one's going to come buy ice cream for the rest of the year.

Desc.SourceString: 所有人都在，为什么只有小帕不见了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Everyone's here, so why is only Puff missing…

Desc.SourceString: 哪里不对劲……
Desc.LocalizedString: Something is not right…

Desc.SourceString: 漏掉了什么重要的东西……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm missing something important…

Desc.SourceString: 不同季节   跳起同一支舞  地轴倾转瞬间  舞步终将重叠
Desc.LocalizedString:
Across the seasons, we danced cheek to cheek.
When the Earth takes a tilt, our steps will then meet.

Desc.SourceString: 月光小船划破银雪   你是航线   也是春天
Desc.LocalizedString:
A moonlight boat glides on silver snow,
You're my compass, my springtime glow.

Desc.SourceString: 我会用力奔赴  哪怕化作繁星点点
Desc.LocalizedString: And I'll rush hard to you, even if I turn to starlit sand.

Desc.SourceString: 嘿，夏刑草，今年我也没有辜负每一天哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, old friend, I didn't waste a single day this year either!

Desc.SourceString: 真笨啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: How silly of me…

Desc.SourceString: 还是把雪下成冰淇淋了呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: You somehow managed to make it snow ice cream.

Desc.SourceString: （欸？客人怎么反倒走了？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Wait, why are customers leaving?)

Desc.SourceString: 客、客人对不起……我我我……
Desc.LocalizedString: C-customer, I'm sorry… I I I…

Desc.SourceString: 你先冷静一下……
Desc.LocalizedString: Just calm down for a moment…

Desc.SourceString: 兰德里柯的事情你们听说了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Have you heard what happened to Landric?

Desc.SourceString: 调香师？……好像是……冬司？
Desc.LocalizedString: The Perfumer? That would be… Toshi, right?

Desc.SourceString: 他的调香技术略有耳闻。
Desc.LocalizedString: I've heard about his perfume-making skills.

Desc.SourceString: 听说卷入了异象事件，兰德里柯对外宣称是身体状况，需要修养……
Desc.LocalizedString: Word is he got caught up in an anomaly case. Landric's official statement claims he needs rest due to health reasons…

Desc.SourceString: 卷入异象事件这么长时间，恐怕事情不小。
Desc.LocalizedString: If he's been involved in an anomaly case for this long, it must be something serious.

Desc.SourceString: 最近他的新款有正常发布吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Has he released any new fragrances lately?

Desc.SourceString: 兰德里柯不知道从哪个角落找了个异象猎人团队，把冬司救回后，新品可算是正常发布了。
Desc.LocalizedString: After Landric hired a low-ranking team of anomaly hunters to rescue Toshi, he was finally able to release his new collection on schedule.

Desc.SourceString: 啧，冬司好歹也是知名调香师，兰德里柯什么时候财务这么紧张了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Tsk, Toshi's a renowned Perfumer—since when did Landric start pinching pennies?

Desc.SourceString: 可能是没名气的团队，更利于隐蔽处理和背后控制吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Perhaps a lower-ranking team is easier to keep under wraps… and control from behind the scenes.

Desc.SourceString: 惠比寿在异象交易的投资额度还在不断加大……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ebisu keeps pumping more and more money into anomaly trading…

Desc.SourceString: 未来的异象事件将更加频繁。
Desc.LocalizedString: Anomaly cases will only become more frequent in the future.

Desc.SourceString: 我打算投资与异象医疗有关的产业，你们有兴趣吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm planning to invest in anomaly healthcare industries. Anyone interested?

Desc.SourceString: 「竹本清源」可不会坐以待毙。
Desc.LocalizedString: Bamboo Pharmacy isn't one to take things lying down.

Desc.SourceString: 占比股份如何计算？
Desc.LocalizedString: How will the shares be calculated?

Desc.SourceString: 你还是一如既往地直截了当……
Desc.LocalizedString: As blunt as ever, I see…

Desc.SourceString: 老规矩，方斯小于资源，我们现在比较需要一些「特别的东西」。
Desc.LocalizedString: As usual, Fons isn't as valuable as resources. We want something special.

Desc.SourceString: 「小布妮」如何……
Desc.LocalizedString: What about Little Buni…

Desc.SourceString: 你总是会带来惊喜。
Desc.LocalizedString: You never cease to amaze me.

Desc.SourceString: 德沃夏克长子四婚在即的报道，最近闹得沸沸扬扬……
Desc.LocalizedString: The upcoming fourth marriage of Dvořák's eldest son has been causing quite a stir in the news lately…

Desc.SourceString: 他现在多少岁了……
Desc.LocalizedString: How old is he now…?

Desc.SourceString: 上次参加他的婚礼，我还是个孩子……
Desc.LocalizedString: I was just a child when I attended his wedding…

Desc.SourceString: 今天有到场吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is he with us here today?

Desc.SourceString: 小打小闹的地方，他们可不会亲自到场……
Desc.LocalizedString: This is far too small an affair for someone like them to attend in person…

Desc.SourceString: 即使今天有……
Desc.LocalizedString: Even if things like…

Desc.SourceString:
哒哒哒哒，
卡伦小姐穿着新舞鞋，
Desc.LocalizedString:
Tap, tap, tap, 
Miss Karen's new shoes gleam,

Desc.SourceString:
跳呀跳呀，
剧场的帷幕永不落下。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Dance, dance, 
the curtain stays up like a dream.

Desc.SourceString:
哒哒哒哒，
卡伦小姐穿着旧舞鞋，
Desc.LocalizedString:
Tap, tap, tap, 
Miss Karen's old shoes sigh,

Desc.SourceString:
哭呀哭呀，
单脚的天鹅总是害怕。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Cry, cry, 
the one-legged swan is shy.

Desc.SourceString:
哒哒哒哒，
卡伦小姐穿着红舞鞋，
Desc.LocalizedString:
Tap, tap, tap, 
Miss Karen's red shoes glow,

Desc.SourceString: 笑呀笑呀，
Desc.LocalizedString: Laugh, laugh,

Desc.SourceString:
善良的刽子手啊，
放下手中的斧子吧，
Desc.LocalizedString:
Kind executioner, 
let the axe go,

Desc.SourceString:
就算是卡伦小姐的葬礼，
舞步不会停下。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Even at Miss Karen's funeral, 
the dance will flow.

Desc.SourceString: 狂热的朝圣者，
Desc.LocalizedString: The fervent pilgrim,

Desc.SourceString: 在早上看到了星星，
Desc.LocalizedString: Saw stars in the morning,

Desc.SourceString: 晚上我们参加他的葬礼。
Desc.LocalizedString: In the evening we attended his funeral.

Desc.SourceString: 于是得到了一面奖旗。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alas, he received a token.

Desc.SourceString:
曾经美丽的新郎，
还有丑陋的新娘，
Desc.LocalizedString:
The once beautiful groom, 
And the ugly bride,

Desc.SourceString:
他们听见教堂的钟声，
为可怜的爱情响起。
Desc.LocalizedString:
They heard the church bells, 
Ringing for their pitiful love.

Desc.SourceString: 没想到「呗果」上说的竟然是真的！
Desc.LocalizedString: I can't believe what they said on Bagel was actually true!

Desc.SourceString: 传说中的「幽灵车神」竟然真的在豆腐店……！
Desc.LocalizedString: I can't believe the Legendary "Ghost Racer" is actually at a tofu shop…!

Desc.SourceString: 哎，麻烦让让，我要和「车神」合影！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, excuse me! Make way! I need to get a photo with the God Racer!

Desc.SourceString: 发生什么了？怎么围了这么多人……
Desc.LocalizedString: What's going on? Why are so many people gathered here…

Desc.SourceString: 你没看最近的呗果热帖？大家都在聊，那个「海特洛的午夜幽灵车神」！
Desc.LocalizedString: Haven't you seen the trending post on Bagel? Everyone's talking about Midnight Ghost Racer of Hethereau!

Desc.SourceString: 深夜，它总是出现在环山公路上，和其他车辆竞速……
Desc.LocalizedString: At midnight, it always appears on the mountain roads, racing against other vehicles…

Desc.SourceString: 被它超过而无法反超回来的车辆会被贴上撕不下来的「败北贴纸」，只能看着「幽灵车神」扬长而去！
Desc.LocalizedString: Any vehicle that gets passed and can't overtake it again is slapped with a "Loser's Mark" that can't be removed—leaving them with no choice but to watch as the Ghost Racer disappears into the distance!

Desc.SourceString: 而且，迄今为止，还没有人能战胜它、撕下贴纸！
Desc.LocalizedString: And to this day, not a single person has been able to defeat it or remove the sticker!

Desc.SourceString: 「车神」怎么会出现在豆腐店门口啊，会不会是你们搞错了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's the "God Racer" doing at a tofu shop? You sure this wasn't a mistake?

Desc.SourceString: 车身涂装和改装风格都一模一样，不会错的！
Desc.LocalizedString: The livery and modification style are exactly the same! There's no mistake!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了，薯条兽？你的心情不好吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's wrong, Frizzle? Are you feeling down?

Desc.SourceString: 好奇怪啊，为什么会这样……
Desc.LocalizedString: That's strange… why is it like this?

Desc.SourceString: （薯条兽，能感觉到自己薯条的气息！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Fry Beast can smell its own fries!)

Desc.SourceString: （薯条兽，能找到领取了薯条的人类！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Fry Beast can find the human who took its fries!)

Desc.SourceString: （就在这附近！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It's close by! I can tell!)

Desc.SourceString: （怎么感觉有点像小狗……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It somehow resembles a little dog…)

Desc.SourceString: （薯条兽的薯条……！！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Frizzle's fries…!!)

Desc.SourceString: （好过分……呜呜……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (That's so mean… *sniff sniff*…)

Desc.SourceString: 难道……地上这些都是薯条兽送给人们的薯条吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Could it be… are all these fries on the ground gifts from the Frizzle to people?

Desc.SourceString: （谢谢你，人类！薯条兽，今天非常开心！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Thank you, human! Frizzle is super happy today!)

Desc.SourceString: （再见！下次，再一起吃薯条吧！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Bye-bye! Let's eat fries together again next time!)

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，约好了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a promise then.

Desc.SourceString: ——再见，薯条兽。
Desc.LocalizedString: Goodbye, Frizzle.

Desc.SourceString: （人类！人类！收下薯条兽的薯条吧！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Human! Human! Please take Frizzle's fries!)

Desc.SourceString: （嗯？这本书上好像有微弱的异象气息。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Hm? This book seems to have a faint trace of anomaly around it.)

Desc.SourceString: （封面上没有字，看上去不像普通的书……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (There's no text on the cover, and it doesn't look like an ordinary book…)

Desc.SourceString: （是输入法出问题了吗？还是……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Is there something wrong with my keyboard? Or is it…)

Desc.SourceString: （有点不好的预感。还是尽快去店里看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I have a bad feeling about this. I should go check on the shop as soon as possible.)

Desc.SourceString: 万理先生？……不在店里吗。
Desc.LocalizedString: Miles? …He's not in the shop?

Desc.SourceString: 是埃德嘉要的杂志。如万理先生所说，已经到货了啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's the magazine Edgar ordered. Just like Miles said, it's arrived.

Desc.SourceString: ……先前的那本日记不见了。是被主人取走了吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: …The diary from before is gone. Did the owner take it away…

Desc.SourceString: 茶还热着，看来万理先生刚出门不久。
Desc.LocalizedString: The tea is still warm, so it looks like Miles just stepped out not too long ago.

Desc.SourceString: （既然万理先生说了会在店里等，现在应该只是暂时离开吧。先在这里稍等片刻好了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: Since Miles said he'd be waiting at the shop, he must have just stepped out temporarily. I'll wait here for a little bit.

Desc.SourceString: （……刚刚一瞬间，日记上的异象气息变强了？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…Just now for a moment, did the anomaly aura from the diary get stronger?)

Desc.SourceString: （万理先生的状态也很不对劲。不能让他这样独自待着。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Miles's being really off too. I can't leave him alone like this.)

Desc.SourceString: 怎么还没来啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: Why aren't they here yet…

Desc.SourceString: 真是的，明明急得不行的是她，怎么又放我鸽子！再不来，下次别想借我作业抄了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Seriously! She was the one who was so urgent about this, so why is she standing me up again! If she doesn't show up soon, she can forget about copying my homework next time!

Desc.SourceString: 真过意不去，又要劳烦你跑一趟。
Desc.LocalizedString: I really feel bad about this, making you go through all this trouble again.

Desc.SourceString: 我这毛病，到底是怎么回事……之后得抽个时间上医院看看了。
Desc.LocalizedString: What's wrong with me, anyway… I should find some time to go to the hospital and get this checked out.

Desc.SourceString: 上次店主身上出现异状时，也发送了这种乱码短信……得赶紧过去看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: The last time something strange happened to the shop owner, he sent garbled messages like this too… I need to get over there quickly.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然时代不同，但毕竟都是年轻人，共同点说不定意外很多呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even though it was a different era, they were still young people after all. We might have more in common than we'd expect.

Desc.SourceString: 下一个地点是？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's the next location?

Desc.SourceString: 啊，什么家属？为什么不让进？这里……什么时候开始要收门票了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh, what family member? Why can't I go in? This place… when did they start charging admission?

Desc.SourceString: 每周都来，从没听说不对外开放。是器材在维修吗？我就看看，不会上手的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I come here every week. I've never heard it wasn't open to the public. Is the equipment under maintenance? I'll just take a look, I won't touch anything.

Desc.SourceString: 《特工Z世代》？
Desc.LocalizedString: "Gen Z"?

Desc.SourceString: 我？孙辈？我怎么听不懂你在说什么……
Desc.LocalizedString: Me? Grandkids? I have no idea what you're talking about…

Desc.SourceString: 按照日记记载，万理爷爷接到奶奶之后，两人一起去了附近的广场。
Desc.LocalizedString: According to the diary, after Grandpa Miles picked up Grandma, the two of them went to the nearby plaza together.

Desc.SourceString: 当年，广场好像是很受孩子们欢迎的游乐场所。奶奶周末经常去那边，用零花钱买些饲料，在广场上喂鸽子。
Desc.LocalizedString: Back then, the plaza seemed to be a popular playground for kids. Grandma would often go there on weekends, using her pocket money to buy feed and feeding the pigeons in the plaza.

Desc.SourceString: 不过，几十年过去，随着城市规划变动，广场早搬迁去了别的地方。广场原本在的地方，现在已经变成了商业区……
Desc.LocalizedString: However, after several decades, with changes in city planning, the plaza was relocated somewhere else long ago. Where the plaza used to be has now become a commercial district…

Desc.SourceString: 啊，到了！就是那边。万理爷爷也停下脚步了……看来我的调查没错嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, we're here! It's over there. Grandpa Miles stopped walking too… Looks like my research was right!

Desc.SourceString: 接下来……日记里说，奶奶和万理爷爷去了附近的报刊亭，买新到货的漫画杂志。
Desc.LocalizedString: Next… the diary says that Grandma went to a nearby newsstand with Grandpa Miles to buy newly arrived manga magazines.

Desc.SourceString: 真难想象他们年轻的时候也跟我们一样，会追漫画连载啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's hard to imagine that when they were young, they were just like us, following manga series…

Desc.SourceString: 对了，当年的那家报刊亭似乎也早早关门了。现在在原本报刊亭位置的……我没搞错的话，应该是一家抽风猫奶茶店吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, that newsstand from back then closed down pretty early too. What's at the original newsstand location now… if I'm not mistaken, should be a Crazy Cat bubble tea shop, right?

Desc.SourceString: 这边大概也行不通了吧。我看看，嗯……直接去下一个地方吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: This place probably won't work either. Let me see, hmm… let's just go to the next location…

Desc.SourceString: 是咖啡店。很巧——五十年后，这个地址竟然还是一家咖啡店！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a coffee shop. What a coincidence! After fifty years, this address is still a coffee shop!

Desc.SourceString: 虽然不是同一家品牌了……怎么说呢，物是人非的感觉还真是让人感慨呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Though it's not the same brand anymore… How should I put it, seeing how everything's changed while staying the same really makes you feel nostalgic.

Desc.SourceString: 万理爷爷离开了……应该是去今天的最后一个地方了吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Grandpa Miles has left… He's probably going to his last stop for today.

Desc.SourceString: 从咖啡店出来时，太阳已经快落山了。奶奶把要乘车离开海特洛市的万理爷爷送到了车站。
Desc.LocalizedString: When we came out of the coffee shop, the sun was already setting. Grandma escorted Grandpa Miles, who was leaving Hethereau by bus, to the station.

Desc.SourceString: 两人在车站等待着，像往常一样闲聊……然后，车来了。万理爷爷上了车，奶奶向他挥手道别。
Desc.LocalizedString: The two of them waited at the station, chatting as usual… Then the bus arrived. Grandpa Miles got on, and Grandma waved goodbye to him.

Desc.SourceString: ……就算想要再劝劝万理爷爷，我们好像也插不上手了。
Desc.LocalizedString: …Even if we wanted to try convincing Grandpa Miles again, it seems like there's nothing we can do now.

Desc.SourceString: 大爷，来找家属的？这楼非员工不得进入，您给孩子打个电话，在楼下等吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sir, are you here to see a family member? This building is for employees only. Why don't you give your kid a call and wait downstairs?

Desc.SourceString: 门票？我们又不是什么供人参观的公共设施，根本不对外开放的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Admission? We're not some kind of tourist attraction or public facility. This place isn't open to the public at all.

Desc.SourceString: 哎、哎哎！大爷您怎么还硬闯呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, hey hey! Sir, you can't just barge in like that!

Desc.SourceString: 漫画……？爷爷，您是说想购买《特工Z世代》的联名套餐吗……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Manga…? Grandpa, are you saying you want to buy the "Gen Z" collaboration meal set…?

Desc.SourceString: 就是那个嘛……橙黄头发、蓝头发和金头发的动画小人……咳、咳咳，您是来帮孙辈代购的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You know… those cartoon characters with orange, blue, and whatever-color-it-is hair and eyes… Ahem! Are you here to buy something for your grandkids?

Desc.SourceString: 我也听不懂您的话呀。您到底需不需要购买呢？我这边还需要做别的单子……
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't understand what you're saying either. Do you actually need to buy something or not? I still have other orders to work on…

Desc.SourceString: 你之前没有来过吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Haven't you been here before?

Desc.SourceString: 明媚阳光照耀下的风景……很适合拍张照记录一下。
Desc.LocalizedString: The scenery is glowing under bright sunlight… perfect for a snapshot.

Desc.SourceString: 大家应该都是这么想的吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sure everyone feels the same way.

Desc.SourceString: 外景拍摄地？
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah?

Desc.SourceString: 原来如此。
Desc.LocalizedString: I see.

Desc.SourceString: 不过，这些在照相馆应该也能拍吧？爬山还是挺累的。
Desc.LocalizedString: But couldn't you take those kinds of photos at a photo studio too? Hiking up mountains is quite a task.

Desc.SourceString: 这么一说，确实还是阳光更美些。
Desc.LocalizedString: Now that you mention it, natural sunlight really is more beautiful.

Desc.SourceString: 你好像一直都很喜欢小动物。
Desc.LocalizedString: You seem to have a soft spot for animals.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What happened?

Desc.SourceString: 感觉变形的照片有一种微妙的……俏皮感？总之也很有趣。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's something oddly… endearing about that photo. It sparks joy.

Desc.SourceString: 不是安慰啦，是真心话。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not saying that to make you feel better, I mean it.

Desc.SourceString: 但这样你们就没有合影了。或许，我可以给你们拍张合照？
Desc.LocalizedString: But that means you won't have a photo together. Why don't you let me take one for you?

Desc.SourceString: 不知道我的自拍技术如何……
Desc.LocalizedString: I wonder if my selfie skills are any good…

Desc.SourceString: 怎么怎么？打起来了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's this? A fight?

Desc.SourceString: 偏偏在马路当中？有什么恩怨去管理局说！
Desc.LocalizedString: Of all places, right in the middle of the street? If you've got beef with each other, take it to the Bureau!

Desc.SourceString: 嚯，这是异能者之间打上了啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: Whoa, so it's Espers going at it?

Desc.SourceString: 是不是在拍短视频啊？想上镜——
Desc.LocalizedString: Are they filming reels or something? I wanna get on camera…

Desc.SourceString: 街头家族斗争？这是我没买门票能看的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Street gang turf war? And I get to watch this for free?

Desc.SourceString: 「鼠鼠」们在不在？我想看场面更混乱点！
Desc.LocalizedString: Are the whiskers around? I wanna see things get even messier!

Desc.SourceString: 作秀吧，他们念词儿也太搞了哈哈哈~
Desc.LocalizedString: It's totally staged! Their line delivery is so ridiculous, haha!

Desc.SourceString: 红色封面的，在哪里……
Desc.LocalizedString: Red cover one… where is it…

Desc.SourceString: （说起来，安魂曲的年纪和早雾、埃德嘉他们差不多吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Come to think of it, Lacrimosa's probably around the same age as Sakiri and Edgar.)

Desc.SourceString: （那边站着的老人……大概就是安魂曲的房东吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (That elderly person standing over there… must be Lacrimosa's landlord.)

Desc.SourceString: ……嗯……找到了。
Desc.LocalizedString: …mm… found it.

Desc.SourceString: （伊波恩有阿德勒先生尽心照顾着，安魂曲却是独自生活吗……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Eibon has Adler taking such good care of her, but Lacrimosa is living all by herself…)

Desc.SourceString: 自从鉴定师加入伊波恩，明里暗里摆平了不少异象事件。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ever since you joined Eibon, you've been handling quite a few anomaly cases, both openly and behind the scenes.

Desc.SourceString: 托你的福，管理局给的假期也多起来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thanks to you, the Bureau's been giving us a lot more vacation time lately.

Desc.SourceString: 要是攒一攒，说不定还能去海岛度个假呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: If I save them up, I might even be able to take a nice island vacation.

Desc.SourceString: 呃，法帝娅一天不调侃人，大概会无聊到失眠吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Uh, you'd probably get so bored that you couldn't sleep if you were to go a day without teasing someone.

Desc.SourceString: 是呢，所以得不停地找乐子。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exactly, so I have to keep finding ways to entertain myself.

Desc.SourceString: 说起来……你身上似乎有股药味。
Desc.LocalizedString: Speaking of which… you seem to have a medicinal smell about you.

Desc.SourceString: 法帝娅，你受伤了吗？是不是又不要命地去战斗了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Fadia, are you hurt? Did you go throwing yourself into battle recklessly again…

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀，原来鉴定师这么在意我？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my, so the Appraiser cares about me this much?

Desc.SourceString: 可惜伤口已经消失了……要亲自检查下吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Too bad the wound's already healed… Want to give me a personal inspection?
Ah… I… no…

Desc.SourceString: 放心吧，我没受伤。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry, I'm not hurt.

Desc.SourceString: 我的异能是可以分散痛觉，只要我想，战斗造成的伤口也能在瞬间愈合。
Desc.LocalizedString: My ability lets me disperse pain sensations. As long as I will it, wounds from battle can heal instantly too.

Desc.SourceString: 你闻到的药味其实是猫薄荷。
Desc.LocalizedString: That medicinal smell you picked up is actually catnip.

Desc.SourceString: 是我去猫猫激推馆，想更彻底地享受猫师傅们的抓背服务，才故意涂的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I applied it on purpose when I went to Kitty Bakery. I wanted to fully enjoy the scratching services from the little biscuit makers.

Desc.SourceString: 咦，这里也有猫师傅。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, there are more little biscuit makers here too.

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，你来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you have arrived.

Desc.SourceString: 让我看看……选些什么家具好呢，得将她的「狗窝」打扮得焕然一新才行。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let me see… what furniture should I pick? I need to spruce up her little "doghouse" and give it a complete makeover.

Desc.SourceString: 呀，你不会觉得我说话刻薄吧，鉴定师？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, you don't think I'm being too harsh, do you, Appraiser?

Desc.SourceString: 有，有点。
Desc.LocalizedString: A… a little.

Desc.SourceString: 哈哈。但她真的住在「狗窝」里哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Haha. But she really does live in a kennel, you know.

Desc.SourceString: 她住的房子……是用郊外一个废弃狗屋改造的，条件简陋，附近也没什么人。
Desc.LocalizedString: The house she lives in… it's converted from an abandoned kennel on the outskirts of town. Those are pretty rough conditions, and no one around for miles.

Desc.SourceString: 只有不断上门骚扰的异象，和我这种……被异象吸引去的「战斗狂魔」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just Anomalies constantly showing up to cause trouble, and people like me… battle maniacs drawn in by the Anomalies.

Desc.SourceString: 经常有异象去捣乱吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do Anomalies show up to cause trouble often?

Desc.SourceString: 是啊。团三郎会去偷食物，长明灯组队去偷电，家里值钱的东西么……也都被包包蚊搬空了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah. Danzaburou steals her food, the Eternal Lamps team up to steal electricity, and anything valuable in the house… well, the Pouch Mosquitoes cleaned all that out too.

Desc.SourceString: 这些听起来都是低级异象，不像是你会感兴趣的程度啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: These all sound like low threat Anomalies. Doesn't seem like the kind of thing that would interest you?

Desc.SourceString: 之前你可是觉得，连五级异象都不够刺激。
Desc.LocalizedString: You used to think even Class 5 Anomalies weren't exciting enough.

Desc.SourceString: 为什么会突然盯上那里呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why the sudden interest in that place?

Desc.SourceString: ……唔，跟那些小家伙，是算不上什么激烈交手。不过偶尔来场「按摩SPA」，也不错~
Desc.LocalizedString: …Mm, fighting those little guys hardly counts as intense combat. Though an occasional "massage session" isn't too bad either…

Desc.SourceString: 还以为有多大能耐，这么一看，不就是个邋遢大叔吗！
Desc.LocalizedString: I thought he'd be something special, but look at him—he's just some scruffy old man!

Desc.SourceString: 得罪了我们老大，你完蛋了！
Desc.LocalizedString: You've messed with our boss! Now you're done for!

Desc.SourceString: （发信人的口吻不像是阿德勒先生，但约见的地点却在伊波恩里……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The sender's tone doesn't sound like Adler, but the meeting place is inside Eibon…)

Desc.SourceString: （去看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Let's go take a look.)

Desc.SourceString: 呆头鸟，不许你事不关己！要不是你突然从背后冒出来吓我，我怎么会撞到桌子！
Desc.LocalizedString: Silly, you can't just stand there and do nothing! If you hadn't suddenly popped up behind me and scared me, I never would've bumped into the table!

Desc.SourceString: 都说了我只是路过！又不是小孩了，故意吓唬你有什么意思啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: I already told you I was just passing by! We're not kids anymore! Why would I just try to scare you like that?

Desc.SourceString: （咳咳，好浓郁的香气……甚至有些呛人。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Cough, cough… what a strong fragrance… it's almost overwhelming.)

Desc.SourceString: 说来，鉴定师也已经在海特洛生活了一段时间了吧。现在适应得怎么样？
Desc.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, you've been living in Hethereau for a while now, haven't you, Appraiser? How are you adjusting now?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，已经习惯了。海特洛是一座很包容的城市，不会让人有「客人」的感觉。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah, I'm used to it now. Hethereau is a very welcoming city. It doesn't make you feel like an outsider.

Desc.SourceString: 真像是你会说出来的话啊。呵呵……就像刚破壳的雏鸟似的。
Desc.LocalizedString: That sounds exactly like something you'd say. Hehe… just like a newly hatched young bird.

Desc.SourceString: 雏鸟？
Desc.LocalizedString: A young bird?

Desc.SourceString: 懵懂的幼鸟，往往会把拥有的最初一个居所当做真正的「家」。对你而言，海特洛大概就是这样的地方吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Naive young birds often mistake their very first nest for their true home. For you, Hethereau is probably that kind of place.

Desc.SourceString: （九原小姐……果然知道我没有过去记忆的事吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Miss Jiuyuan… she's figured out I have memory loss, hasn't she?)

Desc.SourceString: （真是什么都瞒不过她的眼睛……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Nothing gets past those eyes of hers…)

Desc.SourceString: 到啦。嗯……再走近些吧，跟我来。
Desc.LocalizedString: We're here. Hmm… let's get a bit closer. Follow me.

Desc.SourceString: 这里是……
Desc.LocalizedString: This place is…

Desc.SourceString: <!>那边有个门，我们过去看看
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a door over there, let's go take a look.

Desc.SourceString: <!>那边有个门，我们过去看看
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a door over there, let's go take a look.

Desc.SourceString: 现在下车可是会迟到的~
Desc.LocalizedString: You'll be late if you hop off at this station, you know.

Desc.SourceString: 邀请函的替换已经完成，辛苦了，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: The invitations have all been sorted. Thanks for your hard work, Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 我知道了！是「体检雕塑」——的袖珍版！
Desc.LocalizedString: I got it! It's the mini version of the Medical Examination Sculpture!

Desc.SourceString: 体检雕塑的衍生异象中……有这种吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Anomaly derivatives from health examination sculptures…? Those exist?

Desc.SourceString: 果然是塔吉多才会喜欢的那类奇奇怪怪的玩具吧？！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's the kind of weird and wacky stuff that only Taygedo likes, right?

Desc.SourceString: 报告大姐头，我也想跟着一起去！今天没有谜皮鬼要抓！
Desc.LocalizedString: Boss! I want to come along too! There are no Mysties to catch today!

Desc.SourceString: 本店可没说今天就此关门歇业哈，阿德勒买菜回来前总得有人好好看家，别半天不见就把家拆个七零八落的。
Desc.LocalizedString: The shop isn't closing for the day. Someone needs to handle things until Adler gets back with groceries. Don't blow up the place while I'm gone.

Desc.SourceString: 好的，放心吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, you can count on us.

Desc.SourceString: 哦——那师父回来后记得和我说说到底是怎么一回事！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh…when you're back, make sure you fill me in!

Desc.SourceString: 好。
Desc.LocalizedString: Okay.

Desc.SourceString: 哦对了，你们那个什么什么车咱们就不坐了。邻居要是看见还以为伊波恩搞非法经营被抓了呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, by the way, we're not taking that… vehicle of yours. If the neighbors saw, they'd think Eibon got busted for shady stuff.

Desc.SourceString: 那边来的……前总队长？我没看错吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is that… her? The former Commander…? I'm not seeing things, am I?

Desc.SourceString: 今儿太阳是打西边出来了？那位祖宗怎么来了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Yikes… Did the sun rise in the west today? Why is SHE here?!

Desc.SourceString: 我今天最好还是老实点儿……布洛。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'd better keep my head down today… barra.

Desc.SourceString: 没看错！是浔前辈！！！浔前辈来了！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's her! It's Hotori senpai!!! Hotori senpai is here!!!

Desc.SourceString: 当年我就是为追随浔前辈才考的异象管理局……！如今终于再见到您了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I only joined the BAC to follow your footsteps…! Now I finally saw you!

Desc.SourceString: 要继续努力哟~
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah. Good girl. Keep up the good work.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll do my best!

Desc.SourceString: 浔总队长，浔前辈怎么会突然过来？莫非是出现了只有浔前辈才能解决的紧急事态？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Captain Hotori! What brings you here all of a sudden, senpai? Don't tell me there's some emergency only you can handle?!

Desc.SourceString: 哪里哪里，只是来谈生意~谈生意~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh no no, I'm just here for business! Just business!

Desc.SourceString: 你好，方便让一让吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hello, can I pass through?

Desc.SourceString: 不好意思，借过一下。
Desc.LocalizedString: Excuse me, coming through.

Desc.SourceString: 想攀关系排个队，按顺序来好不好，不是只有你们有求于她！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, get in line if you want to butter up the missus! Take turns like everyone else. You're not the only ones who need something from her!

Desc.SourceString: 要我说德洛莉丝就是对你们这些平民太仁慈了，不懂礼节的土包子！
Desc.LocalizedString: Dolores is far too kind to you commoners, who are uncultured bumpkins with no etiquette!

Desc.SourceString: 需要我提醒你先来后到吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do I need to remind you about what "first come, first served" means?

Desc.SourceString: 快来快来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Come on!

Desc.SourceString: 轮到你当鬼了！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's your turn to be it!

Desc.SourceString: 嘻嘻！我打赌！这回一定是我赢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe! I bet this time I'll win!

Desc.SourceString: 真无聊，凭什么一家人都围着蕾妮团团转个不停。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm so bored. Why do we have to revolve around Renee all the time?

Desc.SourceString: 只有蕾妮那样的小孩子才喜欢这么幼稚的游戏！
Desc.LocalizedString: Only little kids like Renee enjoy such a childish game!

Desc.SourceString: 我已经受够了啦……
Desc.LocalizedString: I've had enough…
Erm…

Desc.SourceString: 唉……永无止境的闹剧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sigh… Another day in the circus.

Desc.SourceString: 谁让那家伙开心，妈妈就开心。为了讨妈妈开心，还得继续忍下去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Whoever makes that kid happy, makes Mom happy. And to do that, I'll just endure.

Desc.SourceString: 只是为了我开心……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Just to make me happy…?

Desc.SourceString: 阳光这么好的下午，出去踢球或者散步该多好。
Desc.LocalizedString: This afternoon is nice and sunny… if only I can go play soccer or take a walk.

Desc.SourceString: 我——不想——再陪小屁孩过家家了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't want to play pretend with that brat anymore!

Desc.SourceString: 吼出来心情果然畅快多了。要是真能实现的话……
Desc.LocalizedString: I feel better getting that out of my system. If only I could do what I want…

Desc.SourceString: 叫我这么个大高个硬挤进小缝隙里来……呼……哈！
Desc.LocalizedString: Making someone as tall as me squeeze into this tiny space…? Whew… ha!

Desc.SourceString: 脸比昨晚烤的饼干还要扁……！
Desc.LocalizedString: My face is flatter than the cookies I baked last night…!

Desc.SourceString: 蕾妮最好赶紧把我找到，快放我去厨房。
Desc.LocalizedString: Renee better find me quick and let me go to the kitchen.

Desc.SourceString: 我还是喜欢待在炉边研究菜谱，试着弄些母亲大人会喜欢的新菜式。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'd rather stay by the stove, study recipes, and make new dishes Mother would enjoy.

Desc.SourceString: 可恶。为什么母亲大人只会嘱咐我做蕾妮喜欢的菜……明明您自己的喜好才是最重要的……
Desc.LocalizedString: Argh. Why does Mother always tell me to make dishes Renee likes… when her own preferences should matter most…

Desc.SourceString: 那时候的我当真从没想过哥哥姐姐的感受？我是这个家最自私的孩子……
Desc.LocalizedString: Did I really never think about how my siblings felt? I must be the most selfish child in the family…

Desc.SourceString: 最适合浇花的时间……被白白浪费掉了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The perfect time to water flowers… wasted.

Desc.SourceString: 新生的生命，脆弱的花朵，是需要精心打理，被关爱呵护的呀……
Desc.LocalizedString: Newborn life, fragile flowers… they must be tended to with care…

Desc.SourceString: 小孩子怎么懂呢？小孩子有意识到自己的生命……何其脆弱吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: How could children understand? Do children realize how… fragile they are?

Desc.SourceString: 她是伴随诅咒而来的，同样也是易折的生命……
Desc.LocalizedString: She came with the curse, but she's also a fragile living being…

Desc.SourceString: 如果我这易折的生命能换回你们的幸福的话……
Desc.LocalizedString: If I could trade my fragile life for your happiness…

Desc.SourceString: 那孩子如果从未诞生过……
Desc.LocalizedString: If that child had never been born…

Desc.SourceString: 诅咒也不会降临这个家……
Desc.LocalizedString: …the curse would never have come to this family…

Desc.SourceString: 一切如往，母亲将永远享受着我们策划的幸福。
Desc.LocalizedString: Everything would have been the same, and Mother would have been enjoying the happiness we built for her.

Desc.SourceString: 如果那孩子在捉迷藏中真正「消失」的话，诅咒是不是也会随之消失？
Desc.LocalizedString: If that child truly "disappears" during hide and seek, would the curse disappear with her?

Desc.SourceString: 也许会有一天，她会「藏」在我们永远找不到的地方……
Desc.LocalizedString: Perhaps someday, she'll "hide" somewhere we'll never be able to find …

Desc.SourceString: 如果我从未诞生在这个家……就不会发生这一切。你们也不会惨遭厄运，变回木偶的模样。
Desc.LocalizedString: If I was never born into this family… none of this would've ever happened. You also wouldn't have turned back into puppets… a terrible fate.

Desc.SourceString: 我理解的……姐姐。倘若当真如此，该多好。
Desc.LocalizedString: I understand, big sis… If only that were true.

Desc.SourceString: 蕾——妮——！我最讨厌你了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Re-nee! I hate you!

Desc.SourceString: 究竟还要忍耐多久……！这样的日子还不如变回木头的好！
Desc.LocalizedString: How much longer do I have to endure…? I'd rather turn back into wood than live like this!

Desc.SourceString: 享受阳光的日子还剩下多少？凭什么你要夺走我们一家永久的幸福？
Desc.LocalizedString: How many days of sunshine do we have left? What gives you the right to take away our family's lasting happiness?

Desc.SourceString: 一家人最后的晚餐……已经准备好了。一切都如您的心愿，母亲大人。
Desc.LocalizedString: The family's last supper… is ready. Everything is as you wished, Mother.

Desc.SourceString: 蕾妮~蕾妮~我们要因你而死了唷……你呢？能不能为我们而死呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh Renee…! Oh Renee…!!! We're going to die because of you… What about you? Why don't you… die for us?

Desc.SourceString: 你听到了吧？我们真正的「心声」。
Desc.LocalizedString: You heard that, didn't you? Those are our true feelings.

Desc.SourceString: 你找到我啦，妮妮！
Desc.LocalizedString: You found me, Nini!

Desc.SourceString: 玩得开心吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you have fun?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯！开心就好！
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes! As long as you're happy!

Desc.SourceString: 这么快就找到我啦？
Desc.LocalizedString: You found me that fast?

Desc.SourceString: 我不服，明天再来比比看！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not giving up! Let's have a rematch tomorrow!

Desc.SourceString: 今天是我故意放水，下次就说不定了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I was going easy on you. Next time might be different.

Desc.SourceString: 晚上想吃什么？差不多该准备晚餐了。
Desc.LocalizedString: What do you want for dinner? It's about time to start preparing.

Desc.SourceString: 不要青椒、不要胡萝卜……对吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: No green peppers, no carrots… right?

Desc.SourceString: 是是是，不会忘记你最讨厌的青豆的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, yes, I'll never forget how much you hate green peas.

Desc.SourceString: 这身衣服是怎么回事？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's with those clothes?

Desc.SourceString: 过来，我帮你拍干净。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come here, I'll help you brush the dirt off.

Desc.SourceString: 捉迷藏又不是爬树，你在哪里蹭的这一身灰……
Desc.LocalizedString: You don't have to climb trees for hide and seek, so where did you get all this dirt… (laughs)

Desc.SourceString: 明天，也叫上母亲吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's invite Mother tomorrow.

Desc.SourceString: 母亲喜静不喜欢闹腾？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mother likes quiet, not hustle and bustle?

Desc.SourceString: 小傻瓜，只要能多陪陪你，无论做什么她都会喜欢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Silly… as long as she spends time with you, anything makes her happy.

Desc.SourceString: 我们中只有你不一样……只有你能为母亲带来真正的幸福……
Desc.LocalizedString: You are different from us… You're the only one who can bring Mother happiness…

Desc.SourceString: 您好，尊敬的客人，为了您的顺利入场，请出示邀请函。
Desc.LocalizedString: Greetings, honored guest. Please present your invitation.

Desc.SourceString: 这种时候，可别松懈哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Now's not the time to let your guard down!

Desc.SourceString: 一亿？！怎么不按剧本来啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: One hundred million?! How could you do that!

Desc.SourceString: 看来，胜利归我喽~
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like victory goes to me!

Desc.SourceString: 你……你好！
Desc.LocalizedString: H-Hello there!

Desc.SourceString: （是在叫我吗……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Is that voice speaking to me…?)

Desc.SourceString: 阳光落满的庭院，母亲种下的樱花树正值花期。时间已然停驻，幸福的一瞬反复重演……
Desc.LocalizedString: The cherry tree Mother planted in the courtyard is bathing in sunlight and in full bloom. Time has come to a standstill, and moments of happiness plays over and over again…

Desc.SourceString: （不知道钨丝先生准备的怎么样了，有时间过去看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I wonder how Tungsten's preparations are going. I should take a look when I can.)

Desc.SourceString: 腿、腿软了，走不了……
Desc.LocalizedString: My… my legs gave out, I can't move…

Desc.SourceString: （光辉的光辉事迹……原来是这个意思吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Clarion's glory days… Is this what he meant?)

Desc.SourceString: （看来光辉和迦楼罗的合作很顺利啊……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…Looks like their plan is going well.)

Desc.SourceString: 这种东西发出去只会掉粉。
Desc.LocalizedString: This trash content will only cost me followers.

Desc.SourceString: ***这些该死的记者！
Desc.LocalizedString: Those friggin' damn reporters!

Desc.SourceString: ……正义，呵。
Desc.LocalizedString: …Justice, heh.

Desc.SourceString: （光辉的状态有点不对劲，他准备做什么……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (There's something wrong with Clarion… What's going on?)

Desc.SourceString: 赶紧干掉他！这些事不能让第三个人知道！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hurry up and get rid of this rat! No one can know about this!

Desc.SourceString: 废物！废物！废物！一群人连一个人都打不过！
Desc.LocalizedString: You useless, worthless fools! Can't even stop one guy?

Desc.SourceString: ……朋友！你来得正好！我拖住他们了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Friend… Perfect timing! I held them back for you!

Desc.SourceString: 他们这些人都是城市的毒瘤！
Desc.LocalizedString: These are all but cancer cells to the City!

Desc.SourceString: 把他们都解决掉！
Desc.LocalizedString: Purge them!

Desc.SourceString: 不过，现在这个位置似乎不太好……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm, this angle doesn't seem quite right…

Desc.SourceString: 这里也没法拍到摩天轮……再换个位置看看？
Desc.LocalizedString: I can't get a good shot of the Ferris wheel from here either… Let's try another spot?

Desc.SourceString: 角度还差一点，还要再往上边去……爬上去试试？
Desc.LocalizedString: The angle's still off, I need to go higher… Let's go higher?

Desc.SourceString: 我真的看到了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I really saw it!

Desc.SourceString: 真的吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Is that really true…

Desc.SourceString: （想象中的自己、未来、平行世界……好多复杂的概念。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (My imagined self, the future, parallel worlds… So many complex concepts.)

Desc.SourceString: （很少能见到这种类型的异象，最好还是找到实物研究一下。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It's rare to see this type of Anomaly. I should try to find the actual object to study it.)

Desc.SourceString: （总之先去中古店找找这面镜子……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Anyway, I should start by looking for this mirror at the vintage shop…)

Desc.SourceString: （接下来要去哪里呢……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Where should I go next…?)

Desc.SourceString: （对了，好人乔提到金苹果藏馆，说不定这件东西真的被收到那里去了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Oh right, Good Joe mentioned the Gold Apple Collection Hall. Maybe it really was taken there.)

Desc.SourceString: （过去看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Let's go take a look.)

Desc.SourceString: 这好像，并不是我啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: This seems like… it's not really me…

Desc.SourceString: 可是某些地方又很相似……
Desc.LocalizedString: But in some ways, it's quite similar…

Desc.SourceString: 完成了，就这样交卷吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's done. Let's submit it like this.

Desc.SourceString: 再检查一下
Desc.LocalizedString: Check again

Desc.SourceString: 时间还充裕，再检查一遍吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's still plenty of time. Let's check it again.

Desc.SourceString: 这个人……不行，面相看着不像是会好好珍惜车的……
Desc.LocalizedString: This person… No, their face doesn't look like someone who'd take good care of a car…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……那边那个……好像可以？
Desc.LocalizedString: Um… that person over there… might work?

Desc.SourceString: （感觉无视她会更麻烦……还是去现场一趟，把话好好说清楚吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I feel like ignoring her would just cause more trouble… I should go and clear things up properly.)

Desc.SourceString: （没找到拒绝的时机，还是坐上来了……既然如此，至少享受这场比赛吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I couldn't find the right moment to refuse, so I ended up getting in anyway… Well, since I'm here, I might as well enjoy the race.)

Desc.SourceString: 弯道刹车点要来了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Braking point coming up!

Desc.SourceString: 前面是两连续复合弯道……最考验技术的部分！
Desc.LocalizedString: Up ahead are two consecutive compound turns… the most technically challenging section!

Desc.SourceString: 呜呼！我最喜欢长直道了，只需要……一脚油门踩到底！
Desc.LocalizedString: Woohoo! Long straights are my favorite! FLOOR IT!

Desc.SourceString: 终点就在眼前——就交给你了，「极光」！
Desc.LocalizedString: The finish line is right ahead—it's all up to you now, Aurora!

Desc.SourceString: 我第一次来管理局的时候，薄荷就是把临时收容的异象送到这里来了吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: When I first came to the Bureau, Mint brought the anomaly to Temp-con here, right?

Desc.SourceString: 是的，临时收容层负责收容管理暂未探明特性的异象和异象衍生物。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, Temp-con manages anomalies and derivatives that we don't fully comprehend.

Desc.SourceString: 后续会根据情况进行泯除处理或者送至「塞拉伊诺馆」长期收容。
Desc.LocalizedString: Depending on the situation, they'll either be nullified or transferred to the Celaeno Compound for long-term containment.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然等下我们会不可避免地和未知特性的异象衍生物直接接触，但安全方面无需担心。
Desc.LocalizedString: We're about to directly contact anomaly derivatives of unknown properties. That said, your safety is guaranteed.

Desc.SourceString: 快来快来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Come on!

Desc.SourceString: 嘻嘻！我打赌！这回一定是我赢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe! I bet this time I'll win!

Desc.SourceString: 奇怪，推不开。
Desc.LocalizedString: Strange, it won't budge.

Desc.SourceString: 居然是……先吃了闭门羹。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm feeling rather… shut out.

Desc.SourceString: 这真的是一扇门吗？摸起来好不真实。
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this really a door? It feels so strange.

Desc.SourceString: 会不会是不能从我们这边打开？
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe… it needs to be opened from the other side?

Desc.SourceString: 有可能。我们先去那边看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe. Let's check over there.

Desc.SourceString: 哎，我说，好像有个不太好的传闻……
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a bad rumor going around…

Desc.SourceString: 前阵子我先生告诉我……
Desc.LocalizedString: A while back, my husband told me…

Desc.SourceString: ……哦！您先请说。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh! Please, go ahead.

Desc.SourceString: 不不不，还是您先请。
Desc.LocalizedString: No, no, you go first.

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀，这个这个……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my, this…

Desc.SourceString: 行了行了，不就是请我们来的那位的那点儿事嘛！有什么说不得的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come on, you're talking about the one who invited us here, right? What's so unspeakable about this?

Desc.SourceString: 唉哟，在人家家里说这些，总归是不太好的嘛……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my, gossiping about someone in their place doesn't feel right…

Desc.SourceString: 最近生意挺顺的哈？我可听说你家又拓展了新业务……改天聊聊？
Desc.LocalizedString: I heard you've been doing well. Is that right? Your family business also expanded into new ventures… Can we have a little chat some time?

Desc.SourceString: 哟！原来是您……！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh! It's you…!

Desc.SourceString: 唉唉，低调低调，没什么了不起的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please, I haven't done much. No need to make a big deal out of it.

Desc.SourceString: 真没想到在这能结识您，以后还请您多关照，多关照。合作的事都好说。
Desc.LocalizedString: I never expected to meet you here. Please look after us in the future. I look forward to working together.

Desc.SourceString: 能得到德洛莉丝女士的邀请，这里谁不是城中有头有脸的人物。别那么谦虚，哈哈哈！
Desc.LocalizedString: Anyone who gets an invitation from Lady Dolores is someone important in the city. Don't be so modest!

Desc.SourceString: 咳……晚辈……咳咳，晚辈我只是替家父出席。家父工作繁忙，特意嘱咐我来当面转达他的感谢。多亏有康斯坦丁家族的关照，家里才能从那次失败的投资里走出来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahem… I… umm, this humble one is here representing his father, who is busy at work but nonetheless asked his son to express gratitude in person. Thanks to the Constantines, our family was able to recover from our failed investment.

Desc.SourceString: 这么说，在座的各位，都或多或少受到了康斯坦丁家族的关照啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: So it seems everyone here received help from the Constantines in one way or another…

Desc.SourceString: 这大胆奇妙的笔触，不愧是巴兹尔大师！
Desc.LocalizedString: Such bold and marvelous brushwork! Master Basil truly lives up to his reputation!

Desc.SourceString: 真正的精美……绝对的优雅……
Desc.LocalizedString: Absolutely exquisite… thoroughly elegant…

Desc.SourceString: 怎么？我的朋友，也是来感受这些「真正的艺术」的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, my friend, are you also here to experience true art?

Desc.SourceString: 我听说巴兹尔大师与德洛莉丝女士私交不错。在巴兹尔大师还是默默无名的毛头小伙子的时候，德洛莉丝女士便很是赏识他。
Desc.LocalizedString: I heard that Master Basil and Lady Dolores have a good personal relationship. When Master Basil was still a young artist, Ms. Dolores already recognized his talent.

Desc.SourceString: 巴兹尔大师的每次展览，背后都有康斯坦丁家族的资助。而巴兹尔大师也回赠了很多自己的作品……
Desc.LocalizedString: All of Master Basil's exhibitions were backed by the Constantines. Master Basil also gave them many of his own works in return…

Desc.SourceString: 所以，毫无疑问，墙上的都是巴兹尔大师的真迹！
Desc.LocalizedString: Without a doubt, everything on these walls are authentic works by Master Basil!

Desc.SourceString: 只是我稍微有些不明白……你也注意到了吧朋友？那幅画真是特别……巴兹尔大师还留下过那样的作品吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm just slightly baffled… You noticed it too, friend? That painting is unusual… Did Master Basil ever paint something like that?

Desc.SourceString: 实不相瞒，我每次来访都会在它面前站上一阵子，对它的每根线条都在熟悉不过啦。绝对不是我眼花，但我怎么觉得……每次看那幅画，它的表情神态都不大一样？就好像画中人活着，会挤眉弄眼，会动一样！
Desc.LocalizedString: To be honest, I stand before this painting every visit. I'm familiar with every single stroke. But somehow… each time I look at the painting, its seems… a bit different? I swear I'm not making things up. It's like the person in it is alive, winking, moving, and making faces!

Desc.SourceString: 这就是伟大的艺术……太美妙，太难以置信了！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is what great art is… So wonderful, so incredible!

Desc.SourceString: 我表舅前阵子去世了。唉，最终还是没能看到他投资的那部电影上映。
Desc.LocalizedString: My uncle passed away recently. In the end, he never got to watch the movie he invested in. What a pity.

Desc.SourceString: 甚至他的回忆录才刚起了个头……
Desc.LocalizedString: He had barely started writing his memoir…

Desc.SourceString: 生命苦短，节哀。
Desc.LocalizedString: Life is short. My condolences.

Desc.SourceString: 是啊，赚再多的钱有什么用， 重要的是有时间花……
Desc.LocalizedString: Indeed. What's the point of making money if you don't have the time to spend it…?

Desc.SourceString: 很久没来问候德洛莉丝女士。之前一直卧病在床，现在身体才勉强恢复了些。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's been a while since I visited Lady Dolores. I was sick before, and I've just recovered a bit.

Desc.SourceString: 她还是那么温柔又细心地招待大家，就像以往的每一次……
Desc.LocalizedString: She's still welcoming everyone with such consideration, like all the times before…

Desc.SourceString: 可是，是我的错觉吗？我觉得她虽然笑着，招呼着我们，但眼里并没有神采。
Desc.LocalizedString: But is it just my imagination? Though she's smiling and greeting everyone, there's no light in her eyes.

Desc.SourceString: 就好像……一个空壳子一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: As if… she's an empty shell.

Desc.SourceString: 此前重病的时候，我也是那样。所以我再清楚不过了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I was the same when I was sick in my bed. I know this feeling all too well.

Desc.SourceString: 但其他人都没觉得德洛莉丝女士今天有何不一样，是我感觉有误，还是她从来都是如此呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: But no one else seems to think Lady Dolores is any different today. Am I mistaken, or has she always been like this…?

Desc.SourceString: 我家老头子，一天一个主意。这不，最近又想投资书店。怎么说都拦不住。
Desc.LocalizedString: My old man has a new idea every day. Now he wants to invest in a bookstore. I wasn't able to talk him out of it.

Desc.SourceString: 没两天功夫，地方选好了，名字也定好了，叫什么什么白鲸书店。
Desc.LocalizedString: In merely two days, he found a spot and even came up with a name… something like "Moby-Dick Bookstore."

Desc.SourceString: 我真是搞不懂他！
Desc.LocalizedString: I have no idea what's on his mind!

Desc.SourceString: 老先生有想法又有行动力，好事啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a good thing that he's got ideas and puts them to action.

Desc.SourceString: 啧，老头子懂什么投资理财。这年头，开书店哪有不赔的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch, what does the old man know about investment? All bookstores lose money these days!

Desc.SourceString: 我看不出两年那地方就要关门歇业，哼。
Desc.LocalizedString: I bet that place will shut down in two years… heh.

Desc.SourceString: 现在还不行？现在就是最好的机会！等散场就没法下手了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Not yet? This is a perfect chance! Once everyone leaves, it'll be too late!

Desc.SourceString: 一个个凑上去献殷勤，跟一条条小狗在主人身边蹦似的。
Desc.LocalizedString: One by one, they fawn over her like puppies hopping around their owner.

Desc.SourceString: 我弟弟可就不一样了……
Desc.LocalizedString: My brother is different though…

Desc.SourceString: 说你呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm talking about you!

Desc.SourceString: 我……嗯嗯。对的，是这样……
Desc.LocalizedString: I… uh-huh. Right, that's… that's right…

Desc.SourceString: 刚刚直勾勾看谁呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Who were you staring at?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？是的。不对不对，没看谁。
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? Yes. Wait, no. I wasn't looking at anyone.

Desc.SourceString: 刚刚过去的那位，是德沃夏克小姐的秘书吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: The one who just walked by is Miss Dvořák's secretary, right?

Desc.SourceString: 居然把德沃夏克家族也请来了，德洛莉丝真是不简单。
Desc.LocalizedString: Dolores even managed to invite the Dvořáks? She really is something else.

Desc.SourceString: 不止。我要是没看错的话，噗卡集团的柯德莱茵先生也在，就在那边。
Desc.LocalizedString: If I'm not mistaken, Mr. Kodlein from Puka Group is also here. Ah, over there.

Desc.SourceString: 哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oooh!

Desc.SourceString: 这女人真是不简单，很不简单。
Desc.LocalizedString: That woman is impressive. Extremely impressive.

Desc.SourceString: 唉哟，那都是我父辈那时候的事了。我家当时啊，都濒临破产啦！多亏有德洛莉丝拉我们一把……
Desc.LocalizedString: During my father's generation, our family was almost broke. Thank goodness, Dolores was there to give us a helping hand…

Desc.SourceString: 但她只是说这些都是应该的。在康斯坦丁家麻烦缠身的时候，是我爷爷伸出了援手……
Desc.LocalizedString: She told us she was just doing the right thing, since when the Constantines were in trouble, my grandfather also helped them…

Desc.SourceString: 据说更早的时候，康斯坦丁家还是上一任家主在打拼事业的时候，我们两家就有过合作往来。
Desc.LocalizedString: They say that back when Constantines were still building up business, our two families worked together.

Desc.SourceString: 真想不到原来还有这样的交情！
Desc.LocalizedString: I had no idea there was such history!

Desc.SourceString: 哟，那你们关系一定很近了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, your families must be close.

Desc.SourceString: 这可是世家的交情啊，别人羡慕都羡慕不来！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a bond between established families! Others can only dream of such connections!

Desc.SourceString: 真可惜，现在我们两家已经越来越远了。要是我那不争气的亲戚没有三天两头找德洛莉丝借钱的话……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a shame that our families have been growing apart. It's all because a good-for-nothing relative kept asking Dolores for money…

Desc.SourceString: 什么时候动手？
Desc.LocalizedString: When do we make our move?

Desc.SourceString: 现在还不行，再等等。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not yet. We need to wait longer.

Desc.SourceString: 欸，别急别急~相信我的准备。现在，我们只需要静静等待时机。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, don't worry. Trust my preparations. We just need to wait for the right moment.

Desc.SourceString: 如果我们的A计划不成功，我还有备用的B计划，C计划。
Desc.LocalizedString: If Plan A doesn't work out, I still have Plan B and Plan C.

Desc.SourceString: 要是宴会上没办法搞定，结束后我还有D计划E计划……
Desc.LocalizedString: If we can't take action during the party, I still got Plan D and Plan E for after the party…

Desc.SourceString: 小声点吧你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Keep your voice down!

Desc.SourceString: 干杯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Cheers?

Desc.SourceString: 祝邀请我们来品酒的德洛莉丝女士永远幸福，永远美丽。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here's to Lady Dolores, who invited us for wine tasting. May she be forever happy and forever beautiful!

Desc.SourceString: 干杯。
Desc.LocalizedString: Cheers.

Desc.SourceString: 多好的艾琳诺。我听说是艾琳诺伯爵珍藏的最好的一批。
Desc.LocalizedString: What excellent Irenor wine. I heard this is from Count Irenor's finest collection.

Desc.SourceString: 市面上哪儿有这种品质？简直可以说它无价也无市。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nothing on the market beats this. It's truly priceless and impossible to buy.

Desc.SourceString: 所以要趁现在好好珍惜，干杯。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's why we should treasure this opportunity. Cheers!

Desc.SourceString: 今天的告别宴真是有声有色。德洛莉丝女士的千金看起来年纪轻轻，能力却不简单呐。
Desc.LocalizedString: This farewell banquet is terrific. The daughter of Lady Dolores may look young, but her abilities are certainly remarkable.

Desc.SourceString: 他们说这是她大女儿，你们就信了？反正我不信。
Desc.LocalizedString: They say she's her eldest daughter, and you all just believe it? I, for one, don't buy it.

Desc.SourceString: 这就是你有所不知咯。我不仅知道这是她的大女儿，我还知道有其他孩子。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's where you're wrong. Not only is this the eldest daughter, she also has other children.

Desc.SourceString: 我家裁缝之前也给康斯坦丁家做过一批衣服。你们猜猜，一共有几套？
Desc.LocalizedString: My tailor made a batch of clothes for the Constantines before. Guess how many outfits were requested?

Desc.SourceString: 两三套？三四套？
Desc.LocalizedString: Two or three sets? Three or four?

Desc.SourceString: 七套。
Desc.LocalizedString: Seven.

Desc.SourceString: 不可能，这也太多了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Impossible, that's way too many!

Desc.SourceString: 这有什么不可能？还记不记得她资助过的孤儿院……现在知道这些孩子打哪儿来的吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's so impossible? Remember, she funded an orphanage… Now you know where those children come from.

Desc.SourceString: 我懂了。收养一群能力出色的孩子，从中挑选一位最合适的继承人。
Desc.LocalizedString: I get it now. She adopted a group of talented children, so she could pick the best one among them to inherit the family.

Desc.SourceString: 看来最合适的就是今天露脸的这位了。是不是叫贝拉？我等会多关注关注……
Desc.LocalizedString: The daughter who showed up today seems most likely the successor. Her name is Bella, isn't it? I'll have to keep an eye on her…

Desc.SourceString: 兰斯酒庄。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reims Winery.

Desc.SourceString: 噗卡集团。至少就我知道的，有至少三条产线是康斯坦丁在实际控制。
Desc.LocalizedString: Puka Group. As far as I know, the Constantines control at least three production lines.

Desc.SourceString: 我家的买卖也有一部分。
Desc.LocalizedString: As well as part of my family's business.
Ugh…

Desc.SourceString: 我不敢继续数了，怕最后数出来半个海特洛都在德洛莉丝手里。
Desc.LocalizedString: I need to stop counting. I might end up realizing half of Hethereau is under the control of Dolores.

Desc.SourceString: 那倒不至于。德沃夏克还差不多。
Desc.LocalizedString: That would more likely be the case for the Dvořáks.

Desc.SourceString: 我一直挺好奇的，德洛莉丝总是请我们来——图个什么呐？
Desc.LocalizedString: I've always been curious about this. Dolores keeps inviting us over… but what is she really after?

Desc.SourceString: 我起初以为是请我们来谈生意，结果我的暗示她压根就不感兴趣。
Desc.LocalizedString: I thought she wanted to talk business, but she was never interested in any business talk.

Desc.SourceString: 也不像和朋友叙旧。我观察那边好一阵子了，她对谁都一副爱答不理的样子。
Desc.LocalizedString: It doesn't seem like she wants to catch up with friends either. I've been observing her for a while, and she's indifferent to everyone.

Desc.SourceString: 也就和噗卡的那个老头聊上几句。
Desc.LocalizedString: She only chats a bit with that old guy from Puka.

Desc.SourceString: 所以说德洛莉丝女士对噗卡人偶戏感兴趣？欸，我突然有个主意……
Desc.LocalizedString: You mean Dolores is interested in Puka's puppet theater? Hey, I suddenly have an idea…

Desc.SourceString: 省省吧你，买几张票都没用。她不会搭理你的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop it. A few tickets won't help. She won't pay any attention to you.

Desc.SourceString: 这不是手头资金周转困难吗，只要能借到钱，什么招都得使出来……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm having cash flow problems. I'll have to try everything to get a loan…

Desc.SourceString: ……但你永恒的夏天不会褪色，
Desc.LocalizedString: …but thy eternal summer shall not wane,

Desc.SourceString: 你也不会丢失皎洁的芬芳，
Desc.LocalizedString: Nor shall thy blooming fragrance e'er decay;

Desc.SourceString: 死神无法夸口你漂泊在他的阴影里，
Desc.LocalizedString: Death vaunteth not that thou art in his reign,

Desc.SourceString: 阴影里……阴影里……后面是什么来着？
Desc.LocalizedString: …in his reign… reign… What comes next again?

Desc.SourceString: 哦哦！时间，时间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, it's Time, Time!

Desc.SourceString: 因为你在我不朽的诗里与时间同长。
Desc.LocalizedString: For in my verse thou liv’st beyond Time’s sway.

Desc.SourceString: 真的假的？我还以为那些青春永驻的传闻，都是为了讨好她瞎编出来的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Really? I thought all those rumors about eternal youth were made up to flatter her.

Desc.SourceString: 当然是真的，我年轻时见过她一面。和现在一模一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course it's true. I saw her once when I was young. She looks exactly the same now.

Desc.SourceString: 也许是人保养的好？她肯定不缺护肤品用，就比如，那个叫什么什么柯来着？
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe she has a great skincare routine? She definitely has access to all skincare products, like, what was that brand called… something that ends with "rick"?

Desc.SourceString: 兰德里柯。他们家设计师就在这，说话注意点儿！
Desc.LocalizedString: Landric. Their product designer is right here, watch your tongue!

Desc.SourceString: 知道了大伯……
Desc.LocalizedString: Got it, uncle…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师！这边这边！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser! Over here, over here!

Desc.SourceString: 等见到协会的人，千万不要轻信他们的话，这些钓鱼佬最喜欢和陌生人吹牛了！
Desc.LocalizedString: When you meet the Association members, don't believe everything they say. Those fishing fanatics love bragging to strangers!

Desc.SourceString: 他们人倒是都不坏，可一旦沾上钓鱼，就全变成笨蛋了……
Desc.LocalizedString: They're not bad people, really. But the moment fishing comes up, they all turn into total airheads…

Desc.SourceString: 你平时不和他们一起钓鱼吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You don't usually go fishing with them?

Desc.SourceString: 等见到协会的人，千万不要轻信他们的话，这些钓鱼佬最喜欢和陌生人吹牛了！
Desc.LocalizedString: When you meet the Association members, don't believe everything they say. Those fishing fanatics love bragging to strangers!

Desc.SourceString: 真抱歉，还得麻烦你陪他们胡闹……但比起会长，协会的几位都很好说话，而且我会帮你的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Sorry you have to put up with their antics… But compared to the President, the other members are pretty easy to talk to. I'll even help you out!

Desc.SourceString: 水菱湖方向好像有些异象波动……
Desc.LocalizedString: There seems to be some fluctuation coming from Caltrop Lake…

Desc.SourceString: <!>镜与戏这里书房的门打不开应该说两句吧
Desc.LocalizedString: The door to the study here, which is locked, should I say something?

Desc.SourceString: 是妈妈送给我们的礼物，我也有一个属于我的。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a gift from Mom to all of us. I have one too.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然时时刻刻把它带在身边，我却早就忘记了它的来历，也忘了它象征着什么。
Desc.LocalizedString: Though I carry it all the time, I've forgotten where it came from and what it means.

Desc.SourceString: 能回来真好。找到你，终于找到你了……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's so good to be back. I found you, I finally found you…

Desc.SourceString: 我最重要的家人。
Desc.LocalizedString: …my most important family.

Desc.SourceString: 好奇怪，妈妈不喜欢红色，衣服上为什么会有这样的东西？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's strange. Mom doesn't like red. Why would something like this be on her clothes?

Desc.SourceString: 红色的字母？
Desc.LocalizedString: Red letters?

Desc.SourceString: 我还是很在意红色的字母……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm still bothered by those red letters…

Desc.SourceString: 唔，是名字的话……的确和刚刚听到的声音对得上号。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm, if they are names… they do match with the voices we heard earlier.

Desc.SourceString: 但明晃晃扎眼的红色，就好像……警告一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: But that bright red… is like a warning.

Desc.SourceString: 我想应该不是妈妈缝上去的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't think Mom did this.

Desc.SourceString: 不是名字的首字母么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Aren't they the first letters of names?

Desc.SourceString: 因为他们都真心实意地爱过我，所以才会如此这般痛恨我吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: They truly loved me once, which is why now they hate me so much.

Desc.SourceString: 我都理解的，很抱歉过去让你们承受了那么多……
Desc.LocalizedString: I understand. I'm sorry for making you go through so much in the past…

Desc.SourceString: 很抱歉我现在才知道，很庆幸我现在终于能知道了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sorry I'm only learning this just now, but I'm grateful that I finally do.

Desc.SourceString: 哥哥姐姐们，我能为你们做些什么呢……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Big brothers and sisters, what can I do for you…?

Desc.SourceString: 我能回到这里来，一定是因为我还有能做的事，对吧……？
Desc.LocalizedString: I came back here, because there was something I can do, right…?

Desc.SourceString: 「tayge！」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Tayge!"

Desc.SourceString: 好偏僻的地方……感觉真不舒服。
Desc.LocalizedString: We're in the middle of nowhere… I don't like this.

Desc.SourceString: 「今天难得有委托，娜娜莉，快走啦。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Nanally, let's go already. Commissions are hard to come by."

Desc.SourceString: 雾气很重，大家小心脚下。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's foggy here. Mind your steps.

Desc.SourceString: 「娜娜莉，今天的早餐做了你最喜欢的芝士肉塔饼。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Nanally, I made your favorite cheese and meat pancake for breakfast."

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，你说里面会不会也有塔吉多这样的电视海獭？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you think this place has TV Otters like Taygedo?

Desc.SourceString: 你说塔吉多老了以后，会不会来这个度假村养老？
Desc.LocalizedString: You think Taygedo can move here once he gets old?

Desc.SourceString: 欸，这里环境真好啊……我也想住进来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Woah, this place is great…! Even I want to live here.

Desc.SourceString: 等等、岛屿生存……感觉可以拍一部《娜娜莉漂流记》。传奇岛主娜娜莉，酷！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait… island… survival… Maybe I can star in a movie, Nanally Stranding! It'll be a strand-type of movie!

Desc.SourceString: 虎老大说，只要我有需要随时可以将它当作依靠，然后给了我一个大大的、温暖的拥抱~
Desc.LocalizedString: Boss Tiger told me that I can rely on him whenever I need to! Then he gave me a big, warm hug!

Desc.SourceString: 明天给虎老大带点阿德勒先生做的芝士蛋卷吧~它一定会喜欢的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tomorrow, I'll bring Boss Tiger some cheese eggrolls the old man made. I'm sure he'll like it!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……忘记问它平时会做什么事了。得多多了解它才行！
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… I forgot to ask about his hobbies. I need to do better!

Desc.SourceString: 回去后先把虎老大的事情分享给大家！然后，唔……给师父发消息！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll tell everyone about Boss Tiger as soon as I get back. Then… hmm, I'll send a message to Master!

Desc.SourceString: 等师父回来，我就带她一起去看虎老大。她一定也会喜欢的，嘿嘿~
Desc.LocalizedString: When Master comes back, I'll bring her to see Boss Tiger! I'm sure she'll like him, hehe!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师……我有点……跑不动了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser… I can't… go on anymore…

Desc.SourceString: 唔……太困了。鉴定师，多亏了你，这下我能清醒地做个好梦了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… I'm so sleepy… Appraiser, thanks to you, I can finally have a good dream…

Desc.SourceString: 带我回家，就……交给你啦！这是老大的嘱托！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll rely on you to… bring me home. Boss's orders!

Desc.SourceString: 等到了伊波恩，见到大家，见到师父……一定要记得……把我喊醒……
Desc.LocalizedString: When we get back to Eibon, when we see everyone… and Master… remember to… wake me…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm!

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼~新开的店？半角街可是我的地盘！
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheh, a new shop just opened? Hankaku Street is my turf!

Desc.SourceString: 柯林斯家族一代目，也是唯一成员——娜娜莉
Desc.LocalizedString: I, Nanally, the Ichi-daime, and the only member of the Coluccis…

Desc.SourceString: 前来踢馆！
Desc.LocalizedString: …Is here to challenge you!

Desc.SourceString: 这里可是我早就看上的秘密基地！你们管事的呢，叫出来！
Desc.LocalizedString: This place is going to be my secret hideout. Tell your boss to come here right now!

Desc.SourceString: ——哎哟！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ouchyyy—!

Desc.SourceString: 「小屁孩，你打碎了我们店最贵的藏品。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Hey, little brat, you just broke the most valuable antique in our shop."

Desc.SourceString: 「看你身上也没钱的样子，就给我留下来打工还债吧！」
Desc.LocalizedString: "I don't think you can ever compensate us. Stay here and work off your debt!"

Desc.SourceString: 总之，我就这样加入了伊波恩
Desc.LocalizedString: Anyway, that's how I joined Eibon.

Desc.SourceString: 在伊波恩，就好像……
Desc.LocalizedString: At Eibon, it's like…

Desc.SourceString: 拥有了一个真正的家族，或者说「家」
Desc.LocalizedString: …I have a real family, or rather, "home."

Desc.SourceString: 师父！要怎么样才能像你一样呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Master! What should I do to be like you?

Desc.SourceString: 我想变得更强大
Desc.LocalizedString: I want to be stronger.

Desc.SourceString: 强大到所有人都认可我的家族
Desc.LocalizedString: So strong, that everyone recognizes my family.

Desc.SourceString: 强大到可以庇护每一个家人和朋友
Desc.LocalizedString: So strong, that I can protect all my family and friends.

Desc.SourceString: 强大到不会再失去任何一个人
Desc.LocalizedString: So strong, that I won't lose anyone anymore.

Desc.SourceString: 这次……不要再丢下我了
Desc.LocalizedString: This time… don't leave me alone.

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉！永远强大！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally! Forever strong!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师……我有点跑不动了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser… I can't… go on anymore…

Desc.SourceString: 尊敬的各位来宾，各位记者……
Desc.LocalizedString: Esteemed guests and members of the press…

Desc.SourceString: 生面孔？来，来这边！
Desc.LocalizedString: New face? Come on, over here!

Desc.SourceString: （达芙蒂尔似乎在后院，去看看她吧……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Daffodill seems to be in the backyard. I should check on her…)

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀~真是因祸得福，居然还能坐上你开的车~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh wow! Talk about a blessing in disguise. I even get to ride in your car!

Desc.SourceString: 你最好不是故意的……
Desc.LocalizedString: You'd better not have done that on purpose…

Desc.SourceString: 怎么会~我是那种喜欢偷懒占便宜的人吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: What? Me? Do I look like the type who enjoys slacking off and taking advantage of situations?

Desc.SourceString: 唉呀~这次真的是意外！下回换我开车，也带你去哪逛逛，总能扯平了吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oops! This time it really was an accident! Next time I'll drive and take you somewhere fun to hang out. That should make us even, right?

Desc.SourceString: 那我就记着了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll keep that in mind, then.

Desc.SourceString: 之前看不出来，你车技还挺不错的嘛，这车比较老，我还担心你开不习惯呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're actually a pretty good driver! This car's pretty old, so I was worried you might have trouble getting used to it.

Desc.SourceString: 我有时会兼职送快递。
Desc.LocalizedString: I sometimes work part-time delivering packages.

Desc.SourceString: 嚯……深藏不露啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Whoa… You're full of surprises!

Desc.SourceString: 要是哪天我因为摸鱼被开除了，也去送送快递好了~
Desc.LocalizedString: If I ever get fired for slacking off one day, I guess I could just deliver packages instead!

Desc.SourceString: 感觉能看到你被客户投诉的画面……
Desc.LocalizedString: I can already picture you getting complaints from customers…

Desc.SourceString: 没……没气了？！我只是路过！不是我干的！
Desc.LocalizedString: There is… no breath? I was just passing by! I didn't do it!

Desc.SourceString: 这是证据？要、要毁掉吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this evidence? Should I get…get rid of it…?

Desc.SourceString: 什么人？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Who's there?!

Desc.SourceString: 拦住他！别坏了「暗火」老大的好事！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop him! Don't let him ruin Nox's plans!

Desc.SourceString: 我就说不该让新人守门！解决他！
Desc.LocalizedString: I told you we shouldn't have left the rookies on door duty! Take him out!

Desc.SourceString: 哟，新来的群演……不、不对劲！抄家伙！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey there, new extra… Wait, something's off! Grab your weapons!

Desc.SourceString: 你怎么进来的？！出事了快去通知老大！
Desc.LocalizedString: How did you get in here? Go tell the boss we got trouble!

Desc.SourceString: 该死……有人进来了！警戒！
Desc.LocalizedString: Damn it… Someone's broken in! Be on guard!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？换班了？不对！大姐头！有人闯进来了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Shift change? Wait, no! Boss! Someone's broken in!

Desc.SourceString: 能闯到这，看来下面的人都被你解决了啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're here. That means you took care of everyone downstairs.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然我也看不上那位，但不能让你影响暗火大哥！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not a fan of that guy, but I can't let you mess with Nox!

Desc.SourceString: 上！让他看看迦楼罗精英的实力！
Desc.LocalizedString: Get 'em! Show 'em what Garuda's elites are made of!

Desc.SourceString: 是！队长！
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, Captain!

Desc.SourceString: （阿德勒先生看起来，比平时话更少了……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Adler is even more quiet than usual…)

Desc.SourceString: （埃德嘉……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Edgar…)

Desc.SourceString: （如果这间屋子坏掉了，塔吉多可以修好它。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Even if this house falls apart, Taygedo can still fix it.)

Desc.SourceString: （这支钢笔，看起来挺贵重的样子，就这样被人丢掉了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This pen looks expensive. Can't believe someone just threw it away.)

Desc.SourceString: （……仔细看，笔尖还有红色的墨渍？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Wait… there's some red ink at its nib?)

Desc.SourceString: 要不然，塔吉多还是留下吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, I think Taygedo should stay.

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多照顾好娜娜莉，我和呆子去把他们找回来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo, take care of Nanally. I'll go with dummy to bring them back.

Desc.SourceString: 又多了一个差评，让我看看怎么说的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Another bad review? Lemme see what this loser has to say.

Desc.SourceString: 「……店员矮个小孩性情恶劣……」咦，呆子也有被挑刺的时候？
Desc.LocalizedString: "…the short kiddo employee has no manners…" Why would anyone find fault with the dummy?

Desc.SourceString: 快给我！
Desc.LocalizedString: Gimme! Gimme!

Desc.SourceString: 停下！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop already!

Desc.SourceString: 你给我等着！！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll catch you!

Desc.SourceString: 没听说。那是大叔留下的纸条，上面写了啥？
Desc.LocalizedString: I dunno. What's on that note from the old man?

Desc.SourceString: 六队另外那个小队员去哪了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where's the other ETD-6 member?

Desc.SourceString: 调查得差不多了吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: I think we're almost done here.

Desc.SourceString: ……上个月做了好几单大生意，账面上怎么还是冒出赤字来了？
Desc.LocalizedString: …We did a few big commissions last month, how are we still losing money?
Tch…

Desc.SourceString: 还得靠招财宝，多招揽几笔买卖，把钱狠狠赚回来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Precious, I'll need you to get us more cases and make our money back.

Desc.SourceString: 对了，招财宝……
Desc.LocalizedString: By the way, Precious…

Desc.SourceString: 除了咱们，还有E.T.D的人，和那位莳小姐。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's us, ETD personnel, and Thyme.
