Desc.SourceString: 招财宝……
Desc.LocalizedString: Precious…

Desc.SourceString: 「特殊收容」只是个临时的说法，真正发挥作用的是某个保密级异象。不知道艾尔菲德从哪里弄来这种东西……
Desc.LocalizedString: The "special containment protocol" is just a cover. What really worked was a classified anomaly. I have no idea how Alphard managed to get something like that…

Desc.SourceString: 局长大人淘来的黑科技还是不要碰的为好，她可不是那种循规蹈矩的保守派。
Desc.LocalizedString: You should stay away from the Director's sketchy hacks. She isn't some goody-two-shoes who goes by the book.

Desc.SourceString: 走吧，上楼帮T女士打扫去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go upstairs and do some cleaning for Madam T.

Desc.SourceString: 看看去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's take a look.

Desc.SourceString: ……简直是一片狼藉，树根把墙体都撑破了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The room… is a total wreck. Tree roots have burst through the walls.

Desc.SourceString: 哎，镜子里是不是多了一扇门？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, is the mirror showing an extra door?

Desc.SourceString: 哪有猎物会主动登上猎人家的大门，只是那些人没有自知之明罢了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Have you ever heard of prey knocking on the hunter's door? Those people have absolutely no idea what's going on.

Desc.SourceString: 好高……电视机在这么高的地方，该不会是什么诱饵吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: So high… The TV is all the way up there. Could it be some kind of trap?

Desc.SourceString: 走吧，这次我们一起进去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's enter together this time. Go.

Desc.SourceString: 小心，前面有人。
Desc.LocalizedString: Careful. Someone's there.

Desc.SourceString: 小姐，您忘了刚刚结掉斯特利那边的赊账。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lady, you haven't settled the tab from Sterry.

Desc.SourceString: 关掉电视机，红线也消失，树开始松动……看来卡厄斯的方法是奏效的。
Desc.LocalizedString: The TV is off, the red line is gone, and the tree is looser… Whatever Chaos wanted us to do is working.

Desc.SourceString: 有扇房门亮着灯？
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a door with a light on?

Desc.SourceString: 小心脚下！
Desc.LocalizedString: Watch your step!

Desc.SourceString: 原来如此……镜子能照出空间真正的样子。
Desc.LocalizedString: I get it now… the mirror reflects what the space actually is.

Desc.SourceString: 回到地面了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Back to the ground.

Desc.SourceString: 店里已经没有需要修理的东西了。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's nothing to fix in the shop anymore.

Desc.SourceString: 可是，屋子里的人不在了，修好了也只是一个空空的伊波恩呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: But fixing the house wouldn't fix the fact that people are missing from their rooms at Eibon.

Desc.SourceString: （这里就是你的狩猎场么，T女士。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Madam T, this is the hunting grounds you mentioned?)

Desc.SourceString: 犯不着你操心。
Desc.LocalizedString: None of your business.

Desc.SourceString: 哼……大开大合，破绽过多。
Desc.LocalizedString: Heh, your moves have too many openings.

Desc.SourceString: 猎犬呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where's your hound?

Desc.SourceString: 那边……有什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's… there?

Desc.SourceString: （这两个孩子，是被装在麻袋里的那些……由T女士的宾客赞助的「耗材」。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (These two kids are the ones stuffed in the sacks… mere "consumables" sponsored by Madam T's guests.)

Desc.SourceString: （如果不是拥有异能，她们也不会被抓进来吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (They wouldn't have been captured in the first place if they weren't Espers.)

Desc.SourceString:
罪人 前行
迷雾之中 寻回「过去」
直面你恶 直面我身
Desc.LocalizedString:
The sinner presses on,
Through mist to reclaim, what was the past.
To face your evil, and myself unmasked.

Desc.SourceString: 「过去」？
Desc.LocalizedString: The past?

Desc.SourceString: 该不会，和「忒修斯之舵」有关……
Desc.LocalizedString: Could this be related to the Helm of Theseus?

Desc.SourceString: （这片浓到不自然的雾……难道还藏着什么危险？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This fog is unusually thick… Could there be hidden dangers?)

Desc.SourceString: 小心点，可能会有敌人。
Desc.LocalizedString: Careful. There might be enemies.

Desc.SourceString: 卡厄斯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Chaos?

Desc.SourceString: ……你还在吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you there…?

Desc.SourceString: 卡厄斯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Chaos?

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's wrong?

Desc.SourceString: 应该，也就一会儿吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, it's been a while.

Desc.SourceString: 你看到的身影，难道不是我？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you sure that wasn't me?

Desc.SourceString: （都到这种时候了，他还是信不过我？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (At a time like this, he still doesn't trust me?)
(That's not it…)

Desc.SourceString: 卡厄斯，你的猎犬呢？难道它也会受到雾的影响……
Desc.LocalizedString: Chaos, where's that hound of yours? Did the fog affect it too?

Desc.SourceString: （果然是她……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It has to be her…)

Desc.SourceString: 这里怎么会有蝴蝶？
Desc.LocalizedString: How's a butterfly here?

Desc.SourceString: 你们在哪？我看不见你们……
Desc.LocalizedString: Where are you? I can't see you…

Desc.SourceString: （不，残虹。你所在意的，已经不合时宜了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (No, Zankou. You're so out of touch.)

Desc.SourceString: （正因为有他们在，我才能走到这里。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I made it this far only because of them.)

Desc.SourceString: 这是……伊波恩？
Desc.LocalizedString: This is… Eibon?

Desc.SourceString: 大厅……怎么少了好多东西？
Desc.LocalizedString: The hall… Why are so many things missing?

Desc.SourceString: 震惊全市的「雾巢」异象事件迎来重大后续……艾尔菲德于昨日正式引咎辞职。这起三个月前发生……
Desc.LocalizedString: In a major development following the shocking "Fogden" incident… Alphard formally resigned, taking responsibility for the matter. About three months ago…

Desc.SourceString: 等等，三个月前？
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait, three months ago?

Desc.SourceString: 这里是……
Desc.LocalizedString: This is…

Desc.SourceString: 未来的，伊波恩？
Desc.LocalizedString: Eibon from the future?

Desc.SourceString: （那些亲昵的旧称谓，早已积了好厚一层灰。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Those old nicknames, haven't used them in a long time.)

Desc.SourceString: （我最后能为你做的，是回应此刻你的请求——）
Desc.LocalizedString: (All I can do for you is to answer your request at this moment…)

Desc.SourceString: （战斗）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Battle)

Desc.SourceString: （至死方休。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Till death holds sway.)

Desc.SourceString: 你回来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're back.

Desc.SourceString: （让我想起小时候的试炼。你把我们丢在荒山里，命令大家在日落前回家。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It reminds me of the tests you put me through when I was little. You threw us deep in the mountains and told us to get home before the sun set.)

Desc.SourceString: （伊波恩只剩下我一个人？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Am I the last one at Eibon?)
Huh…?

Desc.SourceString: （你给一些孩子准备了登山靴，而另一些孩子仍穿着芭蕾舞鞋。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (You gave some children hiking shoes, while others wore ballet shoes.)

Desc.SourceString: （在山里面，穿着舞鞋和赤脚也没什么分别。岩石摸起来明明是冰凉的，但脚底却是火燎般地痛着。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (But deep in the mountains, wearing ballet shoes is as good as wearing nothing. The rocky walls were cold to touch, but our feet were burning with pain.)

Desc.SourceString: （接受T女士的吹捧，深陷她的掌心却不自知，还以为自己真的与众不同。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The scholar considered himself outstanding when in fact he was just buttered up and manipulated by Madam T.)

Desc.SourceString: （小时候的我，又何尝不是如此……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Exactly like how I was when I was little…)

Desc.SourceString: （还是把你们牵连了进来……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (In the end, I still dragged them all into this…)

Desc.SourceString: （现在的伊波恩还愿意接纳我吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (At this point, will Eibon still accept me?)

Desc.SourceString: （一个自说自话的「叛徒」……站在家人们的对立面。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A "traitor" speaking to herself… standing on the opposite side from her family.)

Desc.SourceString: （看来箱子里的值钱家当已经被洗劫一空。把雾巢当作最后的翻身之地么……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The valuables in the box have been looted. He must have tried to turn his life around in the Fogden…)

Desc.SourceString: （她以为自己走投无路，再没什么好失去的，只想得到一双眼睛。殊不知在T女士这里，一个人的自由，生命，甚至连灵魂都被标上了价格。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (She thought she had nothing more to lose with only a pair of eyes to gain. Little did she know that for Madam T, there was a price tag on everything—including her freedom, life, and soul.)

Desc.SourceString: （而最初那双眼睛，不过是最小的代价罢了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (And her eyesight was nothing but the smallest price to pay.)

Desc.SourceString: （形似黑色秃鹫的歧骸——有些印象，它们是某种伴生歧骸，跟雾柩没有关系。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (An oddity resembling a black vulture… I vaguely remember them being surge oddities. They should be unrelated to the Fogden.)

Desc.SourceString: （为什么会出现在这里，是被人带进来的？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (So why are they here… Did someone bring them inside?)

Desc.SourceString: 小姐，楼里很安静，没有埋伏。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lady, no one is waiting to ambush us here.

Desc.SourceString: 那「红字」和访客们……他们去哪了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Then where did the visitors and the Scarlet Letter go…?

Desc.SourceString: 果果果果，真不是隐藏职业吗？会触发隐藏剧情的那种！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taya, Taya, did you really not get some hidden class—one that triggers secret plots?

Desc.SourceString: 不太清楚，应该不是。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not sure. Probably not.

Desc.SourceString: 咦！莫非果果是想挑战自己，故意没有设定自己的职业和长处？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh! Did you set up to not get a class to challenge yourself?

Desc.SourceString: 并没有。做个普通人也挺好的。
Desc.LocalizedString: No. I think being a villager is just fine.

Desc.SourceString: 这样哦，虽说根据我的经验，有职业会方便很多欸……
Desc.LocalizedString: I see. In my previous runs, class skills helped a lot…

Desc.SourceString: 咳咳！不管怎么说，来到新的环境，首先要多多收集情报！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahem! Anyway, since we just got here, we should collect some intel!

Desc.SourceString: 最简单的方式，就是向本地人打听！我已经找到目标了！
Desc.LocalizedString: The easiest way to do that is to ask around. I found someone to ask!

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷是听不懂绵绵说的话吗？但伊洛伊施了个法术后，你就……？
Desc.LocalizedString: So Mint couldn't understand the Fuzzy? But you could after Iroi cast a spell…?

Desc.SourceString: 我？刚刚吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You're talking about me?

Desc.SourceString: 我用了个叫「动物交谈」的法术。
Desc.LocalizedString: I cast a spell called "Animal Speech."

Desc.SourceString: 效果好像是，让动物能理解其他智慧生物说的话——那个「旁白」告诉我的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I think it allows animals to understand other intelligent species. At least that's what the narrator said.

Desc.SourceString: 我们和绵绵都是「智慧生物」，薄荷却是……「动物」？
Desc.LocalizedString: So Fuzzies and us are intelligent species, but Mint is… an animal?

Desc.SourceString: 可我们和薄荷的沟通似乎没什么问题？
Desc.LocalizedString: But we can communicate with Mint without any issues?

Desc.SourceString: 宠物可以理解主人的话，这没什么奇怪的呀~
Desc.LocalizedString: Completely normal phenomenon. Pets simply understand their masters.

Desc.SourceString: 哦~原来是这么回事！没错没错。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, that explains everything! You must be right!

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷你也不知道吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint, you didn't know about this?

Desc.SourceString: 大笨猫的「智力」太低，被判定成动物了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The game must be treating the dumcat like an animal because her Intellect is too low.

Desc.SourceString: 意外！数值的问题都是意外啦！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not good with numbers, that was just a mistake!

Desc.SourceString: 这里怎么会有这么厉害的怪物！也太不合理了吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Why is such a strong monster here? That makes no sense!

Desc.SourceString: （有人拿雾巢当实验场？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Someone's using the Fogden to run experiments?)

Desc.SourceString: （蝴蝶？但这些不是真的蝴蝶。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Butterflies? But these aren't real.)

Desc.SourceString: （是有人自信到暴露踪迹，还是陷阱……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Is this a trap, or just someone who doesn't care being tracked down…?)

Desc.SourceString:
Khal. Dra.
Nesh. Fen Auld.Yith.
Kon-thul. Kon-drom.
Desc.LocalizedString:
Khal. Dra.
Nesh. Fen Auld.Yith.
Kon-thul. Kon-drom.

Desc.SourceString: 别担心，我把她们移去了安全的角落。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry. I moved them to a safe corner.

Desc.SourceString: 忘掉那些无趣的旁人，
Desc.LocalizedString: Forget the dull crowd fading from sight.

Desc.SourceString: 忘掉那些冗余的挂碍。
Desc.LocalizedString: Forget every burden clinging tight.

Desc.SourceString: 忘掉你是你，
Desc.LocalizedString: Forget that you are you.

Desc.SourceString: 我是我，
Desc.LocalizedString: And I am me, too.

Desc.SourceString: 就把今天，当作与我共度的末日……
Desc.LocalizedString: Let today be our end of the world, just us two.

Desc.SourceString: 战斗，
Desc.LocalizedString: Battle

Desc.SourceString: 直至消融。
Desc.LocalizedString: Till we melt away.

Desc.SourceString: 这鬼地方什么也看不见……
Desc.LocalizedString: Can't see a thing in this cursed place…

Desc.SourceString: 该死！
Desc.LocalizedString: Argh!

Desc.SourceString: 你知道我们在雾里走了多久吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you know how long we've been stuck in this fog?

Desc.SourceString: 我看到有人跑了过去……
Desc.LocalizedString: I just saw someone run across…

Desc.SourceString: 他们会把船舵带到哪里？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where would they bring the helm?

Desc.SourceString: 你太磨蹭了，我走两步就要等你半天。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're dragging the pace. I have to wait for you.

Desc.SourceString: 还是说……她还在帮她那位「母亲」狩猎？
Desc.LocalizedString: Or is she… still helping that "mother" on a hunt?

Desc.SourceString: 那……汪汪？
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… Woof, woof?

Desc.SourceString: 那边……有东西在动。
Desc.LocalizedString: Something… is moving over there.

Desc.SourceString: 那里有个洞口！
Desc.LocalizedString: There's an exit here!

Desc.SourceString: ……在这边！
Desc.LocalizedString: This way…!

Desc.SourceString: 好厉害！
Desc.LocalizedString: Amazing!

Desc.SourceString: 还没完，那家伙……
Desc.LocalizedString: The snake isn't done with us yet…

Desc.SourceString: 它……生气了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's… angry.

Desc.SourceString: 妮夏妮夏，准备好——
Desc.LocalizedString: Nitsa, get ready—

Desc.SourceString: 欸嘿。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe.

Desc.SourceString: 唔……怎么说呢，电波来自大蛇，好东西……来自直觉？
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… How do I put this… The signal was from the snake, and the good thing… was from my gut?

Desc.SourceString: 也不完全是这样。我能模糊地感觉到，那个电波能帮我们摆脱困境……但没想到会这么麻烦……
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, it's more than pure luck. Somehow I knew the signal was going to lead us to a way out… I just didn't think it was going to be so much trouble.

Desc.SourceString: 欸嘿嘿……也没有那么厉害啦……
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheheh… not that impressive…

Desc.SourceString: 咳……对了，大面具这次说的话，我和你听到的又不一样？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahem, by the way, did we hear different versions of what the big mask said?

Desc.SourceString: 「现在」？
Desc.LocalizedString: "Present"?

Desc.SourceString: ……所以现场是找到了有用的情报？
Desc.LocalizedString: —So did they find any useful intel on-site?

Desc.SourceString: 「过去」、「现在」、「未来」么……组合起来正好是「时间」呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Past," "present," and "future"… The underlying theme is "time."

Desc.SourceString: 哇——我们变成巨人了？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow… we're giants now?

Desc.SourceString: 别闹，你的力量一点也没有变强……这不是真的城市，我们还在雾巢里。
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop it already. You didn't get stronger… This isn't the real city. We're still in the Fogden.

Desc.SourceString: 那边，好吵。
Desc.LocalizedString: That way. So noisy.

Desc.SourceString: 就是它们害我听不清……
Desc.LocalizedString: They're the ones messing with my hearing…

Desc.SourceString: 呼……世界安静了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Phew… the noise finally went away.

Desc.SourceString: （唔……又是那个噪音。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Ugh… that noise again.)

Desc.SourceString: 妮夏……
Desc.LocalizedString: Nitsa…

Desc.SourceString: 妮夏？小贞？
Desc.LocalizedString: Nitsa? Xiaozhen?

Desc.SourceString: 你们人呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Where did you go…?

Desc.SourceString: 我发现好像只要你跟我说话，那些刺耳的声音就会消失。
Desc.LocalizedString: I just realized that when you speak to me, those painful noises go away.

Desc.SourceString: 好啊！呃，对了……你是谁来着……
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure! But… umm, who are you again…?

Desc.SourceString: （聊什么话题呢……奇怪，什么都想不起来……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (What can I talk about…? Weird, I can't remember anything…)

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……有什么靠说话玩的游戏吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is there… some game we can play by just talking?

Desc.SourceString: ……治、治什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: How's that… a game?

Desc.SourceString: 这个我会！我来起个头？
Desc.LocalizedString: I know this! Can I start?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……我先来个「一命通关」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… I'll start with "speedrun."

Desc.SourceString: 不重要啦，只要是4个字的就算数吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: The word just popped out of my head. It's still a start, right?

Desc.SourceString: 吉——吉——「极限反杀」？
Desc.LocalizedString: E… "Epic"!

Desc.SourceString: 「天牛流星拳」。
Desc.LocalizedString: "DPS."

Desc.SourceString: 「付费道具」？
Desc.LocalizedString: "Lagging"?

Desc.SourceString: 獭……麻吉？
Desc.LocalizedString: "T… Tamachi"?

Desc.SourceString: 獭麻吉是电子宠物，很可爱的！
Desc.LocalizedString: No way! Tamachis are cute electronic pets!

Desc.SourceString: 「下班回家」！
Desc.LocalizedString: "Cartridge"!
Xiao… zhen…

Desc.SourceString: ……小贞？
Desc.LocalizedString: …Xiaozhen?

Desc.SourceString: 都不知道你跑哪去了，全靠妮夏……
Desc.LocalizedString: I dunno where you went… Luckily, I had Nitsa…

Desc.SourceString: 妮夏？
Desc.LocalizedString: …Nitsa?

Desc.SourceString: ……呃，难怪一直都觉得很吵，原来是你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… no wonder I thought it was noisy—it was you!

Desc.SourceString: ……那个人，就是被困在这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: …That person… is stuck here.

Desc.SourceString: 灯杆子上有个开关。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a switch on the lamp.

Desc.SourceString: 这个眼睛，正看着我们前进的方向呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: The eye is looking at where we're headed to.

Desc.SourceString: 眼睛，是坐在木桩上用石子画的……他们接下来要走的是左边。
Desc.LocalizedString: They marked out the eye using the pebbles on the wooden stake… they're going left.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯。这里残留着好几种的电波，吵吵嚷嚷的，但又很融洽……他们，是彼此信任的同伴。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm. There are a few remaining signals here. They're noisy but also in tune. They're… companions that trust each other.

Desc.SourceString: 喔、喔——呜哇！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, wow—woohoo!

Desc.SourceString: 别怕，水到船头——有光了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry. It'll be smooth sailing—There's light!

Desc.SourceString: 这种时候别乌鸦嘴——哇啊啊啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't jinx it—ARRGHHHHH!

Desc.SourceString: 上去看看吧，说不定能找到有用的信息。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go take a look. We might find some useful clues.

Desc.SourceString: 唔……雾巢……这么可怕么……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh… the Fogden… is such a scary place…?

Desc.SourceString: 还有一本日志……呃，字好多，头开始疼了。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's also a diary… Umm, so many words. I'm getting a headache.

Desc.SourceString: 嘿嘿，我好像超大号的心猎铁骑。
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheh, I look like a gigantic Kokoro Rider.

Desc.SourceString: 灵可前辈……真是让人捉摸不透呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Linko senpai… is really hard to figure out.

Desc.SourceString: 前辈，这条路走不通了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Senpai, the road is blocked…

Desc.SourceString: 挡住了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Parried it!

Desc.SourceString: 它退回洞里了……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's going back to a cave…

Desc.SourceString: 听你的，前辈。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, senpai.

Desc.SourceString: 我们竟然以这种方式过关，好不可思议……
Desc.LocalizedString: I didn't think we could have won in that way. It's almost incredible…

Desc.SourceString: 前辈，你当时说「前面肯定有好东西」……是指那条大蛇吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Senpai, when you said there was a good thing ahead… were you referring to the snake?

Desc.SourceString: 前辈的直觉，很有参考价值。
Desc.LocalizedString: Senpai, your microbiomes are very valuable.

Desc.SourceString: 但结果是理想的。甚至可以说，比在地面搜寻更顺利……
Desc.LocalizedString: But in the end it all worked out. I'd even say that it went better than expected…

Desc.SourceString: 灵可前辈，我在加入行动前就听说过你……你比传闻中的还要厉害呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Linko senpai, I heard about your achievements before joining this team… You're even more impressive than I'd heard.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯。不过说的都是一个意思。谜题的题眼，应该是「现在」这个词。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm, they should mean the same thing. The key to the puzzle should be "present."

Desc.SourceString: ……对了，灵可前辈抢在前面进了雾巢，错过了局长她们对现场的分析情报。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, Linko senpai charged into the Fogden and missed the director's analysis of the mission.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯。有破译一组仪式文字，是「过去」、「现在」、「未来」这三个词，正好对应那三件异象的特性。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm. They decoded a set of ritual text: "past," "present," and "future," which corresponds to traits of the three anomalies.

Desc.SourceString: 根据推测，三件异象很可能就在雾巢里。所以，这里提到的「现在」，兴许是指「恒今时」。
Desc.LocalizedString: The three anomalies are likely located in the Fogden. Also, the "present" in the code might refer to the Eternal Present.

Desc.SourceString: 要到出口了……
Desc.LocalizedString: We're almost there…

Desc.SourceString: 诶？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh?

Desc.SourceString: 或者……是城市缩小了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Or maybe… the city got smaller?

Desc.SourceString: 可它看起来和我们每天生活的地方几乎没什么区别……
Desc.LocalizedString: But it does look exactly like the city we live in…

Desc.SourceString: 前辈发现了线索？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did senpai find a lead?

Desc.SourceString: 那是T女士的广告？之前在公寓楼里看到过。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's one of Madam T's ads? I saw that in an apartment.

Desc.SourceString: 原来是歧骸……
Desc.LocalizedString: So they're oddities…

Desc.SourceString: 这是……「恒今时」？我在档案里看到过。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's… the Eternal Present? I read about it in the files.

Desc.SourceString: 那……建议我们持续进行聊天行为。
Desc.LocalizedString: Then we should… continue to engage in the act of talking.

Desc.SourceString: 哎？我……我是……唔……
Desc.LocalizedString: Me? I-I'm… umm…

Desc.SourceString: 有许多种类。比如——辩论游戏？我们各持不同的观点，互相质询。
Desc.LocalizedString: There are a few. Maybe… a debating game? We can hold contrasting views and question each other.

Desc.SourceString: 呃……或者——成语接龙？
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… how about… the word chain game?

Desc.SourceString: 好。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure.

Desc.SourceString: 一命通关是成语么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Speedrun? Is that a popular genre on Bagel?

Desc.SourceString: 呃，那——「关门大吉」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright then, I'll follow up with "negotiate."

Desc.SourceString: 「杀气冲天」。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Compound."

Desc.SourceString: ……「全力以赴」。
Desc.LocalizedString: …"Social."

Desc.SourceString: 「聚沙成塔」。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Gestalt."

Desc.SourceString: 「獭麻吉」是什么？而且这次只有3个字呀。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tamachi? Did you just make up that word?

Desc.SourceString: （这布袋，看大小，我甚至都能钻进去。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Look at this bag. It's big enough to hold me.)

Desc.SourceString: （还有麻绳，白手帕……这些东西是拿来干嘛的？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (There's rope and white handkerchiefs… but what for?)

Desc.SourceString: 是绑架。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's kidnapping.

Desc.SourceString: 绑架？
Desc.LocalizedString: Kidnapping?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯。看起来，有4名受害者。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yep. Looks like there have been four victims.

Desc.SourceString: 救……救救我！
Desc.LocalizedString: H-Help me…!

Desc.SourceString: 是达芙蒂尔小姐。
Desc.LocalizedString: Daffodill, it's you.

Desc.SourceString: 你的出现，真是令这片垃圾场蓬荜生辉啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your presence graces this dump with a radiance.
Who's this…?

Desc.SourceString: 一条落单的野犬罢了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just a stray without a pack.

Desc.SourceString: （他们的武器是异象，契约者么。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (They're using anomalies as weapons… Are they contract bearers?)

Desc.SourceString: （看样子，得先解决眼前这个……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I'll have to deal with this one first…)

Desc.SourceString: 小心，这人很危险。
Desc.LocalizedString: Careful. This one's dangerous.

Desc.SourceString: 你放心——
Desc.LocalizedString: Rest assured.

Desc.SourceString: 她的爪子虽锋利但短得可怜，不会给她机会近身的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Her sharp fangs are pitifully short. I won't let her get close.

Desc.SourceString: 咳……这种歧骸，只能应对最简单的状况……
Desc.LocalizedString: Cough… An oddity like this can only deal with easy situations…

Desc.SourceString: 还是得……亲自来……才行。
Desc.LocalizedString: Must do… by… oneself…

Desc.SourceString: 唉，这么多年了，管理局的破电梯还是这么慢。
Desc.LocalizedString: After so many years, the Bureau's shabby elevator is still so slow.

Desc.SourceString: 艾尔菲德不准备批点经费换个新的吗？明明新人都招了那么多……
Desc.LocalizedString: Why wouldn't Alphard spend her budget to upgrade it? She hired so many new employees…

Desc.SourceString: 浔小姐离开E.T.D的这段时间，确实有很多新鲜血液涌入。
Desc.LocalizedString: Indeed, there have been many new hires after you left ETD.

Desc.SourceString: （气氛，好尴尬……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This is awkward…)

Desc.SourceString: （这是青年女性模样的木偶，神态温婉。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A puppet of a young woman with a gentle expression.)

Desc.SourceString: （这是青年男性模样的木偶，表情专注。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A puppet of a young man with a focused expression.)

Desc.SourceString: （这是少年模样的木偶，似乎是个好动的孩子。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A puppet of a teenage boy who seems energetic.)

Desc.SourceString: （这是少女模样的木偶，不知为何觉得她正看向这边……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A puppet of a teenage girl. For some reason she's looking this way…)

Desc.SourceString: （这是少年模样的木偶，五官稚嫩，看起来年纪很小。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A puppet of a teenage boy who looks really young.)

Desc.SourceString: 静待时机。
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait for the moment.

Desc.SourceString: 希望来点好东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hope I get a nice catch.

Desc.SourceString: 落点不错。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's a good spot.

Desc.SourceString: 上钩了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Gotcha!

Desc.SourceString: 有了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Here it comes!

Desc.SourceString: （用力）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Pull)

Desc.SourceString: 就差一点了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Almost there.

Desc.SourceString: 可不能让你跑了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I won't let you get away…

Desc.SourceString: （用尽全力）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Giving it everything)

Desc.SourceString: 好像钓到了不得了的东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: Might have caught something big!

Desc.SourceString: 是个大家伙。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a big one.

Desc.SourceString: 糟了，鱼线要断了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh no, the line's about to snap!

Desc.SourceString: 线绷得有点太紧了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The line is getting tight.

Desc.SourceString: 不好，鱼要脱钩了。
Desc.LocalizedString: No, it's getting away.
(Morning already…?)

Desc.SourceString: 这家伙……爬起来了！
Desc.LocalizedString: This guy… got back up again!

Desc.SourceString: 神清——气爽！
Desc.LocalizedString: Feeling like ten million Fons!

Desc.SourceString: 看来药草茶的效果很不赖呢！薄荷前辈今晚也要乖乖喝一杯哟~
Desc.LocalizedString: That herbal tea must have worked! Mint senpai, make sure you drink another!

Desc.SourceString: 咦~~~~！！！晚上再说吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Huuuuuuh! We'll see tonight!

Desc.SourceString: 该出发了吧，接下来，就是剑指赤龙了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's time to go. Our next target is the Crimson Dragon.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，我们走吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm, let's go.

Desc.SourceString: 唔……不知怎么感觉越来越困了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh… I'm getting sleepy for no reason…

Desc.SourceString: 带我回家，就……交给你啦！这是老大的嘱托！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll rely on you to… bring me home. Boss's orders!

Desc.SourceString: 等到了伊波恩，见到大家和师父……记得把我喊醒……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wake me up… when I get back to Eibon to see everyone and Master…

Desc.SourceString: 是从树林里穿过来的。往下面去了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The tracks went throughout the forest, leading to down there.

Desc.SourceString: 「老大……注意安全。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Boss… take care."

Desc.SourceString: 「握拳，腹部核心收紧，肘部带动手腕发力。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Clench your fists, engage your core, and drive the punch from your elbow."

Desc.SourceString: 愤怒，憎恨，不甘……多么热烈的情感，仿佛火焰焚身……
Desc.LocalizedString: Rage, hatred, resentment… what fierce emotions… as if engulfed in flames…

Desc.SourceString: 只可惜，它注定在绝望中熄灭。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a pity that such flames are meant to be smothered in despair.

Desc.SourceString: 就和那具无魂的木偶一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just like that soulless wooden puppet.

Desc.SourceString: 自不量力。
Desc.LocalizedString: Know your place.

Desc.SourceString: 难缠的家伙……你值得一些特别的款待。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're stronger than I expected. Let me show you something…

Desc.SourceString: 用你的挣扎取悦我吧，等我厌倦之后……
Desc.LocalizedString: Entertain me with your struggles. Once I'm bored…

Desc.SourceString: 我会用这片猩红的花海……埋葬你。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll bury you in this scarlet… floral sea.

Desc.SourceString: 该起舞了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Time for a dance.

Desc.SourceString: 你想去哪？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where are you going?

Desc.SourceString: 往日重现，旧恨重燃……
Desc.LocalizedString: Relive the past and rekindle the hate…

Desc.SourceString: 在这里，你不必隐藏自己，你的一切恶念都可以向我袒露……
Desc.LocalizedString: Here, you don't have to hide. Unleash your ill intentions towards me…

Desc.SourceString: 就用鲜血与烈火，将我们相连。
Desc.LocalizedString: In blood and flames, we shall be chained.

Desc.SourceString: 还跟得上吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can you follow this?

Desc.SourceString: 比起那天，你真是精进了不少……
Desc.LocalizedString: You've improved a lot since that day…

Desc.SourceString: 接下来，就让我们毫无保留。
Desc.LocalizedString: Now, let's keep nothing to ourselves.

Desc.SourceString: 真让人怀念啊，姐姐战斗时的姿态……
Desc.LocalizedString: How nostalgic, sister, the way you fight…

Desc.SourceString: 你的剑比从前更快，那我也该提提速了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Your blade moves faster than before. I'll speed up too…

Desc.SourceString: 残阳如血，共舞吧，姐姐。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sister, dance with me in this sanguine sunset.

Desc.SourceString: 姐姐，没有你，今天的我不过是过去的影子。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sister, without you, I am but a shadow of the past.

Desc.SourceString: 「做得很好，娜娜莉。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Very good, Nanally."

Desc.SourceString: 两位，你们就是本次度假村「幸运家庭游活动」的贵客吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm, you two are the winners of the Lucky Family Tour, right?

Desc.SourceString: 呗果后台的实名登记有录入你们的信息和样貌啦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your profiles can be found in Bagel's back-end records.

Desc.SourceString: 都是第一次来吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this your first visit?

Desc.SourceString: 那可得好好体验一下咱们这的氛围——哎唷，这边走，小心脚下碎石。
Desc.LocalizedString: Then you must explore everything here! Oww, watch out for the pebbles.

Desc.SourceString: 无忧又无虑……何必……趄趄行！
Desc.LocalizedString: They could have lived easy lives… Why make them suffer?

Desc.SourceString: 太阳、太阳不会落下！
Desc.LocalizedString: The sun, the sun never sets!

Desc.SourceString: 不要走，留下来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't go. Stay!

Desc.SourceString: 谁啊？大清早吵死啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: What? So early in the morning?!

Desc.SourceString: 她、她……不要再说了！
Desc.LocalizedString: S-She… stop!

Desc.SourceString: <blue>忒修斯之舵</>……它不会允许规则被打破……必须驶向过去……
Desc.LocalizedString: The Helm of Theseus… it won't allow rules to be broken… it must sail to the past…

Desc.SourceString: 没用的！规则……规则……
Desc.LocalizedString: That won't do! The rules… the rules…

Desc.SourceString: ……嗯！我们回家！
Desc.LocalizedString: …Mhm! Let's go back!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，就算不够强大、拳头不够有力，我也可以是家族老大吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, can I still be the boss of the family even if I'm not strong enough, or if my fists aren't fast enough?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，就算抓不住想抓住的东西，留不住想留住的人，我也可以是家族老大吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, can I still be the boss of the family even if there are things I can’t grasp and those who can't be made to stay?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，就算我一直一直，一直是个怪小孩，我也可以是家族老大吗——？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, can I still be the boss of the family even if I'm this weird kid, like for ever and ever and ever?

Desc.SourceString: 昨晚，我又梦见了虎老大
Desc.LocalizedString: Last night, I dreamed about Boss Tiger again.

Desc.SourceString: 至今为止，依然只有我能看到它
Desc.LocalizedString: Even now, I'm the only one who can see him.

Desc.SourceString: 我问为什么，它只说我是「特别」的
Desc.LocalizedString: I asked him why, he just said it was because I was special.

Desc.SourceString: 我们散着步，突然发现地上有什么东西
Desc.LocalizedString: We were taking a stroll, then I found something on the ground.

Desc.SourceString: 哦哦，一个相框！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ooh, a picture frame!

Desc.SourceString: 里面的合照是我和……爸爸妈妈？
Desc.LocalizedString: That's me and… my parents in the photo?

Desc.SourceString: 他们长什么样子？好模糊
Desc.LocalizedString: What do they look like? It's so blurry.

Desc.SourceString: 醒过来时，我在自己的房间里
Desc.LocalizedString: When I woke up, I was in my own room.

Desc.SourceString: 啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah!

Desc.SourceString: 时间到了！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's time!

Desc.SourceString: 《尼尼历险记》最新集播出了
Desc.LocalizedString: A new episode of "Nini's Adventures"!

Desc.SourceString: 这次的故事发生在哪里呢
Desc.LocalizedString: Where does the story take place this time?

Desc.SourceString: 看样子是书店嘛
Desc.LocalizedString: That looks like a bookstore.

Desc.SourceString: 虎老大，这一集也期待你的英勇表现哟
Desc.LocalizedString: Looking forward to Boss Tiger in action once again!

Desc.SourceString: 这么想着，不知怎么回事
Desc.LocalizedString: As I was thinking, I somehow…

Desc.SourceString: 我竟然穿进了动画片里！
Desc.LocalizedString: …entered the animation!

Desc.SourceString: 难道是虎老大在召唤我……
Desc.LocalizedString: Am I being summoned by Boss Tiger…?

Desc.SourceString: 不好！是暴走族！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh no, Biker Gangsters!

Desc.SourceString: 正义守卫战一触即发
Desc.LocalizedString: An epic battle for justice is about to begin.

Desc.SourceString: 虎老大及时赶到！
Desc.LocalizedString: Boss Tiger arrives just in time!

Desc.SourceString: 我们使出了无敌的「柯林斯·嗷呜合体技」
Desc.LocalizedString: Together, we cast the invincible "Colucci Bow-wow Combo."

Desc.SourceString: 大获全胜！嘿嘿
Desc.LocalizedString: Overwhelming victory! Hehe!

Desc.SourceString: 又一次完美的并肩作战
Desc.LocalizedString: Another perfect fight alongside each other.

Desc.SourceString: 赶紧回去告诉其他家族成员
Desc.LocalizedString: Gotta go back and tell the other family members.

Desc.SourceString: 因为他们看不到虎老大……
Desc.LocalizedString: Because they can't see Boss Tiger…

Desc.SourceString: 每次都只能由我转述光辉事迹
Desc.LocalizedString: I have to tell them about his glorious deeds.

Desc.SourceString: 每次都只能由我转述光辉事迹
Desc.LocalizedString: I have to tell them about his glorious deeds.

Desc.SourceString: 「骗子」！伙伴们朝我喊
Desc.LocalizedString: "Liar!" That's what my friends shouted at me.

Desc.SourceString: 某个异象猎人告诉他们
Desc.LocalizedString: Some Anomaly Hunter told them…

Desc.SourceString: 我口中的「虎老大」根本不存在
Desc.LocalizedString: …that Boss Tiger doesn't even exist.

Desc.SourceString: 可它明明……
Desc.LocalizedString: But he's…

Desc.SourceString: 是我最重要的家人，和你们一样
Desc.LocalizedString: …he's my most important family, just like you.

Desc.SourceString: 虎老大送我的徽章……
Desc.LocalizedString: The badge Boss Tiger gave me…

Desc.SourceString: 不知道在混乱中掉去哪了
Desc.LocalizedString: …was lost somewhere in the chaos.

Desc.SourceString: 柯林斯家族会这样解散吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this the end of the Coluccis?

Desc.SourceString: 我……又要一个人了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Am I… going to be alone again?
Bird…

Desc.SourceString: 那个亮闪闪的是……我的徽章！
Desc.LocalizedString: That shinny thing is… my badge!

Desc.SourceString: 飞走了，等等！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's flying away! Wait!

Desc.SourceString: 在楼顶！
Desc.LocalizedString: On the rooftop!

Desc.SourceString: 我追到楼下
Desc.LocalizedString: I followed it downstairs.

Desc.SourceString: 顺着水管往上爬
Desc.LocalizedString: Climbed up the pipe.

Desc.SourceString: 没想到踩到了施工中的电缆
Desc.LocalizedString: Only to step onto an electric cable in a work zone.

Desc.SourceString: 虎老大及时拉住了我！
Desc.LocalizedString: But Boss Tiger caught me just in time!

Desc.SourceString: 能感觉到「电流」从脚底和手心交汇……
Desc.LocalizedString: I felt a shock from my feet to my palms…

Desc.SourceString: 像被轻松地吸附在墙上
Desc.LocalizedString: I stuck to the wall easily.

Desc.SourceString: 好！一鼓作气！
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright! In one go!

Desc.SourceString: 嗬呀！
Desc.LocalizedString: Haiya!

Desc.SourceString: 定睛一看，才发现这只是个相似的瓶盖
Desc.LocalizedString: I looked closely, and realized it was just a bottle cap.

Desc.SourceString: 虎老大告诉我，这叫「长大」
Desc.LocalizedString: Boss Tiger said to me, that this is called "growing up."

Desc.SourceString: 孩子在「得到什么，又失去什么」之后……
Desc.LocalizedString: Once us kids "gained something and lost something"…

Desc.SourceString: 才算真正告别了童年
Desc.LocalizedString: We bid our childhood farewell.

Desc.SourceString: 然后……虎老大说自己已经完成了使命
Desc.LocalizedString: And… Boss Tiger told me his time has come.

Desc.SourceString: 它消失了
Desc.LocalizedString: Then disappeared.

Desc.SourceString: 而我，再也没能找到它
Desc.LocalizedString: And I never saw him again.

Desc.SourceString: 得到了与虎老大一样的力量后
Desc.LocalizedString: After I gained the same powers as Boss Tiger…

Desc.SourceString: 大家都吃惊极了
Desc.LocalizedString: …everyone was amazed.

Desc.SourceString: 「原来你先前没骗我们！」
Desc.LocalizedString: "So you weren't lying to us!"

Desc.SourceString: 解开了误会，家族也越来越壮大
Desc.LocalizedString: We cleared the misunderstanding, and the family got stronger.

Desc.SourceString: 我向每个人承诺，只要有我在
Desc.LocalizedString: I promised everyone, as long as I'm here…

Desc.SourceString: 一定能保护他们！
Desc.LocalizedString: …I'll protect them all!

Desc.SourceString: 我想，这样就能一直在一起了
Desc.LocalizedString: I thought that was enough to keep us together.

Desc.SourceString: 但慢慢地，升学、搬迁……
Desc.LocalizedString: But slowly, some graduated, some moved away…

Desc.SourceString: 为什么我们的「长大」不一样？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why is "growing up" different for all of us?

Desc.SourceString: 还不想放弃……如果虎老大以后还回来的话……
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't wanna give up… If Boss Tiger ever comes back…

Desc.SourceString: 柯林斯家族必须存在，哪怕只有我一个人
Desc.LocalizedString: The Coluccis have to welcome him. Even if it's just myself.

Desc.SourceString: ……嗯！我们回家！
Desc.LocalizedString: …Mhm! Let's go back!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，就算不够强大、拳头不够有力，我也可以是家族老大吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, can I still be the boss of the family even if I'm not strong enough, or if my fists aren't fast enough?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，就算抓不住想抓住的东西，留不住想留住的人，我也可以是家族老大吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, can I still be the boss of the family even if there are things I can’t grasp and those who can't be made to stay?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，就算我一直一直，一直是个怪小孩，我也可以是家族老大吗——？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, can I still be the boss of the family even if I'm this weird kid, like for ever and ever and ever?

Desc.SourceString: 或许在其他地方。一层层往上找找看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe she's elsewhere. Let’s look at each floor.

Desc.SourceString: 来，这里。从这个电梯下去，有一片秘密林地。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here. Take this elevator and you'll find a secret forest.

Desc.SourceString: 那里很隐蔽，不会被监视到。那家伙真聪明，找到了最安全的地方。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's very secure. No one can see you when you hide there. She's smart to have found the safest place.

Desc.SourceString: 有某种感应。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sensing something.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……那是我的家。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm… that's my place.

Desc.SourceString: 这就是我说的。这里的本质。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's the essence of this place. This is what I was talking about.

Desc.SourceString: 还有其他像这样伪装的假象。如果你想，可以用万花筒看到原本的样子。
Desc.LocalizedString: There are other illusions in effect. You can use the kaleidoscope to see their truths.

Desc.SourceString: 跟紧我。
Desc.LocalizedString: Follow me.

Desc.SourceString: 来吧，走这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here, this way.

Desc.SourceString: 我们需要绕开「母亲」的监视。
Desc.LocalizedString: We need to avoid "Mother's" gaze.

Desc.SourceString: 看到这个窗户了吗？对准它，转动万花筒试试。
Desc.LocalizedString: See this window? Turn the kaleidoscope against it.

Desc.SourceString: 进来了。得先找到我的房间。
Desc.LocalizedString: We're in. Must find my room first.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯。但我也不太熟悉……像你刚才说的，我是「游梦人」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm, but I'm not too familiar with it either… Like you said, I'm a Dreamwalker.

Desc.SourceString: 这里是我过往的「梦」，由记忆和想象拼凑出来的地方。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a place of my past dreams, stitched from my memory and imagination.

Desc.SourceString: 这不是给我们吃的。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is not for us.

Desc.SourceString: 是「母亲」的相片。
Desc.LocalizedString: A photo of "Mother."

Desc.SourceString: 我不习惯直视她。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not used to looking at her.

Desc.SourceString: 出门，禁止。
Desc.LocalizedString: Going out is not allowed.

Desc.SourceString: 最好不要走楼梯，动静太大。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't take the stairs. It's too noisy.

Desc.SourceString: 穿过这间房间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Go through this room.

Desc.SourceString: 犯错或者任务失败时，「母亲」会把我关在这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: When I make a mistake or when I fail a mission, "Mother" shuts me in here.

Desc.SourceString: 习惯了就不觉得那么黑。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's not that dark once you're used to it.
…Hush.

Desc.SourceString: 这里也被堵住了吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Another dead end?

Desc.SourceString: 再用一下万花筒吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Try using the kaleidoscope.

Desc.SourceString: 这里比较安全。忍一下，马上就能出去了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's safer like this. Just hold your breath. We'll be out soon.

Desc.SourceString: 跟我来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Follow me.

Desc.SourceString: 越往高处走，视野越好。
Desc.LocalizedString: The higher it is, the better the view.

Desc.SourceString: 我喜欢用望远镜看远处，总能看到不一样的东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: I like to use binoculars to look far. I always see something different.

Desc.SourceString: 你要看看吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you want to give it a go?

Desc.SourceString: 前面应该就是我的房间。
Desc.LocalizedString: My room should be up ahead.

Desc.SourceString: 更正一下。是「我和妹妹」的房间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Actually, it's me and my little sister's room.

Desc.SourceString: 不想听的时候就捂住耳朵。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just cover your ears if you don't want to hear it.

Desc.SourceString: 小老虎不在这里……我知道了。走吧，我们去阁楼。
Desc.LocalizedString: The little tiger isn't here… Ah, I know where she went. Let's go to the attic.
Phew…

Desc.SourceString: 书架这里有机关。用万花筒看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: The bookshelf has a mechanism. Inspect it with the kaleidoscope.

Desc.SourceString: 熊也让你尝尝，在垃圾场里被任意摆布的滋味！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ever been treated like garbage? This bear will show you!

Desc.SourceString: 瞧瞧，你也被人遗弃了哟~
Desc.LocalizedString: See? You're being abandoned too!

Desc.SourceString: 桀桀桀桀桀桀！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: TEEHEEEHEEEHEEE!

Desc.SourceString: 好痛啊，熊不打了，可以和解吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ouch! It hurts! This bear surrenders!

Desc.SourceString: 蠢货，上当了桀桀桀！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fools, it's a trap! TEEHEE!

Desc.SourceString: 切！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch!

Desc.SourceString: 来玩捉迷藏吧~桀桀桀……
Desc.LocalizedString: Teehee, let's play hide and seek…!

Desc.SourceString: 啊，是。你怎么……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, yes. How did you…?

Desc.SourceString: （太好了，感觉恢复了一点精神。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Good, seems like she's feeling a little better.)

Desc.SourceString: 或许应该先注意一下自己的音量。
Desc.LocalizedString: Perhaps you should consider lowering your voice.

Desc.SourceString: 这是……诺诺斯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this… Noros?

Desc.SourceString: （邀请它去伊波恩坐坐会不会有什么奇效……？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I should invite the Noros over to Eibon…)

Desc.SourceString: 这倒是神奇。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's incredible.

Desc.SourceString: 扁扁……外形扁扁的水类生物异象，至今没有发现其技能和特长。如果谁欺负了它，也只会扁扁地走开。
Desc.LocalizedString: Flatty, a flat, aquatic bio anomaly. Up till now, no one knows what it can do. When it is bullied, it simply moves away… flatly.

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉不喜欢吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally, you don't like this anomaly?

Desc.SourceString: （没有回应……那就暂且不打扰她了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (No response… I'll leave her alone for now.)

Desc.SourceString: 等等、娜娜莉！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally, wait!

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉！呃，娜娜虎？
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally! Umm, Nana Tiger?

Desc.SourceString: 果然这招不行吗。
Desc.LocalizedString: I guess that didn't work.

Desc.SourceString: 一个新的房间……？
Desc.LocalizedString: A new room…?

Desc.SourceString: （没有找到娜娜莉的踪迹……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (No traces of Nanally here…)

Desc.SourceString: 所以，这枚蓝色徽章是不是仿制的，都不重要。和你一样，真心，都藏在其中。
Desc.LocalizedString: So it doesn't matter whether the blue badge is original or not. Like your pure heart, it's the authenticity that matters.

Desc.SourceString: 现在一起回家？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why don't we go home together?

Desc.SourceString: 可以，老大！
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure, boss!

Desc.SourceString: 可以！老大！
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course, boss!

Desc.SourceString: 可以——老大！
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure thing—boss!

Desc.SourceString: 坚持一下，还差一点，马上就能离开洄廊。
Desc.LocalizedString: We're almost there, just a few steps from leaving this place.

Desc.SourceString: Va bene,capo.
Desc.LocalizedString: Va bene,capo.

Desc.SourceString: 丢掉执念，变成一个你认为「快乐」的空壳？我会证明给你看，娜娜莉不是那种人。
Desc.LocalizedString: Toss away desires to become a "happy" shell of oneself? I'll show you that Nanally is better than that.

Desc.SourceString: 但也从不升起。这片黄昏你还没有看腻吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: But neither does it rise here. Aren't you tired of this view?

Desc.SourceString: 这个空间由你造就，那么莳小姐，你也在逃避什么吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Thyme, you created this space. Are you running away from something too?

Desc.SourceString: 你的故人，她也希望你一直留在这里吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Would your friend wish you to remain here forever?

Desc.SourceString: 是它不允许，还是你不敢改变？
Desc.LocalizedString: Does it make the rules, or do you make the rules?

Desc.SourceString: 冷静下来，莳小姐。洄廊是你创造的，但毫无疑问，你也是被反噬而困于其中的人。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thyme, don't you see? You created the Corridor of Echoes, but you are also its victim.

Desc.SourceString: 我可以带你出去。带你、娜娜莉、花园里的女孩、游梦人们……带你们所有人出去！
Desc.LocalizedString: I can bring you out, along with Nanally, the girl in the garden, and all the Dreamwalkers!

Desc.SourceString: 你忘了吗？我从一开始进来，你就说我不受规则束缚。
Desc.LocalizedString: Remember? When I first entered here, you told me the rules here don't apply to me.

Desc.SourceString: 一个空空如也的「0」，正适合兜走一群乱七八糟的家伙们！
Desc.LocalizedString: Here, I am the embodiment of neverness. I might as well bring back these riffraffs!

Desc.SourceString: 既然那个船舵可以载人驶向过去，那就由我来让它调转方向——
Desc.LocalizedString: If that helm can steer people to the past, then I can change its direction—

Desc.SourceString: 不要再倒退……你们的双腿都该往前走。
Desc.LocalizedString: No more sailing into the past… All of you are meant to move on.

Desc.SourceString: 莳小姐，试试看吧——和所有人一样，抱着愤怒、沮丧、不甘、遗憾，眼里噙满泪水去亲眼看看前方的风景！
Desc.LocalizedString: Thyme, you should try like the others. Carry your anger, sadness, frustration, and regret, then behold what lies ahead with those teared-up eyes!

Desc.SourceString: 有一本绘本。娜娜莉画的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a sketchbook. Is it Nanally's?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？好像有脚印。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm? I think I see footsteps.

Desc.SourceString: 两排大小不一的脚印。小的这个和玩偶熊似乎对得上。
Desc.LocalizedString: Two different sets of footsteps. The smaller ones seem to match a teddy bear.

Desc.SourceString: 大的脚印会是娜娜莉留下的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Could the bigger steps be from Nanally?

Desc.SourceString: 空间的结构看起来七零八落……
Desc.LocalizedString: The structure of this space is splintering…

Desc.SourceString: 得弄明白这里是怎么回事。
Desc.LocalizedString: Gotta figure out what's going on.

Desc.SourceString: 「游梦人」的队伍……为什么一直在倒退？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why is the Dreamwalker procession… going backwards?

Desc.SourceString: 看来不太欢迎其他人进入。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like they're not recruiting new members.

Desc.SourceString: 入口紧闭。
Desc.LocalizedString: The entrance is shut.

Desc.SourceString: 没法进去……
Desc.LocalizedString: Can't get in…

Desc.SourceString: 只能绕到另一边了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll have to take a detour.

Desc.SourceString: 碍事的家伙！
Desc.LocalizedString: What a bother!

Desc.SourceString: 不见了。应该是躲到那里面了。
Desc.LocalizedString: She's gone. She should be hiding there.

Desc.SourceString: 找到了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Found her.

Desc.SourceString: 这就是刚才莳小姐说的……「房间」？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this the "room" Thyme was talking about…?

Desc.SourceString: 医院……？病房里似乎有声音。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hospital…? There's a sound coming from the room.

Desc.SourceString: 房间发生了变化……
Desc.LocalizedString: The room changed…

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜虎！喂！等等！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nana Tiger! Hey, wait!

Desc.SourceString: 一溜烟就没影了……
Desc.LocalizedString: She's gone all of a sudden…

Desc.SourceString: 这家伙还真是好动！
Desc.LocalizedString: This one is energetic…

Desc.SourceString: 看来没那么容易逮到她……
Desc.LocalizedString: She's not going to let me simply capture her…
Hmm…

Desc.SourceString: 别跑！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么会有一片墓地？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why is there a graveyard here?

Desc.SourceString: <blue>长寿</>却已逝的村民……会和这个异象空间有什么关系吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Villagers who <blue>lived long</> yet are no more… Is the Anomalous Realm about them?

Desc.SourceString: 「游梦人」们的状态还真是各不相同。
Desc.LocalizedString: There seem to be all kinds of Dreamwalkers.

Desc.SourceString: 到处都有游行……
Desc.LocalizedString: There are processions everywhere…

Desc.SourceString: 你好像知道她在哪里？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you know where she is?

Desc.SourceString: 好大的房子。要去那里找吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: This house is huge. Should I take a look inside?

Desc.SourceString: 这片湖水很漂亮。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a pretty lake.

Desc.SourceString: 湖水……变成了泥潭？
Desc.LocalizedString: The water… became mud?

Desc.SourceString: 从外面看，房子似乎有些年头了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The house looks a bit old from outside.

Desc.SourceString: 为什么不从正门进去？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why don't we enter from the front door?

Desc.SourceString: 「母亲」？
Desc.LocalizedString: "Mother"?

Desc.SourceString: 这里不是你的家吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Isn't this your home?

Desc.SourceString: 脸是模糊的……
Desc.LocalizedString: The face is blurry…

Desc.SourceString: 好黑……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's so dark…

Desc.SourceString: 有哭声……
Desc.LocalizedString: Someone's crying…

Desc.SourceString: 唔！我们在水下……？有些喘不上气。
Desc.LocalizedString: Umpf, we're under water…? It's hard to breathe…

Desc.SourceString: 从水里出来了……还真是没有逻辑的地方。
Desc.LocalizedString: We just emerged from water… I really can't figure this place out.

Desc.SourceString: 有一股霉味……
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a moldy smell…

Desc.SourceString: 讨厌的声音又出现了……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's that annoying sound again…

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally!

Desc.SourceString: 睡得很沉——是梦中梦？
Desc.LocalizedString: She's deep asleep—is she dreaming inside a dream?

Desc.SourceString: 旁边……又是绘本？
Desc.LocalizedString: That book there… another sketchbook?

Desc.SourceString: 又是睡着的娜娜莉，看来我正通过绘本进入她的梦境。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally is still sleeping. I must be entering her dreams through the sketchbooks.

Desc.SourceString: 果然，这里也有绘本。
Desc.LocalizedString: Another sketchbook. I knew it.

Desc.SourceString: 是趁虚而入的梦魇……
Desc.LocalizedString: A nightmare exploiting her weakness…

Desc.SourceString: 还没醒来。难道是在更深的梦里？
Desc.LocalizedString: She's not waking up. Is she in an even deeper dream?

Desc.SourceString: 这是「真正的」娜娜莉吗？好像有点不对……
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this the "real" Nanally? Something's off…

Desc.SourceString: 一个卧室……这是谁的房间？
Desc.LocalizedString: A bedroom…? Whose room is it?

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉小时候的卧室，和伊波恩的感觉不太一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's Nanally's room when she was little. It's different from her room at Eibon.

Desc.SourceString: 当然，老大。
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course, Boss.

Desc.SourceString: 如果这样做能让你感到安心——你的声音为什么在颤抖。
Desc.LocalizedString: If what you're doing makes you at ease, why is your voice trembling?

Desc.SourceString: <blue>「长寿村」</>的村民们……他们是你的家人吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: The villagers from <blue>Elden Ville</>… Are they your family?

Desc.SourceString: 带着疑问，去和不同的人相遇，参与经历他们不同的人生和故事……总有一天，会有答案的。
Desc.LocalizedString: But bring that question with you. Meet different people. Step into their lives… And one day, you'll find an answer.

Desc.SourceString: 莳小姐，出去后为你的家人们垒一座墓茔吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thyme. Once you leave this place, build a tomb for your family.

Desc.SourceString: 在太阳可以升起的地方，离他们最近的地方。
Desc.LocalizedString: Find a spot where the sun rises, a spot close to where they lived.

Desc.SourceString: 我或许没有资格回答这个问题。因为我也还在寻找。
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't have an answer, and I may not be qualified to respond…

Desc.SourceString: 不要再说了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop!

Desc.SourceString: 都死了。很久以前的事了。我一直一直一直一直在想……
Desc.LocalizedString: They're all dead. A long time ago. I've always, always, always been thinking…

Desc.SourceString: 为什么我活下来了？
Desc.LocalizedString: …Why am I the only one who survived?

Desc.SourceString: 为什么我死不掉？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why can't I just die?

Desc.SourceString: 为什么我和他们不一样？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why am I different from the others?

Desc.SourceString: 为什么心脏会这么痛？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why does my heart hurt so much?

Desc.SourceString: 我仍然存在于世的意义是什么……生命的意义是什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: What do I exist for in the world…? What is the meaning of life?

Desc.SourceString: 在……最近的地方……
Desc.LocalizedString: Where… they lived…

Desc.SourceString: 所有假象和谎言总是漂亮无暇的。如果你想瞧瞧更有意思的东西……给你这个。
Desc.LocalizedString: Illusions and lies are always flawless and pristine. If you want to see more interesting things… take this.

Desc.SourceString: 我的父母曾是考古学者。小时候他们告诉我，事物像万花筒般从不同视角展开，才能窥见本质。
Desc.LocalizedString: My parents were archaeologists. When I was younger, they said, "If you want to see the true nature of things, you need to look from different angles, as if using a kaleidoscope."

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉，你睡了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally, are you still awake?

Desc.SourceString: （那是……娜娜莉身上挂着的老虎！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (That's… Nanally's tiger!)

Desc.SourceString: 好漂亮的花园。
Desc.LocalizedString: What a pretty garden.

Desc.SourceString: 嗨，鉴定师！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 来吧，一起上去！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go up there!

Desc.SourceString: 雨停了。看看时间，我们也该走了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The rain stopped. It's about time to go.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，走吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, let's go.

Desc.SourceString: 既然她急着逃跑，为什么还要把小狗带来码头呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why did the criminal bring the dogs along if she wanted to escape?

Desc.SourceString: 其实她是想带着小狗们一起逃走的。
Desc.LocalizedString: She wanted to take the dogs along on her escape.

Desc.SourceString: 也是因为这个，她才会被抓住。
Desc.LocalizedString: And that is how she got caught in the end.

Desc.SourceString: 要是她一个人逃走，我根本就来不及发现。
Desc.LocalizedString: If she tried to escape alone, I couldn't have found out.

Desc.SourceString: 她真的很爱它们啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: She must have really loved them…

Desc.SourceString: 你是不是想说，这个人好像也没那么坏？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you going to tell me that she's not that bad of a criminal?
Umm…

Desc.SourceString: 请问你见过一只粉色的小老虎吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Excuse me, did you see a little pink tiger?

Desc.SourceString: 这个身体……难道是？
Desc.LocalizedString: This body… can it be?

Desc.SourceString: 呃……要不看看别的吧。太吵了，店长不会同意领回家的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… we should check around more. Hotori won't want these noisy ones back at Eibon.

Desc.SourceString: 包包蚊……伊波恩也有呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: A Pouch Mosquito… Eibon has that too.

Desc.SourceString: 走吧走吧！鉴定师！我们回伊波恩！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go! Appraiser, back to Eibon!

Desc.SourceString: 下手？
Desc.LocalizedString: Strikes?

Desc.SourceString: 真的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Really?

Desc.SourceString: （不好！纸是媒介，必须阻止他！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Oh no, the paper is the medium. I need to stop him!)

Desc.SourceString: （是店长……她在这里做什么？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It's the Shopkeeper… What is she doing here?)

Desc.SourceString: （不知道娜娜莉现在怎么样了……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I wonder how Nanally is…)

Desc.SourceString: 该死的鱼讨厌讨厌讨厌讨厌讨厌讨厌讨厌……
Desc.LocalizedString: I just hate, hate, hate, hate, hate, hate, hate those darn fish…

Desc.SourceString: 这雾不对……鉴定师，你要小心！
Desc.LocalizedString: There's something wrong with this fog… Careful!

Desc.SourceString: 唔……站位分散开了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh… our formation got seperated…

Desc.SourceString: 欸——怎么什么都看不清了！？
Desc.LocalizedString: Eeek! I can't see anything clearly!

Desc.SourceString: 我不太会整理床铺……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not good at making my bed…

Desc.SourceString: 阿姨送我的见面礼
Desc.LocalizedString: My aunty gave me this when we first met.

Desc.SourceString: 还有一些事没做……
Desc.LocalizedString: There's something I need to do…

Desc.SourceString: 绘本嘛……晚点再画好了
Desc.LocalizedString: The sketchbook… I'll continue later.

Desc.SourceString: 一些行李，还没理好呢
Desc.LocalizedString: Some luggage, not really prepared.

Desc.SourceString: 现在几点了……
Desc.LocalizedString: What time is it now…
Ohhh!

Desc.SourceString: 哈哈哈！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hahaha!

Desc.SourceString: 咻咻咻！
Desc.LocalizedString: Weeee!

Desc.SourceString: 没拍出本老大的气质，可惜了
Desc.LocalizedString: Too bad the pic doesn't capture my aura as the boss.

Desc.SourceString: 接下来，这边请。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please come this way.

Desc.SourceString: 这是大部分水生异象的生活区域。不过天气炎热的话，这里也会成为最受欢迎的游乐场所。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is where most of the aquatic anomalies live. When it gets warm, this place becomes the most popular recreation spot.

Desc.SourceString: （快粗去！给窝们次饼干的客人~嚎人！快粗去！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Get owwwt! Nice visitor who fed coookies, go nauuu!)

Desc.SourceString: 神秘商绵大人终于来了！再不来，我就没蓬松松生发膏用了咩！
Desc.LocalizedString: The Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant is finally here! I almost ran out of my Cloudcoat Growth Salve!

Desc.SourceString: 那个东东真的有效咩？
Desc.LocalizedString: Bah, does that thing really work?

Desc.SourceString: 回头给你试试，咩！彻底告别秃毛烦恼，咩！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll share with you once I buy it, bah! You'll finally part ways with baldness, bah!

Desc.SourceString: 这是我第一次向神秘商绵大人许愿！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is my first time making a wish to the great Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant!

Desc.SourceString: 我想让她把我的牙疼治好！最近啃草都不香了，咩。
Desc.LocalizedString: I want her to fix my toothache! I can't even chew grass these days, bah!

Desc.SourceString: 为什么，绵绵不会冬眠……Zzz……
Desc.LocalizedString: Why don't Fuzzies hibernate… Zzz…

Desc.SourceString: 我要许愿大家一起冬眠，睡上好几个月……
Desc.LocalizedString: I wish all Fuzzies could hibernate for a few months together…

Desc.SourceString: 睡觉，最好了咩……Zzz……
Desc.LocalizedString: Sleep is… the best… bah… Zzz…

Desc.SourceString: 不要随便许愿，咩！睡觉到底哪里好了咩！明明大家一睡觉就只会做噩梦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don’t make wishes for others! Bah! Sleep isn't that great when you have nightmares all the time!

Desc.SourceString: 你喜欢做噩梦不要带上我咩！
Desc.LocalizedString: You can have all my nightmares instead!

Desc.SourceString: 天上掉了个怪东西下来咩……
Desc.LocalizedString: Something strange fell from the sky…

Desc.SourceString: 是的咩。好可怕，不敢过去看……
Desc.LocalizedString: That's right, bah. But I'm too scared to check…

Desc.SourceString: 绵不害怕「怪东西」，但绵害怕怪物咩！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not afraid of weird stuff. Weird stuff is afraid of meh!

Desc.SourceString: 绵先走了咩！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll take mah leave!

Desc.SourceString: 有什么东西围在那儿……
Desc.LocalizedString: Something is gathering over there…

Desc.SourceString: 这个东西像飞船一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: This thing looks like a flying ship.

Desc.SourceString: 这里有个好大的按钮，边上还有一行小字。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a big button here with a line of small text next to it.

Desc.SourceString: 「如果你看到这个按钮就按一下谢谢了」……
Desc.LocalizedString: "If you're reading this, please press the button"…

Desc.SourceString: 可如果他不回去，整个绵绵村都会被毁掉的。
Desc.LocalizedString: But if he doesn't go back, the entire Fuzzy Village will be burned to the ground.

Desc.SourceString: 有没有办法能把咩丁和绵绵村都救下来……
Desc.LocalizedString: Is there a way to save both Maaartin and the village?

Desc.SourceString: ……只要火山不喷发就行了……但又要怎么让火山不喷发呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: We can if the volcano doesn't erupt… but how are we going to stop it?

Desc.SourceString: 莫非伊洛伊有办法？
Desc.LocalizedString: Iroi, you have a way to stop it?

Desc.SourceString: 好像是火山附近才会出现的怪物。
Desc.LocalizedString: They look like monsters from the volcano area.

Desc.SourceString: 好的好的，一路顺风~幸好我们不害怕怪物咩~
Desc.LocalizedString: Okie, stay safe! Good thing we're not afraid of monsters!

Desc.SourceString: 按一下。
Desc.LocalizedString: Press it.

Desc.SourceString: 要不要救他呢？不如，就让他别回去了吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Should we save him? Why don't we keep him in this timeline?

Desc.SourceString: 按照最朴素的逻辑，当然是整个绵绵村比较重要啦。
Desc.LocalizedString: By the simplest logic, of course the whole Fuzzy Village matters more.

Desc.SourceString: 不过现在看来，一个真实可感的人，和一大群遥远不具体的人相比，果然还是不一样啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: But we're talking about someone we actually know here. A distant and faceless crowd doesn't even compare.

Desc.SourceString: 哦不，不是「人」，是「绵」~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, not "someone" but "some Fuzzy."

Desc.SourceString: 嗯~听起来很简单哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm. That sounds pretty easy to me!

Desc.SourceString: 唔——鉴定师，前面有怪物！
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm, Appraiser, there's a monster!

Desc.SourceString: 完成啦！回去找咩丁~
Desc.LocalizedString: Tada! Let's go back to Maaartin!

Desc.SourceString: 啊，你们来了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, you're here!

Desc.SourceString: 我这边也都准备好了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm done with my preparations.

Desc.SourceString: 帮我买两套盲盒就好，其他还有什么感兴趣的直接买，别客气。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just get me two Mystery Boxes. Feel free to buy anything else you're interested in.

Desc.SourceString: 这下跟你的约定也兑现了。
Desc.LocalizedString: There, I've kept my promise.

Desc.SourceString: 那个礼物的约定吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: The promise about my gift?

Desc.SourceString: 是啊，后续像这张照片这样的东西会越来越多吧，那些收藏慢慢地就会变成我和你，和朋友们留下的回忆的集合。
Desc.LocalizedString: From now on, we'll have more things like this picture. One by one, the mementos will become a trove of memories shared by you, me, and our friends.

Desc.SourceString: 或许这样的故事才是最珍贵的宝藏。
Desc.LocalizedString: And the stories behind them, perhaps are the most precious treasure.

Desc.SourceString: 毕竟就算没有「愿望更容易实现」的传闻，也不枉来一趟呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even if wishes weren't more likely to come true today, it was time well-spent.

Desc.SourceString: 啧，本来路就不算宽敞，倒是给我好好靠右走啊，这些观光客。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch, these tourists. The road's already narrow enough. Why don't they stay on the right side like they should?

Desc.SourceString: ……人开始多起来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: …It's getting crowded.

Desc.SourceString: ……要是走散了就不好了，对吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: We don't want to get separated in the crowd… do we?

Desc.SourceString: 真没办法……
Desc.LocalizedString: You…
Hmm? I guess we don't?

Desc.SourceString: 来吧，把手给我。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here, take my hand.

Desc.SourceString: 奇怪，怎么又回来了？不该在什么湖边吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh, how am I back again? I was just by the lake.

Desc.SourceString: 人又去哪儿了……难道我和{Gender}|gender(他,她)们走散了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where did they go… Did I lose them again?

Desc.SourceString: 四处走走看，找一找吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I should walk around to find them.

Desc.SourceString: {Gender}|gender(他,她)们……都很好，薄荷是个热心肠，什么想法都写在脸上。
Desc.LocalizedString: They… are great people. Mint cares a lot, and she wears her heart on her sleeve.

Desc.SourceString: 今天第一次见面的鉴定师很可靠，是个表里如一、很真诚的人。
Desc.LocalizedString: I can tell the Appraiser I met for the first time is an honest and reliable person.

Desc.SourceString: 伊洛伊……感觉那家伙和我有点像。也许就是因为这个，我才总是忍不住和她拌嘴……
Desc.LocalizedString: As for Iroi… I can tell that we're somewhat similar. Maybe that's why we can't stop arguing…

Desc.SourceString: 绵绵们打不过，我们就不一样了！走走走！给这条大坏龙一个教训！
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe the Fuzzies can't win by themselves, but we're built different. Let's go teach that big bad dragon a lesson!

Desc.SourceString: 不是要等等村长，继续听故事吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I thought we were going to keep listening to the story?

Desc.SourceString: 趁他打扫的功夫搞定不就好了？正好给爷爷一个惊喜。
Desc.LocalizedString: We'll simply deal with the dragon before he's done cleaning. Let's give grandpa a surprise.

Desc.SourceString: 会……这么简单吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is it going to be that… easy?

Desc.SourceString: 可可是不是还没确认过我们的能力呀？你快看看！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, have you tried checking our powers? Give it a look!

Desc.SourceString: 你那自信的样子让我以为我看漏了两位数……我们不是100级，是只有1级啊大笨猫！
Desc.LocalizedString: You were so confident, I almost thought I missed two digits… We're not level 100, we're level 1, you dumcat!

Desc.SourceString: 但讨伐恶龙总得有个开始是不是？
Desc.LocalizedString: But we have to start somewhere to beat the dragon, right?

Desc.SourceString: 先离开这个和平的小村庄，让等级在冒险的路上不断提升吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's leave this peaceful village and level up as we explore!

Desc.SourceString: 按村长爷爷的说法，北方的这座古堡就有英雄曾经活跃过的传说咩。
Desc.LocalizedString: According to the Elder Fuzzy, there's a legendary tale that heroes once roamed this ancient castle up north, baa.

Desc.SourceString: 都教训完啦！这些邪恶的绵绵居然在这么重要的地方乱涂乱画！
Desc.LocalizedString: We've taught them all a lesson! Those evil Fuzzies were vandalizing a landmark!

Desc.SourceString: 赶快回去把这个好消息告诉巫师绵吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hurry back and tell Wizard Fuzzy the good news!

Desc.SourceString: 说起来，英雄信物的需求最近突然增加了好多呢，难道是什么行情热门的特殊时节？
Desc.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, demand for hero tokens just spiked. Is there a seasonal trend, or what??

Desc.SourceString: 下了很多信物订单的，该不会是同一只绵吧……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Think all those orders came from the same Fuzzy…?

Desc.SourceString: 真奇怪，脑袋里马上就冒出来一个感觉很容易上当的身影呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Funny, a real sucker just popped into my head.

Desc.SourceString: 咩嘿嘿~这可是优质客户咩。绵很有职业操守，不会随意泄露客户的信息咩。
Desc.LocalizedString: Baa-heehee… That's a premium customer, baa. I'm all class about keeping customer info private—I don't kiss and tell, baa.

Desc.SourceString: 这个奸商……
Desc.LocalizedString: That merchant was running a racket…

Desc.SourceString: 刚才没来得及问，那只看起来很有大人物感觉的绵绵怎么披了一床棉被……
Desc.LocalizedString: I didn't get a chance to ask earlier, but why was that big-shot Fuzzy wrapped in a quilted blanket…

Desc.SourceString: 那是披风啦，大笨猫！
Desc.LocalizedString: That was a cloak, Dumcat!

Desc.SourceString: 还好没问出来。要是因为口无遮拦冒犯了别人该怎么办！说不定会触发什么不妙的事件……
Desc.LocalizedString: Good thing I didn't ask after all. If I'd offended someone with my lack of filter, I might've triggered a nasty fight…

Desc.SourceString: 到时候就把薄荷交出去吧，没有人或者绵会跟笨笨的野蛮人计较啦~
Desc.LocalizedString: When the time comes, just hand Mint over. Nobody—human or Fuzzy—is gonna make a fuss over that silly little one.

Desc.SourceString: ——喔，有件小事余差点忘记了。
Desc.LocalizedString: —Ah, I nearly forgot one little thing.

Desc.SourceString: 这个村子里，好像没有足够「摇滚」的乐器咩。
Desc.LocalizedString: This village appears to lack the proper instruments required to summon such a rockin' tempest.

Desc.SourceString: 猜到了……
Desc.LocalizedString: I thought so…

Desc.SourceString: 都帮到这个份上了，再去找找奸商吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: We've already gotten this far, so let's pay another visit to the merchant.

Desc.SourceString: 看来不是错觉呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like it wasn't my imagination after all!

Desc.SourceString: 「狮心」绵和巫师绵的演奏真的提供了像魔法一样的支援。
Desc.LocalizedString: The performance by "Lionheart" Fuzzy and Wizard Fuzzy really boosted our spirits, almost like magic.

Desc.SourceString: 那就承蒙好意，放开手脚大干一场吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Then thanks for the offer—let's cut loose and go all out!

Desc.SourceString: 真的有黄金铠甲！
Desc.LocalizedString: It really is the Golden Plate!

Desc.SourceString: 那是村长绵！好多绵绵在围观，发生什么事了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: That's Elder Fuzzy! There are so many Fuzzies crowding around… I wonder what happened?

Desc.SourceString: 是勇者大人！勇者大人们回来了！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's the adventurers! They have returned!

Desc.SourceString: 是全新版本！可可一定会陪薄荷玩的对吧！一定会陪薄荷打到通关的对吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a brand-new update! Coco, you'll definitely play with me, right? You'll definitely stick with me till we clear it, right?!

Desc.SourceString: 既然薄荷这样说的话……
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, if you say so…

Desc.SourceString: 设定集这种东西，直接摆在外面真的可以吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Is it really okay to just leave a lore book out in the open like this…?

Desc.SourceString: 这里就是村长绵标记的地点了，似乎没有看到馋馋绵呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: So this is the spot Elder Fuzzy marked. Looks like Glutton Fuzzy isn't here.

Desc.SourceString: 地上似乎是一些遗落的物品？
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like someone dropped a few things over here.

Desc.SourceString: 黏黏的，好像还散发着糖的甜香，难道是馋馋棉吃过的钥匙形状的糖果？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's sticky, and it even smells sweet… could this be the key-shaped candy Glutton Fuzzy was chewing on?

Desc.SourceString: 这个烧焦的痕迹是哪里来的？似乎还散发着焦糖香气，难道馋馋绵想吃焦糖布丁了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where'd this burn mark come from? It still smells faintly of caramel… Don't tell me Glutton Fuzzy was trying to make crème brûlée out here?

Desc.SourceString: 就算难过也不能哭，眼泪会把身子融化的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Even if you're sad—don't cry! You'll melt!

Desc.SourceString: 融化……？
Desc.LocalizedString: M-Melt…?

Desc.SourceString: 身子被融化了就会消失，绵不希望你消失……
Desc.LocalizedString: If your body melts away, you'll disappear entirely. This Fuzzy doesn't want you to go away forever…

Desc.SourceString: 这段对话似乎在哪里听到过呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: I have a massive sense of déjà vu right now…

Desc.SourceString: 原来是奸商绵呀~
Desc.LocalizedString: So that was a scammer Fuzzy!

Desc.SourceString: 啊！奸商绵已经不见了啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah! That shady Fuzzy Merchant's already ghosted!

Desc.SourceString: 被绵绵上了一课啊，薄荷前辈。
Desc.LocalizedString: That Fuzzy really taught Mint senpai a lesson.

Desc.SourceString: 不过也算是好结局！至少绵没事！
Desc.LocalizedString: But the Fuzzy didn't die, so that's a good ending!

Desc.SourceString: 原来薄荷是守序善良派呀。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint, your alignment must be lawful-good.

Desc.SourceString: 是店长的字。她这是要出去办事么？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's Hotori's handwriting. Is she out on an errand?

Desc.SourceString: 好吧。那就，「急转直下」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Fine. I'll follow up with "ironic."

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……几句嘱咐吧。有叫你好好吃东西呢，早雾。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… just a few reminders, like telling you to eat well.

Desc.SourceString: （店长她那么担心娜娜莉，也很防备「红字」，这种时候会轻易外出吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The Shopkeeper is worried about Nanally and wary of the Scarlet Letter. Would she go out at a time like this without a good reason?)

Desc.SourceString: （还想问问阿德勒先生来着，怎么他也不见人影呢。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Adler probably knows more about this, but he's nowhere to be seen.)

Desc.SourceString: （只能去附近看看了，说不定阿德勒先生也在找店长。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I'll have to look around. Maybe Adler is looking for the Shopkeeper too.)

Desc.SourceString: 店长，「园丁」还有哪些人？
Desc.LocalizedString: Shopkeeper, who are the "gardeners"?

Desc.SourceString: 「家喻户晓」。
Desc.LocalizedString: "Equinox."

Desc.SourceString: 莳小姐这么快就能行动了，看来后续恢复得不错。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thyme is already out of bed? She must have recovered well.

Desc.SourceString: 对了店长，那招「特殊收容」用的是什么道具？竟然连人的灵魂都能收容。
Desc.LocalizedString: By the way, Shopkeeper, what was used in the special containment protocol? It was even meant to contain human souls!

Desc.SourceString: 灵可前辈……
Desc.LocalizedString: Linko senpai…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm?

Desc.SourceString: 一路上的灯都熄灭了，只剩下前面这盏……
Desc.LocalizedString: All the lamps went out, except for the one ahead…

Desc.SourceString: 还有这样的异象，真想亲眼见识见识。
Desc.LocalizedString: I didn't know there was an anomaly like that. I hope I can see it one day.

Desc.SourceString: 灵可前辈，你在看——这个旧帐篷？还是地上刻着的这个图案……呃，是一只眼睛么。
Desc.LocalizedString: Linko senpai, are you… looking at the old tent or the picture carved on the ground? Umm… is that an eye?

Desc.SourceString: 明白。毕竟，是她把我送到伊波恩来的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Understood. She was the one who sent me to Eibon after all.

Desc.SourceString: 会不会是给同伴留下的记号？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this some kind of code left for a companion?

Desc.SourceString: 只是这样的红线还有好多，延申到不同的楼层。
Desc.LocalizedString: <male=>The problem is there are so many red lines that extend across different floors.<male><female=>The problem is that there are so many red lines extending across different floors.<female>

Desc.SourceString: 他们？
Desc.LocalizedString: They?

Desc.SourceString: 小心礁石和树干！
Desc.LocalizedString: Watch out for the rocks and trees!

Desc.SourceString: 好黑……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's so dark…

Desc.SourceString: 坡度越来越陡了……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's getting steeper…

Desc.SourceString: 「收到明信片就不用等了」——写信人猜到自己会遭遇不测，但还是没能抵住游戏的诱惑么……
Desc.LocalizedString: If you're reading this letter, stop waiting… The sender knew something bad would happen to them, but they couldn't help but join the game…

Desc.SourceString: 看到红线了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I see a red line!

Desc.SourceString: 右边的墙上是不是又刻着眼睛？会是巧合么，我们一直是沿着眼睛所看的方向在走。
Desc.LocalizedString: Is there another eye marked on the right wall? We've been following the direction the eyes look towards the whole time. Is this a coincidence?

Desc.SourceString: 完好无损的穿衣镜？和周围的破败有些格格不入呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: A floor mirror in perfect condition? It doesn't quite match the ruin around it.

Desc.SourceString: 大蛇的脑袋上面插着一把剑……是之前的参赛者和大蛇拼到同归于尽么？
Desc.LocalizedString: A sword driven into the snake's skull… Did a participant and the snake mutually destroy each other?

Desc.SourceString: 日志先拿着吧，等空了我来看。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's take it for now. I'll read it in my spare time.

Desc.SourceString: 这些灯好奇怪……该不会真和什么二进制有关吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: These lights are weird… are they related to a binary system?

Desc.SourceString: 看信的内容，那些收件人都遇到了不小的麻烦……所以他们才会找T女士。
Desc.LocalizedString: Judging from what was written in the letters, the recipients all had serious troubles… which brought them to Madam T.

Desc.SourceString: ……好冷。
Desc.LocalizedString: So cold…

Desc.SourceString: （原来娜娜莉平时走在墙上是这种感觉。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (So this is what Nanally feels when she walks on walls.)

Desc.SourceString: 伊艾尔在我的怀里……像块冰。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm holding Irael… like holding ice.

Desc.SourceString: 我想松手了……
Desc.LocalizedString: I want to let go…

Desc.SourceString: （并非自愿参与游戏——跟莳小姐的家人一样。为什么？难道这游戏必须有牺牲者？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (They were forced to join the game, like Thyme's family. Why? Does the game require someone to be sacrificed?)

Desc.SourceString: （一只精美的铁盒……是打火机？上面还有血渍，可现场明明没有打斗的痕迹。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A delicate iron box… it's a lighter? There are bloodstains on it, but there are no traces of fighting on site.)

Desc.SourceString: （它的主人多半已是病入膏肓，那他参加游戏图什么？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Its owner must have been sick to the bone, so why did they even join the game?)

Desc.SourceString: 哼，新人就是好糊弄。
Desc.LocalizedString: Newbie, you're too easy to fool.

Desc.SourceString: 好！
Desc.LocalizedString: Got it!

Desc.SourceString: 小鬼！小心头顶！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey! Watch out!
BLARGH—

Desc.SourceString: 小鬼！
Desc.LocalizedString: Scamp!

Desc.SourceString: 哪边？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where is it?

Desc.SourceString: 哇——漂亮！
Desc.LocalizedString: Woah, nice!

Desc.SourceString: 继续啊大笨蛇！
Desc.LocalizedString: C'mon, big stupid snake!

Desc.SourceString: 嗐，瞎猫碰上死耗子罢了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Pfft, she just got lucky.

Desc.SourceString: 新人啊，还以为你跟臭小鬼不一样，是个聪明人来着~如今看来，啧啧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Newbie, I thought you were a smart one, different from Linko. Now that I've known you…

Desc.SourceString: 臭小鬼每次都只知道跟着电波瞎跑，结果连人家话都没听完就闯进来了——
Desc.LocalizedString: That scamp only knows how to follow her signal. She even charged in without listening to the full—
Woah!!!

Desc.SourceString: 呜呼呼~~本恶灵的力量终于回来啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Muwahaha! This evil spirit has finally gained back her powers!

Desc.SourceString: ……怎么一个鬼影也看不到？喂——快出来拜见海特洛第一恶灵！
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm, where's everyone? HEYYY! Come out and meet the strongest evil spirit of Hethereau!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么怎么？电波小鬼感应到什么了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What is it? Did the signal scamp sense something?

Desc.SourceString: 是坑还是线索，过去看了才知道。
Desc.LocalizedString: We'll have to see if it's a lead or another pitfall.

Desc.SourceString: 咦，大白天的闹鬼了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? Ghosts appearing in the middle of the day?

Desc.SourceString: 电波小鬼的电波真好用！
Desc.LocalizedString: The signal scamp got it right!

Desc.SourceString: 噗……本恶灵的名讳也能算是成语？
Desc.LocalizedString: Pfft… This evil spirit is in a detective universe now?

Desc.SourceString: 臭小鬼，想我了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Scamp, you missed me?

Desc.SourceString: 你还倒打一耙？我刚刚被关在黑箱子里出不来，怎么叫你都不理我！
Desc.LocalizedString: You're blaming me? I was shut in some black box and I kept calling you!

Desc.SourceString: 帐篷都破成这样了，鬼知道是多少年前留下的东西……
Desc.LocalizedString: The tent is totally tattered. No living being would know how long ago it's from…

Desc.SourceString: 唉，现在可不是为陌生人伤感的时候。前进吧，小鬼。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh, this isn't the time to feel sentimental about strangers. Keep going, little scamp.

Desc.SourceString: 快把挡路的锤飞！
Desc.LocalizedString: Just blast everything away!

Desc.SourceString: 不会要起飞了吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are we going to fly?

Desc.SourceString: 喂！破坏公共设施，记大过处分！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey! You're destroying public property! Your review isn't going to look great!

Desc.SourceString: 你像反派大怪兽还差不多~
Desc.LocalizedString: You're more like a kaiju baddie!

Desc.SourceString: 我才不需要你记得。
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't need you to remember me.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么没跟你那位「母亲」一块行动？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why aren't you with that "mother" of yours?

Desc.SourceString: 哼，真是冷淡。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmph, how cold.

Desc.SourceString: 等等……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait…

Desc.SourceString: 受死吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Die!

Desc.SourceString: ……什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: What…?

Desc.SourceString: 就是现在，「睚」！
Desc.LocalizedString: Glaire, now!

Desc.SourceString: 噢、噢！！原来如此，原来如此！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: O-Oh…! That's it! That's it!!!

Desc.SourceString: 全身上下连意志也被分解了个干净，只剩下岩浆般的热情！
Desc.LocalizedString: Every last part, even consciousness—disintegrated! Nothing left but molten passion!

Desc.SourceString: 这就是理性崩坏的世界，如此美妙，哈哈！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is the world in which sanity has fallen apart. Such beauty, hahahaha!

Desc.SourceString: 我……在哪……
Desc.LocalizedString: Where… am I…

Desc.SourceString: ……像这样快速回击？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do a fast counter like this…?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 懂不懂先来后到！
Desc.LocalizedString: I got first dibs!

Desc.SourceString: 略略略……
Desc.LocalizedString: Nyah nyah nyah!

Desc.SourceString: 你~追~不~着~
Desc.LocalizedString: Can't—touch—this!

Desc.SourceString: 这条路蜿蜒向上，顺着走说不定也能离开山谷。
Desc.LocalizedString: This path is winding upwards. Maybe it can lead us out of the valley.

Desc.SourceString: 小鬼还想带着我们绕远路？希望的曙光明明就在眼前！
Desc.LocalizedString: Little scamp, you want us to take a detour? Our path is shining bright ahead of us!

Desc.SourceString: 是塌方了？还好离我们远得很。
Desc.LocalizedString: Did something cave in? Good thing we're far from there.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么回事？是地震吗？！
Desc.LocalizedString: What's going on? An earthquake?

Desc.SourceString: 悬崖边很危险，赶紧找个开阔平坦的地方！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's dangerous around the cliff. Go find an open space right now!

Desc.SourceString: 哎？它好像——
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? It's—

Desc.SourceString: 别好像了，快走！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop looking! Run!

Desc.SourceString: 左边！
Desc.LocalizedString: Go left!

Desc.SourceString: 注意脚下！注意头顶！还有注意鞋带——总之多注意！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mind your steps! Mind your head! Mind your shoelaces! Mind everything!

Desc.SourceString: 踩着落石爬上去！小鬼们坚持住了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Step over the fallen rocks! Little scamps, you got this!

Desc.SourceString: 就当是练习身法了！新人你还好吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Just treat this like an exercise! Newbie, you okay there?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，我还跟得上。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah, I'm alright.

Desc.SourceString: 这些洞穴，好……好规整。
Desc.LocalizedString: These tunnels are… so neat.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，我很好。不过，灵可前辈，你看那边。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah, I'm still alive. Linko senpai, look over there.

Desc.SourceString: 我不喜欢这个猜想，快撤回。
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't like this thought. Take it back.

Desc.SourceString: 是大蛇！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's the giant snake!

Desc.SourceString: 噫，怎么又来了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Eeek, how is it here again…?

Desc.SourceString: 这臭蛇真是阴魂不散！
Desc.LocalizedString: This cursed snake just won't go away!

Desc.SourceString: ……那是大蛇的骸骨没错吧？我们之前在瀑布那也看到过。难道说——
Desc.LocalizedString: That's the giant snake's skeleton, right? We also saw one at the waterfall. Can it be—

Desc.SourceString: 你是小机灵鬼，它是大笨蛇，肯定想不到的。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're a smart scamp, and that's a dumb snake. It won't even know.

Desc.SourceString: 小鬼们动作轻柔点，别说话了，它好像听得懂——
Desc.LocalizedString: Little scamps, tread carefully. Don't speak. I think the snake can understand—

Desc.SourceString: 小心！
Desc.LocalizedString: Watch out!

Desc.SourceString: 嚯，脾气可真大！
Desc.LocalizedString: Heh, what a temper.

Desc.SourceString: 你跑不了的，穿山蛇！
Desc.LocalizedString: Cavey Snakey, I won't let you get away!

Desc.SourceString: 啥时候起的名字？
Desc.LocalizedString: When did you start to call it that?

Desc.SourceString: 跑得可真快。
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, that was fast.

Desc.SourceString: 不是，怎么变成我们追大蛇了？小机灵鬼你快拉住她！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, how are we chasing the snake right now? Smarty scamp, stop her already!

Desc.SourceString: 小贞前辈，我认为灵可前辈的判断是正确的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Xiaozhen senpai, I think Linko senpai made the right call.

Desc.SourceString: 我一直在担心时间。如果这场游戏有时间限制，那我们现在最好的选择，就是追击最近的高价值目标。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm worried about time constraints. If this game has a time limit, then our best chance is to go after the closest high-value target.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯嗯！我从一开始就是这么想的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Exactly! That's what I was thinking!

Desc.SourceString: 我信你个鬼！
Desc.LocalizedString: Not even a scamp would believe you!

Desc.SourceString: 这棵盘根错节的巨树，似乎有些松动？
Desc.LocalizedString: This massive tree with tangled roots now seems a bit looser?

Desc.SourceString: 要想办法去上一层呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: We need to get up there.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm?

Desc.SourceString: 这房间有人呆过，而且刚离开不久。
Desc.LocalizedString: Someone was just in this room not long ago.

Desc.SourceString: 刚离开么……难道是那些访客？
Desc.LocalizedString: Not long ago…? Could it be the visitors?

Desc.SourceString: 会飞的信？它要飞去哪？
Desc.LocalizedString: A flying letter? Where's it going?

Desc.SourceString: 一个台阶？好像可以跳上去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Stairs? Seems like one can jump over it.

Desc.SourceString: ……真是煞有介事的把戏。
Desc.LocalizedString: …What a pointless charade.

Desc.SourceString: 看来，这信封是开启特定房间的「钥匙」。
Desc.LocalizedString: This letter should be a key to a specific room.

Desc.SourceString: 小心！
Desc.LocalizedString: Watch out!
The 21st floor?

Desc.SourceString: 怎么有好几台电视机……
Desc.LocalizedString: Why are there so many TVs…?
Hmmm…

Desc.SourceString: 糟糕，选错了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh, wrong one…

Desc.SourceString: 没时间跟它们磨蹭了，快离开这儿。
Desc.LocalizedString: We don't have time to waste on them. Just get out of here.

Desc.SourceString: 这没品的电视广告真是吵死了。
Desc.LocalizedString: This garbage ad is so noisy.

Desc.SourceString: 电梯的入口……终于出现了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The entrance to the elevator… finally appears.

Desc.SourceString: 前辈，这个歧骸很危险。山谷的塌方，应该就是它追逐我们所引发的。要记录情报的话，我们得先保证自己的安全。
