Desc.LocalizedString: Senpai, this oddity is dangerous. The valley collapsed likely because it was chasing us. Before we collect any intel, we need to guarantee our own safety.

Desc.SourceString: 抱歉……我失误了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Sorry… I made a mistake!

Desc.SourceString: 一起把这一分扳回来吧，可可！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, let's get this point back together!

Desc.SourceString: 对面的家伙……别得意！
Desc.LocalizedString: You guys… not so fast!

Desc.SourceString: 相信柯林斯不会输！
Desc.LocalizedString: The Coluccis will never lose!

Desc.SourceString: 只是一次小小的失败~
Desc.LocalizedString: Just a minor setback!

Desc.SourceString: 走神了……对不起。
Desc.LocalizedString: Got distracted… Sorry.

Desc.SourceString: 训练还不够……
Desc.LocalizedString: Need more practice…

Desc.SourceString: 别灰心。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's alright.

Desc.SourceString: 没关系，下回合赢回来！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's okay. We'll win the next round!

Desc.SourceString: 还有机会！
Desc.LocalizedString: There's still a chance!

Desc.SourceString: 啧……是我大意了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch… I got careless.

Desc.SourceString: 哼……暂时的失利而已。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmph… nothing but a temporary setback.

Desc.SourceString: 完美得分~
Desc.LocalizedString: Perfect play!

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷龙卷风，乘胜追击！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint Tornado, pressing on!

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼，手感火热！
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheh, I'm on a streak!

Desc.SourceString: 我有胜利的预感~
Desc.LocalizedString: Victory is near!

Desc.SourceString: 得分~离胜利更进一步了呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Score! We're closer to victory!

Desc.SourceString: 我们一定会赢的，对吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: We'll surely win, right?

Desc.SourceString: 这一球，还不错。
Desc.LocalizedString: That was a great play.

Desc.SourceString: 别掉以轻心。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't let your guard down.

Desc.SourceString: 好球！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nice one!

Desc.SourceString: 继续进攻吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's keep going!

Desc.SourceString: 哼~真是不堪一击。
Desc.LocalizedString: Heh. How pathetic.

Desc.SourceString: 看来，我们要赢咯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like we're about to win.

Desc.SourceString: 这里，这里！
Desc.LocalizedString: Over here! Look over here!

Desc.SourceString: 想要挑战「碧波之星沙滩排球大赛」的有志者，别不好意思！都上这儿来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Does anyone want to join the beach volleyball tournament for the Jade Star? Don't be shy! Come over here!

Desc.SourceString: 报名就要截止了喔！
Desc.LocalizedString: Sign-up is almost over!

Desc.SourceString: 用不着紧张~忘掉了享受阳光和沙滩的初衷就得不偿失了，排球只是夏日的调剂之一~
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry! It won't be fun if you forget to enjoy the sun and the beach! Volleyball is just one part of summer!

Desc.SourceString: 所以别有压力，这就是场训练赛而已。
Desc.LocalizedString: No need to feel pressure. This game is just for training purposes.

Desc.SourceString: 明白！我会拿出百分之两百的劲头来享受每一场比赛的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Got it! I'll play every game with 200% of my passion!

Desc.SourceString: 请多指教啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's goooo!

Desc.SourceString: 直至消融（至死方休）。
Desc.LocalizedString: Till we melt away. (Till death holds sway.)

Desc.SourceString: 战斗（战斗）。
Desc.LocalizedString: Battle (Battle)

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师得分~
Desc.LocalizedString: The Appraiser scores!

Desc.SourceString: 哇，我是不是要输了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh no, am I losing?

Desc.SourceString: 啊啊，是我大意了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahh! I got careless!

Desc.SourceString: 下一回合，才是我的回合！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll put up a show the next round!

Desc.SourceString: ……手滑了。
Desc.LocalizedString: …My hand slipped.

Desc.SourceString: 得认真起来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll have to get serious.

Desc.SourceString: 啊，就差一点！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, that was so close!

Desc.SourceString: 这么厉害！
Desc.LocalizedString: You did great!

Desc.SourceString: 哼……有两下子。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmph… not bad.

Desc.SourceString: 啧……别高兴得太早！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch… don't get your hopes up just yet.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，先调查，再分析！总感觉这里离大蛇的老窝很近了，只要再往里走走……
Desc.LocalizedString: Mm, we'll inspect before analyzing. I feel we're close to the giant snake's nest. Just need to go a bit further…

Desc.SourceString: 我已经——和过去不一样了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I am different—from who I used to be!

Desc.SourceString: 你的眼睛怎么了？谁把你弄伤的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Your eye… Who did this to you?

Desc.SourceString: （左眼……完全看不见了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (My left eye… can't see at all.)

Desc.SourceString: （就靠身体的本能去应对吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I'll have to use my instincts to fight on.)

Desc.SourceString: （我不会在这里倒下！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I won't just fall down here!)

Desc.SourceString: 那边有辉环！快快，先到先得！
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a Lumen Circle! Quick, let's go grab it!

Desc.SourceString: 欸欸欸欸——你站稳点儿！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, hey hey, don't fall down!

Desc.SourceString: 嚯！停停停！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oi! Stop right there!

Desc.SourceString: 快停下！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop right now!

Desc.SourceString: 要命了，怎么后面也在塌方？！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's collapsing behind too? I'm so dead!

Desc.SourceString: 危险！
Desc.LocalizedString: Watch out!

Desc.SourceString: 一拳打穿大骨头！
Desc.LocalizedString: Punch through the ribcage!

Desc.SourceString: 呜……鬼死了会变成什么……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh… what happens to evil spirits who die…?

Desc.SourceString: 小心！
Desc.LocalizedString: Careful!

Desc.SourceString: 当心，小鬼！
Desc.LocalizedString: Watch out, scamp!

Desc.SourceString: 您还真是博爱呀，母亲。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mother, how benevolent of you.

Desc.SourceString: 我当然是想帮您一把了。从母亲的餐桌上挑一道菜——是选鉴定师好呢，还是……
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course we want to help. We'll put something on our plate—the Appraiser, or…

Desc.SourceString: 还想打？那我只好奉陪了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wanna play? I'll play with you!

Desc.SourceString: 你敢动他们试试。
Desc.LocalizedString: I double dare you.

Desc.SourceString: （气息）
Desc.LocalizedString: [Effort] Daffodill interrupts Madam T with her blade

Desc.SourceString: 小心，我还是头一回见她这么癫狂……
Desc.LocalizedString: Careful. This is the first time I've seen her this insane…

Desc.SourceString: 巨像快支撑不住了！必须尽快……
Desc.LocalizedString: The colossus can't take it anymore! We need to…

Desc.SourceString: （明明不用狩猎也能获得辉环，那个面具是想诱导我么……让我们自相残杀。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (They didn't have to hunt to collect Lumen Circles. Was that mask baiting me… to kill other participants?)

Desc.SourceString: （这人是之前游戏的参赛者。辉环还在，说明他并不是被其他参赛者淘汰。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This one was from a previous game. His Lumen Circle is still here, which means that he wasn't taken out by another participant.)

Desc.SourceString: （游戏结束时，如果没能拿到10个辉环，就会变成这个样子永远留在雾巢吧……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I guess those who don't collect ten Lumen Circles turn into stone and stay in the Fogden forever…)

Desc.SourceString: （这些人同时遇害？不，还有一个，至少当时还活着。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Did these people die together? No, there's one more who was alive at the time.)

Desc.SourceString: （也可能他当时不在现场。等赶来的时候，看到同伴已经遇害，于是丧失了斗志在这里等死。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Maybe he wasn't here when his companions died, and when he realized that, he lost his will to fight and stayed here till the end.)

Desc.SourceString: （躲在这种角落，也还是被找到了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This one tried to hide in a corner but someone still found out.)

Desc.SourceString: （……真是恶趣味。莫非是T女士的手笔？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (How wicked… Is this the work of Madam T?)

Desc.SourceString: （那处山洞似乎能走。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (There's a cave over there.)

Desc.SourceString: （你们……在哪？我知道你们不会输，不会败给红字的任何人。是我动作太慢了吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Where are you all…? I know you wouldn't lose to anyone from the Scarlet Letter. Am I just too slow?)

Desc.SourceString: （……居然和异象融合到这种地步？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (You can fuse with an anomaly to this extent…?)

Desc.SourceString: （我没时间浪费在这里，必须尽快……尽快赶到你们身边。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I don't have any time to waste. I must… find you ASAP.)

Desc.SourceString: （这么多人死在一起……真是一场屠杀。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (So many people dead together… Must have been a massacre.)

Desc.SourceString: （他们最后的姿态几乎没有反抗的痕迹，更像是被动卷入、不知情的「耗材」。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It doesn't look like they resisted at all. It's as if they were passively involved and didn't know they were expendable.)

Desc.SourceString: （你们不是在堂堂正正的搏斗中死去的，对吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (You didn't die in an honorable duel, did you?)

Desc.SourceString: （把后背交给了错误的人……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (You let the wrong person watch your back…)

Desc.SourceString: （这！！！说是地狱景象也不为过……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (What…! What a hellish sight…)

Desc.SourceString: （虽然不知道你们是谁，为什么会参加游戏，但我会将这些遗物带出去，转交给你们的家人。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I don't know who you are and why you joined the game, but I'll make sure to deliver the keepsakes to your family.)

Desc.SourceString: 我想鉴定师猜得没错，这些数字，就是电视机的「编号」。
Desc.LocalizedString: I think the Appraiser is right. These numbers should be the ID numbers of the TV.

Desc.SourceString: 快结束了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's almost over.

Desc.SourceString: 小心身后！
Desc.LocalizedString: Behind you!

Desc.SourceString: 没看到数字？这台电视机可能又是陷阱。
Desc.LocalizedString: No number? This TV might be another trap.

Desc.SourceString: 地上都是什么，要爆炸了？妮夏……
Desc.LocalizedString: What's that on the ground? Are they exploding? Nitsa…

Desc.SourceString: 零号异象？竟然在这里出现……不管了，好歹它拖住了那个大的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Code Zero? What is it doing here…? Whatever, at least it's keeping the big guy busy.

Desc.SourceString: 地上这个……她这样子……还能算是人类吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: This thing… Is she… even human anymore?

Desc.SourceString: 快躲进蓝色的罩子里！
Desc.LocalizedString: Get under the blue cover!
No…

Desc.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔……
Desc.LocalizedString: Daffodill…

Desc.SourceString: 电视机旁有个数字「8」……我记得楼下那台的地面上，写着一个「9」。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a number "8" written next to the TV… I remember a "9" written near the TV downstairs.

Desc.SourceString: 这些数字会跟电视机有关吗？比如，是它们的编号之类的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are these numbers related to the TVs? Like their ID numbers?
The number "7."

Desc.SourceString: 又找到一封信。
Desc.LocalizedString: Another letter.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？走廊之前不长这样吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm? The corridor wasn't like this before, was it?

Desc.SourceString: 她就不怕我们来个一锅端？
Desc.LocalizedString: She's not concerned that we'll take them out at once?

Desc.SourceString: 这次是「6」。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's "6" this time.

Desc.SourceString: 开了灯以后，房间变样了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Does the room look different after the lights are turned on?
Here. It says "5."

Desc.SourceString: 是电视机！怎么没看到数字？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a TV! But why isn't there a number?

Desc.SourceString: 有电梯！
Desc.LocalizedString: There's an elevator!

Desc.SourceString: 她很喜欢扮演这个角色呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: She really likes that role.

Desc.SourceString: 路被挡住了……
Desc.LocalizedString: The path is blocked…

Desc.SourceString: 不知不觉爬了这么高？
Desc.LocalizedString: We somehow climbed this high?

Desc.SourceString: 我的小花朵们，你们打算在一旁看着，还是接受我的庇荫活到最后？
Desc.LocalizedString: My little flowers. Are you just going to stand there and watch, or survive under my protection?

Desc.SourceString: 乖孩子，越挣扎会越痛噢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Kiddo, struggling only makes it hurt…

Desc.SourceString: 欢迎来到我的花园——
Desc.LocalizedString: Welcome to my garden—

Desc.SourceString: 现在的你动作可真慢啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're a lot slower than before.

Desc.SourceString: 哼！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmph!

Desc.SourceString: 不安分的小虫子，你逃不掉了——
Desc.LocalizedString: Insolent vermin, you have nowhere to go—

Desc.SourceString: 在我的茧房里化为肉泥吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn to mush inside my chamber!

Desc.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔，达芙蒂尔，达芙蒂尔——！
Desc.LocalizedString: Daffodill, Daffodill, Daffodill…!

Desc.SourceString: 别心急，鉴定师，很快你也会成为我的家人——不管你愿不愿意。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry, Appraiser. You'll be part of my family soon—whether you like it or not.

Desc.SourceString: 躲躲藏藏的小虫子！
Desc.LocalizedString: Scrambling around like vermin!
Hmph…

Desc.SourceString: 弱不禁风的孩子，活着也是受罪。
Desc.LocalizedString: A kid as weak as you… would be better dead than alive.

Desc.SourceString: 死吧！死吧！死吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Die! Die! Die!

Desc.SourceString: 埋葬在花海中吧——
Desc.LocalizedString: Get buried in the bloom—

Desc.SourceString: 离我——远点！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stay away… from me!

Desc.SourceString: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈……
Desc.LocalizedString: Muwahahaha!

Desc.SourceString: 给我——过来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Get over here!

Desc.SourceString: 送你们——最后一程！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let me send you… on your final trip!

Desc.SourceString: 你们都干了什么？！花园得好好织补！
Desc.LocalizedString: What have you done? My garden…could use a fresh weave!

Desc.SourceString: 别担心，她不会输。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry. She won't lose.

Desc.SourceString: 别听她的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't listen to her!

Desc.SourceString: 一个人动作慢，那就两个人、三个人一起上。
Desc.LocalizedString: If I'm slow by myself, we'll slow you down with two or three of us.

Desc.SourceString: 算吧？算是身心都败给异象的人类。
Desc.LocalizedString: One who lost her body and soul to an anomaly—I guess so.

Desc.SourceString: 别心急，鉴定师，很快你也会成为我的家人——不管你愿不愿意。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry, Appraiser. You'll be part of my family soon—whether you like it or not.

Desc.SourceString: 再看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's look around more.

Desc.SourceString: 拿到「钥匙」就能继续前进的意思？看来，主人真正的心意，并不是将我们拒之门外，而是引导着我们继续找下去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Does that mean we can continue if we find the key? Maybe instead of leading us astray, the owner wants us to stay on the right path.

Desc.SourceString: 她想必是有不怕的底气。不过别担心，这次艾尔菲德——我们也是做足了准备。
Desc.LocalizedString: I bet she's not afraid of us, but that's okay. Alphard also… I mean, we also prepared a lot.

Desc.SourceString: 能不能用还不知道。
Desc.LocalizedString: I hope it still works.

Desc.SourceString: 自称「母亲」——这口吻，是T女士写的吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: She calls herself "Mother." It must be written by Madam T.

Desc.SourceString: 待会怎么下去……
Desc.LocalizedString: We'll need to find a way to get down…

Desc.SourceString: 怎么连电视机也有假货？
Desc.LocalizedString: There are fake TVs here now?

Desc.SourceString: 快离开洞穴！
Desc.LocalizedString: Get out of the tunnel right now!

Desc.SourceString: 感觉跟大蛇的体型接近呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: They look about as wide as the giant snake.

Desc.SourceString: 实验——开始！
Desc.LocalizedString: The experiment commences!

Desc.SourceString: 这个村子是怎么了？人都去哪了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What happened to this town? Where are the townsfolk?

Desc.SourceString: 这是卡斯科村，夏天的时候，来了个猎巫人，吓跑了不少村民。后来邻国的士兵游荡到这，把这彻底毁了。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is Casco. Come summer, a witch hunter passed through and drove the villagers away. Then soldiers from the neighboring kingdom came in and left nothing standing.

Desc.SourceString: 不过你们放心，圣阿尔博镇还是很太平的。再坚持坚持，很快就到。
Desc.LocalizedString: But rest easy, St. Arbor is still at peace. Hold on a little longer and we'll be there.

Desc.SourceString: 马修·霍普金斯……这就是安妮说的猎巫人吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Matthew Hopkins… is this the witch hunter Annie was talking about?

Desc.SourceString: 这、这审判的方式也太荒唐了……
Desc.LocalizedString: These trials… are absolutely ridiculous.

Desc.SourceString: 战争、瘟疫、饥荒……这究竟是什么地方？
Desc.LocalizedString: War, famine, and plague… What is this place?

Desc.SourceString: 这个距离有些危险，得走远点……
Desc.LocalizedString: Getting too close. Must stay away…

Desc.SourceString: 前面就是圣阿尔博镇了。带你们回家前，我得先带你们去拜访一下维克托镇长，他也是圣阿尔博镇的长老。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just ahead lies the town of St. Arbor. Before I bring you back, I must first take you to Magistrate Victor, who is an elder of the town.

Desc.SourceString: 卡斯科村子的事，你们也看到了，镇长只是为了我们的安全着想，并不是讨厌你们。
Desc.LocalizedString: You saw with your own eyes what became of Casco. The magistrate only seeks to keep us from harm. He bears you no ill will.

Desc.SourceString: 他的话你们别太放在心上了，等他下回心情好了，你们再和他多说说话，他指定会接纳你们的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Do not take his words to heart. When his mood is lighter, speak with him again. In time, he will surely take you in.

Desc.SourceString: 贝蒂是她们的独生女，会不会和玛莎大婶一样，都是金发？
Desc.LocalizedString: If Betty is their daughter, could she be a blonde like Martha?

Desc.SourceString: 有这个可能，我们去找找贝蒂吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's possible. Let's go find Betty.

Desc.SourceString: 快一天了，那个金发的女孩一点影子没有。唉……
Desc.LocalizedString: The day's almost over. We still haven't found that blonde girl. Ugh…

Desc.SourceString: 不过，我们倒是听到了不少八卦呢。这样一路听过去，感觉比占卜更快呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: We did hear a great deal of gossip. I feel like eavesdropping is more efficient than divination.

Desc.SourceString: （看来镇里的人都已经想好了，明天要拿什么去接受神树之火的检验。）
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like the townsfolk are prepared to bring objects to the trial at the Sacred Tree tomorrow.

Desc.SourceString: 不知道安妮准备了些什么，我们回去看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I wonder what Annie is bringing with her. Let's go back and check on her.

Desc.SourceString: 时间不早了，也该回去了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's getting late. Time to go back.

Desc.SourceString: 魔女！我代唯一的神明传信，以陪审团和神明的名义，判处你——恶魔的代行者，火刑！
Desc.LocalizedString: Witch! Your soul has been weighed and found wanting. In the name of the Highest One, I condemn you, servant of the Devil, to the fire!

Desc.SourceString: 这世上只有一种恶魔，就是孕育你的疯狂和恶意！你，才是恶魔的代行者！
Desc.LocalizedString: There's only one devil in this world—the madness and malice that made you. You are the true servant of the Devil!

Desc.SourceString: 火已降下，审判已至。
Desc.LocalizedString: The flames of judgment have come.

Desc.SourceString: 神明之火，焚尽污秽。
Desc.LocalizedString: The fire of the Highest One cleanses all filth.

Desc.SourceString: 圣火既临，罪无可藏。
Desc.LocalizedString: No sin shall hide before this sacred blaze.

Desc.SourceString: 吾乃神明所造之使者，奉其意志而守望此世。凡魔女与恶魔，皆当焚灭。
Desc.LocalizedString: I am the messenger of the Highest One, sent forth to keep vigil over this world. All witches and devils shall burn to ashes.

Desc.SourceString: 今汝既见吾真形，便当受火之审判。
Desc.LocalizedString: Now that thou hast beheld my true form, thou shalt face the judgment of fire.

Desc.SourceString: 以火，净汝之罪。
Desc.LocalizedString: Fire cleanse thy sins.

Desc.SourceString: 火已为证，汝无可辩。
Desc.LocalizedString: The fire hath witnessed. Thou shalt not flee.

Desc.SourceString: 汝既有罪，何敢逃于火外。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sinner, how darest thou flee from the flames?

Desc.SourceString: 不洁者，当焚。
Desc.LocalizedString: Unclean one, thou shalt burn.

Desc.SourceString: 早上好，安妮。我们打算定居在镇上，正要去拜访镇长。
Desc.LocalizedString: Good morning, Annie. We want to visit the magistrate and tell him that we want to settle down in this town.

Desc.SourceString: 记得谨言慎行，不要得罪人就好。祝你们一路顺利。
Desc.LocalizedString: Pray mind your words and manners, and take care not to give offense. I wish you well on your way.

Desc.SourceString: 借给你钱？你又要拿去喝酒或打牌了吧。你再这样下去，会被神明抛弃的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lend you money? You'll just go drink or gamble it away again. Keep this up and even the Highest One will turn away from you.

Desc.SourceString: 我家里已经没东西吃了，我只是想要些买面包的钱。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's not a scrap left to eat in my house. I ask only for a little coin to buy bread.

Desc.SourceString: 除去你卖给比利的土地和牲畜，你起码还有两笼鸡和皮克托家边上那片地。如果你认真干活，怎么会没有面包吃？
Desc.LocalizedString: Even setting aside the land and livestock you sold to Billy, you still have two chicken coops and that plot by Pickett's place. How can you go hungry if you put in an honest day's work?

Desc.SourceString: 够了！维克托，你该对他仁慈点，他实在经受太多了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Enough, now! Victor, you ought to show him more mercy. The poor man has been through far too much.

Desc.SourceString: 丽贝卡和弗兰都死在了瘟疫里，安妮没多少财产也没有土地，我怎么没见她整日酗酒赌博。我还没把吉尔斯赶出镇子，已经是最大的仁慈了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rebecca and Fran both died in the plague, and Annie, with no land to her name, I've never once seen her drink or gamble her days away. That I've not yet driven Giles from the town is mercy enough.

Desc.SourceString: 神明曾经用苦难考验过那么多人，有许多人都依然保持着正直善良，为什么只有吉尔斯没能通过考验？
Desc.LocalizedString: The Highest One has tested so many souls with hardship, and many still keep their honesty and goodness. Why is it that only Giles has failed the trial?

Desc.SourceString: 你……你要是不想把我气出病，就给他点钱！
Desc.LocalizedString: You… if you don't want to worry me into sickness, then give him some coin!

Desc.SourceString: 不给，我们的粮食也就是将将够吃，贝蒂的事你忘了吗？我们没有多余的钱了。
Desc.LocalizedString: No. We've barely enough grain to get by as it is. Have you forgotten what happened with Betty? There's no coin to spare.

Desc.SourceString: 你……你要让整个镇子看我们的笑话吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Would you have the whole town make a mockery of us?

Desc.SourceString: 如果我给他钱，才是让人看笑话。
Desc.LocalizedString: We'd become a laughingstock the moment I gave him coin.

Desc.SourceString: 妈妈，快看，这是丽兹阿姨给我新做的布娃娃，好看吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mama, come look! This is the new doll Auntie Lizzie made for me. Isn't it lovely?

Desc.SourceString: 你今天应该在丽兹阿姨家打扫，怎么能随便跑出来呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: You were meant to be cleaning at Auntie Lizzie's today. Why have you run off?

Desc.SourceString: 我是来帮丽兹阿姨买面包来的……
Desc.LocalizedString: I only came here to buy bread for Auntie Lizzie…

Desc.SourceString: 乖玛丽，你今天早上应该直接把面包带过去的。我看是你故意忘了，就为了偷懒回家吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Now Mary, you were supposed to bring the bread straight over this morning. You forgot on purpose to slip off home and laze about, didn't you?

Desc.SourceString: 这些鲜啤酒，你顺道也带过去吧，算是谢谢皮克托先生上次给了我们多余的谷粒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Take this fresh ale along with you, would you? A thank-you to Mister Pickett for sparing us that extra grain last time.

Desc.SourceString: 好的，爸爸妈妈再见！
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes! I'll be back in a bit, Papa, Mama!

Desc.SourceString: 马蹄铁我已经换好了，你们今天怎么来了这么远的地方放羊，害我一顿好找。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm done changing the horseshoes. What brought you all the way out to graze the goats? Had me searching a good while.

Desc.SourceString: 比利说这是吉尔斯刚卖给他的地，太久没打理，长了太多杂草，让我们今天带羊过来清理清理。
Desc.LocalizedString: Billy says it's the plot Giles just sold him. Been left too long, all grown with weeds, so he had us bring out the goats to graze.

Desc.SourceString: 给，这是你换马蹄铁的钱。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here, this is for changing the horseshoes.

Desc.SourceString: 多谢。我还要去帮皮克托修锄头，就先走了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Much obliged. I've still to go mend Pickett's hoe, so I'll be off.

Desc.SourceString: 里维斯，等等，我跟你一起走！
Desc.LocalizedString: Levis, wait, I'll go with you!

Desc.SourceString: 回来，阿比盖尔！早都说过了，你以后就跟着我们一起放羊，皮克托家已经用不上你了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait, Abigail! I've told you time and again, from now on you're to graze the goats with us. The Picketts have no more need of you.

Desc.SourceString: 可是婶婶，你们两个放羊就够了，我在这里一点用处都没有，你让我回去打扫一下也好，我可以给你们提前做好晚餐。
Desc.LocalizedString: But Auntie, the two of you are enough to graze the goats, I'm of no use out here. Let me go back and clean, at least, I could have your supper ready ahead of time.

Desc.SourceString: 别以为我不知道你在想什么，我也有过你这样的年纪。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't think I don't know what's on your mind. I was your age once too.

Desc.SourceString: 叔叔，婶婶在说什么呢，我都听不懂。
Desc.LocalizedString: Uncle, what is Auntie saying? I do not understand.

Desc.SourceString: 你听不懂，我更听不懂了，但我知道，维达向来诚实。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you can't understand, I make even less of it. But this I know: Vida always speaks the truth.

Desc.SourceString: 皮克托，皮克托！你为什么要这么对我？你以前不是这样冷酷无情的男人，你是一名真正的绅士，求求你再吻我一次吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Pickett, oh, my Pickett! Why do you treat me so? You were never such a heartless man. You're a true gentleman, I beg you, kiss me but once more!

Desc.SourceString: 阿比盖尔，我犯了错，我已经在忏悔了。我向丽兹承认了一切，我跪下求她，她才愿意给我一个机会。为了我的家庭，我现在也愿意跪下求你，求你不要再来找我了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Abigail, I have sinned, and I am doing penance for it. I confessed all to Lizzie, knelt and begged her, and only then would she grant me a chance. For my family's sake, I will kneel and beg you the same, I beg you, seek me out no more!

Desc.SourceString: 你向她忏悔，对她诚实，求她原谅。可我呢？我只是一个负担，一个错误，你恨不得把我赶出圣阿尔博镇，是吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You confessed to her, were honest with her, begged her forgiveness. And me? I'm nothing but a burden, a mistake, one you'd give anything to drive out of St. Arbor, isn't that so?

Desc.SourceString: 我只是希望你不要再来找我了，我们一开始就不应该……
Desc.LocalizedString: I ask only that you seek me out no more. From the very first, we never should have…

Desc.SourceString: 是你吻我的！你！先！吻了我！你打开了我的心，点燃了火，现在又让我回到那种压抑无助坐牢一样的生活吗？你真的有这么残忍吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You were the one who kissed me! You! Kissed me! First! You opened up my heart, you lit the fire, and now you'd send me back to that stifling, helpless life, caged like a prisoner? Can you be so cruel?

Desc.SourceString: 对不起……对不起……你走吧，求你了。我今天还要打猎和砍柴，不能再耽误时间了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Forgive me… forgive me… go now, I beg you. I've hunting and woodcutting to do yet today, I can lose no more time.

Desc.SourceString: 你也快回去吧，约翰和维达需要你帮忙放羊呢。离开的时注意些，千万别被人看到，尤其是丽兹。
Desc.LocalizedString: Off you go now, too. John and Vida need your help with the goats. Mind yourself when you leave, and don't let anyone see you, above all not Lizzie.

Desc.SourceString: 如果我就是不走呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: What if I were not to leave?

Desc.SourceString: 你明知我们做的是错的，神明会惩罚我们，你就不怕下地狱吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You know full well what we were doing was wrong, and the Highest One will punish us for it. Have you no fear of hell?

Desc.SourceString: 如果我要去地狱，也一定会拉着你一起。丽兹或许会原谅你，但我不会。我相信，神明也不会。
Desc.LocalizedString: If I am bound for hell, I shall drag you down with me. Lizzie may forgive you, but I never shall. And I believe neither will the Highest One.

Desc.SourceString: 那就让神明来审判我好了。你，无权审判我！
Desc.LocalizedString: Then let the Highest One be my judge. You… you have no right to judge me!

Desc.SourceString: 我在地狱门口等着你，皮克托先生。
Desc.LocalizedString: I shall await you at the gates of hell, Master Pickett.

Desc.SourceString: 听说了吗？有个镇子因为烧死了太多人，把城里派去的审判官赶走了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Have you heard? There's a town that burned so many folk they drove off the Inquisitor the city had sent!

Desc.SourceString: 那他们的司铎呢？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Then what of their confessor?

Desc.SourceString: 就是司铎带领他们赶走了审判官。
Desc.LocalizedString: It was the confessor who led them in driving off the Inquisitor.

Desc.SourceString: 天哪，他们都着了魔啊！一定是恶魔在捣鬼！神明保佑，可千万别让恶魔跑到圣阿尔博来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Heavens above, they're all possessed! Surely it is the Devil's work! By the Highest One's grace, let the Devil never come to St. Arbor.

Desc.SourceString: 唉，要是我们的司铎在就好了……他会不会再也不回来了？听说连总督都知道他的名字了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, if only our confessor were here… Might he never return? They say even the governor has come to know his name.

Desc.SourceString: 咱们的司铎大人可是驱魔的好手，城里审判的可都是最危险的邪魔歪道，所以司铎大人必须去帮忙！
Desc.LocalizedString: Our Confessor's a fine hand at driving out devils. It's the most dangerous wicked ones they're trying in the city. Of course he's needed there!

Desc.SourceString: 再说了，如果总督知道了我们的司铎，那岂不是连总督都知道咱们圣阿尔博人有多么虔诚了！
Desc.LocalizedString: What's more, if the governor be acquainted with our confessor, then he shall know full well how devout we folk of St. Arbor are!

Desc.SourceString: 傻不傻啊你，如果总督大人欣赏司铎，司铎肯定要升职了，那他就不会回来了。谁知道下一任司铎会是什么样的人？
Desc.LocalizedString: Aren't you a fool? If the governor favors the confessor, then he's sure to be raised up, and he'll not come back. Who's to say what the next confessor will be like?

Desc.SourceString: 你想想，我们上一任司铎的德行有多糟糕？成天管我们要柴火，还要银烛台，每周都要讲那些恶魔的故事吓唬我们。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just think how bad our last confessor was. Always after us for firewood, and silver candlesticks too, and every week those devil tales to scare us witless.

Desc.SourceString: 司铎是代表神明来教导我们的，就算你再不喜欢他，也不能在背后说人坏话啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: The Confessor comes in the Highest One's name to teach us. However little you like him, it's not right to speak ill of him behind his back.

Desc.SourceString: 你不说出去不就行了？反正，我觉得我们很快就要迎来新司铎了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just don't go telling anyone, and where's the harm? Either way, I've a feeling we'll be getting a new confessor before long.

Desc.SourceString: 唉，有司铎在总好过没有，无论来个什么样的司铎都成。镇上没有司铎在，我日日都不能安心睡觉。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, better a confessor than none, whatever sort he may be. With no confessor in the town, I've not had a peaceful night's sleep.

Desc.SourceString: 老比利去世后，比利真是越来越过分了！我看，他就是想让全镇子的人都给他做农奴！
Desc.LocalizedString: After Old Billy's passing, young Billy's grown more insufferable by the day! If you ask me, he'd have the whole town toiling as his serfs!

Desc.SourceString: 谁叫他家里几个长辈都在瘟疫里去世了，几年的功夫就继承了两个大农场还有一块牧场。
Desc.LocalizedString: With all his elder kin taken by the plague, in just a few years, he's come into two great farms and a pasture besides.

Desc.SourceString: 你等着瞧吧，他那么贪心的人，是不会有满足的时候的！迟早他会把费思的森林也抢到手。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just you wait and see. A man greedy as that is never content! Sooner or later he'll get his hands on Faithful's forest too.

Desc.SourceString: 噗，你说要是丽贝卡还在，他会不会娶了丽贝卡，做安妮的继父？
Desc.LocalizedString: Pfft, say Rebecca were still living, do you reckon he'd have wed her and made himself Annie's stepfather?

Desc.SourceString: 那是为什么啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: And why's that?

Desc.SourceString: 弗兰本来是有一小块土地的，如果丽贝卡还活着，比利肯定会为了土地娶她啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fran had a little plot of land to his name. If Rebecca were still alive, Billy would've wed her for the land for certain!

Desc.SourceString: 那到时候，安妮才真是入了狼窟！不对啊，安妮并没有土地啊，她家的院子，不是维克托镇长的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Then Annie would truly be walking into the wolf's den! But wait, Annie has no land at all, has she? That yard of hers, doesn't it belong to Magistrate Victor?

Desc.SourceString: 那是因为她当时年纪小，丽贝卡死前，在司铎的见证下，把土地卖给了镇长，那笔财产由镇长和司铎共同看守。所以安妮才能一直租住镇长的院子。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's because Annie was but a child then. Before she died, Rebecca sold the land to the magistrate with the confessor as witness, and it's kept in their joint charge. That's how Annie still rents the magistrate's yard.

Desc.SourceString: 我还是第一次听说这事！
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, that's the first I've heard of it!

Desc.SourceString: 吉尔斯，你这个德行败坏的家伙，快丢了你的酒壶吧！别再堕落了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Giles, you wretch, cast away thy ale! Fall no further into sin!

Desc.SourceString: 镇长，我需要些钱……买面包！还要买酒！
Desc.LocalizedString: Magistrate… This lowly one needs coin… to buy bread… and ale!

Desc.SourceString: 镇长，把吉尔斯交给我吧，他喝醉了，我来照顾他。
Desc.LocalizedString: Magistrate, leave Giles to me, he's deep in his cups, and I'll see to him.

Desc.SourceString: 丽兹大婶，你还是这么品行端正。可你或许，应该先问问你的丈夫……
Desc.LocalizedString: Goodwife Lizzie, upright as ever you are. And yet, perhaps you'd best first put the question to your husband…

Desc.SourceString: ……阿比盖尔，我不知道皮克托该说什么。
Desc.LocalizedString: Abigail… I don't know what Pickett's meant to say.

Desc.SourceString: 那你就换个人学嘛，你去学玛丽好了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Then mimic someone else, why don't you do Mary instead!

Desc.SourceString: 莉莉，莉莉，我的乖娃娃，你饿了么，渴了么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Lily, Lily, my sweet babe, are you hungry? Are you thirsty?

Desc.SourceString: 玛丽，你又没在干活！神明没教过你吗，品行端正、名声无瑕的好姑娘！我这就告诉你爸爸！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mary, idle again? Has the Highest One taught you nothing? A girl ought to have upright conduct and a spotless name! I shall tell your father of this!

Desc.SourceString: 我错了，镇长，您别告诉我爸爸！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sorry, Magistrate, pray don't tell my father!

Desc.SourceString: 安妮，我家里最近也在闹老鼠，想请你带猫去我家看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: Annie, my house has been troubled with rats of late. I'd have you bring your cat to see to them.

Desc.SourceString: 啊，汤姆最近跑出去了，还没找回来呢，下回吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, Tommy's run off of late and I've not found him yet. Another time, perhaps.

Desc.SourceString: 那我想请你帮我的羊看看，她最近不产奶了，小羊快饿死了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Then I'd ask you to look at my goat. She's stopped giving milk of late, and the kid's near starving.

Desc.SourceString: 这个简单，我今晚配好药，明天拿给贝蒂，就省得日理万机的比利先生多跑一趟了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Easy enough. I'll mix a tonic tonight and give it to Betty tomorrow, so busy Master Billy need not trouble himself with an extra trip.

Desc.SourceString: 安妮，你知道我不是真的在乎那些羊……你究竟还要守着你可怜的院子多久？你总要嫁人的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Annie, it's not the goat I care for… How much longer do you mean to sit on that pitiful yard of yours? You'll have to marry someday.

Desc.SourceString: 啊，今天得换药呢。我有事要忙，比利先生，再见。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, those bindings need changing today. Master Billy, I've matters to see to. Good day.

Desc.SourceString: 哼！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmpf!

Desc.SourceString: 玛丽，听你父母的话，把那个娃娃烧了吧，等我们找出了魔女，我再给你做个新的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mary, mind your mother and father now. Burn that doll. Once we've found the Witch, I'll make you a new one.

Desc.SourceString: 可莉莉不是魔女，她是我的好朋友，我每天晚上都会给她讲故事，我……
Desc.LocalizedString: But Lily isn't the Witch, she's my dear friend. I tell her a story every night, I…

Desc.SourceString: 一个会听故事的娃娃，还不是魔女附身的征兆吗？你难道要让尊敬的审判官大人，亲自到我们家翻箱倒柜吗？我现在可是治安官，应该以身作则！
Desc.LocalizedString: A doll that listens to stories… Isn't that a sign of the Witch's possession? Would you rather the Inquisitor turn our house upside down? I'm a constable now, I must set an example!

Desc.SourceString: 爸爸，莉莉不是魔女，真的不是，求求你了，别把她交出去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Father, Lily is no Witch. Pray not make me give her up.

Desc.SourceString: 我的女儿真是着了魔，你就不怕神明降罚吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: My own daughter, truly bewitched. Have you no fear of the retribution of the Highest One?

Desc.SourceString: 够了，路易。她还是个孩子，别把她吓坏了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Enough, Louis. She is yet a child. Do not scare her further!

Desc.SourceString: 妈妈，求求你了，莉莉真的不是魔女！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mama, I'm begging you, Lily isn't the Witch!

Desc.SourceString: 丽兹，你有没有多余的娃娃可以卖给我？
Desc.LocalizedString: Lizzie, have you a spare doll you might sell me?

Desc.SourceString: 本来我也打算把家里的娃娃都烧了，免得惹麻烦。我给你一个就行了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I was to burn all the dolls in my house to save trouble. I'll just give you one.

Desc.SourceString: 疯了疯了，你们都着魔了，你们竟然想欺骗审判官大人！如果留着这个娃娃，我们所有人都会下地狱！
Desc.LocalizedString: Madness, sheer madness, you've all been bewitched. You'd dare deceive the honored Inquisitor? Keep that doll, and we'll all end up in hell!

Desc.SourceString: 爱自己的家人，这也是神明的教导。你身为一个父亲，让自己的女儿流这么多泪，难道就不是品行败坏了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: To love one's family is also the Highest One's teaching. As a father, to make your own daughter weep so, is that not to show depraved morals?

Desc.SourceString: 我现在还是全镇的治安官，这都是为了大家的安全，我的品行无可指摘，神明会理解我！
Desc.LocalizedString: I am the whole town's constable now, and this is all for everyone's sake. My conduct is beyond reproach, and the Highest One will bless me!

Desc.SourceString: 丽兹，别听这个冷酷的男人。我跟你回家去取娃娃。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lizzie, listen not to this man of cold heart. I shall go with you to fetch the doll.

Desc.SourceString: 神明保佑我们，这些女人已经失了心智！
Desc.LocalizedString: The Highest One preserve us, these women have lost their wits!

Desc.SourceString: 吉尔斯，把你的锡酒壶和木骰子交出来吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Giles, hand over your pewter flask and your wooden dice.

Desc.SourceString: 你说什么……凭什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: What…? Why would I?

Desc.SourceString: 恶魔已经近在咫尺了，你怎么还不能清醒过来！我每每看到你拿出酒壶时，就觉得背后发凉。
Desc.LocalizedString: The Devil is close at hand, and you still do not come to your senses! Every time I see you draw out that flask, a chill runs down my spine.

Desc.SourceString: 现在我不得不疑心，那是神明在告诉我，恶魔正在借酒壶，败坏你的身体。你不能再堕落下去了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I cannot help but suspect it is the Highest One telling me the Devil is using that flask to corrupt your body. You must fall no further into ruin!

Desc.SourceString: 我……我……我听不懂你的话。
Desc.LocalizedString: I… I… understand you not.

Desc.SourceString: 你再不和酒壶与骰子断清关系，魔女的灵魂一定会缠上你！你就不怕诅咒吗！
Desc.LocalizedString: If you'll not break clean from that flask and those dice, the Witch's soul is sure to take hold of you! Have you no fear of the curse?

Desc.SourceString: 我知道我的品格不够高尚，但第一个被缠上的明明是费思！他可没有……
Desc.LocalizedString: I know my character's not of high standing, but the first to be taken hold of was Faithful! And he never…

Desc.SourceString: 他要负责去城里送绞刑架，绞死恶魔的代行者，当然第一个被诅咒！你还不明白吗！
Desc.LocalizedString: He was the one hauling the gallows to the city to hang the Devil's servants, of course he was cursed first! Do you still not see?

Desc.SourceString: 我得去找审判官大人说说，治安官不能让比利担当，他的品格还不足以承担这样的重任。
Desc.LocalizedString: I must go and speak with the Inquisitor. Billy cannot be made a constable, his character is not fit to bear such responsibility.

Desc.SourceString: 你清醒一点吧，现在比利正在审判官大人面前出风头，审判官大人那么信任他。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come to your senses. Billy's busy showing off before the Inquisitor as we speak, and the Inquisitor puts trust in him.

Desc.SourceString: 你去说了几句，难道大人就会把刚给出去的治安官帽子收回来？
Desc.LocalizedString: And if you go putting in a word, do you suppose the Inquisitor will take back the constable's position he just gave?

Desc.SourceString: 我可是镇长，是这里的长老！
Desc.LocalizedString: But I am the magistrate and elder of this town!

Desc.SourceString: 审判官大人又不是司铎，他根本不清楚镇子上的人，他不清楚比利品格和名声，同样不清楚你的。
Desc.LocalizedString: The Inquisitor is not the confessor. He knows nothing of the townsfolk, nothing of Billy's character, and nothing of yours.

Desc.SourceString: 就你那倔脾气，只会去触人霉头，还是谨言慎行吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: With that stubborn temper of yours, you'll only invite bad luck. Best hold your tongue!

Desc.SourceString: 你懂什么！你根本就不知道……你……听说国王不光是打了败仗，甚至可能死在回来的路上了！
Desc.LocalizedString: What do you know! You've no idea… you… They say the king lost the war and may even have died on his way back!

Desc.SourceString: 啊！愿神明保佑，愿神明怜悯，这肯定不是真的！你决不能听信这种胡言！说这话的，指不定也和恶魔有勾结！
Desc.LocalizedString: My! May the Highest One preserve us and have mercy! This cannot be true! You mustn't believe such wild talk! Whoever said it may well be in league with the Devil!

Desc.SourceString: 至高的神明啊，请您一定要保佑我们的国王平安。世道已经败坏得不比从前了，我们经不起更多变故了。
Desc.LocalizedString: O most high Highest One, I beseech you, keep our king safe. The world is not what it was, and we can bear no more unrest.

Desc.SourceString: 唉……算了，先看看情况吧，如果事态控制不住，我就先给司铎再写封信，上回那些鸽子似乎还是很可靠的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah… never mind, let's see how things stand for now. If it slips beyond control, I'll write the confessor another letter, those pigeons seemed reliable enough.

Desc.SourceString: 阿比盖尔，以后我要和比利一起巡视夜间的治安，白天需要休息。
Desc.LocalizedString: Abigail, from now on I'll be on night watch with Billy. I'll need my rest by day.

Desc.SourceString: 叔叔辛苦了，您为镇子做得一切，大家都看得到。您是个真正品行高尚的人。
Desc.LocalizedString: Uncle, you're a man of truly noble character. All the townsfolk see for themselves what you do for the town.

Desc.SourceString: 以后白天，你要和你婶婶一起去放羊。现在这状况你也看见了，那些林中的游戏，别再继续了。
Desc.LocalizedString: From now on you'll go out with your auntie to feed the goats by day. You've seen how things stand now. Play no more those games of yours in the forest.

Desc.SourceString: 什么游戏啊，我每天都在忙着打扫、做饭，怎么可能有空玩……
Desc.LocalizedString: What games? I'm busy cleaning and cooking all day long, how'd I find time to play…?

Desc.SourceString: 我现在可是治安官，别让你的言行，连累到我和维达的名声。
Desc.LocalizedString: I am a constable now. Mind that your words and deeds bring no shame upon Vida's name and mine.

Desc.SourceString: 是的，叔叔。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, uncle.

Desc.SourceString: 等审判结束，我就能继续牧羊了，到时候你就不用这么忙碌了。我也可以有空给你找个丈夫了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Once the trials are over, I can go back to being a shepherd, and then you'll not have to work so hard. I'll find you a husband as well.

Desc.SourceString: 是的，叔叔……
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, uncle…

Desc.SourceString: 可爱的好玛丽，还记得我们从前玩的游戏吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, sweet Mary. Remember the games we used to play?

Desc.SourceString: 今天也可以玩游戏吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are we playing today?

Desc.SourceString: 我不是指平时林子里玩的游戏。
Desc.LocalizedString: I do not mean the games we play in the forest.

Desc.SourceString: ……哦，你是说学着装病不用去干活的游戏！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh… you mean the game you play sick so you don't have to work!

Desc.SourceString: 没错。那个游戏，不仅可以让你少干活，还可以让你在必要的时候，确保自己的安全。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's right. That game not only gets you out of work, it can keep you safe as well.

Desc.SourceString: 什么意思？
Desc.LocalizedString: What are you saying?

Desc.SourceString: 好玛丽，乖玛丽，我需要你帮我个忙。我……你知道的，我被丽兹大婶赶出来了，她对我实在太恶毒了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Now Mary, sweet Mary, I need you to do me a favor. I… you know how it is, Goodwife Lizzie kicked me out. She was so very cruel!

Desc.SourceString: 不会啊，丽兹大婶明明很好啊，她今天还保护了我的莉莉。
Desc.LocalizedString: But Goodwife Lizzie is nice to me. She kept my Lily safe today!

Desc.SourceString: 那是因为你有多特大婶撑腰，我父母都死了，只有一个不在乎我的叔叔。丽兹就是这样欺软怕硬的人，才不像表面那么正派，你说呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: That's because you've got Goodwife Dot with you. My parents are dead. All I've got is an uncle who couldn't care less. Lizzie bullies the weak and cowers before the strong. She's not half so upright as she puts on!

Desc.SourceString: 我……我不知道，神明不允许我们背地里说人坏话。
Desc.LocalizedString: I… I don't know… The Highest One says not to speak ill of others behind them.

Desc.SourceString: 神明也教导我们帮助自己的朋友，不是吗？我只是想小小惩戒她一下！我就要被叔叔嫁出去了，你以后可就见不到我了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The Highest One also teaches us to help our friends, doesn't He? I only mean to play a little jest! Once my uncle's married me off, you'll see me no more.

Desc.SourceString: ……我该怎么帮你？
Desc.LocalizedString: How am I to help…?

Desc.SourceString: 你愿意就好，等我需要你帮忙的时候，会告诉你的。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's good of you. When the time comes that I need your help, I'll let you know.

Desc.SourceString: 皮克托，里维斯，该怎么办啊，我可怜的玛丽！
Desc.LocalizedString: Pickett, Levis! What am I to do? Oh, my poor Mary!

Desc.SourceString: 都怪那个该死的比利！如果不是他举报了玛丽的布娃娃，她只是珍惜一个玩具，一个不会说话的又破又旧的玩具！
Desc.LocalizedString: Curse that damned Billy! If he hadn't gone informing on Mary's doll! She was merely fond of a toy! It's a shabby, worn-out old toy that can't even speak!

Desc.SourceString: 我早就说了，不要想着藏起那个娃娃。现在好了，都是你害了玛丽！
Desc.LocalizedString: I told you all along not to go hiding that doll away. Now see what's come of it, you're the one who's doomed Mary!

Desc.SourceString: 你是要诅咒自己的女儿吗！你当这个治安官，又有什么用？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Would you curse your own daughter? And what use is it, you being a constable?!

Desc.SourceString: 好了好了，别再吵了。玛丽不会有事的，神明说过，禁食可以保持圣洁，这对她来说没准是件好事。
Desc.LocalizedString: There now, quarrel no more. No harm will come to Mary. The Highest One taught us that fasting keeps one pure. Perhaps it's a good thing for her.

Desc.SourceString: 我可怜的女儿，她还那么小，她会饿坏的！皮克托，求求你，稍微给她塞块面包吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: My poor daughter, so young still. She'll starve! Pickett, I beg you, slip her a bit of bread at least!

Desc.SourceString: 审判官大人说了，要禁食禁水以证明玛丽的清白，如果被发现她偷吃了东西。那比利又有理由怀疑她和恶魔串通了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The Inquisitor said Mary's to be kept from food and water to prove her innocence. If she's found to have eaten in secret, then Billy'll have a new cause to suspect her for working with the Devil.

Desc.SourceString: 比利比利！你们等着吧，今晚他就会来我家，让我们付出点什么，好把玛丽换出来。没准是我的银酒杯银餐具，要不就是过冬的木材和酸面包。
Desc.LocalizedString: Billy, Billy again! Just wait, he'll come to my house tonight, wanting us to pay something to buy Mary back. My silver cups and silverware, maybe, or else our winter firewood and sourdough.

Desc.SourceString: 我们都相信玛丽是清白的，我也会好好照看她。镇长让我跟着比利去，恐怕也是担心她。如果她真有什么不舒服，我会立刻告诉你们。
Desc.LocalizedString: We all believe Mary's innocent, and I'll look after her. The magistrate having me go along with Billy, I daresay he's worried too. If she's not doing well, I'll tell you at once.

Desc.SourceString: 辛苦你了，皮克托，你是个善良的人，神明会保佑你的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you, Pickett. You are a good person. May the Highest One protect you.

Desc.SourceString: 皮克托，你记得让丽兹好好看看家里，还有没有什么别的有嫌疑的东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: Pickett, mind you have Lizzie search over the house well. See if there's anything else that might draw suspicion.

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢提醒，我会的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you for the reminder. I shall do so.

Desc.SourceString: 第一个布里奇特·毕晓普，独自吊死在一棵大橡树的树枝上。现在，诚实的人们可以安心入睡了……
Desc.LocalizedString: First, Bridget Bishop, hanged alone from the branch of a great oak. Now the honest folk may sleep easy…

Desc.SourceString: 第二个莎拉·古德，丈夫与女儿指认了她，在狱中诞下恶魔的孩子后受绞刑……
Desc.LocalizedString: Second, Sarah Good, named by her own husband and daughter, hanged after birthing the Devil's child in her cell…

Desc.SourceString: 第三个丽贝卡·纳斯，第四个苏珊娜·马丁，第五个伊丽莎白·豪，第六个莎拉·怀尔兹……
Desc.LocalizedString: Third, Rebecca Nurse. Fourth, Susannah Martin. Fifth, Elizabeth Howe. Sixth, Sarah Wildes…

Desc.SourceString: 第七个乔治·伯罗斯，恶魔的祭司，扮作光明蛊惑人心；第八个玛莎·卡里尔，猖獗的老巫婆，带来天花和死亡；第九个约翰·威拉德……
Desc.LocalizedString: Seventh, George Burroughs, clergyman of the Devil, beguiling the hears of men. Eighth, Martha Carrier, pestilent old crone, bringer of smallpox and death. Ninth, John Willard…

Desc.SourceString: 第十个乔治·雅各布斯，他的仆人指控他，更多人指控他，还有死后肌肤上的凸起，都足以证明他的罪孽；
Desc.LocalizedString: Tenth, George Jacobs. His own servant accused him, and more accused him still. With risen marks upon his skin in death, all of it proof enough of his sin.

Desc.SourceString: 第十一个约翰·普罗克特，最强大的力量和意志，带领人们反对审判，最可恶的恶魔，他的公义与神明不符，该死！
Desc.LocalizedString: Eleventh, John Proctor, staunch and stalwart, who led the people against the trials, the most loathsome devil of all, his justice accords not with the Highest One's, and so he must die!

Desc.SourceString: 第十二个贾尔斯·科里，指控自己的妻子又撤回，狡猾而阴险，以沉默反抗审判，被巨石压死，罪有应得……
Desc.LocalizedString: Twelfth, Giles Corey, accused his own wife, then took it back. Cunning and treacherous, defying the trial with his silence, crushed to death beneath great stones, and richly did he deserve it…

Desc.SourceString: 第十三个爱丽丝·帕克，第十四个玛丽·帕克，第十五个安·普迪特，用药膏诅咒自己接生的婴儿，绞刑……
Desc.LocalizedString: Thirteenth, Alice Parker. Fourteenth, Mary Parker. Fifteenth, Ann Pudeator, who cursed the babe she midwifed with ointment. Hung.

Desc.SourceString: 第十六个威尔莫特·雷德，第十七个玛格丽特·斯科特，第十八个塞缪尔·沃德韦尔，第十九个玛莎·科里，第二十个玛丽·伊斯蒂……
Desc.LocalizedString: Sixteenth, Wilmot Redd. Seventeenth, Margaret Scott. Eighteenth, Samuel Wardwell. Nineteenth, Martha Corey. Twentieth, Mary Estey…

Desc.SourceString: 没有人可以质疑我！他们都该死！我的权力，来自神明，来自国王，来自人民！
Desc.LocalizedString: None may question me! They all deserve to die! My power comes from the Highest One, from the king, from the people!

Desc.SourceString: 我审判一切邪恶，我能判断恶魔！我绝对不会错！我没有错！我没有……对，我没有错！
Desc.LocalizedString: I judge all that is evil, I can discern the Devil himself! I am never wrong! I have done no wrong! I have not… I have done no wrong!

Desc.SourceString: 玛丽，乖孩子，你父母让我来照看你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sweet Mary, your father and mother told me to see you.

Desc.SourceString: 皮克托叔叔，我好难受，你放我出去吧，我需要看医生！
Desc.LocalizedString: Uncle Pickett, I feel so poorly, pray let me out. I need a physician!

Desc.SourceString: 你知道，我不能这么做。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mary, you know that I cannot do.

Desc.SourceString: 我好疼，我浑身都疼，我的手脚都不听使唤了！
Desc.LocalizedString: It hurts, it hurts all over, my hands and feet won't do as I tell them!

Desc.SourceString: 别拿你们平时玩的游戏或是偷懒的把戏糊弄我，你乖乖听话，熬过去就好了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't try fooling me with those games or little tricks you play. Be good now, persevere, and it'll pass.

Desc.SourceString: 我会偷偷给你送些面包和水的，别担心。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll slip you some bread and water in secret, don't you fret.

Desc.SourceString: 呜呜呜……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wahhh…

Desc.SourceString: 走吧，玛莎，我们也得检查一下家里的牲畜。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come, Martha, we've our own livestock to look over as well.

Desc.SourceString: 检查什么？今年的粮食很多吗，你还想再烧死一头牛还是三只鸡？
Desc.LocalizedString: Look over what? Have we such a surplus of grain this year that you'd burn another cow, or three hens more?

Desc.SourceString: 总要检查一遍，万一他们被魔女的灵魂附身了怎么办？邪灵是最狡猾的，他们悄无声息执行着恶魔的意志，如果不烧死他们，我们就会失去更多牲畜了。
Desc.LocalizedString: We must look over all the same, what if they've been possessed by the Witch? Evil spirits are the most cunning of all, working the Devil in silence. If we don't burn them, we'll lose more livestock.

Desc.SourceString: 你觉得我们家会有魔女的灵魂吗？从哪来？我吗？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you truly think the Witch's soul is in our house? From where? From me?

Desc.SourceString: 这可说不准，你喝了安妮那么多草药。说句实话吧，我现在都有点不敢靠近她了，万一她早就在恶魔的书上签过名呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: There's no telling. You've had so much of Annie's tonics. To speak plainly, I'm half afraid to go near her now. What if she signed her name in the Devil's book long ago?

Desc.SourceString: 不然，为什么你喝了这么久的药，身体还是好不利索？还有，我们的孩子一出生就死了，那时就是她妈妈丽贝卡接生的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Why else, after drinking her tonic all this while, are you still not properly well? And our own child, dead the moment it was born, her mother Rebecca who was the midwife.

Desc.SourceString: 现在想想，我当时在森林里看到什么东西飞过去，没准就是她在森林里骑着木棍飞翔……
Desc.LocalizedString: Now that I think of it, I saw something fly past in the forest that day, perhaps it was her, riding a broomstick through the trees…

Desc.SourceString: 你这么一说……她之前在河边采草药时，我好像也听见河里发出奇怪的声音，像是低沉的牛叫，说不定是恶魔的低语。
Desc.LocalizedString: Now that you say it… when she was gathering herbs by the river, I fancy I heard a strange sound from the water too; low, like an ox bellowing. Perhaps it was the Devil's whisper.

Desc.SourceString: 还有，今年的天气实在太冷了，荒原上早早就刮起了大风，小麦的穗子都鼓不起来，她却还每天都能采到草药，这也太奇怪了！
Desc.LocalizedString: And another thing, it's been so bitter cold this year, the wind came early across the moor and the wheat couldn't even fill its ears, yet still she gathers herbs every day. That's uncanny!

Desc.SourceString: 玛丽！玛丽！你答应过会帮我，还记得吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mary! Oh sweet Mary! Remember how you said you'd help me?

Desc.SourceString: 阿比盖尔？！我按照你说的做了，像平时的游戏那样，抽搐、晕倒、尖叫，为什么他们还不放我出去？
Desc.LocalizedString: Abigail?! I did just as you said, like in our games. I twitched, I fainted, and I screamed, so why won't they let me out?

Desc.SourceString: 现在才是最关键的时候！如果你想活下来，就照我说的办。
Desc.LocalizedString: Now is the most crucial moment! If you want to live, do as I tell you.

Desc.SourceString: 阿比盖尔，我们是不是都被魔女缠上了，我们是不是都要死了，我害怕……呜呜呜……
Desc.LocalizedString: Abigail, have we both been possessed by the Witch? Are we both going to die? I'm scared… Wahhh…

Desc.SourceString: 听好了！我们不会死的！我会带你找出魔女，你只要相信我就够了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Listen to me! We're not going to die! I'll help you find the Witch. All you have to do is trust me!

Desc.SourceString: 你知道魔女是谁？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you know who the Witch is?

Desc.SourceString: 明天的审判上，你要指控丽兹·科里。我会配合你提供所有我知道的证据，我向你保证，魔女就是她。
Desc.LocalizedString: At tomorrow's trial, you're to accuse Lizzie. I'll back you up with every scrap of evidence I know. I promise you she's the Witch.

Desc.SourceString: 不，这不可能，丽兹大婶是镇上名声最好的人，而且一直对我很好。
Desc.LocalizedString: No, that can't be, Goodwife Lizzie has the best name in all the town, and she's always been kind to me.

Desc.SourceString: 你被魔女蒙蔽了眼和耳，所以才被关在这！她在娃娃上下了诅咒，你再不清醒过来，就要堕落了！
Desc.LocalizedString: The Witch has blinded your eyes and blocked your ears, that's why you're locked in here! She laid a curse upon the doll, and if you don't come to your senses, you'll fall to ruin!

Desc.SourceString: 我……我的娃娃上，有魔女的诅咒？
Desc.LocalizedString: My doll… bears the Witch's curse?

Desc.SourceString: 你想摆脱诅咒吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you want to be free of the curse?

Desc.SourceString: 阿比盖尔，帮帮我！
Desc.LocalizedString: Help me, Abigail!

Desc.SourceString: 指控她，我才能帮你！
Desc.LocalizedString: I can help only if you accuse her!

Desc.SourceString: 我……我害怕……
Desc.LocalizedString: I… I'm scared…

Desc.SourceString: 指控她！不然，明天就轮到你被烧死了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Accuse her! Or you will be set ablaze tomorrow!

Desc.SourceString: 呜呜呜……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wahhh…

Desc.SourceString: 真是越来越不像话了，安妮竟然敢缺席审判！她指定是和恶魔勾结了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Annie's insolence grows greater by the day. She even dares miss the trial! She's surely in league with the Devil!

Desc.SourceString: 我现在光是想起她，都觉得浑身发冷。她妈妈帮多特接生过，可多特前两个儿子都在出生不久后就夭折了，只有玛丽活下来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The thought of her sends a chill through me. Her mother midwifed for Dot as well, yet Dot's first two boys both died soon after they were born, and only Mary lived.

Desc.SourceString: 丽贝卡、安妮和玛丽，看来我们镇子早就被恶魔盯上了，他早就派了魔女来诅咒我们。丽贝卡定是第一个，她死后，瘟疫、饥荒、干旱轮换着在这片荒原肆虐！
Desc.LocalizedString: Rebecca, Annie, and Mary… It seems the Devil marked our town long ago, and sent his Witch to curse us. Rebecca must have been the first, and after she died, plague, famine, and drought took their turns ravaging this place!

Desc.SourceString: 安妮表面上是个草药师，说是能帮大家治病，可是哪有几个人真的被她治好过？
Desc.LocalizedString: Annie passes for an herbalist, saying she can heal folk of their ailments, yet how many has she truly cured?

Desc.SourceString: 玛丽也是，她没去丽兹家做女仆前，最喜欢和安妮那只邪恶的魔宠一起玩，说不定早就已经……哎呀，我说对了，你看我的汗毛都竖起来了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mary too, before she served at Lizzie's, loved nothing better than playing with Annie's wicked familiar. Perhaps she'd long since been… Oh, look, the hairs on my arms stand!

Desc.SourceString: 说到丽兹，她恐怕也不是什么善良之人。她家的田地，很早就种不出东西了。听说皮克托每天都在打猎，就为了有足够的吃的过冬。
Desc.LocalizedString: Speaking of Lizzie, I fear she's no kind soul either. Her fields stopped yielding anything long ago. They say Pickett hunts every day, just to have enough food for winter.

Desc.SourceString: 对啊，他家有片森林的松树，今年一大片一大片的死，她以前就经常和丽贝卡一起去森林里。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's right. Whole stretches of pines in their forest died off this year. In the old days, she used to go into the forest with Rebecca often.

Desc.SourceString: 你记不记得，我们在森林里听到过歌声？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you remember, we once heard singing in the forest?

Desc.SourceString: 啊，她们一定是在召唤邪灵！神明保佑我们，让我们尽快把这些魔女都烧死吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, they must have been calling upon evil spirits! The Highest One preserve us, let us burn all these witches soon, and be done with it!

Desc.SourceString: 光是一个玛丽，还不够吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mary alone isn't enough, is it?

Desc.SourceString: 这还不够恐怖吗？如果明天的审判上，玛丽无法证明自己是无辜的，她就要被烧死了。如果不是必须参加审判，我肯定是不会去的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Isn't that dreadful enough? If Mary can't prove her innocence tomorrow, she'll die. I'd rather not attend if it were not required.

Desc.SourceString: 蠢货，一个当然不够了！这个镇子里，有可能和魔女勾结的人实在太多了。再说了，魔女可不一定只有一个。
Desc.LocalizedString: Fool, one is nowhere near enough! There are far too many in this town who might be in league with the Witch. Besides, there may well be more than one.

Desc.SourceString: 为了找出所有魔女，我们得尽可能把更多人送去审判，只有经过审判，才能证明一个人是不是清白的。
Desc.LocalizedString: To root out all the witches, we must send as many as we can to trial, for only through trial can a soul be proven innocent.

Desc.SourceString: 那你觉得谁最有可能？
Desc.LocalizedString: And who do you reckon the most likely?

Desc.SourceString: 丽兹，她送给玛丽一个洋娃娃。玛丽被关禁闭后，刚要承认自己的罪行，就发狂难止。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lizzie. She gave Mary a doll. After Mary was shut away, the moment she made to confess her sins, she fell into a fit she couldn't stop.

Desc.SourceString: 我敢保证，丽兹家里，一定能搜出被诅咒的布娃娃，她就是这样阻止玛丽供出自己的!
Desc.LocalizedString: I'd stake anything on it, search Lizzie's house and you'll surely turn up a cursed doll, that's how she's stopped Mary from naming her!

Desc.SourceString: 明天审判庭上，我会把这件事告诉镇长和审判官的。阿比盖尔，如果我们去搜查丽兹大婶家，你能确保我们一定可以找出被诅咒的布娃娃吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: At tomorrow's trial, I'll bring this before the magistrate and the Inquisitor. Abigail, if we search Goodwife Lizzie's house, are you sure we'll turn up a cursed doll?

Desc.SourceString: 当然。皮克托这会儿正在打猎，我们刚好有机会。
Desc.LocalizedString: For certain. Pickett is now on the hunt. This is our best chance.

Desc.SourceString: 比利治安官，这些话我只和您说。魔女的诅咒像是条巨蛇，紧紧缠绕着我们，大家都快喘不上气了。我想，我们必须加快节奏，尽快找出魔女。
Desc.LocalizedString: Constable Billy, I say this to you alone. The Witch's curse is like some great serpent, coiled tight around us, till we cannot breathe. We must quicken the pace and root out the Witch as soon as may be.

Desc.SourceString: 那是自然。
Desc.LocalizedString: Naturally.

Desc.SourceString: 可魔女如此狡猾，我们接连两天都找不到，接下来又该怎么办？
Desc.LocalizedString: But the Witch is so cunning. It's been two days running and still we can't find her. What are we to do now?

Desc.SourceString: 路易，我们现在是审判官大人任命的治安官，我们要对镇子和神明负责。你必须清楚自己的责任，如果你的私心战胜了公义，那你就是向恶魔妥协，辜负了神明。
Desc.LocalizedString: Louis, we're constables now, appointed by the honored Inquisitor. We answer to the town and the Highest One. Be clear on your duty, if personal feelings triumph over justice, then you've yielded to the Devil and failed the Highest One.

Desc.SourceString: 我、我对神明的虔诚之心，绝不会有一丝一毫的动摇！
Desc.LocalizedString: My… my devotion to the Highest One shall never waver in the least!

Desc.SourceString: 那你还在犹豫什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Then what are you hesitating for?

Desc.SourceString: 明天……真的会烧死我的玛丽吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Tomorrow… will they truly set my Mary ablaze?

Desc.SourceString: 审判官大人是公正无私的，我相信他不会冤枉一个虔诚的信仰者，也不会放过恶魔的代行者。
Desc.LocalizedString: The honored Inquisitor is just and without bias, I trust he'll neither wrong a devout believer nor let a servant of the Devil go free.

Desc.SourceString: 如果玛丽不是魔女，那她一定能平安回家，对吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: If Mary's no witch, then she'll come home safe, won't she?

Desc.SourceString: 当然，但她如果是魔女，为了镇子，你知道你应该做什么。
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course. But if she is a witch, then for the town's sake, you know what you must do.

Desc.SourceString: 今晚……今晚，我担心，恶魔会有所行动，营救自己的代行者。我、我会在夜晚监督他们……
Desc.LocalizedString: Tonight… tonight, I fear the Devil may make his move, to rescue his own servant. I-I'll watch over them by night…

Desc.SourceString: 我明白了，你做得很好。
Desc.LocalizedString: I see. You've done well.

Desc.SourceString: 审判玛丽，倒不如审判新来的外乡人，就是住在安妮家的那两个。
Desc.LocalizedString: Better than trying Mary, we'd do well to try the newcomers, those two strangers lodging at Annie's.

Desc.SourceString: 你拿什么审判他们俩？他们才来多久，我们根本就不了解他们，一点证据都想不到。
Desc.LocalizedString: What will you try them for? They're new, we don't know anything about them. We won't find any evidence.

Desc.SourceString: 你就不觉得他们可疑吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't you find them suspicious?

Desc.SourceString: 可疑的人多了去了，比利家的柴火之前就跑到我家的墙边了，说不定那是他在用巫术！
Desc.LocalizedString: Too many are suspicious. Billy's firewood appeared at my house. Mayhaps he used witchcraft!

Desc.SourceString: 哦，我在多特的酒馆里，有一晚喝了两大瓶威士忌，架着马车又坏了我家一大片麦田，指定是多特在酒里给我下了魔药！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, one night at Dot's tavern I drank two bottles of whiskey, then drove my cart through my wheat field and wrecked it. Dot must've slipped a witch's brew in my drink!

Desc.SourceString: 上次，我不知怎么就坐在了牌桌边上，还输了六个银币，指定是魔女迷惑了我！就是不知道谁才是魔女，让我想想，当时都有谁在桌上来着……
Desc.LocalizedString: One time, I found myself at the card table and lost six silvers. The Witch must've beguiled me! Yet I can't remember who was at that table…

Desc.SourceString: 你快好好想想，这可是指控魔女的重要证据！
Desc.LocalizedString: You think hard now, this is weighty proof for accusing the Witch!

Desc.SourceString: 安妮，你刚刚怎么那么快就走了，像是逃跑一样。你这样，很容易引发大家的疑虑。
Desc.LocalizedString: Annie, why did you leave so soon, as if you were running away? Such conduct will easily raise suspicions.

Desc.SourceString: 我不是这么好吓唬的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I am not so easily frightened.

Desc.SourceString: 看看你异于常人的红发，还有绿色瞳孔，加上你刚收留的外乡人。你真以为你能安全吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Look at your uncommon red hair, and the outsiders you took in. Do you truly think yourself safe?

Desc.SourceString: 如果你想指控我，最好有些更实在的证据。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you mean to accuse me, you'd best have more solid proof.

Desc.SourceString: 一定会有的，你放心，可爱的安妮，我绝不会让你失望。但是……
Desc.LocalizedString: There shall be, rest easy, sweet Annie, I shall not disappoint you. However…

Desc.SourceString: 我可是审判的庭审员，如果你是我的妻子，我就可以保护你，你永远不需要走上审判庭。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm a juror of the trial, if you were my wife, I could shield you, and you'd never have need to stand before the court.

Desc.SourceString: 明天走上审判庭的，究竟是谁，还不一定呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Who ends up on trial tomorrow is still far from certain.

Desc.SourceString: 这是我给你最后的机会了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm giving you your last chance.

Desc.SourceString: 我不需要这种机会。
Desc.LocalizedString: I've no need for such a chance.

Desc.SourceString: 明天，审判庭上见。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tomorrow, I shall see you in the High Court.

Desc.SourceString: 吾乃魔女之审判官，神明所造之使者，阻挠审判之人，皆是恶魔之爪牙！
Desc.LocalizedString: I am the Inquisitor, sent from the Highest One. Whosoever standeth against me doth the Devil's work!

Desc.SourceString: 奇怪，出门前明明看过天气预报，今天是晴天啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Weird. I checked the forecast before I left. It's supposed to be a sunny day.

Desc.SourceString: 这雾浓得诡异，还是小心点吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: This fog is bizarre. Let's be extra careful…

Desc.SourceString: 看来，他们已经分不清异象空间里的审判，和现实中的生活了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like they can no longer tell reality from trials in this Anomalous Realm.

Desc.SourceString: 想必你们也知道，最近这一带不太平。你们俩得低调点，尽量别让人看见。
Desc.LocalizedString: No doubt you know as well as I, these parts have been troubled of late. You must keep quiet and low, and take care not to be seen by any soul.

Desc.SourceString: 我们才刚到这里，还不太了解这一带的事。你的语气听起来很严重，这里……
Desc.LocalizedString: We just arrived here and there's much we aren't familiar with. From what you just said, something serious is going on…

Desc.SourceString: 神明保佑你们。你们出逃的时候，一路上也看到不少了吧，那些可怜人。
Desc.LocalizedString: May the Highest One watch over you. I wager you've seen many poor wretches on your flight.

Desc.SourceString: 愿他们的灵魂终得安息。
Desc.LocalizedString: May their souls rest in peace.

Desc.SourceString: 他们都是经过审判后，因为与恶魔串通而被处刑的人，恐怕是没法安息了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I fear they'll find no rest, for they were ones condemned on trials for consorting with the Devil.

Desc.SourceString: 前年是瘟疫，去年是洪水和饥荒，今年的旱灾才刚结束，我们就在战争上输给了邻国，国王气得大发雷霆！
Desc.LocalizedString: Two years past it was the plague, last year the floods and famine, and this year's drought had barely lifted before we lost the war to a neighboring kingdom. Our king was in a terrible fit of rage.

Desc.SourceString: 城里的司铎说，这一切都是恶魔害的。有人和恶魔暗中勾连，只有找出这些人烧死，大家才能得救。
Desc.LocalizedString: The Confessor of the town says the Devil is behind all of it. That some among us have made secret pacts with him, and only by finding these folk out and burning them can we all be saved.

Desc.SourceString: 世上怎么可能有恶魔？让不存在的恶魔和那些可怜人来为这些灾难承担责任，听上去也太不合理了。
Desc.LocalizedString: How are there any devils in this world? Pinning all the disasters on devils that don't exist and on those poor people…it doesn't make any sense.

Desc.SourceString: 愿神明宽恕你们！你们怎么想，没人管得了。但是这种话一旦说出口，传到别人耳朵里，你们就是亵渎神明的邪魔歪道了！
Desc.LocalizedString: May the Highest One forgive you! What you believe in your hearts, none can govern. But let such words pass your lips and reach another's ear, and you'll be branded blasphemers!

Desc.SourceString: 安静点，跟着我走，千万别被人注意到。
Desc.LocalizedString: Quiet. Follow me. Do not let another notice you.

Desc.SourceString: 喂，外乡人！离我们的神树远一点！
Desc.LocalizedString: You there, outsider! Keep away from our Sacred Tree!

Desc.SourceString: 外乡人，不准你碰神树！
Desc.LocalizedString: Outsider, touch not our Sacred Tree!

Desc.SourceString: 这是只好羊，我也不想烧死它，我只是想保护汤姆而已，安妮很喜欢它。我去把羊藏好先。
Desc.LocalizedString: She's a good goat. I don't want her to burn. I just want to protect Tommy. Annie likes Tommy a lot. I'll just hide this goat.

Desc.SourceString: 那汤姆就交给你了，我去继续调查镇上是否有异样，我们安妮家见。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll leave saving Tommy to you then. I'm going to investigate the town to see what's going on. See you at Annie's.

Desc.SourceString: （虽然玛丽被禁食，但镇上还没开始审判任何人。距离黑羽占卜时看到的火刑，应该还要再等等……那个女孩何时会出现呢？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Mary's being forced to fast, but no one in town's been put on trial yet. It should still be a while before the burning happens in Blackbird's vision… When will that girl show up?)

Desc.SourceString: 人到齐了，该出发了。快，走这边。
Desc.LocalizedString: Everyone's here, it's time to set out. Quick, this way.

Desc.SourceString: 我的审判，不容打扰！
Desc.LocalizedString: My trial shall not be disturbed!

Desc.SourceString: 进来坐吧，我去拿药膏。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come in and take a seat. I'll go grab some ointment.

Desc.SourceString: 看来贝蒂不是我们要找的人，再去其他地方找找金发的女孩吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like Betty isn't the one we're looking for. Let's find another blonde elsewhere.

Desc.SourceString: 啊，光顾着看热闹，差点把找人的事忘了。草地那边还没看过，不如去那看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, I was caught up in the drama. I almost forgot we're looking for someone. We haven't searched the grassland yet. Let's take a look over there.

Desc.SourceString: 也不知道奇闻部现在是什么样……
Desc.LocalizedString: I wonder how the Occult Club is doing…

Desc.SourceString: 去看看呗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go take a look?

Desc.SourceString: 嗨，那边的同学~
Desc.LocalizedString: Heyo, you over there!

Desc.SourceString: 兑奖处、兑奖处，兑奖处在这边……
Desc.LocalizedString: Prize redemption! Redeem your prizes here…!

Desc.SourceString: 呼~好久没有这么热闹过了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Phew… it's been a while since I had this much fun.

Desc.SourceString: 兑奖请到这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: Redeem your prize here.

Desc.SourceString: 要兑奖吗？欢迎来试试手。
Desc.LocalizedString: Try your luck here! Pull a prize.

Desc.SourceString: 兑奖处，兑奖处……
Desc.LocalizedString: Prize redemption is here…

Desc.SourceString: 想兑奖的到这里来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come here and get your prize.

Desc.SourceString: 原来学校里真的会办这种活动啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: So schools really have events like this.

Desc.SourceString: 嗨~嗨~嗨~来看看我们的摊位吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, hey, hey! Come take a look at our stand!

Desc.SourceString: 你声音这么小，谁听得见啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: You think anyone can actually hear your squeaks?

Desc.SourceString: 不讲道理龙！你明明知道我喊不了太大声的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey Meanzilla! You know I can't speak too loud!

Desc.SourceString: 还不是你自己要喊……
Desc.LocalizedString: You were the one who volunteered…

Desc.SourceString: 黑羽擅长走迷宫吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Blackbird, are you good at finding your way through mazes?

Desc.SourceString: 只玩过一些迷宫游戏呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: I've only gone through a few maze games before.

Desc.SourceString: 不过，为了调查的话，还是不擅长走迷宫比较好吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Still, if we're investigating, it'd probably be better not to be too good at mazes, right?

Desc.SourceString: 毕竟我们是要努力迷路的人！
Desc.LocalizedString: After all, we're supposed to be trying our hardest to get lost!

Desc.SourceString: 这里的灌木花丛好像会随机移动，要想经过同一个路口四次，还是得多留心才行。
Desc.LocalizedString: The hedges and flowerbeds here seem to shift around at random, so we'll have to pay close attention if we want to pass through the same maze intersection four times.

Desc.SourceString: 不知道占卜往哪走会不会有结果……
Desc.LocalizedString: I wonder if divination could tell us which way to go…

Desc.SourceString: 黑羽不妨占卜一下试试呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Blackbird, why not try divining it?

Desc.SourceString: 好像……无法预测呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: It seems like I can't predict where it'd appear…

Desc.SourceString: 没事的，不论如何都是命运的安排。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's fine. Either way, it's all part of fate's grand plan.

Desc.SourceString: 呵呵，现在鉴定师也会说这样的话了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe, so now you're starting to talk like that too…

Desc.SourceString: 等等，那边好像有什么声音？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hold on, I think I hear something over there.

Desc.SourceString: 难道说……真有什么异常吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Could it be… there really is some kind of anomaly?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师有听到吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, did you hear that?

Desc.SourceString: 好像是花丛里？去看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sounds like it's coming from the flower bushes. Let's go check.

Desc.SourceString: 到站了呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: We've arrived.

Desc.SourceString: 好像并没有出现「异世界」的入口……
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like the entrance to the "Other World" has yet to show up…

Desc.SourceString: 其它异常也没有。
Desc.LocalizedString: No other anomalies, either.

Desc.SourceString: 「异世界」的传说好像就是在这里吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: I think this is where that "Other World" story is supposed to happen…

Desc.SourceString: 丽兹，吉尔斯想把他的鹅卖给我，关你什么事？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Lizzie, Giles wants to sell me his geese. What's it to you?

Desc.SourceString: 你明知吉尔斯本来是个正派人，全因妻子去世，才染上酗酒和赌博的恶习。同为神明的信众，你不但不帮助他，还助长他败坏自己的德行！
Desc.LocalizedString: You know full well Giles was a decent man once, and that only losing his wife drove him to drink and gamble. As worshippers of the Highest One, you'd not help him but feed his ruin instead!

Desc.SourceString: 别把我们当成和吉尔斯一样醉酒的家伙！你不过就是想趁机把他的土地廉价买光罢了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't lump us in with a drunkard like Giles! All you're after is the chance to buy up his land dirt cheap!

Desc.SourceString: 你们……吵够了没有！我……我要喝酒！
Desc.LocalizedString: You lot… have you quarreled enough? I… I want drinks!

Desc.SourceString: 吉尔斯先生的财产，该、该由吉尔斯先生自己决定，是他想把鹅卖给比利先生的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Goodman Giles's property is h-his own to decide upon. It was he who wished to sell the geese to Master Billy.

Desc.SourceString: 大人们在说话，还没有你一个小女仆插嘴的份。贝蒂，你也该清醒清醒，你母亲躺在床上休养了半个多月呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: The grown folk are speaking. It's not for a little maidservant to put in her word. Betty, it's high time you came to your senses, your mother's been abed more than a fortnight.

Desc.SourceString: 听说，她就是被你敬爱的比利先生气病的，你还在这围着比利转。是想亲眼看他迎娶你未来的女主人吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: They say it was your beloved Master Billy who worried her into her sickbed, and still you circle around him. Do you mean to watch him wed your future mistress with your own eyes?

Desc.SourceString: 你……你……你这个恶毒的女人，你说这些胡言妄语，就不怕神明惩罚你吗！
Desc.LocalizedString: You… you… you wicked woman! Have you no fear of the Highest One, spouting such lies?

Desc.SourceString: 我不过是劝你回家看看玛莎大婶，少跟比利或是阿比盖尔混在一起，做个品行端正的好女儿。
Desc.LocalizedString: I only bid you go home and look in on Goodwife Martha, and keep less company with Billy and Abigail. Be a good, upright daughter.

Desc.SourceString: 贝蒂，别听他们的，玛莎大婶一直体弱，和我可没关系。还有，你爸爸虽是个正派人，但一向顽固，才会用恶魔这种词玷污我的名声。
Desc.LocalizedString: Betty, don't listen to her. Goodwife Martha's always been frail, nothing to do with me. Your father's a decent man, but pigheaded, that's why he soils my name with talk of the Devil.

Desc.SourceString: 嘁！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tut!

Desc.SourceString: 我当然知道了，比利先生！您是最仁慈善良的，神明会保佑你和我的。倒是丽兹大婶，你这样嚼人舌头，如果圣阿尔博真的要举行审判，也是你第一个被……
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course, Master Billy! You're the most merciful of men, and the Highest One will watch over us both. It's you, Goodwife Lizzie, wagging your tongue so. If St. Arbor should ever hold a trial, you'd be the first to be…

Desc.SourceString: 哼，我的言行还轮不到你这种孩子来评判。我名声清白，举止体面，即便面对神明，也没什么好畏惧的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmph. It's not for a child like you to judge me. My name is clean and my bearing decent. Even before the Highest One, I've nothing to fear.

Desc.SourceString: 我是看在你父亲的面上，才会良言劝你。既然你听不进去，就别再耽误我的时间了，我还有好几件裙子要缝。
Desc.LocalizedString: It was only for your father's sake that I offered you counsel. Since you'll not heed it, waste no more of my time, I've several dresses yet to sew.

Desc.SourceString: 我……我的酒钱。
Desc.LocalizedString: My… My beer money…

Desc.SourceString: 吉尔斯，他们不会给你钱的，还是跟我走吧。你的大衣我已经补好了，皮克托砍了不少木柴，你也拿回去吧，天气已经开始凉了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Giles, they'll not give you a coin. Leave with me instead. I've mended your coat, and Pickett's chopped plenty of firewood. Take some back, it's turning cold.

Desc.SourceString: 我……我没有钱。
Desc.LocalizedString: I… I don't have a coin…

Desc.SourceString: 不收你的钱。今年的收成太差，皮克托每天都在林子里砍柴打猎，我们不差这么一点柴火。
Desc.LocalizedString: No coin from you. The harvest's been poor this year, and Pickett's in the woods every day chopping and hunting, so we've firewood enough to spare.

Desc.SourceString: 海月……一直在看手机啊。是有工作消息吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Aurelia… you've been looking at your phone a lot. Is it work-related?

Desc.SourceString: 没有没有，只是在查地图。
Desc.LocalizedString: No, no—I'm just checking the map.

Desc.SourceString: 地图？我们要去什么地方吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: A map? Are we trying to find something?

Desc.SourceString: 啊哈哈……只是我方向感太差，怕带你走错路……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahaha… No, I'm just terrible with directions, so I was worried I'd lead you the wrong way…

Desc.SourceString: 想吃点什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: What do you want to eat?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……一时间想不出来啊。感觉每一家都很美味……
Desc.LocalizedString: Mm… I can't decide. Everything looks delicious…

Desc.SourceString: 那要不要先去尝尝抽风猫和Myosotis合作推出的鲜果茶？
Desc.LocalizedString: How about we try the fresh fruit tea from Crazy Cat and Myosotis first?

Desc.SourceString: 啊，这个主意不错！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, that's a great idea!

Desc.SourceString: （这……竟然排了这么长的队伍吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Huh… is the line really this long?)

Desc.SourceString: （难怪明音会喜欢，看来是相当热门的乐队啊。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (No wonder Akane likes them—they must be a pretty popular band.)

Desc.SourceString: 接下来就该去找主唱了吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: We should go find the lead singer, then?

Desc.SourceString: 按照她的说法，主唱很可能躲在教学楼的天台上。我们走吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Based on what she said, the lead singer is probably hiding out on the roof of the academic building. Let's go.

Desc.SourceString: 好，我们去找她吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, lead the way.
Hey—!

Desc.SourceString: 你在那站着做什么？在这里，在这里！
Desc.LocalizedString: Why are you just standing there? Over here, over here!

Desc.SourceString: 喂——！快来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, come quick!

Desc.SourceString: 准备好登台了吗？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ready for the stage?!

Desc.SourceString: 来场超——酷的演出吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: You bet! Let's rooooooooock!

Desc.SourceString: 这里是……时空胶囊里记录的，「回忆中的片段」吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: This must be… fragments of memories in the time capsule.

Desc.SourceString: （被不同的人梦见的同一串数字……还挺有意思的。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Different people dreaming of the same number… Interesting.)

Desc.SourceString: （……我也早点休息吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…I should go to bed soon.)

Desc.SourceString: E.T.D的办公室原来是这样。
Desc.LocalizedString: So this is what the ETD office looks like.

Desc.SourceString: 那个……鉴定师，姑且还是请对这里的情况保密。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser… please keep everything you see here in confidence.

Desc.SourceString: 零食旁边的字条，「可以自取」……坐在这里的应该是个友善的人吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: <male=>A note next to the snacks says, "Help yourself"… This seat must belong to a friendly person.<male><female=>A note next to the snacks says, "Help yourself"… This seat must belong to someone friendly.<female>

Desc.SourceString: 妮夏的桌面像本人一样板正。有点好奇，她的相框里会放什么样的照片。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nitsa's desk is as buttoned-up as she is. I wonder what she put in her frame.

Desc.SourceString: 感觉这里坐着的人经常熬夜。但话又说回来，设备却几乎没有使用痕迹，奇怪……
Desc.LocalizedString: <male=>This one must work overnight a lot. But the desk also seems hardly used. Strange…<male><female=>This person must work overnight a lot. But the desk also seems hardly used. Strange…<female>

Desc.SourceString: 真的有人坐在这个位置吗？不爱待在工位上的人……感觉隐约猜到是谁了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The onboarding items haven't even been unpacked. It must be someone who never actually works at their desk… I think I know who this is.

Desc.SourceString: 这些物件存在于此的原因和联系……嗯，完全搞不懂，不愧是灵可。
Desc.LocalizedString: The reason these things are here and the way they interconnect… I have no clue. Classic Linko.

Desc.SourceString: 让你久等，所有相关文件我都查阅完毕了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thanks for waiting. I just looked up all related documents.

Desc.SourceString: 说起来，刚刚那个用扬声器说话、帮我开门的人……在哪里？
Desc.LocalizedString: By the way… where's the guy who spoke through the speaker and opened the door for me?

Desc.SourceString: 那个人……你好，请问——
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… Hi there, did you…

Desc.SourceString: ……稍等。
Desc.LocalizedString: …A moment.

Desc.SourceString: 可以走了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Proceed.

Desc.SourceString: 搭交通工具走吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Use the transportation device there.

Desc.SourceString: 这里还有交通工具？
Desc.LocalizedString: There's transportation here?

Desc.SourceString: ——那边的电话。
Desc.LocalizedString: The phone… over there.

Desc.SourceString: 这个存档单元好空……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why is this archive unit so empty…?

Desc.SourceString: （一个拼图相框？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A puzzle photo frame?)

Desc.SourceString: （看样子是要填入一些拼图碎片。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Looks like I need to complete the puzzle.)

Desc.SourceString: 新学生？好漂亮的头发……
Desc.LocalizedString: New student? Her hair's so pretty…

Desc.SourceString: （看起来是新学生的欢迎会……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Looks like it's a welcome party for new students...)

Desc.SourceString: 小猫要掉下来了……接住了，做得好！
Desc.LocalizedString: The kitty is falling… Caught it! Nice one!

Desc.SourceString: (这么小的幼猫……从树上掉下来恐怕不妙。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The kitty is so small… They could get hurt falling from the tree.)

Desc.SourceString: (好在下面的人接住了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Good thing someone down there caught them.)

Desc.SourceString: 在朋友的帮助下，她渐渐融入集体了。
Desc.LocalizedString: With her friends helping, she gradually settled in.

Desc.SourceString: （虽然看不清……但其中的两次，似乎是同一个人。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Too hard to read… but the same student placed twice.)

Desc.SourceString: 大家都在为校园庆典做准备，期待着新的学年……
Desc.LocalizedString: The students are getting ready for the festival and looking forward to the new school year…

Desc.SourceString: （这看起来是某种……庆典装饰？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This looks like… some festival decoration?)

Desc.SourceString: （在海特洛没见过这样的习俗。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Never seen anything like this in Hethereau.)

Desc.SourceString: （这张相片里的东西变多了……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (There are more things in the photo now…)

Desc.SourceString: 用来弃置各种不必要物件的地方，偶尔也能翻找出宝藏。说来，这段友情正是如此开始的啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: A place for dumping junk. Though every now and then you dig up some treasure. Come to think of it, that's how this friendship began…

Desc.SourceString: 把好东西还原出来，用正确的方式打开，说不定就能发现有趣的事情了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Restore the good stuff, open it the right way, and who knows, maybe you'll find something fun?

Desc.SourceString: 被我「拖动」了？怎么打开呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: I just "dragged" it? How do I open it?

Desc.SourceString: 啊咧？这个后缀名类型的文件，应该不是用这种打开方式哦？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? That's probably not how you open a file with that extension, you know?

Desc.SourceString: 打开了！能读取到内容。
Desc.LocalizedString: Opened it! I can read it now.

Desc.SourceString: 「X」最开始，反复研究怎么把「Y」卸载掉，为此捣鼓了好久呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: From the very start, X tried to find a way to uninstall Y. He kept trying and trying.

Desc.SourceString: 杀毒软件、格式化、重装系统……齐上阵！你说你说，怎么能理直气壮对人家做这种事啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: Antivirus, reformatting, reinstallation… He tried it all! Tell me, how do you do that to someone with a straight face?

Desc.SourceString: 干什么都要从旁边冒出来，零帧起手切进窗口里，烦个没完。你猜体验如何？
Desc.LocalizedString: Whatever I did, Y popped out of nowhere before I could even blink. Wanna guess how that felt?

Desc.SourceString: 那里本来就是「Y」的地盘吧，哪边是外来入侵者来着？
Desc.LocalizedString: That was Y's turf to begin with. Who's the real intruder there?

Desc.SourceString: 不构成入侵，它主动说了「一起玩」、「随时来玩」，生怕这次开了电脑的人下次不再来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not an intruder. Y kept saying "Let's play! Come by anytime!" as if scared that they wouldn't show up after the next reboot.

Desc.SourceString: 所以呢，被秘密基地的原主人邀请留下来玩的「X」，马上就在那儿想方设法要把对方赶走自己占地为王吗？啧啧！烂透了！
Desc.LocalizedString: So, the owner of the secret base invites X to play, and X immediately tries to remove them from their place and take over? Tut tut, real nasty!

Desc.SourceString: 花了有段时间才勉为其难接受与「Y」共处的「X」，搞来了各种各样的电子游戏光盘。
Desc.LocalizedString: It took some time for X to begrudgingly coexist with Y. Then X went to get a lot of computer game CDs.

Desc.SourceString: 杂物间又小又窄还不通风，待在里面怪不舒服的，奈何屏幕里跳动闪烁的那些玩意儿实在太有意思啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: The storage room was small, cramped, stuffy, and uncomfortable. But the flickering pixels on the screen were just so—much—fun!

Desc.SourceString: 「X」几乎天天都是一放学就跑来，从那个点开始一直和「Y」玩到深更半夜，不是眼睛快睁不开了绝不回去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Almost every day, X ran here after school and played with Y late into the night, not leaving until his eyes could barely stay open.

Desc.SourceString: 话说竟然能长达六年都没被大人发现，这也是要点本事的啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: You pulled that off for six years without getting caught? Takes some real skills.

Desc.SourceString: 本来那房间就常年锁着没人管，开了进去之后再锁起来而已。
Desc.LocalizedString: The room was locked up and forgotten anyway. All I did was unlock it, enter, and lock it back up.

Desc.SourceString: 小小年纪连开锁都学会了，还真是一早就挖空心思要往没人的地方钻啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: You learned to pick locks at that age too. You really were dead set on holing up in a place with absolutely no one else.

Desc.SourceString: 「Y」不管什么时候去都是那样，从未离开过那台电脑，「X」好奇过它到底是个怎样的人，但没有刨根问底的打算。
Desc.LocalizedString: When X visited, Y was always the same, still there in the computer, never having left. X was curious who Y used to be, but never asked.

Desc.SourceString: 是不是以前发生过什么事，要躲起来逃避什么……「Y」不说，就算啦，不知道那些又不影响一起玩。
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe something happened, maybe Y was hiding… But if Y didn't say anything about it, then whatever! What mattered was that they had fun together!

Desc.SourceString: 「X」耐不下性子，玩游戏的时候也偏爱爽快、有打击感的动作类玩法，那时候特别讨厌慢悠悠的解谜要素……
Desc.LocalizedString: X didn't have any patience. He liked simple games with lots of action, and at that time, he hated slow, puzzle-solving games…

Desc.SourceString: 现在也讨厌。
Desc.LocalizedString: I still hate them.

Desc.SourceString: ……至少现在，就算是穷举法也愿意用上，有耐心来多少拆多少了啊。看这一大片的存储载体被刷啦啦破解完，有觉得解压了一点不？
Desc.LocalizedString: …At least now you use the brute-force method to solve them as you go. Doesn't it feel great hacking into these storage media one by one?

Desc.SourceString: 这么为人着想不如直接给我亮答案？说得好像对你这种东西还有穷举以外的方法一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: Why don't you just tell me how to hack this if you're so considerate? As if I had a choice other than brute-forcing.

Desc.SourceString: 「XY」一起，即使玩小体量游戏，也能存下成百上千小时的成就和记录！
Desc.LocalizedString: When X and Y were together, they could rack up countless achievements and records even for small games.

Desc.SourceString: 都要归功于「Y」在电子世界的神奇力量！图方便跳关开门什么的，只是基础用法。
