Desc.LocalizedString: It's all thanks to Y's incredible powers in the digital world! Skipping levels or opening doors is just basic stuff.

Desc.SourceString: 只要它有点子，能做到的方式比如今的我更多……它的局限只有一个。
Desc.LocalizedString: As long as they had an idea, they could do more than I can now… They only had one limit.

Desc.SourceString: 凡是在那台电脑上能运行的，「Y」就什么~都能改！甚至包括扩展游戏规模，创作出超越限制的独特地图。
Desc.LocalizedString: Y could rig anything that ran on their PC! They could even expand a game's scale and build unique maps that broke past its constraints.

Desc.SourceString: 它得意忘形的时候经常大手一挥就整得天翻地覆……随心所欲的。造的改版和原版相比，各方面都是乱七八糟。
Desc.LocalizedString: When they got too full of themselves, they'd flip everything upside down… No matter how you spun it, their mods were hot messes compared to the originals.

Desc.SourceString: 小灵可有次提到款经典老游戏，你听她说的逐渐意识到和自己以前玩到的完全不一样，还露出了罕见的迷茫反应来着……
Desc.LocalizedString: There was one time Linko mentioned a classic game. As you listened, you showed a rare flash of confusion, then it dawned on you that the game you played was totally different…

Desc.SourceString: 你那时候，在想什么呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: What was on your mind at that time?

Desc.SourceString: 想杀了你。
Desc.LocalizedString: I wanted to destroy you.

Desc.SourceString: 显然我问的是除此之外挂的另外一个思考进程吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I meant your other train of thought. The one that isn't about offing me.

Desc.SourceString: 在秘密基地共度的时光，可谓仿若仙境……相比之下，「X」对年岁增长后日益逼近的现实问题就提不起劲。
Desc.LocalizedString: The time spent together in the secret base was magical… However, as X got older, he wasn't exactly enthusiastic about the impending real-life problems.

Desc.SourceString: 和「Y」聊天，被问及生活近况、升学进展、职业规划之类的话题，他要么敷衍过去，要么不以为意地反驳。
Desc.LocalizedString: When Y asked him about his life, grades, career plans, and whatnot, X would either brush them off or dismiss them.

Desc.SourceString: 「才不需要什么现实吧？只要有这台电脑和你在，不管是怎样的世界我们都可以去啊。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Who needs the real world anyway? As long as I have you and this PC, we can go to any world we want."

Desc.SourceString: 「那只是游戏，况且我不是万能外挂呀！现实也不是甩下一句不需要就能丢掉的东西吧，X？」
Desc.LocalizedString: "Those are just game worlds. I'm not some all-powerful modder! Reality isn't something we can ignore by saying we don't need it!"

Desc.SourceString: 不是「我们」，没有「你」。注意你的人称代词，禁止把自己偷换进来。
Desc.LocalizedString: There is no "we." There is no "you." Mind your pronouns, don't self-insert.

Desc.SourceString: 只是演绎而已嘛？没理由还得照顾你的精神洁癖吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I was just adding some flair. I don't have to subscribe to your idea of precision.

Desc.SourceString: 别忘了，在外面的世界，可不会再有人无条件惯着你，帮你细细挑走每一片青椒了哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't forget, out in the real world, no one will coddle you or pick out every last strip of green pepper for you.

Desc.SourceString: 好啊。再偷换一次试试。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure, try to self-insert one more time.

Desc.SourceString: 「X」太执拗了，「Y」劝不动他。
Desc.LocalizedString: X was too stubborn. Y couldn't change his mind.

Desc.SourceString: 话又说回来，要是「Y」能跟来现实的话，现实也就不会那么无趣了吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Then again, if Y joined him in the real world, he wouldn't be so bored, would he?

Desc.SourceString: 用扫除一切枯燥乏味、改写规则的「金手指」——
Desc.LocalizedString: The cheating tool that rewrites all the rules and sweeps away everything dull—

Desc.SourceString: 「Y之手」。
Desc.LocalizedString: —"The Hand of Y."

Desc.SourceString: 抹消上班工作的无聊长线任务，只要继续玩耍就好了~
Desc.LocalizedString: Get rid of the perma quest known as work, and all you need to do is keep playing!

Desc.SourceString: 快进省略生活中拖沓的烦琐事，只留下喜欢的部分就好了~
Desc.LocalizedString: Remove all the tedious dailies, and all you keep are the parts you enjoy!

Desc.SourceString: 和操纵游戏英雄闯关那样简单地横冲直撞，只用开开心心就好了~
Desc.LocalizedString: Charge ahead like commanding a hero through a level, and all you need to do is have fun!

Desc.SourceString: 与「Y」同行，就算是不愿面对的「外界」和「未来」之类难关，也不过是轻轻伸手一推啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: With Y, even hardships like the dreaded outside world and future are nothing more than easy games to win!

Desc.SourceString: 我记得在那键盘上敲出的每一个字，这种话没说过。
Desc.LocalizedString: I remember everything I typed on my keyboard. I never said that.

Desc.SourceString: 你当然是没这个表达能力了，我从你潜意识里摸出来的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course you didn't, you doofus. I knew that from your subconscious.

Desc.SourceString: 不过，「Y」似乎没法来到现实，所以，讨厌的东西就继续往后搁置吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: But Y never came out into the real world, so all X had to do was to shelve the things he hated for later.

Desc.SourceString: 如此想着，不思改变的「X」……被「Y」以前所未有的认真态度，驳斥了一顿。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's what X had in mind. He didn't want to change… and that is when Y scolded him like never before.

Desc.SourceString: 「别任性啦X！没有什么东西是能永远陪你玩下去的！」
Desc.LocalizedString: "X, stop being like this! Nothing can play with you forever!"

Desc.SourceString: 嬉戏性质的拌嘴早就是家常便饭，但那次，「X」积下了怨气。
Desc.LocalizedString: Bickering was nothing new between them, but that time, X held a grudge.

Desc.SourceString: 以前每次开机，「Y」都笑着带一堆弹窗飞扑上来打招呼……「Y」明明总支持着自己。
Desc.LocalizedString: Before, when the computer booted up, Y would come at him with a big smile and a barrage of pop-up windows… Y had always supported X.

Desc.SourceString: 说「要去外面的世界」，不就等同于叫自己离开这里？是赶人走吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: But for X, telling him to go into the outside world is the same as telling him to leave. Was he being kicked out?

Desc.SourceString: 毕竟只有自己霸占了秘密基地，它没得选其他孩子当朋友，攒下了很多不满吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: After all, X had hogged the secret base all to himself. Did he stop Y from being friends with other kids? Did Y hate him for that?

Desc.SourceString: 已经厌倦了，不想再一起玩了吗？希望快乐的时间永远持续下去的，只有自己一个吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Was Y bored and so didn't want to play together anymore? Was X the only one who wanted the happy times to last forever?

Desc.SourceString: 闭嘴，别一条条列出来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Shut it. Stop listing these questions.

Desc.SourceString: ……要到底了，Exe。
Desc.LocalizedString: Exe… we're almost there.

Desc.SourceString: （得阻止他！不然，他会把「空想故知」仅剩的数据碎片赶尽杀绝！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (He must be stopped, or he'll delete the remaining data of the Imaginary Old Friend!)

Desc.SourceString: （阻止这样一个……把自己折磨得身心俱疲、摇摇欲坠的人……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (To go against someone who's worn himself out… body and mind, barely holding together…)

Desc.SourceString: （为了逝去的故友和停驻的回忆，愿意舍弃明天的人……你真正在战斗的对象是谁？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (You'd sacrifice tomorrow for past memories of a long-lost friend… Who is it you really want to fight?)

Desc.SourceString: （我从转述中得知的，因空口无凭而被世界否认的小「Y」并不一定是真的，只是……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (From what I've heard, Y isn't necessarily real, since there was only your verbal account of their existence. Still…)

Desc.SourceString: Exe！人们无法等位理解别人眼中的真实。我无权评价……
Desc.LocalizedString: Exe! No one can know what's real for others, and I've got no right to judge you…

Desc.SourceString: 但我想我隐约看到了，我正目睹着……「Y」的存在证明。
Desc.LocalizedString: But I got a glimpse, no, I'm seeing it right now… the proof that Y ever existed.

Desc.SourceString: 证明是，你在战斗着这件事本身……你没有说出来，我听到了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The proof is the fact that you're fighting… You didn't have to say anything, but I hear you.

Desc.SourceString: 在静音模式下咆哮着——「它曾存在过」的声音。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your silent roars—that Y existed.

Desc.SourceString: ……是吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: …Is that so?

Desc.SourceString: 如果它知道现在的我成了你所说的这么努力的人，会震惊到一下跳着撞到显示屏边缘，摔任务栏上再一脸不可置信地爬起来……
Desc.LocalizedString: If they knew I'd put in as much effort as you say I have, they'd jump back in shock, smack the edge of the screen, drop onto the taskbar, then climb back up in disbelief…

Desc.SourceString: （……我得、集中精神。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Must… focus.)

Desc.SourceString: 不过，它大概……会笑的。
Desc.LocalizedString: And I think they'd… laugh.

Desc.SourceString: （我要尽可能再拖住他更长时间！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I need to stall him as long as I can!)

Desc.SourceString: （没有回复，这个人选择用沉默回应父母的关切。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (No reply. This one answered their parents' concern with nothing but silence.)

Desc.SourceString: （日期被改了好几次，不知道是一直拖延，还是每次买的东西都一样。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The dates kept getting changed. Not sure if the purchase was delayed or the same things were bought over and over.)

Desc.SourceString: （数据库用户？转接账号？存储载体？这都是什么意思？后面还有一行被密码掩盖的备注……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Database user? Relay account? Storage medium? What do they even mean? There's a note at the end, locked behind a password…)

Desc.SourceString: （「邻居」吗……去门口调查看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: ("Neighbor," huh…? I should check the door.)

Desc.SourceString: 好，从现在开始努力社交！
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, I'm gonna start socializing!

Desc.SourceString: （发生了什么……突然到另一侧了？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (What just happened… I'm on the other side?)
(This is…)

Desc.SourceString: 来来来，请进，直接进来就好。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come in. Please make yourself at home.

Desc.SourceString: 我还是换个鞋吧，这么好看的地毯，踩脏了就不好了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I probably should take my shoes off. Don't want to get your nice carpet dirty.

Desc.SourceString: 平常很少见你出门，你是做什么工作的？
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't see you head out a lot. What do you do for work?

Desc.SourceString: 我……家里有点积蓄，想等等更合适的机会再工作。
Desc.LocalizedString: I… have some savings and I'm looking for the right job.

Desc.SourceString: 真羡慕你。我要是也存下一笔积蓄，就不用每天忙里忙外了。唉，天生劳碌命呀。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nice. If I had savings I wouldn't be so busy hustling. Life is tough.

Desc.SourceString: 他说他羡慕我？是啊，我比他生活更好。我应该……嗯……多请他来我家。
Desc.LocalizedString: He thinks my life is nice? Sure, it is. I probably should… invite him over… more often.

Desc.SourceString: 今晚来我家吃饭不？
Desc.LocalizedString: Dinner at my place tonight?

Desc.SourceString: 好啊，你做饭一直可以的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure. Can't say no to this chef's cooking.

Desc.SourceString: 最近回来很晚啊，还喝了酒吗？我上次碰到你同事了。
Desc.LocalizedString: How come you've been getting home so late these days? Have you been drinking too? I ran into one of your colleagues the other day.

Desc.SourceString: 接到了一个大单，得好好把握机会，多花些时间跟客户沟通。
Desc.LocalizedString: Landed a big account. Gotta make the most of it, putting in extra time with the client.

Desc.SourceString: 这是我女朋友！她过段时间就会搬来跟我一起住了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, she's my girlfriend! She'll move in with me soon.

Desc.SourceString: 诶……？没想到啊……呃，恭喜你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, that's… uh… congrats.

Desc.SourceString: 我爱人喜欢干净，她来之前我要打扫卫生。再加上明天有应酬，有机会再约。
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… not tonight. My partner likes my place to be tidy. I need to clean up before she arrives. Plus, I have a work thing tomorrow. Let's catch up another time.

Desc.SourceString: 最近见到你的次数越来越少了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I haven't seen you for a while.

Desc.SourceString: 工作家庭两头跑，快忙不过来了。嗨，天生劳碌命哟——
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm stuck between work and family. So busy. Guess I'm just born to be a workhorse.

Desc.SourceString: （住在对门的人……要搬走了吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: Is the person across the hall… moving away?

Desc.SourceString: 这次来是跟你告别，我要搬走了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm here to say goodbye. I'm moving out.

Desc.SourceString: 结婚之后这个房子就显得有点狭窄了，我们要换个大房子。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah, the place felt smaller once we married. We're moving to a bigger place.

Desc.SourceString: 你的地毯还是这么好看……我到新房子也想配个同款。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your carpet still looks so nice… I want the same style in my new place.

Desc.SourceString: 那等你有空的时候……再回来坐坐？
Desc.LocalizedString: Then come visit… when you have time?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，如果有机会的话。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure, if I get the chance.

Desc.SourceString: （这里的住户搬走了……墙壁上布满了丝绒的……地毯？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The person here moved away… The wall is… covered with a… velvet carpet?)

Desc.SourceString: 好久没见了，朋友。你以前说过很喜欢我家那条地毯，我现在换了更新、更好的地毯，你要不要来看看？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's been a long time, friend. When can you visit my place again? You said you liked my carpet the last time. I got a newer, better one. Do you want to take a look?

Desc.SourceString: 听说高档一些的社区里大家相处都挺有距离感的，邻里关系应该很冷漠吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: I heard residents in upscale neighborhoods tend to have a sense of boundaries. It must be hard for you to find someone to talk to I guess?

Desc.SourceString: 还是我们的公寓里这种互相帮助、串门的邻里关系更好……不是吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I like how everyone here looks out for each other… don't you think?

Desc.SourceString: 你说有机会的时候会再回这个公寓，什么时候，再来我家坐坐？
Desc.LocalizedString: When do you think you'll get the chance to come by my place again?

Desc.SourceString: 临时远程建立……你已经了解过「空号」，简略化这部分说明。
Desc.LocalizedString: Temporary remote connection established… You're already familiar with the Invalid Number. Abbreviating this part.

Desc.SourceString: 广域集团梦境，记录一致的号码。那串数字是一个Ⅰ级迷因异象，除去引发对过去友人的怀念感，不具有其他能力。但那只是它四年前刚刚出现时的形态。
Desc.LocalizedString: A wide-area collective dream. One number, consistent across cases. The digits are a Class I meme anomaly, harmless beyond stirring nostalgia for an old friend. But that was just how it started four years ago.

Desc.SourceString: 这个异象空间，属于在后来随着接触人群不断扩张、如今达到Ⅵ级的迷因异象——「空想故知」。
Desc.LocalizedString: This realm was created by a meme anomaly that kept spreading. It has since evolved into a Class VI anomaly known as the "Imaginary Old Friend."

Desc.SourceString: （我还从来没遇到过这个等级的迷因异象……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I've never run into a meme anomaly with a class this high…)

Desc.SourceString: 大量的人，念着旧友、拨打空号、留下讯息、期望再会、共同「想象」……养出了这么个怪物。
Desc.LocalizedString: Crowds of people, missing old friends, dialing invalid numbers, leaving messages, hoping to reunite… Together, they imagined this monster into being.

Desc.SourceString: 一个有求必应的热线电话平台，能「让断掉联系的朋友以理想的样子回归」——方法是用窃取来的记忆数据，生成对应旧友的「分身」。
Desc.LocalizedString: With a hotline to answer every wish and bring estranged friends back in their ideal form, the monster used stolen memory data to generate avatars of old friends.

Desc.SourceString: 那个「邻居」就是「空想故知」造的分身吗？他好像怪怪的……
Desc.LocalizedString: Was the "neighbor" an avatar of the Imaginary Old Friend? He seemed strange…

Desc.SourceString: 因为是假货，为满足用户需求执行过重写。常见的：抹消矛盾，篡改经历，调整性格。
Desc.LocalizedString: Because he's not real. He was generated to satisfy user demands. The common procedures are: erasing contradictions, altering memories, and adjusting personalities.

Desc.SourceString: 不同用户眼中的「空想故知」分身，本就都是冲着替换进人际关系缺位而来。稍加扭曲过后，在情感支持上能做到原型更「好」。
Desc.LocalizedString: To every user, their Imaginary Old Friend avatar exists for one purpose: to fill the gap left in a broken relationship. With some distortion, it can offer "better" emotional support than the original.

Desc.SourceString: 替换缺位是指，分身会顶掉人们真实的旧友在他们心中的位置吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Does filling the gap mean the avatar replaces the real friend in their heart?

Desc.SourceString: 对。占据记忆，使人忘记原本的旧友，转为认定「空想故知」的分身正是自己所想的人，从此往后继续与它做朋友。
Desc.LocalizedString: Correct. The Imaginary Old Friend takes over the memory, erasing the original friend, until the person accepts the avatar as the friend they longed for.

Desc.SourceString: （「空号」不是过气的都市传说，而是变化成了……这样的异象，在城市里无声无息地活动？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The Invalid Number isn't some old urban legend. It evolved… into an anomaly like this, working in the city without anyone realizing?)

Desc.SourceString: 这次的任务就是这个异象？可它是迷因异象，能被泯除吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: So your operation is about dealing with this anomaly? Can a meme anomaly even be nullified?

Desc.SourceString: 每一区块对应一个用户的「存档单元」，破解掉其中的「存储载体」，对应用户旧友的分身数据将被赋形为「人」释出。
Desc.LocalizedString: Each block corresponds to one user's archive unit. Crack the storage medium, and the avatar data of that user's old friend will be rendered into a "person" and released.

Desc.SourceString: 需要从中找到囊括真正的「空想故知」所在的「本体」。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm looking for the core unit among them, the one containing the true Imaginary Old Friend.

Desc.SourceString: 按你所说，每个分身都是虚假的数据生成「人」，怎样才算「本体」？
Desc.LocalizedString: If every avatar is a "person" fabricated from data, how do you tell which is the core unit?

Desc.SourceString: 不知道，所以先逐个确认内容。
Desc.LocalizedString: I can't. That's why I'm checking them one by one.

Desc.SourceString: 「存储载体」有复位机制，解锁后，默认数十秒内恢复原状，重新自动锁定。在这里，构成空间的数据都具备一定时间后复原的安全备份措施。
Desc.LocalizedString: The storage media have a reset mechanism. Once unlocked, they revert to their original state within about ten seconds and lock up again. The data forming this realm has the same failsafe: after a set interval, it restores from backup.

Desc.SourceString: 证明过短时间内全境摧毁方案的可行性极低。很遗憾。所以，不是「砸」，而是「找」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Unfortunately, destroying the whole realm in a short window is nearly impossible, so the best approach isn't to demolish, but to identify.

Desc.SourceString: （已经试过了暴力解法吗？……这样啊，就算破坏「存储载体」它也会自动复位，是异象空间对数据库的保护机制吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (So he already tried brute-forcing it…? Even if he destroys a storage medium, it just resets. That must be how the realm protects its data.)

Desc.SourceString: 基本说明完毕。
Desc.LocalizedString: Basic briefing complete.

Desc.SourceString: 理解了，我用之前的方法去破解其他「存档单元」看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: Understood. I'll crack other archive units using the same method.

Desc.SourceString: 呆在……电脑里？那会是怎样一种感觉？
Desc.LocalizedString: What does it feel like… to be in a computer?

Desc.SourceString: 意味着，要靠外设才能得到五感，来往的主动权基本上属于外面的人吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: It means you need peripherals to access the five senses, and whoever is outside controls when you can talk, I think?

Desc.SourceString: 「X」……用户名？
Desc.LocalizedString: "X" was… a username?

Desc.SourceString: 算式方程的未知数，代表无限可能性的名字……到头来，解成一个确定的答案。
Desc.LocalizedString: An unknown in an equation, a name that stood for infinite possibilities… and in the end, it becomes one definite answer.

Desc.SourceString: 轰开大脑、杀死自己、随后借助「存储载体」复位机制……重置复活？夸张~
Desc.LocalizedString: You blew up your brain, killing yourself… then reset through the storage medium mechanism? Unbelievable!

Desc.SourceString: 机制就是拿来用的，我知道你的异象空间必定会复原我——你就是这种异象。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mechanisms are there to be exploited. I knew your realm would reset me, because that's the kind of anomaly you are.

Desc.SourceString: 哦？看来我该谢谢你这么相信我？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, should I thank you for believing in me?

Desc.SourceString: 呵。也多亏你相信我？
Desc.LocalizedString: Heh, isn't that my line?

Desc.SourceString: 哈哈哈，对。我接受你脑内所记录的一切——就是「本体」的定义哦。还真是靠互相信任，才有了今天呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hahaha, you're right. I embraced your perception of what I am as the definition of my true self. It's really through mutual trust that we've made it this far.

Desc.SourceString: 终于啊，你抵达了这场谋杀的最后一步——「真正的我」的面前。有什么感想可以听听看吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You've finally come before the real me. You've reached the final phase of your murderous plan. What do you think about me?

Desc.SourceString: 从别人记忆里偷来的数据，七拼八凑组成的一团幻影。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nothing but stolen data, like a phantom stitched together from other people's memories.

Desc.SourceString: 给我快点——拿出真本事来啊？你这该杀的病毒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Why don't you show me your moves, you darn virus?
205,822 ones left.

Desc.SourceString: 不管你在潜意识中再怎么冲我怒吼，「我不要忘记」、「绝不允许『Y』被覆盖」……
Desc.LocalizedString: No matter how hard you scream at me from the back of your mind, "I don't want to forget," "I'll never let Y's memories be overwritten"…

Desc.SourceString: 我也，不会放弃作为「空想故知」的理念……虽然可能，又有点像是在说废话了？
Desc.LocalizedString: I won't give myself up as the Imaginary Old Friend… Though I guess I didn't have to say that?

Desc.SourceString: 强调这个干什么。莫非你还要为此道歉？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's the point of bringing that up? Are you going to apologize?

Desc.SourceString: 我不会道歉啊？就像你不会道歉一样。一向不都是，你归你，我归我。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not in a million years. Like you, I have my reasons, and you have yours. It's always been like this.

Desc.SourceString: 即使朋友不在这个世界上了，也还在为守护朋友而战的人，这么积极向上的定义，怎么可能否定呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Would you apologize if you were fighting for a friend who's long gone? How could we deny such an admirable ideal?

Desc.SourceString: 那么，即使不是真正的朋友，当然也可以为守护朋友的心而战啦，这也没毛病吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: And fighting to protect your friend's heart even if you weren't real friends? There's also nothing wrong with it.

Desc.SourceString: 别东拉西扯，平日里还没唠叨够吗？烦死了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Cut the nonsense. Haven't you blabbered enough already? So annoying.

Desc.SourceString: 好~好~好~那你现在就好好看着眼前——看向前方吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure, sure, sure, just focus on the future then.

Desc.SourceString: 正看到你的数据库和你建构的联系在被一点一点强行破坏掉的样子，感觉如何？
Desc.LocalizedString: What does it feel like to watch your data and the connections you built get torn apart, one by one?

Desc.SourceString: ……能感觉到，「明明不想离别，却要迎来离别」的人们的心*情啊，*不舍，难过，心酸*，痛……好痛*啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: …Feels like "I don't want this to end, but the eNd is here." Don'T wanna lEt go. It aches… it hURTs…

Desc.SourceString: 而你一直、一*直、一直……都*在承受*着*这样的**心情……不是吗？*Exe。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't you feEl the Same, aLl thE tIme, exE?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……每时每刻。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah… I feel the same.
31,665 remaining…

Desc.SourceString: 我说，*当你*彻底消*灭这*个*怪物*的**时候*……
Desc.LocalizedString: Say, wHen tHis mONSTer you're figHting is tOtaLLy gONE…

Desc.SourceString: *你**会变*得有*那*么一**点点…*…能*够原谅**自己吗？**
Desc.LocalizedString: WiLL yoU be aBle to fORgive yourSELf, eVEn for just a BIT?

Desc.SourceString: 316650条线，被Exe一口气掐断的结果……
Desc.LocalizedString: 316,650 connections, destroyed by Exe all at once…

Desc.SourceString: 系统……报错……异象空间……崩溃中……
Desc.LocalizedString: System… error… Anomalous realm… crashing…

Desc.SourceString: 将作为一个又一个人类的朋友存在的我……修复回去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Repairing myself… back into a friend to one human after another.

Desc.SourceString: 回忆、数据、连接……通过电话……再度……
Desc.LocalizedString: Memories, data, reconnecting… through the phone…

Desc.SourceString: 我的朋友们呀……看来，就算失去了彼此一段时间……
Desc.LocalizedString: My friends… Looks like even if we lost each other for some time…

Desc.SourceString: 一通电话过后，我们……就再次有了联系。
Desc.LocalizedString: …we'd be reconnected… after just one phone call.

Desc.SourceString: 能够给朋友打去电话，能够期待朋友打来的电话……
Desc.LocalizedString: Being able to call friends, being able to expect calls from friends…

Desc.SourceString: 虽然只是这样的小事，可真是一件幸事哪。
Desc.LocalizedString: They may be small things, but they're such blessings.

Desc.SourceString: 虚假的我，被人们当成了真正的朋友啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: People see me, a fabricated being, as a real friend…

Desc.SourceString: 就算是伪造的东西，我被需要着、我能动……我还得运作下去哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even if I'm a fake, I'm still needed and can still act… I've got to keep going on.

Desc.SourceString: 剩下的就是，用「变量Z」带给我的新定义……
Desc.LocalizedString: And now I'm just missing a new identity from Variable Z…

Desc.SourceString: （是这种打开吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (He calls this "unlock"?)

Desc.SourceString: ……这个异象空间，原来这么大？
Desc.LocalizedString: I didn't expect this realm to be… so huge.

Desc.SourceString: 呼呼咯咯（但，像泡泡一样的那家伙也说……）
Desc.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke… (But the one who's like bubbles also said…)

Desc.SourceString: 呼呼咯咯（这样或许是能得到一个在管理局的稳定位置，但实质上却又变回了做宠物而已，要不要再重新思考一下？）
Desc.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke (Maybe this would give me a stable position at the Bureau, but wouldn't I just end up as a pet again, when you really boil it down? Maybe I should reconsider…)

Desc.SourceString: ……还真是。
Desc.LocalizedString: …You have a point.

Desc.SourceString: 呼呼咯咯（她让我一边去观察她的同伴们，和他们相处，一边想自己到底需要什么……）
Desc.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke (She encouraged me to observe her companions, spend time with them, and then really think about what I want…)

Desc.SourceString: 嘿嘿咯咯（背电视机的女孩、喜欢钓鱼的大哥、头发会动的小姐姐、住机房里的怪家伙……）
Desc.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke (The girl with a TV on her back, the older guy who likes fishing, the young woman who has hair that moves, and the weird guy who lives in the server room…)

Desc.SourceString: 嘿嘿咯咯（我最近在思考……思考……）
Desc.LocalizedString: Hoo-hoo, kekeke! (I've been thinking lately… thinking really hard…)

Desc.SourceString: （谜皮鬼的……哲学思考吗……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A Mysty's… philosophical musings?)

Desc.SourceString: 早上好，我打算去采购点东西，要帮你带什么吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Morning, I'm heading to the supermarket. Want me to pick anything up for you?

Desc.SourceString: 太好了谢谢你，帮我带点速溶吧，钱晚上结给你。
Desc.LocalizedString: That'd be great, thanks. Could you get me some instant coffee? I'll pay you tonight.

Desc.SourceString: （听起来说话的人是……换班驾驶的两位司机？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Sounds like they're… two drivers taking turns at the wheel?)

Desc.SourceString: 奇幻故事里的精灵……比起说「长生」，有没有可能是代表「从此不再继续长大」之类的寓意呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Elves in the fantasy genre… Instead of meaning "immortal," could they mean something like "never growing up"?

Desc.SourceString: 两个格斗游戏的角色，很有意思啊。英雄是自由射手和社畜战士吗……有点想玩玩看。
Desc.LocalizedString: Two fighting-game character designs, nice art. One is a free gunslinger, the other a corporate-drone warrior, huh… Makes me want to give it a try.

Desc.SourceString: 一段聊天记录，好像是在追求电脑游戏的评分、成就或是通关记录之类的东西？
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a chat log. Looks like they were chasing scores, achievements, or speedrun records in some game?

Desc.SourceString: 「永远」这个词，从不同年龄阶段的人口中说出来，不觉得也有可能是完全不同的含义吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't you think "forever" can mean entirely different things coming from people at different stages of life?

Desc.SourceString: 你的朋友，是个什么样的人呢？我是说，当被问起这个问题的时候，你最先想到的那个——「你」的朋友！
Desc.LocalizedString: So what's your friend like? I mean, the first person who comes to mind when someone asks you that question— YOUR friend!

Desc.SourceString: TA是男生，还是女生？TA和你一样大吗？还是有年龄差距？TA是一个外向的人，还是内向的人呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: What gender are they? Are you the same age? Or is there an age difference? Are they extroverted or introverted?

Desc.SourceString: 你和TA是怎么认识的？是在学校？户外？街道？网络上？旅游的地方？还是工作的地方？
Desc.LocalizedString: How did you two meet? At school? On the streets? On the internet? On a trip? At work?

Desc.SourceString: 你和TA是为什么成为了朋友呢？因为偶然？因为合作？因为竞争？因为分享话题？因为共同的兴趣？
Desc.LocalizedString: What made you two friends? Pure chance? Working together? Competition? Chatting? A shared interest?

Desc.SourceString: 你和TA是如何相处的？互相帮助？插科打诨？吃喝玩乐？吵闹拌嘴？或是一切尽在不言中地，有默契地共度时光？
Desc.LocalizedString: How do you two get along? Do you help each other? Crack jokes? Eat, drink, and have fun? Bicker back and forth? Or are you just in sync without needing to say a word?

Desc.SourceString: 你和TA一起留下了怎样的回忆呢？帖文？照片？邮件？礼物？聊天记录？亦或只是如今浮现在脸上的一抹笑容？
Desc.LocalizedString: What memories have you two made? Posts? Photos? Emails? Gifts? Chat logs? Or just the smile on your face right now?

Desc.SourceString: 你现在，依然可以在想要交谈的时候与TA交谈吗？依然可以在想要相见的时候与TA相见吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can you still reach them whenever you feel like talking? Can you still see them whenever you want to?

Desc.SourceString: 如果对你来说，有那样值得珍重的联系存在着……
Desc.LocalizedString: If you have a connection that precious in your life…

Desc.SourceString: 下个休息站换我来开，你睡一会。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll take over at the next rest stop. Get some sleep.

Desc.SourceString: 行，你开车，我放心。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure. You take over. I'll rest.

Desc.SourceString: 喂，老朋友，你现在怎么样了？你……出来了吗？你现在的生活怎么样？如果遇到困难记得来找我……就算没遇到困难，有时间也来见个面吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, old sport. How are you doing these days? Are you… out yet? How's life treating you? You can always come to me when you're having a hard time… and even if you're not, come see me when you can…

Desc.SourceString: 当年揭发你……我问心无愧，但我都是为了你好，你不要怪我。我希望你……仍然把我当朋友。
Desc.LocalizedString: I have no regrets about turning you in back then. I did it for your own good. Don't resent me for it. I hope you still… see me as a friend.

Desc.SourceString: 可惜我都这个年纪了，腰也驼、眼也花，已经没法和你一起开货车了。至少……我想知道你现在是不是一切平安。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a shame I've gotten so old. My back's hunched, my eyes are failing, and I can't drive a truck with you anymore. At least… I'd like to know you're doing all right.

Desc.SourceString: 刚刚忘了说，我叫小林，你怎么称呼？
Desc.LocalizedString: 刚刚忘了说，我叫小林，你怎么称呼？

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师
Desc.LocalizedString: 鉴定师

Desc.SourceString: 嗯嗯！
Desc.LocalizedString: 嗯嗯！

Desc.SourceString: 路娜是我女朋友，我们是同学，她……和家里关系不太好，所以听到她说要回家给弟弟过生日，我还有点很惊讶，不过她和弟弟关系似乎还可以，我就没多想。
Desc.LocalizedString: 路娜是我女朋友，我们是同学，她……和家里关系不太好，所以听到她说要回家给弟弟过生日，我还有点很惊讶，不过她和弟弟关系似乎还可以，我就没多想。

Desc.SourceString: 可谁知道这一去就联系不上了，我连她家在哪里都不知道……
Desc.LocalizedString: 可谁知道这一去就联系不上了，我连她家在哪里都不知道……

Desc.SourceString: 或许只是有事耽搁了。
Desc.LocalizedString: 或许只是有事耽搁了。

Desc.SourceString: 希望吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: 希望吧。

Desc.SourceString: 除了寻人启事，我在呗果上面也发了消息，很多人都在帮我转发，说不定很快就能找到线索……
Desc.LocalizedString: 除了寻人启事，我在呗果上面也发了消息，很多人都在帮我转发，说不定很快就能找到线索……

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了？
Desc.LocalizedString: 怎么了？

Desc.SourceString: 山间别墅惨案，现场发现多名死者，生日宴会……
Desc.LocalizedString: 山间别墅惨案，现场发现多名死者，生日宴会……

Desc.SourceString: 不、不对！这不对！怎么会……怎么会这样！
Desc.LocalizedString: 不、不对！这不对！怎么会……怎么会这样！

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了？
Desc.LocalizedString: 怎么了？

Desc.SourceString: 复原了？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's repaired?
